text.body: <1> <1-1-1> <1-1-2> <1-1-3> ūd‌rdhvabaddhajaṭājūṭakroḍakroḍatsurāpagam| namāmi yāminīkāntakāntabhālasthalaṃ haram || 1 || yābhyāṃ vaiśeṣike tantre samyag vyutpādito'smyaham| kaṇādabhavanāthābhyāṃ tābhyāṃ mama namaḥ sadā || 2 || sūtramātrāvalambena nirālambe'pi gacchataḥ| khe khelavanmamāpyatra sāhasaṃ siddhimeṣyati || 3 || tāpatrayaparāhatā vivekinastāpatrayanivṛttinidānamanusandadhānā nānāśrutismṛtītihāsapurāṇeṣvātmatattvasākṣātkārameva tadupāyamākalayāmbabhūvuḥ| tatprāptihetumapi panthānaṃ jijñāsamānāḥ paramakāruṇikaṃ kaṇādaṃ munimupaseduratha kaṇādo munistattvajñānavairāgyaiśvaryasampannaḥ ṣaṇṇāṃ padārthānāṃ sādharmyavaidharmyābhyāṃ tattvajñānamevātmatattvasākṣātkāraprāptaye paramaḥ panthā iti manasi kṛtvā tacca nivṛttilakṣaṇāddharmādeteṣamanāyāsena setsyatīti lakṣaṇataḥ svarūpataśca dharmameva prathamamupadiśāmyanantaraṃ ṣaḍapi padārthānuddeśalakṣaṇaparūkṣābhirupadekṣyāmīti hṛdi nidhāya teṣāmavadhānāya pratijānīte -- athāto dharmaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ || 1 || atheti śiṣyākāṅkṣānantaryamāha| ata iti| yataḥ śravaṇādipaṭavo'nasūyakāścāntevāsina upasedurityarthaḥ| yadvā athaśabdo maṅgalārthaḥ| taduktam -- "oṅkāraścāthaśabdaśca dvāvetau brahmaṇaḥ purā| kaṇṭhaṃ bhittvā viniryātau tena māṅgalikāvubhau" ||iti|| yuktañcaitat| kathamanyathā sadācāraparamparāpariprāptakartavyatākasya maṅgalasya vaiśeṣikaśāstraṃ praṇayato mahāmuneranācaraṇaṃ sambhāvyate| na ca kṛtamaṅgalasyāpi phalādarśanādakṛtamaṅgalasyāpi phaladarśanādananuṣṭhānaṃ na hi niṣphale prekṣāvān pravartata iti vācyam akaraṇasthale janmāntarīyasya karaṇasthale cāṅgavaiguṇyasya kalpanayā saphalatvaniścayāt| na hi śiṣṭācārānumitaśrutibodhitakartavyatākasyāpātataḥ phalādarśanamātreṇākāraṇatvaśaṅkāpi| na caihikamātraphalakatvānna janmāntarīyānumānaṃ putreṣṭivadaihikaphalakatvānupapatteḥ| kārīryādau tu tathā kāmanayaivānuṣṭhānādaihikamātraphalakatvam| atra ca samāptikāmo'dhikārī svargakāma iva yāge tatrāpūrvaṃ dvāramiha tu vighnadhvaṃsa iti viśeṣaḥ nirvighnamārabdhaṃ samāpyatāmiti kāmanayā pravṛtteḥ| na ca vighnadhvaṃsamātraṃ phalaṃ samāptistu svakāraṇādeveti vācyam, tasya svato'puruṣarthatvāt samāptestu sukhasādhanatayā puruṣārthatvāt upasthitatvācca| kiñca duritadhvaṃsamātraṃ na phalaṃ tasya prāyaścittakīrta nakarmmanāśāpāragamanādisādhyatayā vyabhicārāt| prārabdhaparisamāptipratibandhakaduritadhvaṃsatvena phalatve samāptereva phalatvocitatvāt| tatrāpi ca haraṇyadānaprayāgasnānādijanyatvena vyabhicārāt teṣāpi maṅgalatvābhidhānaṃ sāhasam| kiñca maṅgale sati samāpterāvaśyakatvamityevaṃ maṅgalasya kāraṇatā| taduktam "śrautāt sāṅgāt karmmaṇaḥ phalāvaśyambhāvaniyamāt" iti| ata eva vikalpitamapi kāraṇaṃ kāraṇameva phalānantaryyaniyamasyave vaidikakāraṇatvāt| vikalpe tu vaijātyakalpanaṃ vaijātyameva yatrānvayavyatirekagamyā kāraṇatā tatra phalapūrvabhāvaniyamo grāhyo na tu vede'pi tatra vyatirekabhāgasya gurutvenānupasthiteḥ tathā ca sāṅge maṅgale samāptirāvaśyakīti na vyabhicāraḥ| samāptistu yasmin anuṣṭhite sampūrṇamidaṃ karmmeti pramā sā ca granthādau caramavākyalikhane yāgādau caramāhutau paṭādāvantyatantusaṃyoge grāmagamanādau grāmacaraṇacaramasaṃyoge evaṃ tatra tatrohanīyamiti| maṅgalajanyasamāptau vaijātyakalpane'pi nobhayathā vyabhicāraḥ| maṃgalañca vighnadhvaṃsadvārakasamaptiphalakaṃ karmma tacca devatānamaskārādirūpameva svataḥsiddhavighnābhāvasthale'pi sāmānyato gṛhītasya vighnadhvaṃsadvārakatvasyānapāyāt namaskārādīnāṃ tādrūpyeṇaiva vighnadhvaṃsa dvārakatvapratipatternāvyāptiriti dik || 1 || atha pratijñātārthamāha -- yato'bhyudayaniśreḥyasasiddhiḥ sa dharmmaḥ || 2 || abhyudayastattvajñānaṃ niḥśreyasamātyantikī duḥkhanivṛttiḥ tadubhayaṃ yataḥ sa dharmmaḥ| abhyudayadvārakaṃ niḥśreyasamiti madhyamapadalopī samāsaḥ, pañcamītatpuruṣo vā| sa ca dharmmo nivṛttilakṣaṇo vakṣyate| yadi tu nididhyāsanādiyogasādhyo dharmmo'dṛṣṭameva tadā vidhirūpaḥ| vṛttikṛtastu abyadayaḥ sukhaṃ niḥśreyasame kakālīnasakalātmaviśeṣaguṇadhvaṃsaḥ| pramāṇañca dharmme devadattaśarīrādikaṃ bhoktṛviśeṣaguṇapreritabhūtapūrvakaṃ kāryatve sati tadbhogasādhanatvāttannirmmitasragvadityāhuḥ| tadetad‌vyākhyānaṃ pratyekasamudāyābhyāṃ na vyāpakam ityarvā cīnairupekṣitam| vastutastu ko dharmmaḥ kiṃlakṣaṇaśceti sāmānyataḥ śiṣyajijñāsāyāṃ yato'bhyudayaniḥśreyasasiddhirityupatiṣṭhate tathā ca yato'bhyudayasiddhiryataśca niḥśreyasasiddhistadubhayaṃ dharmmaḥ| evaṃ puruṣārthāsādhāraṇakāraṇaṃ dharmma iti vaktavye parabhapuruṣārthayoḥ sukhaduḥkhābhāvayorviśeṣataḥ paricayārthamabhyudayaniḥśreyasasiddhirityuktaṃ svargāpavargayorevānyecchānadhīnecchāviyatvena paramapuruṣārthatvāt| sādhayiṣyate ca duḥkhābhāvasyāpi puruṣārthatvam || 2 || nanu nivṛttilakṣaṇo dharmmastattvajñānadvārā niḥśreyasaheturityatra śrutiḥ pramāṇam| śrutereva prāmāṇye vayaṃ vipratipadyāmahe anṛtavyāghātapunaruktadoṣebhyaḥ| putreṣṭau kṛtāyāmapi putrānutpādādanṛtatvam "udite juhoti anudite juhoti samayādhyuṣite juhoti" iti vidheḥ prāpta evoditādikāle homo vyāhanyate "śyāvo'syāhutimabhyavaharati ya udite juhoti śavalo'syāhutimabhyavaharati yo'nudite juhoti śyāvaśavalāvasyāhutimabhyavaharato yaḥ samayādhyuṣite juhoti" ityādinā| tathā "triḥ prathamāmanvāha triruttamāmanvāha" ityanena prathamottamasāmidhenyostriruccāraṇābhidhānāt paunaruktyameva| na cāmnāyapratipādakaṃ kiñcidasti nityatve vipratipattau nityanirdoṣatvamapi sandigdham pauruṣeyatve tu bhramapramādavipratipattikaraṇāpāṭavādisambhāvanayā āptoktatvamapi sandigdhameveti na niḥśreyasaṃ na vā tatra tattvajñānaṃ dvāraṃ na vā dharmma iti sarvametadākulamata āha -- tadvacanādāmnāyasya prāmāṇyam || 3 || tadityanupakrāntamapi prasiddhisiddhatayeśvaraṃ parāmṛśati, yathā "tadaprāmāṇyamanṛtavyāghātapunaruktadoṣebhyaḥ" iti gautamīyasūtre tacchabdenānupakrānto'pi vedaḥ parāmṛśyate| tathā ca tadvacanātteneśvareṇa praṇayanādāmnāyasya vedasya prāmāṇyam| yadvā taditi sannihitaṃ dharmameva parāmṛśati tathāca dharmasya vacanāt pratipādanāt āmnāyasya vedasya prāmāṇyam, yaddhi vākyaṃ prāmāṇikamarthaṃ pratipādayati tatpramāṇameva yata ityarthaḥ| īśvarastadāptatvañca sādhayiṣyate| yaccoktam‌ -- "anṛtavyāghātapunaruktadoṣebhyaḥ" iti tatrānṛtatve janmāntarīyaphalakalpanam, karmakartṛsādhanavaiguṇyakalpanaṃ vā, śrautāt sāṅgāt karmaṇaḥ phalāvaśyambhāvaniścayāt| na ca kārīrīvadaihikamātraphalakatvam tatra hi śuṣyacchasyasañjīvanakāmasyādhikāraḥ putreṣṭau putramātrakāmasyeti viśeṣāt| na ca vyāghāto'pi uditādihomaṃ viśeṣataḥ pratijñāya tadanyakāle homānuṣṭhān "śyāvo'syāhutimabhyavaharati" ityādinindāpratipādanāt| naca punaruktatādoṣo'pi ekādaśasāmidhenīnāṃ prakṛtau pāṭhāt "pañcadaśāvareṇa vāgvajreṇāvabādhe tamimaṃ bhrātṛvyam" ityatra sāmidhenīnāṃ pañcadaśatvasya prathamottamasāmidhenyostrirabhidhānamantareṇānupapattestathābidhānāt || 3 || <1-1-4> śiṣyākāṅkṣānurodhena svarūpato lakṣaṇataśca dharmaṃ vyākhyāyābhidheyasambandhapratipādanāya sūtram -- dharmmaviśeṣaprasūtād dravyaguṇakarmmasāmānyaviśeṣasamavāyānāṃ padārthānāṃ sādharmyavaidharmyābhyāṃ tattvajñānānniḥśreyasam || 4 || etādṛśaṃ tattvajñānaṃ vaiśeṣikaśāstrādhīnamiti tasyāpi niḥśreyasahetutvaṃ daṇḍāpūpāyitam| tattvaṃ jñāyate'neneti karaṇavyutpattyā śāstraparatve dharmaviśeṣaprasūtādityanenānanvayāpatteḥ| sarvapadārthapradhāno dvandvaścātra samāsaḥ sarvapadārthatattvajñānasya niḥśrayasahetutvāt| tadatra śāstraniḥśreyasayorhetuhetumadbhāvaḥ, śāstratattvajñānayorvyāpāravyāpāribhāvaḥ, niśreyasatattvajñānayoḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvaḥ, dravyādipadārthaśāstrayoḥ pratipādyapratipādakabhāvaḥ sambandho'vagamyate| eteṣāñcasambandhānāṃ jñānānniḥśreyasārthināmiha śāstre pravṛttiḥ mokṣamāṇāśca munergṛhītāptabhāvā eva śāstre pravarttante| niḥśreyasamātyantikī duḥkhanivṛttiḥ| duḥkhanivṛtteścātyantikatvaṃ samānādhikaraṇaduḥkhaprāgabhāvāsamānakālonatvaṃ yugapadutpannasamānādhikaraṇasarvātmaviśeṣaguṇadhvaṃsasamānakālīnatvaṃ vā| aśeṣaviśeṣaguṇadhvaṃsāvadhikaduḥkhaprāgabhāvo vā muktiḥ| na cāsādhyatvānnāyaṃ puruṣārthaḥ kāraṇavighaṭanamukhena prāgabhāvasyāpi sādhyatvāt| na ca tasya prāgabhāvatvakṣatiḥ pratiyogijanakābhāvatvena tathātvāt| janakatvañca svarūpayogyatā mātram, nahi prāgabhāvaścaramasāmagro yena tasmin sati kāryyamavaśyambhavet tathā sati kāryasyāpyanāditvaprasaṅgāt| tathā ca yathā sahakārivirahādiyantaṃ kālaṃ nājījanat tathāgre'pi tadvirahānna janayiṣyati, detūcchede puruṣavyāpārāt' ityasyāpi prāgabhāvaparipālana eva tātparyāt| ata eva gautamīyadvitīyasūtre "duḥkha janmapravṛttidoṣamithyājñānānāmuttarottarāpāye tadanantarāpāyādapavargaḥ ityatra kāraṇābhāvāt kāryyābhāvābhidhānaṃ duḥkhaprāgabhāvarūpāmeva muktiṃ draḍhayati| nahi doṣāpāye pravṛttyapāyaḥ, pravṛttyapāye janmāpāyaḥ, janmāpāye duḥkhāpāya ityapāyo dhvaṃsaḥ, kintvanutpattiḥ| sā prāgabhāva eva| naca pratiyogyaprasiddhiḥ sāmānyato duḥkhatvenaiva pratiyogiprasiddheḥ prāyaścittavat, tatrāpi pratyavāyadhvaṃsadvārā duḥkhānutpatterevāpekṣitatvāt loke'pyahikaṇḍakādinivṛtterduḥkhānutpattiphalakatvadarśanāt duḥkhasādhananivṛttyarthameva prekṣāvatāṃ pravṛttiḥ| kecitta duḥkhātyantābhāva eva muktiḥ| sa ca yadyapi nātmaniṣṭhastathāpi loṣṭādiniṣṭha evātmani sādhyate| siddhiśca tasya duḥkhaprāgabhāvāsahavartiduḥkhadhvaṃsa eva tasya tatsambandhatayopagamāt, tasmin sati tatra duḥkhātyantābhāvapratīteḥ| evañca sati "duḥkhenātyantaṃ vimuktaścarati" ityādiśrutirapyupapāditā bhavatotyāhuḥ| tanna duḥkhatyantābhāvasyāsādhyatvenāpuruṣārthatvāt| duḥkhadhvaṃsasya ca na tatra sambandhatvaṃ paribhāṣāpatteḥ "duḥkhenātyantaṃ vimuktaścarati" iti śruterduḥkhaprāgabhāvasyaiva kāraṇavighaṭanamukhenātyantābhāvasamānarūpatvatātparyakatvāt| nanvayaṃ na puruṣārthaḥ nirupādhīcchāviṣayatvābhāvāt duḥkhakāle sukhaṃ tāvannotpadyate iti sukhārthināmeva duḥkhābhāvārthaṃ pravṛtteriti cenna vaiparītyasyāpi suvacatvāt sukhecchāpi duḥkhābhāvaupādhikītyeva kiṃ na syāt, śokākulānāṃ sukhavimukhānāmapi duḥkhābhāvamātramabhisandhāya viṣabhakṣaṇodbandhanādau pravṛttidarśanāt| nanu puruṣārtho'pyayaṃ jñāyamāna eva muktestu duḥkhābhāvasya jñāyamānataiva nāsti anyathā mūrcchādyavasthārthamapi pravartteti cenna śrutyanumānābhyāṃ jñāyamānasyāvedyatvānupapatteḥ| asti hi śrutiḥ "duḥkhenātyantaṃ vimuktaścarati" "tameva viditvā'timṛtyumeti" ityādikā| anumānamapyasti -- duḥkhasantatiratyantamucchidyate santatitvāt pradopasantativadityādi| caramaduḥkhadhvaṃsasya duḥkhasākṣātkāreṇa kṣaṇaṃ viṣayokaraṇāt pratyakṣavedyatā'pi| yogināṃ yogajadharmabalenāgāmino duḥkhadhvaṃsasya pratyakṣopagamācca| tathāpi tulyāyavyayatayā nāyaṃ puruṣārthāṃ duḥkhavat sukhasyāpi hāneḥ dvayorapi samānasāmagrīkatvāditi cet utsargato votarāgāṇāṃ duḥkhadurdinabhīrūṇāṃ sukhakhadyotikāmātre'lampratyayavatāṃ tatra pravṛtteḥ| nanu tathāpi duḥkhanivṛttirna puruṣārthaḥ anāgataduḥkhanivṛtteraśakyatvāt atotaduḥkhasyātītatvāt varttamānaduḥkhasya puruṣaprayatnamantareṇaiva nivṛtteriti cenna hetūcchede puruṣavyāpārāt prāyaścittavat| tathāhi savāsanaṃ mithyājñānaṃ saṃsārahetustaducchedaścātmatattvajñānāt tattvajñānāt tattvajñānañca yogavidhisādhyamiti tadarthaṃ pravṛttyupapatteḥ| nanu nityasukhābhivyaktireva muktirnatu duḥkhābhāva iti cenna nityasukhe pramāṇābhāvāt, bhāve vā nityaṃ tadabhivyaktermuktasaṃsāriṇoraviśeṣāpātāt abivyakterutpādyatvena tannivṛttau punaḥ saṃsārāpatteśca| brahmātmani jovātmalayo muktiriti cenna layo yadyekobhāvastadā bādhāt nahi dvayamekaṃ bhavati| liṅgaśarīrāpagamo layo liṅgañcaikādaśendriyāṇi teṣāṃ śarorasya ca vigamo laya iti cenna etāvatā duḥkhasāmagrīvirahasyoktatvāt tathāca duḥkhābhāva eva muktiriti paryavasānāt| etenāvidyānivṛttau kevalātmasthitirmuktiḥ ātmā ca vijñānasukhātmaka ityekadaṇḍimatamapāstam| ātmano jñānatve sukhatve ca pramāṇābhāvāt| na ca "nityaṃ vijñānamānandaṃ brahma" iti śrutirmānam tasyā jñānavattvānandavattvapratipādakatvāt bhavati hi ahaṃ jāne ahaṃ sukhītipratītiḥ natvahaṃ jñānam ahaṃ sukhamiti| kiñca brahmaṇa idānomapi sattvāt muktasaṃsāriṇoraviśeṣāpattiḥ avidyānivṛtteścāpuruṣārthatvāt brahmaṇaśca nityatvenāsādhyatvāt, tatsākṣātkārasya tadātmakatvenāsādhyatvāt, evamānandasyāpi tadātmakatvenāsādhyatvameveti tadarthaṃ pravṛttyanupapattireva| nirupaplavā citsamtatirmuktiriti cenna| duḥkhādirūpasya upaplavasya vigamo yadiḥ nirupalpavatvam tadā tanmātrasyaiva puruṣārthatvena citsantateranuvṛttau pramāṇābhāvaḥ tadanuvṛtterapi śarīrānuvṛtterāvaśyakatvāditi siddhaṃ duḥkhanivṛttirevoktarūpā niḥśreyasamiti| tattvasya jñānamiti karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī| sādharmyavaidharmyābhyāmiti prakāre tṛtīyā| tatra sādharmyamanugato dharmaḥ, vaidharmyañca vyāvṛtto dharmaḥ| yadyapi kvacit sādharmyamapi kutaścidvaidharmyaṃ kutaścidvaidhammapi keṣāñcit sādharmyam tathāpi tādrūpyeṇa jñānaṃ vivakṣitam| atra ca dravyādipadārthānāmuddeśa eva vibhāgaḥ paryavasannaḥ| sa ca nyūnādhikasaṅkhyāvyavacchedaphalakastena ṣaḍeva padārthā iti niyamaḥ paryyavasyati, sa cānupapannaḥ vyavacchedyasya padārthāntarasya pratipattau niyamānupapapattiḥ, apratītau vyavacchedānupapattiḥ| nanu nāyamanyayogavyavacchedaḥ kintvayogavyavacchedaḥ padārtheṣu ṣaḍ‌lakṣaṇāyogo vyavacchidyata iti cenna padārthapadena prasiddhapadārthamātropasaṃgrahe siddhasādhanāt anaysya cāpratītereva| kiñca lakṣaṇānāṃ militānāmayogo vyavacchedyaḥ pratyekaṃ vā? ādye militāyogaḥ sarvatreti vyavacchedānupapattiḥ| antye'pi pratyekāyorāḥ parasparaṃ sarvatreti vyavacchedānupapattireveti cenna| śaktisaṅkhyāsādṛśyādiṣu padārtheṣu parābhimateṣu ṣaḍ‌lakṣaṇāyogaḥ parairucyate tadyavyacchedo niyamārthaḥ, tathāca ṣaḍeva padārthā ityasya pratīyamāneṣu paṇṇāṃ lakṣaṇānāṃ madhye anyatamalakṣaṇayogo'styeva na tvayoga ityarthaḥ| tatra viśeṣyasaṅgatasyānyayogavyavacchedo viśeṣaṇasaṅgatasyāyogavyavacchedaḥ kriyāsaṅgatasya cātyantāyogavyavacchedastāvat pratīyate| tatra śaktitrayamevakārasyetyeke vyavacchedamātre śaktirayogānyayogādayastu vyavacchedyāḥ samabhivyāhāralabhyā ityapare| dharmaviśeṣaprasūtāditi tattvajñānādityasya viśeṣaṇam| tatra dharmaviśeṣonivṛttilakṣaṇo dharmaḥ| yadi tu tattvaṃ jñāyate'neneti tattvajñānaṃ śāstramucyate tadā dharmaviśeṣa īśvaraniyogaprasādarūpo caktavyaḥ| śrūyate hīśvaraniyogaprasādāvavigamya kaṇādo maharṣiḥ śāstraṃ praṇītavāniti| tattvajñānamātmatattvasākṣātkāra iha vivakṣitastasyaiva savāsanamithyājñānonmūlanakṣamatvāt| "tameva viditvā'timṛtyumeti nānyaḥ panthā vidyate'yanāya" ityatra "dve brahmaṇo veditavye" ityatra ca vedanapadasya sākṣātkaḥraparatvāt, "paśyatyacakṣuḥ" ityatrāpi tathā| sa ca śāstrānmanananididhyāsanādiparamparayeti hetupañcamyā tathaivābhidhānāt || 4 || <1-1-5> idānīmapavargabhāgitayā sarvapadārthāśrayatayā ca prathamoddiṣṭasya dravyapadārthasya vibhāgaṃ viśeṣoddeśañca kurvannāha -- guṇanirūpaṇam pṛthivyāpastejo vāyurākāśaṃ kālo digātmā mana iti dravyāṇi || 5 || itikāro'vadhāraṇārthaḥ| tena naveva dravyāṇi nādhikāni na nyūnāni vetyarthaḥ| nanu vibhāgabalādeva nyanādhikasaṅkhyāvyavacchedasiddhau kimiti kāreṇeti cet uddeśamātraparatayā'pi sūtrasambhave vibhāgatātparyyasphoraṇārthamevetikārābhidhānāt| suvarṇādīnāmīśvarasya cātraivāntarbhāvāt andhakārasya cādhikatvenāśaṅkyamānasyābhāvatvavyutpādanādetadadhyavaseyam| asamāsakaraṇantu sarveṣāṃ prādhānyanyapradarśanāya| lakṣaṇameteṣāntu vadharmyāvasare sūtrakṛdeva darśayiṣyati| nanu suvarṇaṃ na tāvat pṛthivī nirgandhatvāt, na jalaṃ snehasāṃsiddhikadravatvaśūnyatvāt, na tejo gurutvavattvāt, ata eva na vāyurna vā kālādi, tato navabhyo bhidyata iti cenna, ādyadvitīyayoranābhāsatvam tṛtīyasya svarapūsiddhatvaṃ tataḥ paraṃ siddhasādhanaṃ hetosvarūpāsiddhiśca| sādhayiṣyate ca suvarṇasya taijasatvamiti || 5 || <1-1-6> guṇatvena rūpeṇa guṇānāṃ sarvadravyāśritatvaṃ dravyābhivyaṅgyatvaṃ dravyābhivyañjakatvañceti dravyāntaraṃ guṇānāmuddeśaṃ vibhāgañcāha -- rūparasagandhasparśāḥ saṅkhyāḥ parimāṇāni pṛthak‌tvaṃ saṃyogavibhāgau paratvāparatve buddhayaḥ sukhaduḥkhe icchodveṣau prayatnāśca guṇāḥ || 6 || cakāreṇa gurutvadravatvasnehasaṃskāradharmādharmaśabdān samuccinoti te hi prasiddhaguṇabhāvā eveti kaṇṭhato noktāḥ| guṇatvañcābhīṣāṃ yathāsthānaṃ lakṣaṇataḥ svarūpakaraṇyaṃ nāstīti sūcanārthaṃ samāsaḥ| saṅkhyāparimāṇayostu samānakālonasaṅkhyāparimāṇasāmānādhikaraṇyasūcanāyāsamāso bahuvacananirdeśca| yadyapyekatvasamānādhikaraṇaṃ naikatvāntaraṃ na vā mahattvadīrghatvasamānādhikaraṇaṃ mahattvadīrghatvāntaram tathāpi dvitvādīnāmanyonyaṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ mahattvadorghatvādīnāñca vijātīyaparimāṇayoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyamastyeva| pṛthaktvañca yadyapi dvipṛthak‌tvādisamānāvikaraṇaṃ tena saṅkhyāvad bahutvenaiva nirdeṣṭumarhati tathāpyavadhivyaṅgyatvalakṣaṇaṃ saṅkhyāto vaidharmyaṃ sūcayitumekavacananirddeśaḥ| saṃyogavibhāgayordvayorapyekakarmajanyatvasūcanāya dvivacanam| paratvāparatvayoranyonyāśrayanirūpyatayā dikkālaliṅgatvāviśeṣasūcanāya ca dvivacanam| buddhīnāṃ vidyādibhedena sāṅkhyābhimataikamātrabuddhinirākaraṇasacanāya bahuvacanam| sukhaduḥkhayordvayorapi bhogatvāvacchedyaukakāryyajanakatvam aviśeṣeṇa thādṛṣṭonnāyakatvam, sukhasyāpi duḥkhatvena bhāvanañca khyāpayituṃ dvivacanam| icchādveṣayordvayorapi pravṛttiṃ prati kāraṇatvasūcanāya dvivacanam| prayatnānāṃ vihitaniṣiddhagocarāṇāṃ daśavidhānāṃ puṇyahetutvaṃ daśavidhānāñca pāpahetutvamabhisandhāya bahuvacanamityunneyam| yadvā rūparasagandhasparśānāṃ bhautikendriyavyavasthāhetutvajñāpanārthaṃ pākajaprakriyāvyavasthāpanārthaṃ vā te samasyoktāḥ| saṅkhyāyāṃ devitvabahutvādau vipratipattiriti tannirākaraṇasūcanārthaṃ bahutvenābhidhānam| pṛthak‌tve tu sahkhyābahutvenaivāsyāpi bahutvamiti sūcanāyāvadhijñānavyañjanīyatvaṃ saṅkhyāto vaidharmyamiti sūcanāya ca pṛthagabhidhānam| parimāṇe tu dorghatvahrasvatvādivipratipattinirāsāya bahuvacanam| saṃyogavibhāgayoranyonyavirodhajñāpanāya dvivacanam| paratvāparatvayordaiśikakālikabhedena bhinnajātīyatvasambhavena catuṣṭvāpattau guṇavibhāgo nyūnaḥ syāt iti tatrāpi dvivacanamityādyunneyam| eteṣāñca lakṣaṇamagre vakṣyate || 6 || <1-1-7> karmaṇāṃ dravyajanyatayā guṇajanyatayā ca rūpavadravyasamavāyācca pratyakṣateti dravyaguṇābhidhānānantaraṃ karmoddeśavibhāgāvāha -- karmanirūpaṇam utkṣepaṇam avakṣepaṇaṇ ākuñcanaṃ gamanimiti karmāṇi| itiravadhāraṇārthaḥ, bhramaṇāderapi gamanāntargatatvāt| atra ca utkṣepaṇatvāvakṣepaṇatvākuñcanatvaprasāraṇatvagamanatvāni karmatvasākṣādvyāpyāḥ pañca jātayaḥ| nanvetadanupapannaṃ gamanasya karmaparyyāyatvāt sarvatra gacchatīti buddherdṛṣṭatvādutkṣepaṇatvādīnāṃ catasṛṇāṃ jātīnāṃ parasparātyantābhāvasamānādhikaraṇānāṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyānanubavāt catasra eva karmatvavyāpyā jātaya iti cet| satyaṃ karmaparyyāya eva gamanaṃ pṛthagabhidhānantu bhramaṇarecanasyandanordhvajvalananamanonnamanādīnāṃ bhinnabhinnabuddhivyapadeśabhājāmekena śabdena saṅgrahārtham| yadvā gamanatvamapi karmatvavyāpyā pañcamī jātireva tena bhramaṇarecanādiṣveva gamanaprayogo mukhyaḥ ut‌kṣepaṇāvakṣepaṇādiṣu yadi gamanaprayogastadā bhāktaḥ| svāśrayasaṃyogavibhāgāsamavāyikāraṇatvameva gauṇamukhsādhāraṇo dharmaḥ| gamanatvajātestvaniyatadigdeśasaṃyogavibhāgāsamavāyikāraṇatvameva vyañjakam, tacca bhramaṇādiṣu sarvatreti gamanagrahaṇaenaiva teṣāṃ grahaṇamiti| niṣkramaṇatvapraveśanatvādikā tu na jātiḥ ekasminneva karmaṇi gṛhād gṛhāntaraṃ gacchati puruṣe kasyacit draṣṭuḥ praviśatoti pratyayaḥ kasyacittu niṣkrāmatīti tatra jātisaṅkaraḥ syāt tathā bhramaṇāderekasyā jalapraṇālyā niṣkramyāparāṃ praviśatti niṣkrāmati prabiśatīti pratyayadvayadarśanādupādhisāmānyamevaitadadhyavaste tāvadutkṣepaṇaṃ tata utkṣepaṇaviśiṣṭahastanodanādasamavāyikāraṇāt muṣale'pyutkṣepaṇākhyaṃ karma yugapadbā| tata ūrdhvamutkṣiptayorhastamuṣalayoravakṣepaṇecchārjānataprayatnavadātmasaṃyogāddhastanodanācca yugapadeva haste muṣale cāvakṣepaṇam ulūkhalapātānukūlaṃ sañjāyate| tato dṛḍhataradravyasaṃyogād yad kasmānmuṣalasyordhvagamanaṃ bhavati tatra necchā na vā prayatnaḥ kāraṇaṃ kintu saṃskāramātrādeva muṣalasyotpatanam tacca gamanamātraṃ natūtkṣepaṇaṃ bhāktastatrotkṣepaṇavyavahāraḥ| evamanulomapratilomavāyudvayasaṅghaṭṭavaśādvāyvostatpreritatūlakādau cotkṣepaṇavyavahāro bhāktaḥ| evaṃ srotodvayasaṅghaṭṭavaśājjalordhvagamane'pi evamutkṣepaṇāvakṣepaṇavyavahāraḥ śarīratadavayavatatsaṃyuktamuṣalayomarādiṣveva mukhyaḥ bhavati hi hastamutkṣipati muṣalamutkṣipati tomaramutkṣipatīti evamavakṣipatotyapi| ākuñcanantu satsvevāvayavānāmārambhakasaṃyogeṣu parasparamavayavānāmanārambhakasaṃyogotpādakaṃ vastrādyavayavikauṭilyotpādakaṃ karma yato bhavati saṅkucati padmaṃ saṅkucati vastraṃ saṅkucati carmetipratyayaḥ| evamavayavānāṃ pūrvetpannānārambhakasaṃyogavināśakaṃ karma prasāraṇaṃ yato bhavati prasarati vastraṃ prasarati carma pravikasati padmamityādipratyayaḥ| etaccatuṣṭyabhinnaṃ yat karmajātaṃ tatsarvaṃ gamanaviśeṣaḥ| tatra bhramaṇaṃ prayatnavadātmasaṃyogāddhaste karmavatā hastena nodanākhyasaṃyogādavaghaṭṭanācca cakrādau tiryyak‌saṃyogānukūlaṃ kamaṃ| recanādyapi vyākhyeyam| sphuṭīkariṣyati cāgre tadeteṣāṃ karmaṇāṃ vihitayāgasnānadānādiṣu dharmānukūlaprayatnavadātmasaṃyogajanyatvaṃ niṣiddhadeśagamanahiṃsākalañjabhakṣaṇādiṣu cādharmānūkūlaprayatnavadātmasaṃyogajanyatvamadhyavaseyamiti || 7 || <1-1-8> dravyādīnāmuddeśānantaraṃ trayāṇāṃ sādharmyaprakaraṇamārabhate| tatra dravyādīnāṃ trayāṇāṃ sādharmyasya tattvajñānānukūlatayā prathamaṃ śiṣyākāṅkṣitatvāt sāmānyādipadārthatrayasya uddeśāt prāgeva trayāṇāṃ sādharmyamāha -- dravyaguṇakarmaṇāmaviśeṣanirūpaṇam sadanitvaṃ dravyavatkāryaṃ kāraṇaṃ sāmānyaviśeṣavaditi dravyaguṇakarmaṇāmaviśeṣaḥ || 8 || viśeṣe satyapi ayamaviśeṣaśabdaḥ sādharmyaparaḥ saditi| sadākārapratyayavyapadeśaviṣayatvam trayāṇāmeva sattāyogitvāt| anityamiti| dhvaṃsapratiyogitvaṃ yadyapi na paramāṇvādisādhāraṇaṃ tathāpi dhvaṃsapratiyogivṛttipadārthavibhājakopādhimattvaṃ vivakṣitam| dravyavaditi| dravyaṃ samavāyikāraṇatayā'syāstoti dravyavat, etadapi paramāṇvādau nāstīti dravyasamavāyikāraṇakavṛttipadārthavibhājakopādhimattvaṃ vivakṣitam| kāryyamiti| prāgabhāvapratiyogivṛttipadārthavibhājakopādhimattvaṃ vivakṣitam| kāraṇamiti| jñānetarakāryyaniyatapūrvavarttijātīyavṛttipadārthavibhājakopādhimattvam tena svasākṣātkāre viṣayatayā kāraṇe gotvādau nātiprasaktirna vā pārimāṇḍalyādāvajanake'vyāptiḥ| sāmānyaviśeṣavaditi| sāmānyaṃ sadviśeṣo'nyonyavyāvartakatayā dravyatvaguṇatvakarmatvādi tadvattvamityarthaḥ| nanu "gāṃ dadyāt" "gauḥ padā na spraṣṭavyā" iti śruterdharmādharmajanakatvaṃ jāterapīti kāraṇatvamativyāpoti cenna avacchedakatāmātreṇa jāterviniyogāt| upalakṣaṇañcaitat svasamavāyārthaśabdābhidheyatvamapi trayāṇāṃ sādharmyaṃ draṣṭavyam| yadi tu kāryyatvānityatvekāraṇavatāmeva "kāraṇatvañcānyatra" iti praśastadevācāryyavyavasthitaṃ sādharmyamucyate tadā padārthavibhājakopādhimattayā na viśeṣyaṃ sūtroktarītyā| trayāṇāṃ guṇajanakatvaṃ guṇajanyatvañcānyatra nityadravyebhya iti || 8 || <1-1-9> <1-1-10> etadeva sūtrāntareṇaspaṣṭayati -- dravyaguṇayoḥ sajātīyārambhakatvaṃ sādharmyam || 9 || dravyāṇi dravyāntaramārabhante guṇāśca guṇāntaram || 10 || antyāvayavivibhudravyāṇi tathāntyāvayaviguṇān dvitvadvipṛthaktvaparatvāparatvādīn guṇāṃśca vihāya sajātīyārambhakatvaṃ sādharmyaṃ draṣṭavyam| sajātīyārambhakavṛttipadārthavibhājakopādhimattvaṃ vā vivakṣitaṃ tenājanakadravyavyaktīnāmapyupagrahaḥ || 10 || <1-1-11> nanu karmāṇi kuto na karmāntaramārabhanta ityata āha -- karma karmasādhyaṃ na vidyate || 11 || vidirayaṃ jñānārtho na tu sattābhidhāyī| sajātīyārabdhadravyaguṇayoriva karmasādhya ekarmaṇi pramāṇaṃ nāstītyarthaḥ| idamatrākūtam| karma yadi karma janayet svotpattyanantarameva janayet śabdavat| tathāca pūrvakarmaṇaiva yāvat‌saṃyogidravyebhyo vibhāge janite dvitīyaṃ karma kena saha vibhāgaṃ janayet vibhāgasya saṃyogapūrvakatvāt saṃyogāntarasya ca tatrādhikaraṇe'nutpannatvāt, vibhāgājanane tu karmalakṣaṇakṣateḥ| na ca kṣaṇāntare karmāntaraṃ janayiṣyatīti vācyam samarthasya kṣepāyogāt, apekṣaṇīyāntarābhāvāt, pūrvasaṃyoganāśakṣaṇe'pi janane vibhāgajanakatvānupapattireva, uttarasaṃyogotpattikāle'pi janane tathaiva| uttarasaṃyogātpattyanantarakālantu karmanāśa eva| tathā ca suṣṭhūktaṃ `karmasādhyaṃ na vidyataṃ' iti || 11 || <1-1-12> guṇakarmabyāṃ dravyasya vaidharmyamāha -- na dravyaṃ kāryaṃ kāraṇañca vadhati || 12 || dravyaṃ na svakāryyaṃ hanti na vā svakāraṇaṃ hanti, kāryyakāraṇabhāvāpannayordravyayorvadhyaghātakabhāvo nāstītyarthaḥ| āśrayanāśārambhakasaṃyoganāśābhyāmeva dravyanāśāditi bhāvaḥ| vadhatīti sautro nirdeśaḥ || 12 || <1-1-13> gaṇasya kāryyakāraṇavadhyatvamāha -- ubhayathā guṇāḥ || 13 || kāryyavadhyāḥ kāraṇavadhyāścetyarthaḥ| ādyaśabdādīnāṃ kāryyavadhyatvaṃ caramasya tu kāraṇavadhyatvam, upāntyena śabdena antyasya nāśāt || 13 || <1-1-14> guṇānāṃ kāryyakāraṇobhayavirodhitvamuktvā karmaṇaḥ kāryyavirodhitvamāha -- kāryyavirodhi karma || 14 || kāryyaṃ virodhi yasyeti bahuvrīhiḥ, svajanyottarasaṃyoganāśyatvāt karmaṇaḥ| dravyāṇāṃ kāryyakāraṇāvirodhitvaṃ niyatameva| guṇakarmaṇostvaniyamaḥ, āśrayanāśāsamavāyikāraṇanāśanimittanāśavirodhiguṇānāṃ nāśakatvasya vakṣyamāṇatvāt || 14 || <1-1-15> śiṣyākāṅkṣānurodhena trayāṇāṃ sādhurmyamabidhāyedānīṃ trayāṇāṃ lakṣaṇamārabhamāṇa āha -- kriyāguṇavat samavāyikāraṇamiti dravyalakṣaṇam || 15 || kriyāśca guṇāśca vidyante'sminniti kriyāguṇavat| atra lakṣaṇaśabdaścihnavacanaḥ, samānāsamānajātīyavyavacchedakavyatirekiliṅgaviśeṣavacanaścalakṣyate'nenetivyutpattibalāt| kriyayā karmaṇā dravyamidamiti lakṣyate guṇavattvena ca samānāsamānajātīyebhyo vyāvṛttaṃ dravyaṃ lakṣyate, tatra samānajātīyā bhāvatvena guṇādayaḥ pañca, asamānajātīyastvabhāvaḥ, tena dravyaṃ guṇādibhyo bhinnaṃ guṇavattvāt yanna guṇādibhyo bhidyate tanna guṇavat yathā guṇādīti| guṇavattvaṃ yadyapyādyakṣaṇe'vayavini nāsti tathāpi guṇātyantābhāvavirodhimattvaṃ vivakṣitam guṇaprāga bhāvapradhvaṃsayorapi guṇātyantābhāvavirodhitvāt| evaṃ samavāyikāraṇatvamapi ṣaṭ‌padārthabhedakameva dravyapadārthasya lakṣaṇam| na ca sādhyāprasiddhirguṇādibhedasya ghaṭādāveva pratyakṣasiddhatvāt| nacātra siddhasādhanaṃ ghaṭatvāvacchedenetarabedasya siddhaṃtve'pi dravyatvāvacchedena sādhyatvāt, pakṣatāvacchedakabhede na siddhasādhanaṃ yathā nitye vāṅyanasī ityatra iti kecittanna pakṣatāvacchedakāvacchinne kvacidapi sādhyasiddhau pakṣatākṣatestathāpyāvaśyakatvāt| itiśabdaśca ityādiparastena saṅkhyāvattvaparimāṇavattvapṛthaktvavattvasaṃyogavattvavibhāgavattvānyapi dravyalakṣaṇatvena saṃgṛhyante || 15 || <1-1-16> dravyānantaraṃ gaṇānāmuddeśāt tallakṣaṇamāha -- dravyāśrayyaguṇavān saṃyogavibhāgeṣvakāraṇamanapekṣa iti guṇalakṣaṇam || 16 || dravyamāśrayituṃ śīlamasyeti dravyāśrayī| etacca dravye'pi gatamata āha -- aguṇavāniti| tathāpi karmarṇyātavyāptirityata āha saṃyogavibhāgeṣvakāraṇam| tathāpi saṃyogavibhāgadharmādharmeśvarajñānādīnāmasaṃgrahaḥ syādata uktamanapekṣa iti| atrānapekṣa ityanantaraṃ guṇa iti pūraṇīyam, saṃyogavibhāgeṣvanapekṣaḥ san kāraṇaṃ yo na bhavati saguṇa ityarthaḥ| saṃyogavibhāgādīnāṃ saṃyogavibhāgau prati sāpekṣatvāt| nityavṛttinityavṛttisattāvyāpyajātimattvaṃ guṇatvam| saṃyogavibhāgau militau pratisamavāyikāraṇatvāsamavāyikāraṇatvarahite sāmānyavati yat kāraṇatvaṃ tad‌guṇatvābhivyañjakam| saṃyogavibhāgayoḥ pratyekameva saṃyogavibhāgakāraṇa katvaṃ na militayoḥ dharmādharmeśvarajñānādīnāṃ dvayornimittakāraṇatvamātraṃ na samavāyikāraṇatvaṃ nāpyasamavāyikāraṇatvamiti teṣāṃ saṃgrahaḥ| yadvā saṃyogavibhāgasamavāyitvāsamavāyikāraṇatvaśūnyatvaṃ sāmānyasamānādhiguṇatvavyañjakam| sāmānyavattve sati karmānyatve ca satyaguṇavattvameva vā guṇalakṣaṇam || 16 || <1-1-17> gaṇānantaramuddiṣṭasya karmaṇo lakṣaṇamāha -- ekadravyamaguṇaṃ saṃyogavibhāgeṣvanapekṣakāraṇakāraṇamiti karmalakṣaṇam || 17 || ekameva dravyam āśrayo yasya tadekadravyam, na vidyate guṇo'sminnityaguṇam, saṃyogavibhāgeṣvanapekṣakāraṇamiti svotpattyanantarotpattikabhāvabhūtānapekṣamityarthaḥ| tena samavāyikāraṇāpekṣāyāṃ pūrvasaṃyogābhāvāpekṣāyāñca nāsiddhatvam| svotpattyanantarotpattikānapekṣatvaṃ vā vivakṣitam pūrvasaṃyogadhvaṃsasyāpi svotpattyanantarānutpattiktatvāt, abhāvatvena tasyādyakṣaṇasambandhābhāvāt| nityāvṛttisattāsākṣād‌vyāpyajātimattvaṃ karmatvam, calatītipratyayāsādhāraṇakāraṇatāvacchedakajātimattvaṃ vā, guṇānyanirguṇātravṛttijātimattvaṃ vā, svotpattyavyavahitottarakṣaṇavṛttivibhāgakāraṇatāvacchedakajātimattvaṃ vā| sa cāyaṃ calatītipratyayasākṣikaḥ padārtho nāviraladeśotpādanādinopapādyaḥ, kṣaṇabhaṅgasyāgre nirākariṣyamāṇatvāt| lakṣaṇasya itarabhedasādhakatāprakāraḥ pūrvokta eva || 17 || <1-1-17> <1-1-18> idānīṃ kāraṇamukhena trayāṇāmeva sādharmyaprakaraṇamupakramate -- dravyaguṇakarmaṇāṃ dravyaṃ kāraṇaṃ sāmānyam || 18 || samānameva sāmānyam ekamityarthaḥ, anayoḥ samānā mātetivat| ekasminneva dravye samavāyikāraṇe dravyaguṇakarmāṇi varttante ityarthaḥ| dravyasamavāyikāraṇakavṛttijātimattvaṃ trayāṇāṃ sādharmyam || 18 || <1-1-19> guṇāsamavāyikāraṇakatvaṃ trayāṇāṃ sādharmyamāha -- tathā guṇaḥ || 19 || guṇāsamavāyikāraṇakavṛttijātimattvaṃ tritayasādharmyam| dravyāṇāṃ saṃyogo'samavāyikāraṇam, kāryyaguṇānāṃ rūparasagandhasparśasaṅkhyāparimāṇapṛthak‌tvādīnāṃ sajātīyakāraṇaguṇāsamavāyikāraṇakatvam, buddhyādīnāmātmaguṇānāṃ manaḥsaṃyogāsamavāyikāraṇakatvam| pārthivaparamāṇuguṇānāmagnisaṃyogāsamavāyikāraṇakatvam| karmaṇāntu vahnyādinodanābhidhātagurutvadravatvasaṃskārādṛṣṭavadātmasaṃyogaprayatnavadātmasaṃyogādyasamavāyikāraṇakatvaṃ yathāyathaṃ svayamūhanoyam| kvacidekasyāpi guṇasya trayāṇāṃ dravyaguṇakarmaṇāmārambhakatvam| tadyathā vegavattūlapiṇḍasaṃyogastūlapiṇḍāntare karma karoti dvitūlakañca dravyamārabhate tatparimāṇañca| kvacideko guṇo dravyaguṇāvārabhate yathā tūlapiṇḍasaṃyoga eva vegānapekṣapracayākhyo dvitūlakaṃ dravyaṃ tatparimāṇañcārabhate || 19 || <1-1-20> kvacidekasya karmaṇo'nekakāryyakāritvamāha -- saṃyogavibhāgavegānāṃ karma samānam || 20 || kāraṇamityanuṣaṅgaḥ| yatra dravye karmotpannaṃ tena samaṃ yāvad‌dravyaṃ saṃyuktamāsīt tāvat‌saṅkhyākān vibhāgān janayitvā tāvataḥ saṃyogānapi punaranyatra janayati, vegaṃ punarekameva svāśrayaṃ karoti vegapadaṃ sthitisthāpakamapyupalakṣayati || 20 || <1-1-21> nanu kriyāvatā dravyeṇārambhakasaṃyoge janite tena ca dravyamārabdhaṃ yattadapi karmajanyameva karmaṇastat‌pūrvavarttitvādata āha -- na dravyāṇāṃ karma || 21 || karma dravyāṇāṃ na kāraṇamityarthaḥ || 21 || <1-1-22> kuta evamata āha -- vyatirekāt || 22 || vyatirekāditi| nivṛtterityarthaḥ| uttarasaṃyogena karmaṇi nivṛtte dravyamutpadyate iti na karmaṇo dravyakāraṇatvaṃ vinaśyadavasthañca karma na dravyakāraṇam| kiñca karma dravyasyāsamavāyikāraṇaṃ vā bhavennimittakāraṇaṃ vā? na tāvadādyaḥ dravyasyāsamavāyikāraṇanāśanāśyatvena avayavakarmanāśādeva dravyanāśāpatteḥ| na dvitīyaḥ mahāpaṭanāśe'vasthitasaṃyogebhya eva khaṇḍapaṭotpattau niṣkarmaṇāmevāvayavānāṃ dravyārambhadarśanādvyabhicārāt || 22 || <1-1-23> bahūnāmekasyārambhakatvamuktvā idānīmekasmin kāryye bahūnāmārambhakatvamāha -- dravyāṇāṃ dravyaṃ kāryya sāmānyam || 23 || dravye ca dravyāṇi ceti dravyāṇi teṣāṃ dravyāṇām| tatra dvābhyāṃ tantubhyāṃ dvitantukaḥ paṭo bahubhirapi tantubhirekaḥ paṭa ārabhyate nanvekatantuko'pi paṭo dṛśyate yatraikenaiva tantunā tānapratitantrau bhavata iti cenna tatraikasya saṃyogābhāvenāsamavāyikāraṇābhāvāt paṭānutpatteḥ| na cāśukatantusaṃyogo'samavāyikāraṇam avayavāvayavinorayutasiddhatvena saṃyogābhāvāt ārabhyārambhakabhāvānabhyupagamāt, mūrttānāṃ samānadeśatāvirodhāt| dṛśyate tāvadevamiti cenna tatra vemādyabhighātena mahāvayavinastantornāśāt khaṇḍāvayavinānātantūtpattau teṣāmanyonyasaṃyogāt paṭotpatteḥ, vastugatyā tatra nānābhūteṣu tantuṣū ekatvābhimānāt || 23 || <1-1-24> nanu yathā dravyāṇāṃ dravyaṃ kāryyaṃ guṇānāñca guṇastathā kiṃ karmaṇāmapi karma kāryyamityata āha -- guṇavaidharmyānna karmaṇāṃ karma || 24 || kāryyamiti śeṣaḥ| dravyaguṇayoḥ sajātīyārambhakatvaṃ sādharmyamuktam| tatra karma karmasādhyaṃ na vidyate iti sūtreṇa karmaṇaāṃ karmajanakatvaṃ pratiṣiddhameva tadihānūdyate iti bhāvaḥ || 24 || <1-1-25> idānīṃ vyāsaḍyavṛttīnāṃ guṇānām anekadravyārabhyatvaṃ darśayannāha -- dvitvaprabhṛtayaḥ saṃkhyāḥ pṛthak‌tvasaṃyogavibhāgāśca || 25 || anekadravyārabhyā iti śeṣaḥ| dvitvādisamabhivyāhṛtaṃ puthak‌tvapadamapi dvipṛthak‌tvādiparam| evañca dvitvādikāḥ parārdhaparyyantāḥ saṅkhyā dvipṛthak‌tvādīni ca saṃyogā vibhāgāśca dvābhyāṃ bahubhiścaiva dravyairārabhyante ityanekavṛttitvamamīṣām| tacca samavāyyanyonyābhāvasāmānādhikaraṇyam || 25 || <1-1-26> nanvavayavidravyāṇāṃ guṇānāñcoktānāṃ yathāvyāsajyavṛttitvaṃ tathā karmaṇāmapi kiṃ na syādata āha -- asamavāyāt sāmānyakāryaṃ karma na vidyate || 26 || asamavāyādityatra dravyayordravyeṣviti yojyam, tathā ca na drayayorekaṃ karma samavaiti na vā dravyeṣvekaṃ karma samavaiti, tena sāmānyasya samudāyasya kāryaṃ karma na vidyate| atrāpi vidirjñānārtho na sattāvacanaḥ| yadi karma vyāsajyavṛtti syāt ekasmin dravye calati dvayordravyayorbahuṣu ca dravyeṣū calatīti pratyayaḥ syāt, na caitat tasmānna karma vyāsajyavṛttītyarthaḥ| nanu śarīratadavayavānāṃ karma śarīratadavayavairbahubhirārabhyata eva kathamanyathā śarīre calati karacaraṇādāvapi calatīti -- pratyayaḥ evamanyātrāpyavayavinoti cenna avayavikarmasāmagnyā avayavakarmasāmagrovyāptatvāt tathopalabdheḥ, na tu vaiparītyaṃ, na hyavayatave calati sarvatrāvayavini calatīti pratyayaḥ, anyathā kāraṇākāraṇasaṃyogāt kāryyākāryasaṃyogo'pi na syāt kāraṇakarmaṇava kāryasyāpi saṃyogopapatteḥ || 26 || <1-1-27> punarbahūnāmekaṃ kāryamāha saṃyogānāṃ dravyam || 27 || bahūnāṃ saṃyogānāṃ dravyamekaṃ kāryyamityarthaḥ| niḥsparśānāṃ dravyāṇaām antyāvayavināṃ vijātīyadravyāṇāñca ye saṃyogāstān vihāyeti draṣṭavyam || 27 || <1-1-28> idānīṃ bahūnāṃ guṇānāmekaṃ guṇakāryyamāha -- rūpāṇāṃ rūpam || 28 || rūpamekaṃ kāryamityanvayaḥ| rūpapadamubhayamapi lākṣaṇikam, ajahatsvārthā ceyaṃ lakṣaṇā| kāraṇaikārthasamavāyapratyāsattyā janyajanakabhāvāśrayatvañca śakyalakṣyasādhāraṇo dharmastena rūparasagandhasparśasnehasāṃsiddhikadravatvaikatvaikapṛthak‌tvāni saṃgṛhyante| ete hi kāraṇe varttamānāḥ kāryeṣu samānajātīyamekameva guṇamārabhante| dvidhā hyasamavāyikāraṇānāṅgatiḥ| kecit kāraṇaikārthapratyāsattyā janayanti, kāraṇamiha samavāyikāraṇaṃ tacca janyasya rūpādilakṣaṇasya kāryasya tena rūpādilakṣaṇasya yat samavāyikāraṇaṃ ghaṭādi tena saha kapāle vartamānaṃ rūpaṃ kāraṇaikārthasamavāyena ghaṭarūpamārabhate, evaṃ rasādyapi| kvacittu kāryaikārthapratyāsattyā'samavāyikāraṇatvam yathā kāraṇamapi śabdo nabhasi kāryamapi śabdāntaramārabhate, nabhasyeva rūpādyapi pārthivaparamāṇāvagnisaṃyogena kāryaikārthasamavāyapratyāsattyā janyate || 28 || <1-1-29> ekasya karmaṇo'nekakāryatvamāha -- gurutvaprayatnasaṃyogānāmutkṣepaṇam || 29 || utkṣepaṇamekaṃ kāryamamīṣāmityarthaḥ| atra gurutvasya hastaloṣṭhādivarttino nimittakāraṇatvam, prayatnavadātmasaṃyogasyāsamavāyikāraṇatvaṃ hastaniṣṭhotkṣepaṇasya, loṣṭhaniṣṭhotkṣepaṇasya tu hastanodanamasamasamavāyikāraṇam| atrāpyutkṣe paṇapadamavakṣepaṇādāvapi lākṣaṇikam || 29 || <1-1-30> nanu mūrttaguṇānāṃ kāryāṇāṃ kāraṇaguṇapūrvakatvaṃ svāśrayaguṇapūrvakatvañcoktam, dravyakarmaṇośca na karma kāraṇamityuktam tathāca karmaṇaḥ kimapi na kāryyamityāyātam, tathācātondriyāṇāṃ sūryyādigatīnām anumānamapi durlabhaṃ liṅgābhāvāt ataḥ saṃyogāvibhāgavegānāṃ karmeti sūtroktameva smārayannāha -- saṃyogavibhāgāśca karmaṇām || 30 || janyā iti śeṣaḥ| vyaktyabhiprāyeṇa bahuvacanaṃ saṃskāro'pyupalakṣaṇīyaḥ || 30 || <1-1-31> nanu dravyakarmaṇī na karmakārye iti pūrvamuktam, saṃyogavibhāgau tu saṃyogavibhāgakāryyāveva tathācedānīṃ karmaṇaḥ kāraṇatvābhidhānaṃ viruddhamityata āha -- kāraṇasāmānye dravyakarmaṇāṃ karmākāraṇamuktam || 31 || kāraṇasāmānyapadena tatprakaraṇamupalakṣyate tena kāraṇasāmānyābhidhānamakaraṇe dravyakarmaṇo prati karmaṇo'kāraṇatvamuktaṃ na tu sarvathāpyakāraṇameva karmeti vivakṣitam| yena `saṃyogavibhāgāśca karmaṇāmiti' sūtraṃ vyāhanyeteti bhāvaḥ || 31 || iti śāṅkare vaiśeṣikasūtropaskāre prathamādhyāyasya prathamāhnikam| prathamādhyāye dvitīyāhnikam <1-2-1> nanvanena praghaṭṭakena dravyādīnāṃ trayāṇāṃ padārthānāṃ kāryaikatvaghaṭitaṃ kāraṇaikatvaghaṭitañca sādharmyamuktam, taccānupapannaṃ kāryakāraṇabhāvasyaivāsiddherityata āha -- kāraṇābhāvātkāryābhāvaḥ || 1 || dṛśyate hi mṛccakrasalilakulālasūtrādau samavahite'pi daṇḍābhāvād ghaṭābhāvaḥ, bhūsalilādau samavahite'pi vījābhāvādaṅkarābhāvaḥ, sa ca daṇḍaghaṭayorbījāṅkurayorvā kāryakāraṇabhāvamantareṇānupapannaḥ| anyathā vemādyabhāve'pi ghaṭābhāvaḥ śilāśakalādyabhāve'pyaṅkurābhāvaḥ syāt| kiñca ghaṭapaṭādīnāṃ kādācitkatvamanubhūyate tadapi hetuphalabhāvamantareṇānupapannam, nahi kiñcitkālāsattve sati kiñcitkālasattvarūpaṃ kādācitkatvaṃ bhāvānāṃ kāraṇāpekṣāmantareṇa sambhavati tadā hi syādeva na syādeva vā natu kadācit syāt na hi bhāvo na bhavatyeva nāpyahetorbhavati nāpyakasmādeva bhavati, na vā nirupākhyādeva śaśaviṣāṇāderbhavati, kintu daṇḍavemādeḥ sopākhyasyāvadherghaṭapaṭādau kārye darśanāt avadhistu kāraṇameva| evaṃ kāryakāraṇabhāvābhāve pravṛttinivṛttī na syātām tathā ca nirīhaṃ jagajjāyeta na hīṣṭasādhanatājñānamantareṇa pravṛttiraniṣṭasādhanatājñānamantareṇa nivṛttiḥ || 1 || <1-2-2> nanu sadevotpadyate nāsat "sadeva saumyedamagra āsīt" ityādiśrutiprāmāṇyāt anyathā'sattvāviśeṣe tantubhya eva paṭo na kapālebhya iti niyamo na syāditi cet pariṇāmavādibhirapi svīkṛtakāraṇakairayaṃ niyamo'bhyupagantavya eva, anyathā ghaṭābhivyaktiḥ kapāleṣveva na tantuṣviti kathaṃ syāt| kiñca yadyabhivyaktirapi pūrvamāsīdeva tadā tasyā api nityatve āvirbhāvatirobhāvādhevotpādavināśāviti riktaṃ vacaḥ| athāvirbhāvatirobhāvau kāraṇāpekṣau, tadā ghaṭapaṭādīnāmapi kāraṇāpekṣaivāsatāmapyutpattirityāyātam| yattu kāraṇaṃ prati niyamānupapattirityuktam, tatra svabhāvaniyamenaivottaram| sa ca svabhāvaniyamo'nvayavyatirekāvagamyo bhavati, bhavati hi daṇḍamantareṇa na ghaṭo daṇ‍ḍe sati ghaṭa iti sarvasākṣiko'nubhavaḥ| evañvānanyathāsiddhaniyatapūrvavarttijātīyatvaṃ sahakārivaikalyaprayuktakāryābhāvavattvaṃ vā kāraṇatvam| yadyapi "yavairyajeta vrīhibhirvā" ityādau niyatapūrvavarttitvaṃ nāsti na hi yavakaraṇakayāganiṣpādye phale vrīhikaraṇakayāgasya pūrvavarttitvam tathāpi vikalpitaṃ vihitakāraṇaṃ kāraṇameva, phalaikajātye'pi dvayoḥ kāraṇatvopapatteḥ| tathā ca sahakārivaikalyaprayuktakāryyābhāvavattvaṃ lokavedasādhāraṇī kāraṇatā, niyatapūrvavarttitvantu anvayavyatirekagamyā kāraṇatā laukikī, nahi "svargakāmo yajeta" ityādau vyatirekabhāgo'pi viṣayaḥ pravṛtteranvayamātrajñānādevopapatteḥ, ata eva "vikalpe ubhayamaśāstrārthaḥ" ityapi ghaṭate, tajjātīyasya phalasya ekenaivopapatteraparānuṣṭhānavaiyarthyāt| ata eva "śrautāt sāṅgāt karmaṇaḥ phalāvaśyambhāvaniyamaḥ" ityapyucitam "āgamamūlatvāccāsyārthasya vyabhicāro na doṣāya" ityācāryābhidhānamṛjvarthatātparyyakameva| tṛṇāraṇimaṇisthale tu kāryavaijātyamāvaśyakaṃ tatrānvayavyatirekagamyatvāt kāraṇatāyā vyatirekādvyatirekasyāvaśyakatvāt| vikalpasthale tu phalavaijātyakalpane rājasūyavājapeyādāvapi vaikalpiko kāraṇatā syāditi kāryakāraṇabhāvaniyamamevopapādayannāha -- na tu kāryābhāvāt kāraṇābhāvaḥ || 2 || yadi kāryakāraṇabhāvaniyamo na bhavati tadā kāryābhāvādapi kāraṇābhāvaḥ syāt| kāryābhāvaḥ kāraṇābhāvaṃ pratyatantraṃ kāraṇābhāvastu kāryābhāvaṃ prati tantram, tena duḥkhābhāvārthaṃ janmābhāve, janmābhāvārthaṃ pravṛttyabhāve, tadarthañca doṣābhāve, tadarthaṃ mithyājñānanivṛttaye, tadarthañcātmasākṣātkārāya mumukṣūṇāṃ pravṛttiḥ prayojanamaupod‌ghātikasyāpyasya dvisūtrakaprakaraṇasya || 2 || <1-2-3> padārthatrayoddeśalakṣaṇānantaramidānīmuddiṣṭasya sāmānyapadārthasya lakṣaṇamāha -- sāmānyaṃ viśeṣa iti buddhyapekṣam || 3 || sāmānyaṃ dvividhaṃ paramaparañca| tatra paraṃ sattā aparaṃ sattāvyāpyaṃ dravyatvādi| tatra sāmānyasya tadviśeṣasya ca lakṣaṇaṃ buddhireva| anuvṛttabuddhiḥ sāmānyasya vyāvṛttabuddhirviśeṣasya| itinā dvayamavacchidya parāmṛśyate tena buddhyapekṣamiti napuṃsakanirdeśaḥ| vṛttikārastu viśeṣānvayamāha parantu "napuṃsakamanapuṃsakenaikavaccāsyānyatarasyām" ityanenaikavadbhāvo napuṃsakatā cetyāha -- buddhirapekṣā liṅgaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ vā yasya tad‌buddhyapekṣam| tatra nityamanekavyaktivṛtti māmānyam, nityatve sati svāśrayānyonyābhāvasāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ vā| paramapi sāmānyamaparamapi tathā'parantu sāmānyaṃ viśeṣasaṃjñāmapi labhate yathā dravyamidamityanuvṛttapratyaye satyeva nāyaṃ guṇo nedaṃ karmeti viśeṣapratyayaḥ tathā ca dravyatvādīnaṃ sāmānyānāmeva viśeṣatvam| nanu vidhirūpaṃ sāmānyaṃ nāstyeva anugatamateratad‌vyāvṛttyaivopapatteḥ bhavati hi gauravamiti pratīteragovyāvṛtto'yamiti viṣayaḥ jātivādinā'pi gotvādiviśiṣṭapratyayasya tadviṣayatvābhyupagamāt na hi vaiśiṣṭyamatadvyāvṛtteranyat, gavādipadapravṛttinimittepyagovyāvṛttyādireva| kiñca gotvaṃ kutra varttate na tāvad gavi gotvavṛtteḥ pūrvaṃ tasyābhāvāt, nāpyagavi virodhāt, yatra gopiṇḍa utpadyate tatra kuta āgatya gotvaṃ varttate, na tāvat tatraivāsīt deśasyāpi tasya gotvāpatteḥ| nāpi gotvamapi tadānīmevotpannaṃ nityatvābhyupagamāt, nāpyanyata āgataṃ niṣkriyatvābhyupagammat, na ca eksayaiva nityasya nānāvyaktivṛttitvaṃ kārtsnaikadeśavikalpānupapatteḥ| na hi kṛtsnamekatraiva vartate anyatra tadviśiṣṭapratyayānudayaprasaṅgāt| nāpyekadeśena, jāterekadeśasyābhāvāt| taduktaṃ -- na yāti na ca tatrāsīnnacotpannaṃ na cāṃśavat| jahāti pūrvaṃ nādhāramaho vyasanasantatiḥ || iti|| sāmānyamasti tacca saṃsthānamātravyaṅgyaṃ gotvaghaṭatvādivat na tu guṇakarmagatamapīti sagotrakalahaḥ| atrocyate sāmānyaṃ nityaṃ vyāpakañca vyāpakatvamapi svarūpataḥ savaideśasambaddhatvam| na deśānāṃ govyavahārāpattiḥ samavāyena tad‌vyavahārasyābyupagamāt kāle rūpādimattve'pi kālo rūpavānityapratītivyavahāravat| na ca kālo nāstyeva pañcaskandhasaṃjñābhedamātramityabhyupagamāditi vācyam kālasya sādhayiṣyamāṇatvāt| tathā ca yatra piṇḍa utpadyate tatrasthameva gotvaṃ tena sambadhyate jātaḥ sambaddhaścetyekaḥ kāla ityabhyupagamāt| etena kīdṛśyāśraye varttate ityatra yatra pratīyate ityuttaram| kutra pratīyate ityatra yatra vartate ityuttaram| gātvavṛtteḥ pūrva sa piṇḍaḥ kīdṛgāsīdityatra nāsīdityevottaram| evañca "na vāti na ca tatrāsīt" ityādikaṃ paridevanamātram| atadvyāvṛttireva gotvamityatra gaurayamiti vidhimukhaḥ pratyaya eva bādhakaḥ| na hyanubhavo'pi vyākhyāyate taduktam -- vidhijaḥ pratyayo'nyo'yaṃ vyatirekāsamarthakaḥ" iti| na hi gorayamiti pratyaye'govyāvṛttirapi bhāsate| kā'rtsnaikadeśavikalpastadā bhavet yadyekasya sāmānyasya kārtsnaṃ bhavedekadeśo vā| kṛrtsnatā hyanekāśeṣatā sā caikasminnopapannā| gaurayamityādyanubhava evāsadviṣayā na vastuvyavasthāpanakṣama iti| atrottaraṃ vakṣyate| prābhākarāstu saṃsthānamātravyaṅgyaṃ sāmānyamācakṣate| tad‌yadyanugatapratītisākṣikaṃ tadā kimaparāddhaṃ guṇakarmagataiḥ sāmānyaiḥ bhavati hi rūparasādāvanugatadhīḥ sā ca jātivyavasthāpikaiva bādhakābhāvāt| rūpatvādijātipu na tāvadvyaktyabhedo bādhakaḥ ākāśatvādivat, rūpasādivyaktīnāmanekatvāt| nāpi buddhitvajñānatvādivat ghaṭatvakalasatvādivadvā tulyatvaṃ bādhakam| taccānyūnānatiriktavyaktikatvam guṇatvāpekṣayā nyūnavyaktikatvāt nīlatvādyapekṣayā cādhikavyaktikatvāt| ata eva na saṅkaraḥ bhūtatvamūrttatvavat, parasparātyantābhāvasāmānādhikaraṇye sati jātyantareṇa sāmānādhikaraṇyābhāvāt| nāpyanavasthā rūpatvadigatasāmānyāntarānabhyupagamāt| nāpi rūpahānirviśeṣatvavat, yadi viśeṣāḥ dravyāśritatve sati jātimantaḥ syuḥ guṇāḥ karmāṇi vā syuḥ vibhuvṛttitve sati yadi jātimantaḥ syurguṇāḥ syuriti yathā viśeṣapadārthasvarūpahānistathā prakṛte'bhāvāt| nāpi samavāyatvavadasambandhaḥ samavāye samavāyābhyupagame'navasthābhayāttathāstu, prakṛte tu samavāyasyaiva sambandhasyābhyupagamāt| yadyapi samavāyatvajātibādhako vyaktyabheda eva tathāpi yanmate utpādavināśaśīlāḥ bahavaḥ samavāyāstanmataṃ draṣṭavyam| abhāvatvādijātyabhyupagame vā bādhakametat| vivādapadamanugatabuddhiḥ anugatanimittasādhyā abādhitānugatamatitvāt dāmakusumabuddhivat iti jātau mānamiti vṛttikārāstaccintyam || 3 || <1-2-4> sāmānyaṃ viśeṣa iti dvaividhyaṃ yaduktaṃ tadupapādayannāha -- bhāvo'nuvṛttereva hetutvāt sāmānyameva || 4 || bhāvaḥ sattā anuvṛttereva hetuḥ na tu vyāvṛtterapi hetuḥ! tathā ca viśeṣasaṃjñāṃ na labhate || 4 || keṣāṃ sāmānyānāṃ viśeṣasaṃjñetyapekṣāyāmāha -- dravyatvaṃ guṇatvaṃ karmatvañca sāmānyāni viśeṣāśca || 5 || cakāraḥ pṛthivītvādīni -- dravyarātajātīḥ, rūpatvādīni -- guṇagatajātīḥ utkṣepaṇatvādonikarmagatajātīḥ samuccinoti| dravyatvamityādāvasamāsaḥ parasparaṃ vyāpyavyāpakabhāvābhāvasūcanārthaḥ| sāmānyāni viśeṣāścetyatrā'samāsaḥ sāmānyatve satyeva viśeṣatvaṃ yathā jñāyeta tadartham, anyathā sāmānyaviśeṣā iti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsabhramaḥ syāt, tathā ca sāmānyatve sati viśeṣatvaṃ na pratīyeta| nanu dravyākārānugatamatisākṣikaṃ na dravyatvam, pṛthivyādau kathañcit tatsattve'pi vāyvākāśādau tadasambhavāt| na ca guṇatvāvacchinnakāryyasamavāyikāraṇatāvacchedakatayā tatsiddhiḥ nityānityavṛttitayā guṇatvasya kāryyatānavacchedakatvāt, guṇatvārthamapi paryanuyogasya tādavasthyāt| maivam saṃyogatvāvacchinnakāryasamavāyikāraṇatāvacchedakatayā dravyatvasiddheḥ| sā hi na pṛthivītvādyavacchedyā nyūnavṛttitvāt, nāpi sattāvacchedyā'dhikavṛttitvāt avaśyaṃ hyavacchedakena bhavitavyam, anyathākasmikatāvatteḥ| tatraparamāṇuṣu dvyaṇukāsamavāyikāraṇavattayā dvyaṇukeṣu tryaṇukāsamavāyikāraṇavattayā vibhucatuṣṭayasya sarvamūrttasaṃyogitayaiva siddheḥ nabhasi indriyamanaḥsaṃyogādhāratayā vāyau tṛṇādinādanāśrayatayā pratyakṣadravyeṣu pratyakṣatayaiva saṃyogābhyupagamasyāvaśyakatvāt| ajastu saṃyogo nāstyeva yena saṃyogatvasyāpi kāryyākāryavṛttitayā kāryatāvacchedakatā na myāt| eva vibhāgasamavāyikāraṇatāvacchedakatayā'pi dravyatvasiddheḥ supratipadatvāt| guṇatvantu saṃyogavibhāga samavāyikāraṇatvāsamavāyikāraṇatvaśūnye māmānyavati yat kāraṇatvaṃ tadavacchedakatayaiva siddhamityuktatvāt| karmatvamapi pratyakṣadravyeṣu calatīti pratyayasākṣikam| anyatra tu saṃyogavibhāgānumeyama saṃyogavibhāgobhayāsamavāyikāraṇatāvacchedakatayā'pi karmatvasiddherāvaśyakatvāt| ata evādityasya deśāntaraprāptyā gatyanumānam, tatra ca deśāntarasyākāśāderatīndriyatve'pi tatkiraṇasaṃyogavibhāgayostanmaṇḍalena pratyakṣatvāt tata eva gatyanumānam| deśāntaraprāptimān ādityaḥ avināśitve dravyatve ca sati prāṅmukhopalabdhasya pratyaṅmukhena tenaivopalabhyatayā pratyabhijñāyamānatvāditi deśāntara prāptyā anubhitayā ādityagatyanumānamityud‌dyotakarācāryāḥ || 5 || <1-2-6> nanu ya eva viśeṣapadārtha uddiṣṭaḥ sa evaṃ kiṃ sāmānyaviśeṣatvenābhidhīyate iti śiṣyākāṅkṣāmapanayannāha -- anyatrāntyebhyo viśeṣebhyaḥ || 6 || antyā viśeṣā nityadravyavṛttayo ye'bhihitāḥ tān varjayitvā sāmānyaviśeṣābhidhānamityarthaḥ| ante'vasāne bhavantītyantyā, yato na vyāvarttakāntaramastītyācāryyāḥ| utpādavināśayorante'vasāne bhavantītyantyā nityadravyāṇi teṣu bhavantītyantyā viśeṣā iti vṛttikṛtaḥ| te hi viśeṣā eva tryāvṛttibuddhihetavo na tu sāmānyarūpā apīti || 6 || <1-2-7> sattāsāmānyamityatra bahūnāṃ vipratipattiratastatra pramāṇamāha -- saditi yatodravyaguṇakarmasu sā sattā || 7 || itikāreṇa yato pratyayavyavahārayoḥ prakāramupadiśati| tathā ca dravyādiṣu triṣu satsaditiprakārako yataḥ pratyayaḥ sadidaṃ sadidamityākārakaḥ śabdaprayogo vā yadadhīnaḥ sā sattā || 7 || <1-2-8> nanu dravyaguṇakarmabhyaḥ pṛthag‌bāvena sattā nānubhūyate'to dravyādyanyatamameva sattā yato hi yad bhinnaṃ bhavati tattato bhedenānubhūyate yathā ghaṭaḥ paṭāt, na ca sattā tebhyo bhedenānubhūyate iti tadātmikaivetyata āha -- dravyaguṇakarmabhyo'rthāntaraṃ sattā || 8 || dravyādayo'nanugatāḥ sattā cānugatā| tathā ca anugatatvānanugatatvalakṣaṇaviruddhadharmādhyāsena tebhyo bhedasya siddhatvāt| yattu tebhyoḥ'nyatra nopalabhyate tadayutasiddhibalāt ghaṭapaṭayostu yutasiddhiḥ| na ca vyaktisvarūpameva sattā, vyaktīnāmananugamāt| svarūpatvaṃ yadyanugataṃ tadā saiva sattā, ananugatairapi svarūpairanugatavyavahāraścettadā gotvādibhirapi gatam| ata eva yatra sattā samavaiti tādṛśairādhāraireva tadvyavahāropapattau kiṃ sattayetyapāstam| ata evārthakrayikāritvaṃ vā prāmāṇikatvaṃ sattvamityayuktaṃ tadananusandhāne'pi san iti pratyayāt || 8 || <1-2-9> bhedakāntaramāha -- guṇakarmasu ca bhāvānna karma na gaṇaḥ || 9 || na guṇo na karmeti vaktavye vyatyayenābhidhānaṃ na dravyamityapi sūcayati| na hi karma karmasu varttate na vā guṇo guṇeṣu na vā dravyaṃ guṇe karmaṇi vā, sattā tu guṇekarmaṇi ca varttate tena dravyaguṇakarmavaidharmyāttebhyo bhinnaiva sattā || 9 || <1-2-10> bhedakāntaramāha -- sāmānyaviśeṣābhāvena ca || 10 || yadi sattā dravyaṃ guṇaḥ karma vā syāt tadā sāmānyaviśeṣavatī syāt| na ca sattāyāṃ sāmānyaviśeṣā dravyatvādaya upalabhyante na hi bhavati sattā dravyaṃ guṇaḥ karma veti keṣāñcidanubhavaḥ || 10 || <1-2-11> evaṃ sattāyā dravyaguṇakarmabhyo'rthāntaratvamabhidhāya dravyatvasya tebhyo'rthontaratvamāha -- anekadravyavattvena dravyatvamuktam || 11 || anekaṃ dravyaṃ samavāyitayā yasyāsti tadanekadravyavat| anekapadamiha sarvaparaṃ tena pṛthivītvādibhyo bhedaḥ, nityatvantu sāmānyalakṣaṇaprāptameva tenāvayavibhyo bhedaḥ, anekadravyavattvañca anekadravyamātrasamavetatvaṃ tena sattāyā bhedaḥ| tena nityamanekadravyamātrasamavetaṃ dravyatvam, ajaḥ saṃyogo neṣyata ityuktam| dravyatvañca sādhitameva| dravyatvamuktamiti| dravyatvamapi sattāvadeva vyākhyātamityarthaḥ || 11 || <1-2-12> nanu dravyatvamapi jātiḥ syāśrayādabhinnameva syāt ko doṣa ityata āha -- sāmānyaviśeṣābhāvena ca || 12 || yadi dravyatvaṃ jātirdravyādyātmikaiva syāt tadā tasyāṃ pṛthivotvajalatvatejastvādayaḥ sāmānyaviśeṣāḥ syurityarthaḥ| na hi bhavati dravyatvaṃ pṛthivī jalaṃ tejo veti keṣāñcit pratyaya ityarthaḥ || 12 || <1-2-13> guṇatvamāha -- tathā guṇeṣu bhāvād guṇatvamuktam || 13 || guṇeṣveva bhāvāt samavāyāt guṇatvaṃ dravyaguṇakarmabhyo bhinnaṃ sattāvadevoktamityarthaḥ || 13 || <1-2-14> bhedakāntaramāha -- sāsānyaviśeṣābhāvena ca || 14 || yadi dravyaguṇakarmabhyo guṇatvamatiriktaṃ na bhavettadā dravyatvaguṇatvakarmatvaṃ tadavāntarajātimattayā upalabhyetetyarthaḥ || 14 || <1-2-15> dravyaguṇakarmabhyo bhedakaṃ karmatvasyāha -- karmasu bhāvāt karmatvamuktam || 15 || karmasveva bhāvāt samavāyāt karmatvamapi jātyantaraṃ dravyaguṇakarmabhyo bhinnamuktaṃ sattāvadityarthaḥ || 15 || <1-2-16> bhedakāntaramāha -- sāmānyaviśeṣābhāvena ca || 16 || karmatvaṃ yadi dravyādyātmakaṃ bhavettadā dravyatvādisāmānyaviśeṣastatra samaveyādityarthaḥ| seyamekākārā catuḥsūtro sattādravyatvaguṇatvakarmatvānāṃ catasṛṇāṃ jātīnāṃ dravyaguṇakarmabhedapratipādanāya ekaprakaraṇenoktetyavadheyam || 16 || <1-2-17> nanu sattā dravyaguṇakarmasu varttamānā dravyatvādyavacchedabhedena bhinnaiva kathaṃ na syādata āha -- saditiliṅgāviśeṣād viśeṣaliṅgābhāvāccaiko bhāvaḥ || 17 || sadityākārakaṃ jñānaṃ śabdaprayogo vā sattāyā liṅgam| tacca dravyaguṇakarmasu samānamaviśiṣṭam| tena bhāvaḥ sattā ekaiva teṣu varttate anyathā dravyatvādibhistulyavyaktikatayā sattā vā na syāt tāni vā na syuḥ| viśeṣaliṅgābhāvācceti| viśeṣo bhedastatra yalliṅgamanumānaṃ tadabhāvācca na bheda ityarthaḥ| bhavati hi sa evāyaṃ dīpa ityanugamastatra yathā viśeṣaliṅgaṃ dīrghahrasvatvādiparimāṇabhedastathātra viśeṣaliṅga nāstīti bhāvaḥ || 17 || iti śrībhagavatkaṇādasūtropaskāre śāṅkare prathamādhyāyasya dvitīyamāhnikam| <2> <3-1-1> dvitīyādhyāyasya prathamāhnikasya navānāṃ dravyāṇāṃ lakṣaṇamarthaḥ| tatra pṛthivyaptejasāṃ lakṣaṇaprakaraṇam, īśvarasiddhiprakaraṇam, ākāśānumānaprakaraṇam| tatra prathamoddiṣṭāyāḥ pṛthivyā lakṣaṇamāha -- rūparasagandhasparśavatī pṛthivī || 1 || rūpaṃ nīlapītādyanekaprakāraṃ pṛthivyā eva, tathāca nīlarūpasamānādhikaraṇadravyatvavyāpyajātimattvaṃ lakṣaṇam| evaṃ rasaḥ kaṭukaṣāyādyanekaprakārakaḥ pṛthivyāmeva, tathāca kaṭurasasamānādhikaraṇadravyatvavyāpyajātimattvaṃ lakṣaṇam| evaṃ kaṣāyādipadaprakṣepeṇa lakṣaṇānyūhanīyāni| gandho dvividhaḥ surabhirasurabhiśca, tathāca gandhasamānādhikaraṇadravyatvavyāpyajātimattvaṃ lakṣaṇam tathā gandhasamānādhikaraṇagandhāsamānādhikaraṇaguṇāsamānādhikaraṇajātyadhikaraṇadravyatvaṃ draṣṭavyam| na ca pāṣāṇādau gandharasayorananubhavāt tatrātryāpakamidamubhayamapīti vācyam tatrāpātato gandharasayorananubhave'pi tadīyabhasmasu tadupalambhāt ya evādhayavāḥ pāṣāṇārambhakāsta eva tadbhasmārambhakā apīti nāvyāptiḥ| katha tarhi surabhiḥ samīraṇaḥ tiktaṃ kāravellajalamitipratītiriti cenna pāthiṃvopādhikatvāt tayorgandharasayoḥ! sparśo'pyanuṣṇāśītaḥ pākajaḥ pṛthivyāmeva tathāca pākajasparśasamānādhikaraṇadravyatvavyāpyajātimattvaṃ lakṣaṇam| pākajatvañca viśeṣāntaravyaṅgyaṃ pṛthivīsparśa eva, viśeṣāntarañca śirīṣalavaṅgīkuṣṭumādau sparśaviśeṣe sphuṭataram na tvevaṃ jalādisparśe| yadyapyavayavini pākādagnisaṃyogāt sparśādayo najāyante tathāpi tatparamparāprabhavatayā tatrāpi vaijātyaviśeṣo'nusaraṇīyaḥ| nanu lakṣaṇāmidaṃ vyatirekiliṅgamitarabhedasādhakaṃ vyavahārasādhakaṃ vā? tatra pṛthivītarebhyo bhidyate gandhavattvāt yannetarabhinnaṃ tanna gandhavat yathā jalādi, itarabhedābhāvavyāpakābhāvapratiyogigandhavatī ceyaṃ, tasmāditarabhinnā| tatretarabhedasya sādhyasya prasiddhau tato hetorvyatireke sapakṣavipakṣavyāvṛttatayā'sādhāraṇyam avyatireke cānvayitvam| aprasiddhau ca aprasiddhaviśeṣaṇaḥ pakṣaḥ| tathā ca tatra na sandeho, na vā siṣādhayiṣā na vā tadviśiṣṭajñānarūpā'numitiḥ| kiñca vyatirekayorvyāptistathā ca na vyāptasya pakṣadharmatvaṃ pakṣadharmasya na vyāptatvamiti vaiṣa myam| ata evopanayavaiyarthyamapi vyākhyāyate na tvagṛhītavyāptikamapi| taduktam -- sādhyāprasiddhivaiṃṣamyaṃ vyarthatopanayasya ca| anvayenaiva siddhiśca vyatirekiṇi dūpaṇam || iti| evaṃ vyavahārasādhyake'pi| tatra yadyapi vyavahāraḥ pṛthivīpadavācyatvam tacca pṛthivītvajātāvapyasti tatra ca pṛthivītvaṃ ddeturnāstītyasādhāraṇyam tathāpi pṛthivītvapravṛttinimittakapṛthivīpadavācyatvaṃ sādhyamiti nāsādhāraṇyam| yadvā pṛthivītvaṃ kvācitkapadapravṛttinimittaṃ jātitvāt ghaṭatvavaditi sāmānyataḥ siddhau pṛthivīpadaṃ pṛthivītvapravṛttinimittakam itarāpravṛttinimittakatve sati sapravṛttinimittakatvāt yannaivaṃ tannaivamiti sādhyam| tathācātrāpi sādhyāprasiddhireveti cet| maivam itareṣāṃ jalādīnām bhedasya ghaṭa eva prasiddheḥ| vāyvāderatīndriyasyāpi bhedasya anyonyābhāvasya ghaṭādau pratyakṣata eva siddhatvāt anyonyābhāvagrahe adhikaraṇayogyatāmātrasya tantratvāt stambhaḥ piśāco na bhavatītyādau tathā darśanāt| na caivaṃ ghaṭa evaha dṛṣṭānto'stu kiṃ vyatirekiṇā| ṛjumārgeṇa siddhyantaṃ ko hi vakreṇa sādhayet| iti vācyam avyatirekiliṅgaṃ cedanābhāsaṃ, tadā'yamapi mārgo vakrarūciṃ pratyapratihata eva| sādhyāprasiddhernirāse tanmūlakadoṣāṇāṃ nirastatvāt| vyatirekasahacāreṇa anvayavyāptereva grahāt vyatirekavyāptyā'nvayavyāpteranumānādvā na vaiṣamyam| nacopanayavaiyarthyam, gṛhītavyāptereva hetoḥ pakṣe upasaṃhārāt| taduktam -- niyamyatvāniyantṛtve bhāvayoryādṛśo mate| ta eva viparīte tu vijñeye tadabhāvayoḥ || iti| vyavahārastu gandhavatī pṛthivītyupadeśādeva yathā kambugrīvādimān ghaṭapadavācya iti| tathā kutracideva ghṛtādau mṛdādau ca gandhavattvenopalakṣaṇena pṛthivītbe pṛthivopadapravṛttinimittatvaṃ yenopadeśād gṛhītam, gandhavat sarvaṃ pṛthivītvena pravṛttinimittena pṛthivīpadavācyaṃ gandhavattvāt yannaivaṃ tannaivamiti vyatirekī tasyāpyavataratyeva| nanu bhedasadhakavyatirekiṇi bhedo vaidharmyaṃ svarūpabhedo vā anyonyābhāvo vā? na tāvadādyau pratyakṣata eva tadavagamāt| na tṛtīyaḥ abhāvabhedasyāpi sādhyatvena tadanyonyābhāvasya tatrābhāvāt, tena saha svarūpabhede sādhye sādhyānanugamāditi cenna abhāvapratiyogikānyonyābhāvasyāpi sādhyatvāt sa yadyatiriktastadā'styeva na cet svarūpamādāya tatparyyavasānāt| vastuto bhinna eva tadvaidharmyasya tadanyonyābhāvavyāpyatvāt, na cānavasthā yāvatyevānubhavastāvatyevāviśrāmāt anyatra tvananubhavenaiva viśrāmāt| yattu trayodaśānyonyābhāvāstrayodaśasu prasiddhāḥ militāḥ pṛthivyāṃsādhyante iti tattṛcchaṃ pratyekaṃ prasiddheratantratvāt militaprasiddherabhāvāt kintu nirgandhatvāvacchinnapratiyogitākānyonyābhāvaḥ sādyeta pratiyogitāvacchedakabhedenābhāvabhedasyāvaśyakatvāt sa ca ghaṭādāveva pratyakṣasiddha ityuktatvāt| ākāśādau kā gatiriti cet ākāśamitarabhinnaṃ śabdāśrayatvāt yannaivaṃ tannaivamityādau pakṣaikadeśe yadyapi na sādhyaṃ prasiddham tathāpi yad yadvaidharmyavat tat tatpratiyogikānyonyābhāvavaditi sāmānyapravṛttavyāptibalena śabdāśrayatvātyantābhāvavatpratiyogikānyonyābhāvasya pūrvameva siddhau kevalaṃ pakṣaniṣṭhatayā idānīṃ bodhyate vahniriva parvatanuṣṭhatayā ityanyo'smatsiddhāntaḥ tadvaidharmyasya tadanyonyābhāvavyāpyatvāt| śabdāśrayatvātyantābhāvavattvameva vipakṣe na gṛhītamiticet tarhi śabdāśrayatvasya na lakṣaṇatvaṃ na vā liṅgatvaṃ vipakṣagāmitva śaṅkāgrastatvāditi || 1 || <3-1-2> pṛthivyanantaramuddiṣṭānāmeṣāṃ lakṣaṇamāha -- rūparasasparśavatya āpo dravāḥ snigdhāḥ || 2 || śuklamadhuraśītā eva rūparasasparśāḥ dravyatvañca sāṃsiddhikaṃ snehastu svarūpaḥ| nanu śuklameva rūpamapāmityayuktam kālindījalādau nailyasyopalambhāt| madhura eva rasa ityapyayuktam jambīrakaravīrarasādau āmlyataiktyāderupalambhāt| śīta eva sparśa ityapyanupapannam madhyandine auṣṇyasyaivopalambhāt| sāṃsiddhikañca dravatvamavyāpakam himakarakādāvabhāvāt| snehastu svarūpāsiddho'tivyāpakaśca jale'nanubhavāt ghṛtādau pārthive'nubhavācca| na ca jalatvaṃ jātireva jalalakṣaṇam vyavasthāpakābhāvena tadanupapatteḥ| na ca snehasamavāyikāraṇatāvacchedakatvena tatsiddhiḥ snehatvasya kāryyākāryavṛttitayā kāryatānavacchedakatvāt tasmādbhedakābhāvād jalaṃ na bhidyata iti, cenmaivam abhāsvaraśuklamātrarūpasyaiva tadbhedakatvāt kālindījalādau nelyasyāśrayopādhikatvāt viyadvikīrṇakālindījale dhāvalyasyopalambhāt| tenābhāsvaraśukletararūpāsamānādhikaraṇarūpavad‌vṛttidravyatvasākṣād‌vyāpyajātimattvam apāṃ lakṣaṇam| rasopi madhura eva jambīrakavīrarasāmlyataiktyādeḥ pārthivopādhikatvāt| jale mādhuryyaṃ nānabhūyata eveti cenna kaṣāyadravyabhakṣaṇānantaraṃ tadabhivyakteḥ| na ca harītakyā eva tanmādhuryyaṃ jalābhivyaṅgyam tatra kaṣāyarasasyaivopalambhāt harītakyāñcāmalakyāmiva kaṣāya eva rasaḥ tasyaivānubhavāt| na ca guṇavirodhena tatra rasānārambhaḥ| avayavānāmapi tatra kaṣāyarasavattvāt ṣaḍrasatvapravādastu tattadrasakāryyakāritvanibandhanaḥ| citrarasastu pramāṇābhāvādeva nirastaḥ citrarūpe tu paṭopalambha eva pramāṇam surabhyasurabhyavayavārambhastu guṇavirodhanirasta eva citragandhe pramāṇābhāvāt| tasmāddharītakībhakṣaṇānantaraṃ yanmādhuryyamapalabhyate tat jalasyaiva, ulbaṇatā tu dravyaviśeṣasannidhānādhīnā śrīkhaṇḍasanniyogājjale śaityolbaṇateva| karkaṭībhakṣaṇānantarantu tiktatā yā'nubhūyate sā karkaṭyā eva tadavayave jalapānamantareṇāpi tiktatopalambhāt, rasanāgravarttipittadravyatiktatāyā vā tatrānubhavāt| tathā ca madhuretararasāsamānādhikaraṇarasasamānādhikaraṇadravyatvasākṣād‌vyāpyajātimattvamapāṃ lakṣaṇam| evaṃ śītasparśasamānādhikaraṇadravyatvavyāpyajātimattvamapāṃ lakṣaṇam| madhyandine tu yadauṣṇyaṃ tattejasa eva tadanvayavyatirekānuvidhānāt| evaṃ sāṃsiddhikadravatvaṃ svarūpata eva lakṣaṇam sāṃsiddhikadravatvavad‌vṛttidvavyatvavyāpyajātimattvaṃ vā jalatvam| snehastu guṇaviśeṣo na tu dugdhatvavat sāmānyaviśeṣaḥ snigdhasnigdhatarasnigdhatameti tāratamyapratīteḥ| na ca jātau tāratamyaṃ sambhavati| nanu bhavatu sneho guṇaḥ sa tu jale vartata ityatra kiṃ pramāṇamiti cenna saktusikatādau jalena saṃgrahe tadanumānāt| saṅgraho hi snehadravatvakāritaḥ saṃyogaviśeṣaḥ sa hi na dravatvamātrādhīnaḥ kācakāñcanadravatvena saṅgrahānupapatteḥ, nāpi snehamātrakāritaḥ styānairghṛtādibhiḥ saṅgrahānupapatteḥ, tasmādanvayavyatirekābhyāṃ snehadravatvakāritaḥ| sa ca jalenāpi saktusikatādau dṛśyamānaḥ ranehaṃ jale draḍhayati| iyañca pratyakṣopaṣṭambhikaiva yuktiḥ snehasya pratyakṣatvāt| ghṛtādau tu raneha upaṣṭambhakajalaniṣṭhaḥ saṃyuktasamavāyena tadgatatayā bhānāt| evaṃ tailarasādiṣvapi| upaṣṭambhakañcātiśayitasnehameva jalam, snehādhikyādeva tasya jalasya nānalavirodhitvam| yadi pṛthivīviśeṣaguṇaḥ snehaḥ syāt sarvapārthivavṛttiḥ syāt gandhavat| jalatvaṃ ca dravyatvasākṣād‌vyāpyajātiḥ snehavanmātravṛttisaṃyogagasamavāyikāraṇatāvacchedikāyā jāteḥ paramāṇusādhāraṇyena siddhatvāt || 2 || <3-1-3> uddeśakramānurodhena tejolakṣaṇamāha -- tejo rūpasparśavat || 3 || rūpaṃ bhāsvaraṃ sparśaścoṣṇastadvatteja ityarthaḥ| nanu bhāsvaratvaṃ paraprakāśakatvaṃ tādṛśañca rūpaṃ noṣmaṇi na vā cāmīkarasthe bharjanakapālasthe vāristhe vā tejasi, śuklañca rūpamukteṣu na kvāpi, uṣṇaśca sparśo na cāndre na vā cāmīkare tat kathametaditi cenna ūṣmādau tejastvena bhāsvararūpānumānāt| tejastvameva tatra svarūpāsiddhamiti cenna uṣṇasparśavattvena tadanumānāt| cāmīkare kathamiti cet tatra bhāsvararūpābhāve'pi atyantānalasaṃyogenānucchidyamānajanyadrāvatvādhikaraṇatvena vyatirekiṇā tejastvānumānāditi vakṣyamāṇatvāt, bharjanakapālādiniṣṭhe coṣṇasparśavattvena tejastvānumānāt| caturvidhaṃ hi tejaḥ kiñcidud‌bhūtarūpasparśaṃ yathā sausadi, kiñcidudbhūtarūpamanudbūtaspaśai yathā cāndram, kiñcidanudbhūtarūpasparśaṃ yathā nāyanam, kiñcidanudbhūtarūpamudbhūtasparśaṃ yathā naidāghaṃ vāribharjanakapālādigatañca tejaḥ| nāyanamagre sādhayiṣyate || 3 || <3-1-4> kramaprāptaṃ vāyulakṣaṇamāha -- sparśavān vāyuḥ || 4 || 1 -- rūpāsamānādhikaraṇasparśasamānādhikaraṇajātimattvam 2 -- rasāsamānādhikaraṇānuṣṇāśītasparśasamānādhikaraṇajātimattvam 3 -- gandhāsamānādhikaraṇānuṣṇāśītasparśasamānādhikaraṇajātimattvam| 4 -- sparśetaraviśeṣaguṇāsamānādhikaraṇaviśeṣaguṇasamānādhikaraṇajātimattvaṃ vā vāyulakṣaṇam || 4 || <3-1-5> nanvākāśakāladigātmanāmapi rūpādimattvaṃ kathaṃ na lakṣaṇamata āha -- ta ākāśe na vidyante || 5 || atra vidirupalabdhivacanaḥ nopalabhyante yato'to na te rūpādayo niyogataḥ -- samuccayato vikalpato vā vartante nabhaḥprabhṛtiṣu dravyeṣvityarthaḥ| nanu dadhidhavalamākāśamiti kathaṃ pratītiriti cenna mihiramahasāṃ viśadarūpāṇāmupalambhāttathābhimānāt| kathaṃ tarhi nīlaṃ nabha iti pratītiriti cenna sumerordakṣiṇadiśamākramya sthitasyendranīlamayaśikharasya prabhāmālokayatāṃ tathābhimānāt| yattu sudūraṃ gacchaccakṣuḥ parā rtamānaṃ svacakṣuḥkanīnikāmākalayattathābhimānaṃ janayatīti mataṃ tadayuktam piṅgalasāranayanānāmapi tathābhimānāt| ihedānīṃ rūpādikamitipratyayāt dik‌kālayorapi rūpādicatuṣkamiti cenna samavāyena pṛthivyādīnāṃ tallakṣaṇasyoktatvāt na tu sambandhāntareṇāpi ihedānīṃ rūpātyantābhāva ityapi pratīteḥ sarvādhārataiva dikkālayoḥ || 5 || <3-1-6> nanvapāṃ dravatvaṃ lakṣaṇamuktaṃ tadayuktam pṛthivyāmapi dravatvopalambhādityata āha -- sarpirjatumadhūcchiṣṭānāmagnisaṃyogād dravatvamadbhiḥ sāmānyam || 6 || sarpirādīnāṃ yad‌dravatvamasti tadagnisaṃyogānnimittāt na tu sāṃsiddhikam tādṛśañcāpāṃ lakṣaṇam dravatvamātrantu pṛthivyā adbhiḥ sāmānyaṃ na tu sāṃsiddhikaṃ dravatvamapīti nātivyāptirityarthaḥ || 6 || <3-1-7> nanu tathāpi trapusīsalohādau tejasi gatatvena tadavasthaivātivyāptirityata āha -- trapusīsaloharajatasuvarṇānāmagnisaṃyogād dravatvamadbhiḥ sāmānyam || 7 || upalakṣaṇañcaitat kāṃsyatāmrārakūṭapāradādīnāmapyupasaṃgrahaḥ| śakya lakṣyasādhāraṇañca atyantāgnisaṃyogānucchidyamānajanyadravatvādhikaraṇatvameva tathāca suvarṇādīnāmapi dravatvaṃ naimittikameva nimittasyāgnisaṃyogasyānvayavyatirekasiddhatvāt, parantu pūrvasūtre'gnipadamauṣṇyaprakarṣavattejaḥparam, iha tu vahniparamiti viśeṣaḥ| nanu suvarṇādīnāmapi pārthivatvameva dravyāntaratvaṃ vāpītimagurutvādeḥ pārthivatvavyavasthāpakatvād dravatvānucchedasya pṛthivīvaidharmyasyāpyanubhavāt dravyāntaratvavyavasthāpakatvāditi cenna suvarṇaṃ taijasam atyantāgnisaṃyoge'pyanucchidyamānadravatvādhikaraṇatvāt yannaivaṃ tannaivaṃ yathā pṛthivīti vyatirekiṇā taijasatvasiddheḥ| na ca jalaparamāṇau viruddhatā dravatvasyānityatvena viśeṣaṇīyatvāt| na ca pradopādeḥ sapakṣārddhatorvyāvṛtterasādhāraṇyam suvarṇaṃ na pārthivamiti sādhyārthatvāt| na cātra gurutvādhārasya pakṣatve bādhaḥ tadatiriktasya pakṣatve cāśrayāsiddhiḥ, dravatvādhikaraṇatvena pakṣatvāt| na cātyantikatvaṃ durvacam, praharaparyyantamagnisaṃyoge'pyanucchidyamānānityadravatvādhikaraṇatvāditi vivakṣitatvāt| na ca taratamādipratyayādāśrayanāśācca dravatvanāśo'pyavaśyaṃ vācya iti vācyam samānādhikaraṇadravatvasāmagryasamavahitāgnisaṃyogajanyadhvaṃsapratiyogyavṛttidravatvasāmānyavaddravatvavattvādityasya hetvarthatvāt| yadvā pītimagurutvāśrayaḥ pītarūpabhinnarūpapratibandhakadravadravyasaṃyuktaḥ praharaparyyantamanalasaṃyoge'pi pītarūpabhinnarūpānāśrayatvāt analasaṃyuktajalamadhyasthitapītapaṭavat| nanu cāndhakāre suvarṇarūpagrahāpattistadānīṃ tadrūpasyābhibhavābhāvāt balavatsajātīyagrahaṇakṛtasyāgrahaṇasyābhibhavapadārthatvāt iti cenna tatra phalabalena balavatsajātīyasambandhamātrasyābhibhavapadārthatvāt| taduktam -- bhūsaṃsargavaśāccānyarūpaṃ naiva prakāśate| iti dik || 7 || <3-1-8> evaṃ sparśavaddravyacatuṣkalakṣaṇaprakaraṇaṃ samāpya vāyorlakṣaṇamāśrayāsiddhamiti tatparijihīrṣayā ādāvanumānaṃ pramāṇamupanyasyānumānasyaiva prathamaṃ dṛṣṭānusāreṇa pramāṇyamupapādya vāyusādhanaprakaraṇamārabhate -- viṣāṇī kakudmān prāntebāladhiḥ sāsnāvān iti gotve dṛṣṭaṃ liṅgam || 8 || yathā gotvaṃ prati viṣāṇādoni liṅgāni gṛhītavyāptikāni tathā'tīndriyavāyvādidravyapañcakaliṅgānyapi sāmānyatā dṛṣṭāni pramāṇabhāvamāsādayantīti bhāvaḥ| atra yadyapi viṣāṇitvamātraṃ na gotve liṅgaṃ mahiṣādau vyabhicārāt, na ca sāsnādimattvaṃ viśeṣaṇam viśeṣyasya vyarthatvāpatteḥ tathāpi goviṣāṇe mahiṣameṣādiviṣāṇāpekṣayā vailakṣaṇyamākalayatāṃ dhūma iva te te viśeṣā liṅgabhāvamāsādayantyeva viṣāṇeṣvapi ṛjutvavakratvakaṭhinatvasukumāratvahrasvatvadīrghatvādayaḥ| te ca viśeṣāḥ nipuṇataravedyāḥ santyeva tathāca vyavahitaviprakṛṣṭagopiṇḍe ayaṃ gaurviṣāṇaviśeṣavattvāt pūrvānubhūtagopiṇḍavadityanumānamapratyūhameva| evaṃ kukudvattāpi liṅgaṃ gotve| prāntebāladhimattvamapi svatantrameva liṅgaṃ gotve prānte bālā ādhīyante'sminniti prāntebāladhiḥ pucchaviśeṣaḥ aluk‌samāsāt gopuccha evānte bāladhiśabdenocyate, na hi yathā gopuccheṣu prāntebāladhitvaṃ tathā'śvameṣādipuccheṣu, teṣāṃ sāmastyena bālamayatvāt, mahiṣādipucchetādṛśī pralambatā nāstīti vailakṣaṇyāt| antebāladimattvamapi gotve liṅgaṃ matub‌lopāt gopiṇḍa ucyate, tathā cāyaṃ gauḥ prāntebāladimattvāt pūrvānubhūtagopiṇḍavat| sāsnāvattā tu prasiddhaiva gotve liṅgam || 8 || <3-1-9> evaṃ sakalalokayātravāhino'numānasya dṛṣṭvānusāreṇa prāmāṇyamabhidhāya vāyusādhanaprakaraṇamāripsamāna āha -- sparśaśca vāyoḥ | 9 || liṅgamiti śeṣaḥ| cakārāt śabdadhṛtikampāḥ samuccīyante| nanūpalabhyamānasparśaḥ pṛthivyā evānud‌bhūtarūpāyāḥ syāditi cenna ud‌bhūtasya pṛthivīsparśasyodbhūtarūpanāntarīyakatvāt| tathāca yo'yaṃ sparśo'nubhūyate sa kvacidāśritaḥ sparśathvāt pṛthivyādisparśavaditi sāmānyatodṛṣṭena sparśāśrayasiddhau sparśāśrayo na pṛthivyāditrayātmakaḥ nīrūpatvāt nākāśādipañcātmakaḥ sparśavattvāditītarabādhasahakṛtenāṣṭadravyātiriktadravyasiddhiḥ| evaṃ śabdaviśeṣo'pi vāyau liṅgam, tathāhi asati rūpavaddravyābhighāte yo'yaṃ parṇādiśabdasantānaḥ sa sparśavadvegavaddravyābhighātanimittakaḥ avibhajyamānāvayavadravyasambandhiśabdasantānatvātdaṇḍābhighātajabherośabdasantānavat| rūpavaddravyābhighātavyatirekastu yogyānupalabdhigamyaḥ| tacca sparśavadvegavaddravyamaṣṭadravyātiriktameva pariśeṣāt| evaṃ dhṛtiviśeṣo'pi vāyorliṅgam tathāhi tṛṇatūlastanayitnuvimānānāṃ nabhasi dhṛtiḥ sparśavadvegavaddravyasaṃyogajā cetanānadhiṣṭhitadravyadhṛtitvāt pravāhe tṛṇakāṣṭhanaukādidhṛtivat| abhidhyānakṛtaviṣādidhṛtau ca asmadādyadhiṣṭhānameva| evaṃ pakṣikāṇḍādadhṛtāvapi| na ceśvarādhiṣṭhitatvena hetuviśeṣaṇāsiddhiḥ cetanapadena taditarasya vivakṣitatvāt| evaṃ kampo'pi vāyusattve liṅgam tathāhi idaṃ rūpavad‌dravyābhighātamantareṇa tṛṇādau karma sparśavadvegavad dravyābhighātajaṃ gurutvaprayatnavadātmasaṃyogadravatvasaṃskārāṇāmupagrahaḥ tenaṃ tadajanyakarmatvaṃ hetuḥ| nanu pratyakṣa eva vāyuḥ kimatra liṅgagaveṣaṇayeti cenna vāyurna pratyakṣaḥ norūpabahirdravyatvāt gaganavadityanumānādatīndriyatvasyaiva siddheḥ| nanu vāyuḥ pratyakṣaḥ sparśāśrayatvād ghaṭavaditi pratyakṣatvānumānamiti cenna ud‌bhūtarūpavattvasyātropādhitvāt ca| na rūpādāvātmani ca sādyāvyāpakametat, pakṣadharmabahirdravyatvāvacchinnasya sādhanadharmā vacchinnasya vā sādhyasya vyāpakatvāt| na ca cākṣuṣapratyakṣatvaṃ tattantraṃ tatraiva tadanvayavyatirekānuvidhānāt spārśanapratyakṣatve tu yogyasparśavattāmātrasya tantrateti vācyam rūpānvayavyatirekayorubhayatrāpi tantratvāt, na hyubhayasidsparśenaiva pratyakṣatā rūpasya grahamantareṇa dṛṣṭā| kiñca yadi vāyuḥ pratyakṣaḥ syāt saṅkhyādisāmānyaguṇopalambhe'pi tantraṃ syāt| nanvastyeva phūt‌kārādau saṅkhyāyāḥ parimāṇasya ca hastavitastyādeḥ ubhayapārśvavartinorvāyvoḥ pṛthak‌tvasya ca paratvāpaparatvayośca pratyakṣatā vāyujātīyasya vyaktiparatayā tu na tavāpi niyamaḥ pṛṣṭhalagnavastrādau tadanupalambhāditi cenna ñyaktiparatayaiva niyamāt pṛṣṭhalagnavastrādau cārjavāvasthāne saṅkhyādīnāṃ grahaṇāt, anārjavāvasthānadoṣāttu tadagrahaḥ| ud‌bhūtarūpasparśau militāveva bahirdravyapratyakṣatve tantre prabhāyā nayanagatapītadravyasya candramahasaśca tparśānudbhavādapratyakṣatvam nidāghoṣmaṇorvibhaktāvayavāpyadravyāṇāñca rūpānudbhavādapratyakṣatvamiti nyāyavārttikatātparyyaṭīkākṛtaḥ| sparśānudbhave'pi prabhādīnāṃ pratyakṣataiva ata eva cāndrāloke nabhasi pakṣikāṇḍādisaṃyogavibhāgayoḥ pratyakṣataiveti sampradāyavidaḥ| na cod‌bhūtasparśavattvaṃ sāmānyato bahirdravyapratyakṣatāprayojakamiti vācyam, indranīlaprabhāyā apratyakṣatāpatteḥ| na cod‌būtaviśeṣaguṇavattvameva tantram ākāśasyāpi pratyakṣatāpatteḥ| na ca janyamahattva samānādhikaraṇod‌bhūtaviśeṣaguṇavattvaṃ tathā rasanāgravarttipittadravyasya taiktyodbhave'pyapratyakṣatvāt, tasmādudbhūtarūpavattvamevātmetaradravyapratyakṣatātantram tacca vāyau nāstītyapratyakṣo vāyuḥ || 9 || <3-1-10> nanu pratyakṣato dṛṣṭamiha liṅgaṃ nāsti na hi vahnidhūmayoriveha pratyakṣeṇa vyāptigrahaḥ| kiñca pṛthivyādyanyatamasyeva sparśo'pyayaṃ bhaviṣyatītyata āha -- na ca dṛṣṭānāṃ sparśa ityadṛṣṭaliṅgo vāyuḥ || 10 || ayaṃ sparśo yaḥ pakṣaḥ kriyate sa dṛṣṭānāṃ pṛthivyaptejasāṃ na bhavati rūpāsahacaratvāt, tathā cāyaṃsparśaḥ kvicidāśrita ityanumeyamityadṛṣṭaliṅgaḥ| sāmānyatodṛṣṭaliṅgo'pi pakṣadharmatābalādāyāta ityarthaḥ| yadyapi dṛṣṭameva sparśādicatuṣkaṃ liṅgamiti tathāpi vāyunā sahāgṛhītavyāptikatvādadṛṣṭaliṅgatvamuktam na hyayaṃ dharmī vāyuriti pratijñāya vāyuḥ sādhayituṃ śakyate, tathāca sāmānyatodṛṣṭādevetaravāsahakṛtādvāyusiddhiriti bhāvaḥ || 10 || <3-1-11> upalabhyamānasparśāśrayamavayavinaṃ sādhayitvā paramāṇulakṣaṇaṃ vāyuṃ sādhayitumāha -- adravyavattvena dravyam || 11 || dravyamāśrayabhūtamasyāstīti dravyavat na dravyavat adravyavat dravyānāśritamityarthaḥ| tathā cākāśavat paramāṇulakṣaṇo vāyurdravyam anyeṣāṃ padārthānāṃ dravyāśritatvāt| āśritatvañcānyatra nityadravyebhya ityabhidhānāt paramāṇubhyāṃ dvyaṇukārambhāt dvyaṇukādiprakrameṇāvayavino mahata ārambhasyopapādanīyatvāditi || 11 || <3-1-12> vāyuparamāṇordravyatvasādhakaṃ hetudvayaṃ samuccinvannāha -- kriyāvattvād guṇavattvācca || 12 || vāyuparamāṇurdravyamiti śeṣaḥ| yadyapi dravyatve siddhe krivāvattvaṃ guṇavattvañca sidhyati tat‌siddhau ca dravyatvasiddhirityanyonyāśrayaḥ tathāpyupalabhyamānasparśāśrayasyāvayavino mūlabhūtasya paramāṇorasamavāyikāraṇasaṃyogānyathānupapattyā kriyāvattvam, avayavisparśarūpādeḥ kāraṇaguṇapūrvakatvaniyamād guṇavattvañca siddhaṃ tābhyāñcadravyatvamityadoṣaḥ| tatra kriyāvattvaṃ sapakṣaikadeśavṛttiguṇavattvañca sapakṣavyāpakam| cakārāt samavāyikāraṇatvaṃ dravyatvasādhakaṃ samuccinoti| nanu paramāṇāveva na pramāṇaṃ kasya dravyatvaṃ sādhyata iti cenna sthūlakāryyasya kriyāvibhāgādinyāyena bhajyamānasyālpataratamādibhāvāt yato nālpīyaḥ sa eva paramāṇuḥ| avayavāvayaviprasaṅgasyānavadhitve anantāvayavatvāviśeṣe sumerusarṣapādīnāṃ parimāṇāviśeṣāpattiḥ kāraṇasaṃyakhyāviśeṣamantareṇa parimāṇāpracayayorapi parimāṇabhedaṃ pratyatantratvāt| na ca vināśāvadhirevāyam avayavāvayaviprasaṅgaḥ antyasya niravayavatvena vināśānupapatteḥ sāvayavatve ca niravadhitvāpattestatra ca doṣasyoktatvāt| nanu truṭirevāvadhirdṛśyamānatvādadṛśyamānakalpanāyāṃ mānābhāvāditi cenna tasya cākṣuṣadravyatvayorāvaśyakatvāt tasmāt trasareṇvavayavāvayava eva paramāṇuryathā pṛthivyādau tathā vāyāvapīti siddho vāyuparamāṇuḥ || 12 || <3-1-13> nanu kriyāvattvād guṇavattvācca ghaṭādivat paramāṇoranityatvamanumeyamata āha -- adravyatvena nityatvamuktam || 13 || paramāṇulakṣaṇavāyoriti śeṣaḥ| dravyaṃ hi samāvāyikāraṇāsamavāyikāraṇānyataranāśānnaśyati paramāṇostu niravayavatayā na tadubhayamasti tathāca vināśakābhāvānna vinaśyati| kriyāvattve guṇavattve ca hetau sāvayavatvamupādhiḥ| sa ca pakṣadharmadravyatvāvacchinnasādhyavyāpakaḥ kevalasādhyavyāpakastu prāgabhāvapratiyogitvamupādhiḥ || 13 || <3-1-14> dvyaṇukādiprakrameṇārambhasiddhau siddhamapi vāyunānātvaṃ prakārāntareṇāpi sādhayitumāha -- vāyorvāyusaṃmūrcchanaṃ nānātvaliṅgam || 14 || vāyusaṃmūrcchanamiti| vāyvorvāyūnāṃ vā saṃmūrcchanaṃ saṃyogaviśeṣaḥ| sa ca samānavegayorviruddhadik‌kriyayoḥ sannipātaḥ| sa ca tṛṇatūlakāderūrdhvagamanenānumīyate| vāyvorūrdhvagamanasya sannipātasya cātīndriyatvāt| tṛṇādīnāntu pratyakṣāṇāmūrdhvagamanalakṣaṇāyāḥ kriyāyāḥ pratyakṣāyāḥ sparśavadvegavad‌dravyābhighātanodanānyatarajanyatvamanumīyate| tathāhi tiryyaggamanasvabhāvasya vāyorūrdhvagamanaṃ parasparapratīghātamantareṇānupapadyamānaṃ parasparapratīghātaṃ sādhayati nadīpayaḥpūrayostathādarśanāt tadūrdhvagamanañca tṛṇādyūrdhvagamanānumeyaṃ na hi tṛṇadīnāmūrdhvagamanaṃ sparśavadvegavad‌dravyābhighātanodanānyatarad vineti || 14 || <3-1-15> nanvadṛṣṭaliṅgo vāyurityuktaṃ tathā ca kathametadityata āha -- vāyusannikarṣe pratyakṣābhāvād dṛṣṭaṃ liṅgaṃ na vidyate || 15 || dṛṣṭaṃ hi liṅgaṃ yatra pratyakṣeṇa vyāptigrahastaducyate yathā dhūmo'raneḥ| vāyusannikarṣe ca vāyunā sahāvinābhāve pratyakṣaṃ nāsti na hi bhavati yo yaḥ sparśakampādimān sa vāyuriti kasyacit pratyakṣaṃ vāyorevāpratyakṣātvādata eva tādṛśaṃ pratyakṣagṛhītavyāptikaṃ liṅgaṃ nāstītyarthaḥ || 15 || <3-1-16> tarhi vāyoranumānameva kathamityata uktameva draḍhayitumāha -- sāmānyatodṛṣṭāccāviśeṣaḥ || 16 || anumānaṃ hi trividhaṃ pūrvavat śeṣavat sāmānyatodṛṣṭam| tathā cāyamanubhūyamānasparśaḥ kvacidāśritaḥ sparśatvāt guṇatvādveti samānyatodṛṣṭādevetarabādhasahakṛtāt aṣṭadravyātiriktadravyāśritatvaṃ sidhyatītyarthaḥ| gataṃ tarhi kevalavyatirekiṇeti cenna itarabādhānantaraṃ yatra sāmānyato dṛṣṭa pravarttate tatrāṣṭadravyānāśritatvaṃ pakṣaviśeṣaṇaṃ siddhamādāya aṣṭadrañyānāśrito'yaṃ sparśaḥ kvacidāśrita iti pratijñārtho'ṣṭadravyātiriktadravyāśritatvamanādāya na paryyavasyatītipratītyarthāparyyavasannatayā'nvayina eva tatsiddhiḥ| yatra tu pūrvameva bādhāvatārāt sāmānyatodṛṣṭaṃ tatra pratītyarthaparyyavasānāt kevalavyatirekotyabhyapagamāt| prakārārtha kevalavyatirekīti tu tucchameva uktasthale prakārasyānvayina evopasthiteḥ| vyāpakatāvacchedakaprakārikaivānumitiritiniyamastvaprāmāṇikaḥ sāmagrīviśeṣasācivyāt prakārāntarabhāvanyāpi sambhavāt || 16 || <3-1-17> nanu cāviśeṣa iti vāyurayamityākāsa'numitirna bhavati kintvaṣṭadravyātiriktadravyāśritatvenaiva prakāreṇeti vivakṣitaṃ yadi tadā tasya dravyasya vāyusaṃjñāyā kiṃ mānamata āha -- tasmādāgamikam || 17 || yasmādviśeṣākāreṇa nānumitiḥ tasmādvāyuriti nāma āgamikam, āgamo vedastataḥ siddhamityarthaḥ| `vāyurvai kṣepiṣṭhā devatā' `vāyavyaṃ śvetaṃ chāgalagālabheta' `vāyavyaṃ śvetaṃ chāgalagālabheta' ityādividhiśeṣībhūtārthavādādeva vāyusaṃjñādhigatiḥ| yathā -- yanna duḥkhena sambhinnaṃ na ca grastamanantaram| ityādyarthavādāt svargasaṃjñāyāḥ| vasante sarvaśasyānāṃ jāyate patraśātanam| modamānāśca tiṣṭhanti yavāḥ kaṇiśaśālinaḥ|| ityarthavādāt yavasaṃjñāyāḥ, `ambujo vetasaḥ' ityarthavādāt vetasasaṃjñāyāḥ, `varāhaṃ gāvo'nudhāvanti' ityarthavādāt varāhasaṃjñāyāḥ| anyathā `svargakāmo yajeta' ityādau viśiṣṭasukhānupasthitau yāgādiṃṣu svargārthināṃ pravṛttirna syāt na syācca `yavamayaścarurbhavati' `vaitase kaṭe prājāpatyaṃ dhinoti' `vārāho copānat' ityādau mlecchaprasiddhimanurudhya pravṛttyanadhyavasāyaḥ| mlecchā hi yavavarāhavetasaśabdān kaṅguvāyasajambuṣu prayuñjate tathācārthavādamantareṇa sandehaḥ syādityāgamādeva tattadarśapratītiriti bhāvaḥ| nāmamātramāgamikaṃ dravyasiddhistu sāmānyato dṛṣṭādeva || 17 || <2-1-18> evaṃ vāyuprakaraṇaṃ samāpya tat kimunmādijalpitaḍitthaḍavitthasaṃjñāvat vāyusaṃjñāpītyāgamasya sarvajñapraṇītatvamupapādayan aupod‌ghātikamośvaraprakaraṇamāripsamāna āha -- saṃjñā karmma tvasmadviśiṣṭānāṃ liṅgam || 18 || tuśabdaḥ sparśādiliṅgavyavacchedārthaḥ| saṃjñā nāma, karma kāryyaṃ kṣityādiḥ tadubhayamasmadviśiṣṭānām īśvaramaharṣīṇāṃ sattve'pi liṅgam || 18 || <2-1-19> kathametadityata āha -- pratyakṣapravṛttatvāt saṃjñākarmaṇaḥ || 19 || atrāpi saṃjñā ca karma ceti samāhāradvandvādekavadbhāvaḥ saṃjñākarttuṃrjagatkarttuścābhedasūcanārthaḥ| tathāhi yasya svargāpūrvādayaḥ pratyakṣāḥ sa eva tatra svargāpūrvādisaṃjñāḥ kartumīṣṭe pratyakṣe caitramaitrādipiṇḍe pitrādeścaitramaitrādisaṃjñāniveśanavat| evañca ghaṭapaṭādisaṃjñānivasenavat| evañca ghaṭapaṭādisaṃjñāniveśanamapi īśvarasaṅketādhīnameva yaḥ śabdo yatreśvareṇa saṅketitaḥ sa tatra sādhuḥ yathā yā kācidoṣadhirnakuladaṃṣ‌ṭrābhraspṛṣṭā sā sarvā'pi sarpaviṣaṃ hantītyetādṛśī saṃjñā asmadādiviśiṣṭānāṃ liṅgamanumāpakaṃ, yā'pi maitrādisaṃjñā pitrā putre kriyate sā'pi `dvādaśe'hani pitā nāma kuryyāt' ityādividhinā nūnamośvaraprayuktaiva tathāca siddhaṃ saṃjñāyā īśvaraliṅgatvam| evaṃ karmāpi kāryyamapīśvare liṅgam tathāhi kṣityādikaṃ sakartṛkaṃ kāryyatvāt ghaṭavaditi| atra yadyapi śarīrājanyaṃ janyaṃ vā janyaprayatnājanyaṃ janyaṃ vā sakartṛkatvāsakartṛkatvena vivādādhyāsitaṃ vā sandihyamānakartṛkatvaṃ vā kṣityāditvena na vivakṣitam adṛṣṭadvārā kṣityāderapi janyaprayatnajanyatvāt vivādasandehayoścātiprasaktatvena pakṣatānavacchedakatvāt, kiñca sakartṛkatvamāpa yadi kṛtimajjanyatvaṃ tadā'sbhadādinā siddhasādhanam asmadādikṛterapyadṛṣṭadvārā kṣityādijanakatvāt, upādānagocarakṛtimajjanyatve'pi tathā asmadādikṛterapi kiṃñcidupādudānagocaratvāt, kāryyatvamapi yadi prāgabhāvapratiyogitvaṃ tadā dhvaṃse vyabhicāra iti| tathāpi kṣitiḥ sakartṛkā kāryyatvāt| atra ca sakartṛkatvamadṛṣṭādvārakakṛtimajjanyatvaṃ kāryyatvañca prāgabhāvāvacchinnasattāpratiyogitvam| na cāṅkurādau sandigdhānaikāntikatvam sādhyābhāvaniścaye hetusadasattvasandehe sandigdhānaikāntikatvasya doṣatvāt anyathā sakalānumānocchedaprasaṅgāt na ca pakṣātirikte doṣo'yamiti vācyam rājājñāpatteḥ, nahi doṣasyāyaṃ mahimā yat pakṣaṃ nākrāmati| tasmādaṅkurasphuraṇadaśāyāṃ niścitavyāptikena hetunā tatra sādhyasiddherapratyūhatvāt kva sandigdhānaikāntikatā tadasphuraṇadaśāyāntu sutarāmiti saṃkṣepaḥ || 19 || <2-1-20> evaṃ sūtrābhyāmīśvaraprakaraṇaṃ samāpyākāśaprakaraṇamāripsamāna āha -- niṣkramaṇaṃ praveśanamityākāśasya liṅgam || 20 || itiśabdaḥ prakārārthaḥ, utkṣepaṇādīnyapi karmāṇi saṃgṛhṇāti| sparśavaddravyasañcāro niṣkramaṇaṃ praveśanañca tadakāryyasyākāśasya liṅgamiti sāṅkhyāḥ || 20 || <2-1-21> tadetad dūṣayitumāha -- tadaliṅgamekadravyatvāt karmaṇaḥ || 21 || niṣkramaṇapraveśanādikarma na tāvat samavāyikāraṇatayā ākāśamanumāpayati karmaṇa ekadravyatvāt ekamātramūrttasamāvāyikāraṇakatvāt, na karmāpi vyāsavyavṛttītyuktaṃ na vā'mūrttavṛttīti || 21 || <2-1-22> nanu cāsamavāyikāraṇatayaivākāśamanumāpayiṣyati niṣkramaṇapraveśanādotyata āha -- kāraṇāntarānuklṛptivaidharmyācca || 22 || anuklṛptirlakṣaṇam anukalpyate jñāpyate'neneti vyutpattyā, kāraṇāntarasya asamavāyikāraṇasya yā'nuklṛptirlakṣaṇaṃ tad‌vaidharmyādityarthaḥ| dravyantāvadasamavāyikāraṇaṃ na bhavatyeva| asamavāyikāraṇatā ca kāraṇaikārthapratyāsattyā kāryyaikārthapratyāsattyā ca| prathamā tanturūpāṇāṃ paṭarūpaṃ prati, iyañcāsamavāyikāraṇatā mahatītisaṃjñāṃ labhate gurupratipattikatvāt| dvitīyā ca yathā ātmamanaḥsaṃyogasya jñānādikaṃ prati, iyañcāsamavāyikāraṇatā laghvīti saṃjñāṃ labhate laghupratipattikatvāt| ākāśasya tu niṣkramaṇapraveśanādau karmaṇi na samavāyikāraṇatā nāpyasamavāyikāraṇatā| tathā ca na ca karmākāśasattve liṅgamiti || 22 || <2-1-23> nanu nimittakāraṇamastu karmaṇyākāśam, dṛśyate hyākāśe pakṣikāṇḍādīnāṃ sañcaraṇamata āha -- saṃyogādabhāvaḥ karmaṇaḥ || 23 || mūrttasaṃyogena karmakāraṇasya vegagurutvādeḥ pratibandhāt karmaṇo'bhāvo'nutpādo na tvākāśābhāvāt tasya vyāpakatvāt| tasmādākāśānvayo'nyathāsiddha eva nākāśanimittatāṃ sādhayatītyarthaḥ || 23 || <2-1-24> evaṃ sāṅkhyāmate dūṣite śabdamākāśe liṅgamupapādayiṣyan pariśeṣānumānāya pīṭhamāracayannāha -- kāraṇaguṇapūrvakaḥ kāryaguṇo dṛṣṭaḥ || 24 || pṛthivyādilakṣaṇe kārye ye viśeṣaguṇā rūpādayaste kāraṇaguṇapūrvakā dṛṣṭāḥ| śabdo'pi viśeṣaguṇaḥ jātimattve sati bāhyaikendriyamātrabhāhyatvāt rūpādivat| tathā ca tādṛśaṃ kāryaṃ nopalabhyate yatra kāraṇaguṇapūrvakaḥ śabdaḥ syādityarthaḥ || 24 || <2-1-25> nanu vīṇāveṇusṛdaṅgaśaṅkhapaṭahādau kārye śabda upalabhyate tathāca tat‌kāraṇaguṇapūrvakaḥ syādata āha -- kāryāntarāprādurbhāvācca śabdaḥ sparśavatāmaguṇaḥ || 25 || bhavedevaṃ yathā tantukapālādiṣu rūparasādyanubūyate tatsajātīyañca rūparasāntaraṃ paṭaghaṭādāvupalabhyate tathā vīṇāveṇumṛdaṅgādyavayaveṣuḥ yaḥ śabda upalabdhastat‌sajātīyaścet vīṇāveṇumṛdaṅgādyavayavinyupalabhyeta na caivam| pratyuta niḥśabdairevāvayavairvīṇādyārambhadarśanāt, nīrūpaistu tantukapālādibhiḥ paṭaghaṭādyārambhasyādarśanāt| kiñca yadi śabdaḥ sparśavatāṃ viśeṣaguṇaḥ syāt tadā tatra tāratārataramandamandatarāpadabhāvo nānubhūyita na hyekāvayavyāśritā rūpādayo vaicitreyaṇānubhūyante tasmānna sparśavadviśeṣaguṇaḥ śabdaḥ || 25 || <2-1-26> nanvātmaguṇo manoguṇo vā śabdo bhaviṣyatītyata āha -- paratra samavāyāt pratyakṣatvācca nātmaguṇo na manoguṇaḥ || 26 || śabdo yadyātmaguṇaḥ syāt tadā'haṃ sukhoyate jāne icchāmītyādivat ahaṃ pūryye ahaṃ vādye ahaṃ śabdavānityādi dhīḥ syāt natvevamasti, kintu śaṅkhaḥ pūryyate ahaṃ vādye ahaṃ śabdavānityādi dhīḥ syāt natvevamasti, kintu śaṅkhaḥ pūryyate vīṇā vādyate iti pratiyanti laukikāḥ| kiñca śabdo nātmaguṇaḥ bāhyendriyagrāhyatvāt rūpādivat api ca śabdo yadyātmayogyaviśeṣaguṇaḥ syādbadhireṇāpyupalabhyeta duḥkhādivat tasmāt sudhṭhūktaṃ paratra samavāyāditi| amanoguṇatve hetumāha -- pratyatvāditi| nātmamanasorguṇa iti samāse karttavye yadasamāsakaraṇaṃ tena tulyanyāyatayā pratyakṣatvādityanenaiva hetunā dikakālayorapi guṇatvaṃ śabdasya pratiṣiddhamiti sūcitam || 26 || <2-1-27> yadathamayaṃ pariśeṣastadāha -- pariśeṣālliṅgamākāśasya || 27 || śabda iti śeṣaḥ| atrāpi śabdaḥ kvacidāśrito guṇatvāt rūpādivaditi sāmānyatodṛṣṭādaṣṭadravyātiriktadravyasiddhiḥ| guṇaścāyaṃ vāhyaikendriyagrāhyajātī yatvāt rūpādivat, anityatve sati vibhusamavetatvāt jñānādivat| anityatvañca sādhayiṣyate| pariśeṣasiddhasya dravyasyāvayavakalpanāyāṃ pramāṇābhāvānnityatvaṃ sarvatra śabdopalabdheviṃbhutvam || 27 || <2-1-28> śabdaliṅgasya dravyasya dravyatvanityatve atideśena sādhayannāha -- dravyatvanityatve vāyunā
