vyākhyāte || 28 || adravyavattvādyathā vāyornityatvaṃ tathākāśasyāpi, guṇvattvād yathā vāyordravyatvaṃ tathākāśasyāpītyarthaḥ || 28 || <2-1-29> tat kiṃ bahūnyākāśāni ekameva vetyata āha -- tattvambhāvena || 29 || vyākhyātamiti vipariṇatenānvayaḥ| bhāvaḥ sattā sā yathaikā tathākāśamapyekamevetyarthaḥ || 29 || <2-1-30> nanvanugatapratyayamahimnā sattāyā ekatvaṃ siddham ākāśe kathamekatvaṃ tad‌dṛṣṭāntena setsyatītyata āha -- śabdaliṅgāviśeṣādviśeṣaliṃgābhāvācca || 30 || tattvamākāśasya siddhimityarthaḥ| vaibhave sati sarveṣāṃ śabdānāṃ tadekāśrayatayaivopapattāvāśrayāntarakalpanāyāṃ kalpanāgauravaprasaṅgaḥ| anyadapi yadākāśaṃ kalpanīyam tatrāpi śabda eva liṅgam taccāviśiṣṭam na ca viśeṣasādhakaṃ bhedasādhakaṃ liṅgāntaramasti| ātmanāṃ yadyapi jñānādikamaviśiṣṭameva liṅgaṃ tathāpi vyavasthāto liṅgāntarādātmanānātvasiddhiriti vakṣyate || 30 || <2-1-31> nanvākāśasya ekatvaṃ tāvadastu, vaibhavāt paramamahattvamapyastu, śabdāsamavāyikāraṇatvāt saṃyogavibhāgāvapi syātām ekapṛthaktvaṃ kathamata āha -- tadanuvidhānādekapṛthaktvañceti || 31 || niyamenaikapṛthaktvamekatvamanuvidhatte ityekapṛthaktvasiddhiḥ| itirāhnikaparisamāptau mānasapratyakṣāviṣayaviśeṣaguṇavaddravyalakṣaṇamāhnikārthaḥ| tena caturdaśaguṇavatī pṛthivī, te ca guṇā rūparasagandhasparśasaṅkhyāparimāṇapṛthaktvasaṃyogavibhāgaparatvāparatvagurutvadravatvasaṃskārāḥ| tāvanta eva gandhamapīsya snehena sahāpām| eta eva rasagandhasnehagurutvānyapāsya tejasaḥ| gandharasarūpagurutvasnehadravatvānyapāsya vāyoḥ| śabdena saha saṅkhyādipañcaguṇavattvamākāśasya| saṅkhyādipañcakamātraṃ dikkālayoḥ| paratvāparatvavegasahitaṃ saṅkhyādipañcakaṃ manasaḥ| saṅgyādipañcakaṃ jñānecchāprayatnāśceśvarasya || 31 || iti śrīśāṅkare vaiśeṣikasūtropaskāre dvitīyādhyāya -- syādyamāhnikam|| dvitīyādhyāye dvitīyāhnikam <2-2-1> idānīṃ bhūtānāṃ lakṣaṇāni gandhādīni parīcikṣiṣurgandhādīnāṃ svābhāvikatvamaupādhikatvañca vyavasthāpayannāha -- puṣpavastrayoḥ sati sannirṣe guṇāntarāprādurbhāvo vastre gandhābhāvaliṅgam || 1 || rūparasagandhasparśā yatra kāraṇaguṇaprakrameṇotpadyante tatra svābhāvikāḥ santo lakṣaṇatāmupayanti nānyathā, na hi samīraṇa upalabhyamānaṃ saurabhaṃ śilātale upalabhyamānaṃ śaityaṃ jale upalabhyamānamauṣṇyaṃ vā lakṣaṇaṃ bhavati tadetadāha -- puṣpavastrayoriti| na hi kanakaketakīkusumasannikṛṣṭe vāsasi kanakaketakīśaurabhanupalabhyamānaṃ vāsavaḥ| na hi vāsasaḥ kāraṇaguṇaprakrameṇa tadutpannam, kintarhi? kanakaketakīsannidhānādaupādhakaṃ, na hi vastre gandhābhāve ketakīgandhābhāvo liṅgam| kiṃ liṅgamata uktaṃ guṇāntarāprādurbhāva iti| guṇāntarāt kāraṇaguṇāt aprādurbhāvo'nutpattiḥ yadi hi vastre yo gandha upalabhyate sa tasya svābhāvikaḥ syāttadā tadavayaveṣa tantuṣu ketakīsannikarṣāt pūrvaṃ tatra vastre colapabhyeta na caivamityarthaḥ| tathāca vivādādhyāsito gandho na vastrasamavetaḥ tadavayavaguṇājanyaviśeṣaguṇatvāt śītoṣṇasparśādivat || 1 || <2-2-2> svābhāvikaṃ gandhaṃ pṛthivyā lakṣaṇamāha -- vyavasthitaḥ pṛthivyāṃ gandhaḥ || 2 || pṛthivyāṃ vyavasthito'yogānyayogābhyāṃ paricchinnaḥ samānāsamānajātīyavyāvarttakatayā gandho lakṣaṇamityarthaḥ| bhavati hi pṛthivī gandhavatyeva, pṛthivyeva gandhavatyeva, pṛthivyeva gandhavatīti, tadevaṃ samānajātīyebhyo jalādyaṣṭabhyo'samānajātīyebhyo guṇādipañcabhyo vyāvarttakaḥ svābhāvikaḥ pṛthivyāṃ gandha iti vyavasthitam || 2 || <2-2-3> gandhasya svābhāvikatvavyavasthāpanaprakāramuṣṇatāyāṃ tejolakṣaṇe'pyatidiśannāha -- etenoṣṇatā vyākhyātā || 3 || abādilakṣaṇe śaityādāvapyayamatideśo draṣṭavyaḥ || 3 || <2-2-4> tejolakṣaṇaṃ parokṣate -- tejasa uṣṇatā || 4 || svābhāvikyuṣṇatā tejolakṣaṇamityarthaḥ| rūpamapi śuklabhāsvaramupalakṣyate || 4 || <2-2-5> apāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ parīkṣate -- apsu śītatā || 5 || svābhāvikī śītatā apāṃ lakṣaṇamityarthaḥ| tathāca śilātalaśrīkhaṇḍādau nātivyāptiriti bhāvaḥ| śītatayā rūparasāvapyuktalakṣaṇau snehaṃ sāṃsiddhikadravatvañcopalakṣayati| nanu uddeśalakṣaṇakramabhaṅgaḥ kuta iti cenna tejaḥsparśasya pṛthivījalasparśayorabhibhāvakatvasūcanāya tayormadhye tejaḥparīkṣāyā uktatvāt, vāyuparīkṣāsūcanārthaṃ vā kramalaṅghanam| tathā cāpākajānuṣṇāśītasparśo vāyoḥ svābhāvikaḥ san lakṣaṇamityunneyamiti tātparyyam || 5 || <2-2-6> tadevaṃ kāraṇaguṇapūrvakāḥ sparśavatāṃ viśeṣaguṇāḥ gandhādayaḥ pṛthivyādīnāṃ lakṣaṇānītyuktam| idānīṃ kramaprāptaṃ kālalakṣaṇaprakaraṇamārabhamāṇa āha -- aparasminnaparaṃ yugapat ciraṃ kṣipramiti kālaliṅgāni || 6 || itikāro jñānaprakāraparaḥ pratyekamabhisambadhyate, tathācāparamitipratyayo yugapaditipratyayaḥ ciramitipratyayaḥ kṣipramitipratyayaḥ kālaliṅgānītyarthaḥ| aparasminnaparamityanena parasmin paramityapi draṣṭavyam tenāyamarthaḥ bahutaratapanaparispandāntaritajanmani sthavire yuvānamavadhiṃ kṛtvā paratvamutpadyate tacca paratvamasamavāyikāraṇasāpekṣam| na ca rūpādyasamavāyikāraṇaṃ vyabhicārāt trayāṇāṃ gandhādīnāṃ vāyau paratvānutpādaka vāt| sparśasyāpyuṣṇādibhedena bhinnasya pratyekaṃ vyabhicārāt| na cāvacchinnaparimāṇaṃ tathā tasya vijātīyānārambhakatvāt, tapanaparispandānāñca vyadhikaraṇatvāt| tadavacchinnadravyasaṃyoga evāsamavāyikāraṇa pariśiṣyate tacca dravyaṃ piṇḍamārttaṇḍobhayasaṃyuktaṃ vibhu syāt| ākāśasya tatsvābhāvyakalpane kvacidapi bheryabhidhātāt sarvabherīṣu śabdotpattiprasaṅgaḥ| tathāca kālasyaiva mārttaṇḍakriyopanāyakaḥ| ātmanaśca dravyāntaradharmeṣu dravyāntarāvacchedāya svapratyāsattyatiriktasannikarṣāpekṣatvāt anyathā vārāṇasīsthena mahārajanāruṇimnā pāṭaliputre'pi sphaṭikamaṇerāruṇyaprasaṅgāt| kālasya tu tat‌svabhāvatayaiva kalpanādayamadoṣaḥ| kālenāpi rāgasaṃkramaḥ kathaṃ neti cet niyatakriyopanāyakatvenaiva tatsiddheḥ| evaṃ sthaviramavadhiṃ kṛtvā yūni aparatvotpattirnirūpaṇīyā| yugapaditi| yugapajjāyante yugapattiṣṭhanti yugapat kurvanti ityādipratyayānāñca ekasmin kāle ekasyāṃ sūryagatau ekasmin sūryaganyavacchinnakāle ityarthaḥ| nacāprāptā eva sūryagatayo viśeṣaṇatāmanujanti na ca svarūpapratyāsannā eva tāḥ, tasmādetādṛśaviśiṣṭapratyayānyathānupapattyā viśeṣaṇaprāpakaṃ yad dravyaṃ sakālaḥ || 6 || <2-2-7> nanu sidhyatu kālaḥ, sa tu nityo dravyaṃ beti na pramāṇamata āha -- dravyatvanityatve vāyunā vyākhyāte || 7 || yathā vāyuparamāṇorguṇavattvād dravyatvam adravyatvācca nityatvaṃ tathā kālasyāpītyarthaḥ || 7 || <2-2-8> tathāpi santu bahavaḥ kālā ityata āha -- tattvambhāvena || 8 | vyākhyātamiti vipariṇatenānvayaḥ| cirādipratyayānāṃ kālaliṅgānāṃ sarvatraviśeṣādanekatve'pyātmanāmiva viśeṣaliṅgābhāvāt sattāvadekatvaṃ kālasyetyarthaḥ| nanbevaṃ kṣaṇalavamuhūrttayāmadivasāhorātrapakṣamāsartvayanasaṃvatsarādibhedena bhūyāṃsaḥ kālāstat kathameka iti cenna bhedabhānasya upādhinibandhanatvāt| yathā eka eva sphaṭikamaṇirjavātāpiñjādyupādhyuparāgeṇa bhinna iva bhāsate tathaika eva kālaḥ sūryaspandādyavacchedabhedena tattkāryāvicchedabhedena ca bhinna iva bhāsate ityabhyupagamāt| tathā ca kālopādhyavyāpakaḥ kālopādhiḥ, svādheyakādācitkābhāvāpratiyogyanādhāraḥ kālo vā kṣaṇaḥ pratikṣaṇaṃ kasyacidutpatteḥ kasyacidvināśādetadadhyavaseyam| kṣaṇadvayañca lava ityādyāgamaprasiddham| nanu tathāpyatītānāgatavartamānabhedena kālatrayamastu śrūyate hi "traikālyāsiddhiḥ" ityādīti cenna| vastutatprāgabhāvatatpradhvaṃsāvacchedena traikālyavyavahārāt yena hi vastunā yaḥ kālo'vacchidyate sa tasya varttamānaḥ, yat‌prāgabhāvena yaḥ kālo'vacchidyate sa tasya bhaviṣyat‌kālaḥ yat‌prāgabhāvena yatpradhvaṃsena yaḥ kālo'vacchidyate sa tasyātītakālaḥ tathācāvacchedakatritvādhīnaḥ kālatritvavyavahāraḥ || 8 || <2-2-9> idānīṃ sarvotpattimatāṃ kālaḥ kāraṇamityāha -- nityeṣu bhāvādanityeṣu bhāvātkāraṇe kālākhyeti || 9 || itiśabdo hetau iti hetoḥ kāraṇe sarvotpattimat‌kāraṇe kāla ityākhyā| hetumāha nityeṣvabhāvādanityeṣu bhāvāditi| nityeṣu ākāśādiṣu yugapajjātaḥ ciraṃ jātaḥ kṣipraṃ jātaḥ idānīṃ jātaḥ divā jātaḥ rātrau jāta ityādipratyayasyābhāvāt, anityeṣu ca ghaṭapaṭādiṣu yaugapadyādipratyayānāṃ āvāt anvayavyatirekābhyaṃ kāraṇaṃ kāla ityarthaḥ| na kevalaṃ yaugapadyādipratyayabalāt kālasya sarvotpattimannimittakāraṇatvam api tu puṣpaphalādīnāṃ haimantikavāsantikaprāvṛṣeṇyādisaṃjñābalādapyetadadhyavaseyam || 9 || <2-2-10> kālaliṅgakaraṇaṃ samāpya idānīṃ dig‌liṅgaprakaraṇamārabhamāṇa āha -- ita idamiti yatastaddiśyaṃ liṅgam || 10 || diśa idaṃ diśyaṃ diganumāpakam| ito'lpatarasaṃyuktasaṃyogāśrayādidaṃ bahutarasaṃyuktasaṃyogādhikaraṇaṃ param itaśca saṃyuktasaṃyogabhūyastvādhikaraṇādidaṃ saṃyuktasaṃyogālpīyastvādhikaraṇamaparamiti niyatadigdeśayoḥ samānakālayoḥ piṇḍayoryato dravyādbhavati sā digityarthaḥ| na hi tādṛśaṃ dravyamantareṇa bhūyasāṃ saṃyuktasaṃyogānāmalpāyasāṃ vā piṇḍayorupanāyakamanyadasti na ca tadupanayamantareṇa tattadviśiṣṭabuddhiḥ na ca tāmantareṇa paratvāparatvayorutpattiḥ na ca tadutpattiṃ vinā tadviśiṣṭapratyayavyavahārau| na ca kāla eva saṃyogopanāyako'stu kiṃ dravyāntareṇeti vācyam kālasya niyatakriyopanāyakatvenaiva siddheḥ| aniyataparadharmopanāyakatvakalpanāyāntu kāśmīrakuṃkumapaṅkarāgaṃ kārṇāṭakāminīkucakalaśaṃ pratyupanayet| ākāśānmanorapi tathā paradharmopasaṃkrāmakatve sa eva prasaṅgaḥ| diśastu niyataparadharmopasaṃkrāmakatayaiva siddhatvānnātiprasaṅgaḥ| evañca kriyopanāyakāt kālāt saṃyogopanāyikā dik pṛthageva| kiñcāsmāt pūrvamidam asmāduttaramidam asmāddakṣiṇapūrvamidam asmāddakṣiṇapaścimamidam asmātpaścimottaramidam asmāduttarapūrvamidam asmādadhastādidam asmādupariṣṭādidam ityete pratyayā ita idamitītyanena saṅagṛhītāḥ eteṣāṃ pratyayānāṃ nimittāntarāsambhavāt| kiñca niyatopādhyunnāyakaḥ kālaḥ aniyatopādhyunnāyikā dika| bhavati hi yadapekṣayā yo varttamānaḥ sa tadapekṣayā vartamāna eva, digupādhau tu naivaṃ niyamaḥ yaṃ prati yā prācī taṃ pratyeva kadācittasyāḥ pratīcītvāt| evamudīcyādiṣvapi vācyam| yadapekṣayā sūryyodayācalasannihitā yā dika sā tadapekṣayā pratīcī| sannidhānantu sūryasaṃyukte saṃyogālpoyastvaṃ te ca sūryyasaṃyogā alpīyāṃso bhūyāṃso vā digupaneyāḥ| evaṃ prācyabhimukhapuruṣavāmapradeśāvacchinnādigudīco, tādṛśapuruṣadakṣiṇabhāgāvacchinnā dik dakṣiṇā| vāmatvadakṣiṇatve tu śarīrāravayavavṛttijātiviśeṣau| gurutvāsamavāyikāraṇakakriyājanyasaṃyogāśrayo dik adhaḥ| adṛṣṭavadātmasaṃyogajanyāgnikriyājanyasaṃyogāśrayo digūrdhvā| evañcendrāgniyamanirṛtavaruṇavāyusomeśānanāgabrahmādhiṣṭhānopalakṣitā daśa diśa iti vyapadeśāntaraṃ prācyādivyapadeśāt || 10 || <2-2-11> diśo dravyatvaṃ nityatvañca vāyuparamāṇuvadityāha -- dravyatvanityatve vāyunā vyākhyāte || 11 || guṇavatatvād dravyatvam anāśritatvācca nityatvamityarthaḥ || 11 || <2-2-12> ekatvamatidiśannāha -- tattvambhāvena || 12 || dig‌liṅgāviśeṣādviśeṣaliṅgābhāvācca sattākadekatvaṃ tadanuvidhānādekapṛthaktvam || 12 || <2-2-13> nanu yadyekaiva dik kathaṃ tarhi daśa diśa iti pratītivyavahārāvityata āha -- kāryaviśeṣeṇa nānātvam || 13 || kāryyaviśeṣaḥ kāryyabhedastena nānātvopacāra ityarthaḥ || 13 || <2-2-14> tameva kāryabhedaṃ darśayannāha -- ādityasaṃyogād bhūtapūrvādbhaviṣyato bhūtācca prācī || 14 || prāk asyāṃ savitā añcatīti prācī, tathāca yasyāṃ diśi merupradakṣiṇakrameṇa bhramata ādityasya prathamaṃ saṃyogo bhūtapūrvo bhaviṣyan vā bhavan vā sā dika prācī| atra puruṣābhisandhibhedamāśritya kālatrayopavarṇanam, bhavati hi kasyacitpūrvedyuḥ prātarasyāṃ diśi ādityaseyogaḥ prathamaṃ vṛtta itīyaṃ prācīti prācīvyavahāraḥ kasya cidaparedyurasyām, ādityasaṃyogaḥ prathamaṃ bhāvītyabhisandhāya prācīvyavahāraḥ, kasyacididānīm asyām ādityasaṃyogo bhavannastītyabhisandhāya prācīvyavahāraḥ| bhūtāditi ādikarmaṇi ktapratyayaḥ tenābhisandheraniyamāt yadāpyādityasaṃyogo nāsti rātrau madhyāhnādau tatrāpi prācīvyavahārānugamaḥ sid‌dhyatīti bhāvaḥ || 14 || <2-2-15> digantaravyavahāre'pīmameva prakāramatidiśannāha -- tathā dakṣiṇā pratīcī udīcī || 15 || tadvadeva dakṣiṇadigvarttinagādinā sahādityasaṃyogād bhūtapūrvādbhaviṣyato bhūtādvā dakṣiṇāvyavahāraḥ| evaṃ pratīcyudīcyorapi vyavahāra unneyaḥ| vāmatvadakṣiṇatve nirukte eva || 15 || <2-2-16> digantarālavyavahāre'pīmameva prakāramatidiśannāha -- etena digantarālāni vyākhyātāni || 16 || prācīdakṣiṇayordiśorlakṣaṇasāṅkaryeṇa dakṣiṇapūrvā digiti vyavahāraḥ| evaṃ dakṣiṇapaścimā paścimottarā uttarapūrvetyūhyam| ete cādityasaṃyogā yena vibhunā drabyeṇopanīyante sā digiti kaṇādarahasye vyutpāditaṃ vistarataḥ || 16 || <2-2-17> caturṇā bhūtānāṃ rūpādīni lakṣaṇāni kāraṇaguṇapūrvakatayā tāttvikāni anyathā tvaupādhikānīti vyavasthitaṃ pūrvameva| viśeṣaguṇaśūnayvibhuliṅgañcoktam| idānīmākāśasya liṅgaṃ śabdaḥ parokṣaṇīyaḥ| santi cātra tāntrikāṇāṃ vipratipattayaḥ| kecicchabdaṃ dravyamācakṣate, kecid guṇam, guṇatve satyapyeke nityamāhuḥ apare tvanityam| anye tu śabde'pi sphoṭākhyaṃ śabdāntaramāhuḥ| tadatra parīkṣāmārabhamāṇaḥ parīkṣāprathamāṅgaṃ saṃśayameva tāvallakṣaṇataḥ kāraṇataśca vyavasthāpayannāha -- sāmānyapratyakṣādviśeṣāpratyakṣādviśeṣasmṛteśca saṃśayaḥ || 17 || sāmānyapratyakṣāditi| sāmānyavato dharmiṇaḥ pratyakṣāt grahaṇāt matublopāt| viśeṣāpratyakṣāditi| viśeṣasya parasparavyāvarttakasya dharmasya vakrakoṭarādeḥ śiraḥpāṇyādeścāpratyakṣādagrahaṇāt| viśeṣasmṛteḥ viśeṣasya koṭidvayasya sthāṇutvapuruṣatvalakṣaṇasya smaraṇāt| smaraṇamapi grahaṇaparaṃ kacidanubhūyamānadharmayorapikoṭitvāt, cakārādadṛṣṭādeḥ saṃśayakāraṇasya saṃgrahaḥ| asādhāraṇo dharmo'nādhyavasāyātmakajñānajanaka iti noktaḥ| yadvā asādhāraṇasyāpi vyāvṛttidvārā kāraṇatvaṃ sapakṣavipakṣavyāvṛttiḥ sādhāraṇadharma eveti noktaḥ| vipratipattirapi viruddhapratipattidvayajanyaṃ vākyadvayaṃ śabdo nitya ityaparaṃ tadubhayaṃ, tadubhayajanyañca jñānadvayamayugapadbhāvitvāt sambhūya na saṃśāyakamatastatra śabdatvādirasādhāraṇaḥ, sattvaprameyatvādiḥ sādhāraṇo vādharmaḥ saśāyaka iti pṛthaṅ noktā| samānatantre gautamīye'nadhyavasāyajñānasyānabhyupagamāt asādhāraṇo dharmaḥ saṃśayakāraṇatvenoktaḥ| vipratipatterviruddhavākyadvayasyānvayavyatirekaśālitayā saṃśayakāraṇatvamuktam| nyāyabhāṣye ca upalabhyamānatvaṃ yat saṃśayakāraṇamuktaṃ sadapyulabhyate asadapyupalabhyate iti upalabhyamānamidaṃ sadasadveti, yaccānupalabhyamānatvaṃ sadapi nopalabhyate mūlakakīlakodakādi, asadapi nopalabhyate gaganāravindādi, tathā ca pañcavidhaḥ saṃśaya iti| tadetatsāmānyameveti sāmānyapratyakṣādityanenaiva gatārtham| nyāyavārttike'pi yat kāraṇabhedena saṃśaye tritvamuktaṃ tadapi na sambhavati vyabhacāreṇa samānadharmādīnāṃ trayāṇāṃ kāraṇatvasyaivāsambhavāt| na hi tṛṇāraṇimaṇijanyavahnau vaijātyavadatrāpi vaijātyaṃ kalpanoyaṃ saṃśayatvāvacchinnakāryaṃ prati samānadharmatvenaiva kāraṇatāyāḥ kalpanāt| yacca pradhānavidhikoṭitvapradhānaniṣedhakoṭitvādi vaijātyamuktam, tadananugatatvānnāvacchedakam| tathāca saṃśayo na trividho na vā pañcavidhaḥ kintvekavidha eva, prakārāntareṇa tu dvaividhyaṃ sūtrakṛdeva spaṣṭayati| nanu jijñāsājanakajñānaṃ saṃśaya iti na lakṣaṇam anadhyavasāye'pi gatatvāt, saṃskārājanakajñānaṃ saṃśaya ityapi nirvikalpakasādhāraṇaṃ visiṣṭajñānatvena saṃśayasyāpi saṃskārajanakatvāt, saṃśayatvañca jātirapi na lakṣaṇaṃ dharmyaṃsaṃ saṃśayatvābhāvena tadaṃśaṃ tajjātyabhāvāt jāteścāvyāpyavṛttitvānabhyupagamāt iti cet, ekasmin dharmiṇi virodhinānāprakārakaṃ jñānaṃ saṃśaya iti tallakṣaṇāt || 17 || <2-2-18> dvividhaḥ saṃśayo bahirviṣayako'ntarviṣayakaśca| bahirviṣako'pi dṛśyamānadharmiko'dṛśyamānadharmikaśca| tatra dṛśyamānadharmiko yathā ūddhvatvaviśiṣṭasya dharmiṇo darśanāt ayaṃ sthāṇuḥ puruṣo veti| adṛśyamānadharmiko yathā araṇye jhāṭādyantarite gogavayādipiṇḍe viṣāṇamātradarśanāt ayaṃ gaurgavayo veti| vastutastatrāpi viṣāṇadharmika eva sandeho viṣāṇamidaṃ gosambandhi gavayasambandhi veti| vivakṣāmātrāttu dvaividhyābhidhānam| yat sāmānyaṃ saṃśayahetustadanekatra dṛṣṭaṃ saṃśāyakam ekatra dharmiṇi vā dṛṣṭaṃ saṃśayaheturityatra prathamāṃ vidhāmāha -- dṛṣṭañca dṛṣṭavat || 18 || dṛṣṭamūrddhatvaṃ saṃśayahetuḥ| dṛṣṭavaditi vatipratyayaḥ tena dṛṣṭāmyāṃ sthāṇupuruṣābhyāṃ tulyaṃ varttate purovarttini yadūrdhvatvaṃ tad‌dṛṣṭaṃ saṃśayaheturityarthaḥ || 18 || <2-2-19> ekadharbhiviṣayaṃ yad dṛṣṭaṃ tadudāharati -- yathādṛṣṭamayathādṛṣṭatvācca || 19 || saṃśayaheturiti śeṣaḥ| cakāraḥ pūrvoktasamuccayārthaḥ| ayathādṛṣṭatvāddhetoryathādṛṣṭamapi saṃśāyakam yathā -- caitro yathā dṛṣṭaḥ keśavān, kālāntare ayathādṛṣṭaḥ keśavinākṛto dṛṣṭa ityarthaḥ| krameṇa tatraiva caitre vastrāvṛtamastake dṛṣṭe sati bhavati saṃśayaścaitro'yaṃ sakeśo niṣkeśo veti| tatra hi caitratvaṃ samāno dharmaḥ saṃśāyakaḥ sa caikatraiva dṛṣṭaḥ saṃśayahetuḥ || 19 || <2-2-20> vidyeti| āntarasaṃśayo hi vidyā'vidyobhyāṃ bhavati yathā mauhūrttikaḥ samyagādiśati candroparāgādi, asabhyagapi| tatra svajñāne saṃśayo'sya jāyate samyagādiṣṭamasamyagveti| yadvā jñānaṃ hi kvicidvidyā bhavati kvaciccāvidyā apramā bhavati, tathāca jñāyamānatvāt sadidamasadveti saṃśayo jāyate| punaḥ saṃśayagrahaṇamihāpi sāmānyapratyakṣādeva saṃśayo na tu nimittāntarāditi sūcanārtham| tathā ca "samānānekadharmopapatternipratipattipatterupalabdhyanupalabdhyavyavasthātaśca viśeṣāpekṣo vimarśaḥ saṃśayaḥ" iti gautamīye lakṣaṇe upalabdhyanupalabdhyavyavasthetyasya pṛthageva saṃśayakāraṇatvaṃ kaiściduktaṃ tannirastam || 20 || <2-2-21> evaṃ lakṣaṇataḥ svarūpataśca parīkṣāprathamāṅgaṃ saṃśayaṃ vyutpādya idānīṃ parīkṣā viṣayaṃ śabdaṃ dharmiṇaṃ darśayannāha -- śrotragrahaṇo yo'rthaḥ sa śabdaḥ || 21 || śrotraṃ grahaṇaṃ grahakaraṇaṃ yasya sa śrotragrahaṇaḥ, artha iti dharmītyarthaḥ| tathā ca śabdavṛttidharmeṣu śrotragrāhyeṣu śabdatvatāratvādiguṇatvasattvādiṣu nātivyāptiḥ| arthapadena dharmipareṇa jātidharmitvam abhipretam ataḥ sphoṭanāmā śabdasamavetaḥ śabdo nāstīti sūcitam| nanvekaṃ padam ekaṃ vākyamiti pratītibalādavaśyaṃ sphoṭo'ṅgīkarttavyaḥ, na hi bahuvarṇātmake pade bahuvarṇātmake vā vākye bhavatyekatvapratyayaḥ| sphoṭa iti cārthasphuṭīkaraṇādhīnā saṃjñā| varṇānāṃ pratyekaṃ tāvadathepratyayājanakatvameva, milanantvekavaktṛkāṇāmāśutaravināśināmamambhavīti sphoṭādevārthapratyayaḥ, tajjñānamantareṇārthasphuṭībhāvābhāvāt| sa ca sphoṭo yadyapi padabhāvenāvasthiteṣu sarveṣveva varṇeṣu tathāpi caramavarṇe sphuṭībhavati| maivam| saṅketadhadvarṇatvaṃ padatvaṃ tathā ca saṅkhetabalādeva padādarthapratītau ki sphoṭena| varṇānāmbahūnāmapyekārthapratipādakatvamekaṃ dharmamabhipretya ekaṃ padamiti bhākto vyavahāraḥ evaṃ vākye'pi| yadi varṇātiriktaḥ padātmā kaścit pratyakṣato gṛhyeta svīkriyetāpi sphoṭaḥ so'yaṃ sphoṭavādastucchatvādupekṣitaḥ sūtrakṛtā || 21 || <2-2-22> tadevaṃ śabde dharmiṇyupasthite guṇatve satyeva tasyākāśaliṅgatvam| ato guṇatvavyavasthāpanāya trikoṭikaṃ saṃśayamupapādayannāha -- tulyajātīyeṣvarthāntarabhūteṣu viśeṣasya ubhayathā dṛṣṭatvāt || 22 || śabde saṃśaya iti śeṣaḥ| śabde śabdatvaṃ śrotragrāhyatvaṃ copalabhyate, tacca tulyajātīyeṣu trayoviśatau guṇeṣu arthāntarabhūteṣu dravyeṣu karmasu ca viśeṣasya vyāvṛtteḥ ubhayathā ubhayatra daśanāt `śabdaḥ kiṃ guṇo dravyaṃ karma veti' saṃśaye janayati| sāmānyaviśeṣasamavāyakoṭikatvantu sattvakāraṇavattvādivaidharmyadarśanānna bhavati| nanu cāsādhāraṇadhamasyānadhyavasāyajanakatvāt saṃśayajanakatvaṃ pratiṣiddham śabdatvaṃ śrotragrāhyatvañcāsādhāraṇa eva dharmaḥ kathaṃ saṃśayaṃ janayiṣyatīti cetsatyam| byāvṛttirasya jātīyāsajātīyasādhāraṇīti vyāvṛtteḥ sādhāraṇasyaiva dharmasya saṃśayajanakatvenottatvāt| śabdatvapratiyogiko vyāvṛttiḥ samāno dharmaḥ ubhayagatavyāvṛttipratiyogitvañca śabdatvamasādhāraṇo dharmaḥ| taduktaṃ viśeṣasyobhayathā darśanāditi'| atra hi viśeṣasya vyāvṛtterubhayatra sajātīye vijātīye ca darśanasya saṃśayahetutvenopādānāt sa ca samāna eva dharma iti || 22 || <2-2-23> tadevaṃ saṃśayaṃ darśayitvā dravyatvakoṭivyudāsāyāha -- ekadravyatvānna dravyam || 23 || ekaṃ dravyaṃ samavāyi yasya tadekadravyaṃ dravyañca kimapyekadravyasamavāyikāraṇakaṃ na bhavatīti dravyavaidharmyānnāyaṃ śabdo dravyamityarthaḥ || 23 || <2-2-24> nanu karmaikadravyameva tathā ca śabdaḥ karma syādityata āha -- nāpi karmā'cākṣuṣatvāt || 24 || pratyayasya śabdaviṣayakasyācākṣuṣatvāt cakṣurbhinnabahirindriyajanyatvādityarthaḥ| tathā ca śabdatvaṃ na karmavṛtti cākṣuṣapratyakṣāvṛttijātitvāt rasatvādivaditi bhāvaḥ || 24 || <2-2-25> nanu śabdaḥ karma āśutaravināśitvāt utkṣepaṇādivaditi cedatrāha -- guṇasya sato'pavargaḥ karmabhiḥ sādharmyam || 25 || apavargaḥ āśunāśaḥ sa ca guṇatve'pi dvitvādivadāśubhāvināśakasannipātādhīna iti karmabhiḥ sādharmyamātramasya na tu karmatvameva| tvaduktahetorāśutaravināśitvasya dvitvajñānasukhaduḥkhādibhiranaikāntikatvamiti bhāvaḥ || 25 || <2-2-26> nanu sidhyatu śabdo guṇastathāpi nāsāvākāśaliṅgam| ākāśaṃ hi tadā'numāpayet yadi tasya kāryaḥsyāt| kintu nitya evāyaṃ, kadāvidanupalambhastu vyañjakābhāvaprayukta ityāśaṅkyāha -- sato liṅgābhāvāt || 26 || yadi hi uccāraṇāt prāgūdhva śabdaḥ san syāt tadā sato'sya liṅgaṃ pramāṇāntaraṃ syāt| na cāśravaṇadaśāyāṃ śabdasattve pramāṇamasti, tasmāt kāryya evāyaṃ na vyaṅgya iti || 26 | <2-2-27> itaśca na vyaṅgyo'sāvityāha -- nityavaidharmyāt || 27 || nityena sahāsya śabdasya vaidharmyamupalabhyate yataścaitro vaktītyatrāvṛto'pi caitramaitrādirvacanenānumīyate| na ca vyañjakaḥ pratīpādirvyaṅgyena ghaṭādinā kvacidanumīyate, tasmājjanya evāyaṃ na vyaṅgya iti bhāvaḥ || 27 || <2-2-28> vyaṅgyatve bādhakamuktvā sampratyanityatve hetumāha -- anityaścāyaṃ kāraṇataḥ || 28 || kāraṇata utpatterdṛṣṭatvāditi śeṣaḥ| upalabhyate hi bherīdaṇḍasaṃyogādibhyaḥ prādurbhavan śabdaḥ, tathā cotpattimattvādanityo'yamiti| yadvā kāraṇata iti kāraṇavattvahetumupalakṣayati || 28 || <2-2-29> nanu ca kāraṇavattvaṃ śabdasya svarūpāsiddhamata āha -- na cāsiddhaṃ vikārāt || 29 || śabdasya kāraṇavattvamasiddhamiti na vācyam tīvramandādibhāvena vikārasya darśanāt bherīdaṇḍābhighātasya tīvratayā tīvrasya mandatayā mandasya śabdasyopalambhāt| nahyabhivyañjakatovratvādyadhīno'bhivyaṅgyatīvratvādiḥ| tathāca kāraṇato vikārādanumīyate janyo'yaṃ na tvabhivyaṅgya iti || 29 || <2-2-30> nanu vyañjakasyaivāyaṃ mahimā yattīvramandādibhāvenābhivyanakti bherīdaṇḍādyabhihato vāyureva tīvrī mandaśca tathā pratyayamādhatte ata āha -- abhivyaktau doṣāt || 30 || śabdasyābhivyaktau samānadeśānāṃ samānendriyagrāhyāṇāṃ pratiniyatavyañjakavyaṅgyatvaṃ doṣaḥ syāt| na ca tādṛśānāṃ pratiniyatavyañjakavyaṅgyatvaṃ kvacid dṛṣṭam| atra yadi tathā na svīkriyeta tadā kakārābhivyaktau sarvavarṇābhivyaktiprasaṅgaḥ| nanu samānadeśānāmapi sattvanaratvabrāhmaṇatvānāṃ svarūpabhedaḥsaṃsthānayonivyaṅgyānāṃ pratiniyatavyañjakavyaṅgyatvaṃ dṛṣṭameveti cenna teṣāṃ samānadeśatvābhāvāt| na hi yāvān deśaḥ sattvasya tāvāneva naratvasya brāhmaṇatvasya vā || 30 || <2-2-31> itaśca nābhivyahgyatetyāha -- saṃyogādvibhāgācca śabdācca śabdaniṣpattiḥ || 31 || saṃyogāt bherīdaṇḍādisaṃyogāt, vibhāgāt vaṃśe pāṭyamāne| tatra saṃyogastāvannādyasya śabdasya kāraṇaṃ tadabhāvāt tasmāt vaṃśadaladvayavibhāgo nimittakāraṇaṃ dalākāśavibāgaścāsamavāyikāraṇam| yatra ca dūre vīṇādāvutpannaḥ śabdaḥ tatra santānakrameṇa utpadyamānaḥ śabdaḥ karṇaśaṣkulyavacchinnamākāśadeśamāsādayan gṛhyate tena śabdādapi śabdaniṣpattiriti || 31 || <2-2-32> anityatve hetvantaraṃ samuccinoti -- liṅgāccānityaḥ śabdaḥ || 32 || varṇātmakaḥ śabdo'nityaḥ jātimattve sati śrotragrāhyatvāt vīṇādidhvanibadityarthaḥ || 32 || <2-2-33> idānīṃ nityatve siddhāntinoktān hetūna dūṣayitumāha -- dvayostu pravṛttyorabhāvāt || 33 || tuśabdaḥ pūrvoktavyavacchedakaḥ pūrvapakṣābhivyaktyathaḥ| dvayorācāryyāntevāsinoradhyāpane'dhyayane ca pravṛttirdṛśyate tasyā abhāvāt abhāvaprasaṅgāt| adhyāpanaṃ hi sampradānaṃ sampradīyate guruṇā siṣyāya vedaḥ sa yadi sthiro bhavati tadā tasya sampradānaṃ sambhavati| nanu sampradīyamānaṃ gavādi dātṛpratigrahītrorantarāla upalabhyate, na ca vedādi guruśiṣyayorantarāle upalabhyata iti nādhyāpanaṃ sampradānamiti cet antarāle'pi tatrasthapuruṣaśrotreṇa tadupalambhāt| kiñcābhyāsādapi śabdasye nityatā, yathā pañcakṛtvo rūpa paśyatīti sthirasya rūpasyābhyāso dṛṣṭaḥ tathā daśakṛtvo'dhoto'nuvākaḥ viśatikṛtvo'dhīta ityabhyāsaḥ sthairyye śabdasya pramāṇam| siddhe ca sthairyye pināśakānupalabdheḥ "tāvat kālaṃ sthirañcainaṃ kaḥ paścānnāśayiṣyati" iti nityataiva paryyavasanneti bhāvaḥ || 33 || <2-2-34> hetvantaraṃ śabdasya nityatve āha -- prathamāśabdāt || 34 || `triḥ prathamāmanvāha triruttamām' iti prathamottamayoḥ sāmidhenyostriruccāraṇaṃ sthairyyaṃ vinā'nupapannamityarthaḥ || 34 || <2-2-35> śabdanityatve hetvantaramāha -- sampratipattibhāvācca || 35 || sampratipattiḥ pratyabijñā tadbhāvāt tatsadbhāvādityarthaḥ| pratipattiśabdādeva tadviśeṣasya pratyabhijñāyā lābhāt sampūrvaḥ satyatvamāha| tathāca yaiva gāthā maitreṇoccāritā tāmevāyamuccarati tameva ślokaṃ punaḥ punaḥ paṭhati uktameva vacanaṃ punaḥ punarabhidhatse yadeva vākyaṃ parāri parucca tvayoktaṃ tadevedānīmapi brūṣe sa evāyaṃ gakāra ityādipratyabhijñābalāt sthairyyaṃ śabdasyeti || 35 || <2-2-36> sarvānimān hetūn dūṣayannāha -- sandigdhāḥ sati bahutve || 36 || sandigdhā anaikāntikā ityarthaḥ| taduktaṃ -- "viruddhāsiddhasandigdhamaliṅgaṃ kāśyapo'bravīt"iti| tathā ca bahutve nānātve'pi adhyayanamabhyasanaṃ pratyabhijñānañca dṛṣṭamityanaikāntikatvaṃ hetūnām| tathāhi nṛtyamadhīte nṛtyamabhyasyati dviranṛtyat yadeva nṛtyaṃ parudakārṣoraiṣaṇo'pi tadeva karoṣi yadeva nṛtyamekena cāraṇena kṛtaṃ tadevāyamapi karotīti nṛtye dṛṣṭatvāt, tasya ca karmaviśeṣasya tvayā'pi sthairyyānabhyupagamāt || 36 || <2-2-37> nanu pañcādaśadvarṇā aṣṭākṣaro mantraḥ tryakṣaro mantraḥ aṣṭākṣarā'nuṣṭubityādisaṅkhyā kathaṃ? varṇānāmanityatve uccāraṇabhedenānantyasambhavādityata āha -- saṃkhyābhāvaḥ sāmānyataḥ || 37 || saṅkhyāyāḥ pañcāśadādisaṅkhyāyā bhāvaḥ sadbhāvaḥ sāmānyataḥ katvagatvādijātita ityarthaḥ| kakārādīnāmānantye'pi katvagatvādyavacchinnānāṃ pañcāśattvaṃ tritvamaṣṭatvaṃ vā dravyaguṇādīnāmāntargaṇikabhedenānantyepi navatvacaturviśatitvādivaditi bhāvaḥ| nanu sa evāyaṃ gakāra iti pratyabhijñaiva sthairyyasādhikā, na caiṣā tīvro gakāro mando gakāra iti pratītyā viruddhadharma gocarayantyā bādhyate tīvratvādestatraupādhikatvāt| na copādhibhedādapi bhedo mābhūt tarhi javātāpiñjādisaṃyogānnīlapītādibhāvena prathamānaḥ sphaṭikamaṇirapi nānā, kṛpāṇamaṇidarpaṇeṣu dīrghādibhāvena bhāsamānaṃ mukhamapi vā nānā na bāseta| nanu kasyāyaṃ tīvratādharmogakāropādhika iti cenna vāyudharmo nādadharmo dhvanidharmo vā bhaviṣyati ki tatra viśecintayā| tvayāpi tāratvādeḥ katvagatvādinā parāparabhāvānupapattyā svābhāvikatvābhyupagamāditi cet| maivam| utpanno gakāraḥ, naṣṭo gakāraḥ śrutapūrvo gakāro nāsti, nivṛttaḥ kolāhala ityādivirodhipratītau satyāmapi cet iyaṃ pratyabhijñā na nivarttate tadāsyā jātiviṣayatākalpanāt| anyathā vyaktisthairyyamālagbamānāyāmasyāṃ satyāmuktavirodhipratyayā eva notpadyeran| na cāyaṃ vāyudharmastaddharbhāṇāṃ śrotrāviṣayatvāt| nāpi nādadharmaḥ, nādo yadi vāyureva tadā doṣasyoktatvāt anyasya nirvaktumaśakyatvāt| nāpi dhvanidadharmaḥ, śaṅkhādidhvanāvanupalabhyamāne'pi gakāre tāratvādipratīteḥ| svābhāvikatve tu na jātisāṅkaryyaṃ gatvādivyāpyasya tasya nānātvābhyupagamāt| kiñca śukasārikāmanuṣyaprabhaveṣu gakārādiṣu sphuṭatarā rūpabhedaprathā'sthi evaṃ strīpuṃsaprabhaveṣu strīpuṃsabhedaprabhaveṣu ca, yataḥ kāṇḍapaṭādyāvṛtā api śukādayo'numīyante| aupādhikatvantvasya nānubhūyamānopādhinibandhanaṃ kuṅkamāruṇā naruṇītivat| nāpyaupapattikamaupādhikatvam upapattestādṛśapramāṇasyābhāvāditi saṃkṣepaḥ || 37 || iti vaiśeṣikasūtropaskāre śāṅkare dvitīyādhyāyasya dvitīyamāhnikam| samāptaścāyaṃ dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ| <3> <3-1-1> tadevaṃ dvitīyādhyāye bahirdravyaparīkṣāmupādya uddeśakramādidānīmātmaparīkṣāyai pīṭhamāracayitumāha -- prasiddhā indriyārthāḥ || 1 || indriyāṇāmarthā gandharasarūpasparśaśabdā bāhyaikaikendriyagrāhyāḥ| tatra "śrotragrahaṇo yo'rthaḥ sa śabda" iti śabdaprasiddhau darśitāyāmarthād gandhādau sparśaparyyante prasiddhirdarśitetyarthaḥ| tathāhi ghrāṇagrahaṇo yo'rthaḥ sa gandhaḥ, rasanagrahaṇo yo'rthaḥ sa rasaḥ, cakṣurmātragrahaṇī yo'rthaḥ tadrūpam, tvagindriyamātragrahaṇo yo'rthaḥ sa sparśaḥ| sarvatra cārthaśabdena dharmī bhāvabhūta ucyate tena gandhatvādau gandhā dyabhāve ca nātivyāptiḥ, tadevaṃ ghrāṇagrahaṇavṛttiguṇatvāvāntarajātimattvaṃ gandhatvam| evaṃ rasādāvapi vācyam tena nātīndriyagandhādyanupagrahaḥ || 1 || <3-1-2> indriyārthaprasiddherātmaparīkṣāyāmupayogamāha -- indriyārthaprasiddhirindriyārthebhyo'rthāntarasya hetuḥ || 2 || heturliṅgamarthāntarasya ātmanaḥ| indriyārbhyeyaḥ iti| indriyebhyorthebhyaśca rūpādibhyastadvad‌bhyaśca yadarthāntaram ātmā tasya liṅgamityarthaḥ| yadyapi jñānameva liṅgamiha vivakṣitam tathāpīndriyārthaprasiddhe rūpādisākṣātkārasya prasiddhataratayā tādrūpyeṇaiva jiṅgatvamuktam| tathāhi prasiddhiḥ kvacidāśritā kāryatvāt ghaṭavat guṇatvādvā kriyātvādvā| sā ca prasiddhiḥ karaṇajanyā kriyātvāt chidikriyāvat| yacca prasiddheḥ karaṇaṃ tadindriyam| tacca kartṛprayojyaṃ karaṇatvāt vāsyādivat tathā yatreyaṃ prasiddhirāśritā yaḥ ghrāṇādīnāṃ karaṇānāṃ prayoktā sa ātmā || 2 || <3-1-3> nanu śarīramindriyāṇi vā prasiddherāśrayo'stu prasiddhiṃ prati tadubhayānvayavyatirekayoḥ sphuṭataratvāt kiṃ tadanyāśrayakalpanayā| tathāhi caitanyaṃ śaroraguṇaḥ tatkāryatvāt tadrūpādivat| evamindriyaguṇatve'pi vācyamityāśaṅkyāha -- so'napadeśaḥ || 3 || apadeśo hetuḥ tadābhāso'napadeśaḥ| tathāca tat kāryatvaṃ gradīpajanyajñānādāvanaikāntikatvādanapadeśa ityarthaḥ || 3 || <3-1-4> nanu tatkāryatvaṃ caitanyatvāvacchinnasyaiva kāryatvaṃ vivakṣitaṃ pradīpādīnāñca samastameva caitanyaṃ na kāryamiti na vyabhicāra ityāśaṅkyāha -- kāraṇājñānāt || 4 || śarīrakāraṇānāṃ karacaraṇādīnāṃ tadabayavānāṃ vā ajñānāt jñānaśūnyatvādityarthaḥ| pṛthivyādiviśeṣaguṇānāṃ hi kāraṇaguṇapūrvakatā dṛṣṭā tathā ca śarīrakāraṇeṣu yadi jñānaṃ syāttadā śarīre'pi sambhāvyeta, na caivam| nanvastu śarīrakāraṇeṣvapi caitanyamiti cenna aikamatyābhāvaprasaṅgāt| na hi bahūnāñcetanānāmaikamatyaṃ ṣṭadṛm, karāvacchedenānubhūyatasya karacchede'smaraṇaprasaṅgāt, yato "nānyadṛṣṭaṃ smaratyanyaḥ" iti| kiñca śarīranāśe tatkṛtahiṃsādiphalānupabhogaprasaṅgāt| na hi caitreṇa kṛtasya pāpasya phalaṃ maitro bhuṃkte tataśca kṛtahānirakṛtābhyāgamaśca syāt || 4 || <3-1-5> nanu śarīrakāraṇeṣu sūkṣmamātrayā bhānamasti śarīre tu sphuṭamato nākāraṇaguṇapūrvakatā na caikamatyānupapattirityāśaṅkyāha -- kāryeṣu jñānāt || 5 || yadi hi śarīramūlakāraṇeṣu paramāṇuṣu caitanyaṃ syāt tadā tadārabdheṣu kāryeṣu ghaṭādiṣvapi syāt| kiñca pārthivaviśeṣaguṇānāṃ sarvapārthivavṛttitayā vyāpteḥ kāryeṣvapi ghaṭādiṣu caitanyaṃ syānna ca tatra caitanyamupalabhyate ityarthaḥ || 5 || <3-1-6> nanu ghaṭādāvapi sūkṣmamātrayā caitanyamastyevetyāśaṅkyāha -- ajñānācca || 6 || sarvaiḥ pramāṇairajñānāt kumbhādau na caitanyamityarthaḥ| sarvapramāṇāgocarasyāpyabhyupagame śaśaviṣāṇāderapyabhyupagamaprasaṅgaḥ| na hi ghaṭādau caitanyaṃ kenāpi pramāṇena jñāyata iti || 6 || <3-1-7> nanu śrotrādibhiḥ karaṇairadhiṣṭhātā'numīyate ityuktaṃ, tadayuktam na hi śrotrādibhirātmanastādatmyaṃ tadutpattirvā, na ca tābhyāmantareṇāvinābhāvasiddhiḥ, na cāvinābhāvamantareṇānumitirityata āha -- anyadeva heturityanapadeśaḥ || 7 || hetuḥ sādhyādanya eva bhavati na tu sādhyātmā sādhyāviśeṣaprasaṅgāt, tasmāttādā myaghaṭito heturaheturanapadeśa ityartaḥ || 7 || <3-1-8> nanu śrotrādibhirindriyairātmano yathā na tādātmyaṃ tathā tadutpattirapi nāsti nahi vahnerdhūma iva ātmanaḥ śrotrādikaraṇamupapadyate ityata āha -- arthāntaraṃ hyarthāntarasyānapadeśaḥ || 8 || hi yataḥ kāryaṃ dhūmādi yathā rāsabhāderarthāntarantathā kāraṇādvahnyāderapyarthāntarameva| tathā cārthāntaratvāviśeṣāt dhūmo rāsabhaṃ na gamayati kintu vahnimeva gamayatītyatra svabhāvaviśeṣa eva niyāmakaḥ| sa ca svabhāvo yadi kāryādanyasyāpi bhavati tadā so'pyadeśo bhavatyeva| tathā ca kāryyamavivakṣitasvabhāvabhedam anapadeśaḥ| tathā ca tādātmyatadutpattī evāvinābhāvaḥ tayorevāvinābhāvaparyavasānam tābhyāṃ samānopāyo vā tadubhayamātragrahādhonagraho veti svaśiṣyavyāmohanāya paribhāṣāmātramiti bhāvaḥ || 8 || <3-1-9> sampratyavinābhāvasya tadubhayavyabhicārameva sphuṭayitumāha -- rsayogi samavāyyekārthasamavāyi virodhi ca || 9 || śarīre tvagvad śarīratvādityayaṃ hetuḥ saṃyogī| vṛddhikṣayavaddravyasahajāvaraṇaṃ hi tvagityucyate| tacca na śarīrasya kāryaṃ kāraṇaṃ vā, kintu sahotpattikamātraṃ niyatasaṃyogavat| evaṃ samavāyi yathākāśaṃ parimāṇavad dravyatvāt ghaṭādivaditi| atra parimāṇaṃ sādhyaṃ dravyatvenākāśasamavāyinā dharmeṇa sādhyate yadvā pirimāṇatāratamyaṃ kvacidviśrāntamityanenāṇutvaṃ parimāṇaviśeṣaḥ siddhaḥ| tena tadāśrayaḥ paramāṇuranumīyate| śabdādinā tvākāśasya, jñānādinā tvātmano'numānaṃ kāryeṇaiva kāraṇānumānamiti nodāhṛtam || 9 || <3-1-10> ekārthasamavāyinaṃ sūtrakṛdudāharati -- kāryaṃ kāryyāntarasya || 10 || kāryaṃ rūpaṃ kāryāntarasya sparśasya liṅgam| upalakṣaṇañcaitat akāryamapyākāśaikatvam ākāśaikapṛthaktve liṅgam| evaṃ paramamahattve || 10 || <3-1-11> virodhiliṅgamudāharati -- virodhyabhūtaṃ bhūtasya || 11 || abhūtaṃ varṣaṃ, bhūtasya vāyvabhrasaṃyogasya liṅgam| evaṃ sphoṭādervirodhī mantrapāṭhaḥ| tathā cābūtamanutpannaṃ sphoṭādi bhūtasya mantrapāṭhasya liṅgam || 11 || <3-1-12> virodhiliṅgasyodāharaṇāntaramāha -- bhūtamabhūtasya || 12 || bhūtaṃ sphoṭādikam abhūtasya mantrapāṭhasya liṅgam| evaṃ bhūto vāyvabhrasaṃyogo'bhūtasya varṣasya liṅgam| evaṃ bhūto dāho'bhūtasya maṇyādisamavadhānasya liṅgamevamanyadapyūhyam || 12 || <3-1-13> liṅgāntaramudāharati -- bhūto bhūtasya || 13 || vidyamānenaiva virodhinā vidyamānasyaiva virodhinaḥ kvacidanumānam yathā visphūrjantamahiṃ dṛṣṭvā jhāṭāntaritasya nakulasya| atra hi visphūrjannahirbhūto vidyamāno jhaṭāntarito nakulo'pi vidyamāna eveti bhavati bhūto bhūtasya liṅgamityarthaḥ| varṣavāyvabhrasayogasya tu naikasmin kāle vidyamānatā na vā sphoṭamantrapāṭhayoriti || 13 || <3-1-14> idānīṃ parigaṇanasya prayojanamāha -- prasiddhipūrvakatvādapadeśasya || 14 || prasiddhiḥ smaryyamāṇā vyāptiḥ apadeśo hetuvacanaṃ, tena smaryamāṇavyāptiviśiṣṭo heturhetvavayavenopanayāvayavena vocyate iti bhavati prasiddhipūrvako'padeśa iti| tathāca śrotrādinā karaṇenādhiṣṭhātuḥ, jñānādinā ca guṇena tadāśrayasthātmanoḥ yadanumānamuktam tatra sarvatra vyāptirasti tvayā tu śarīrakāryyatvena hetunā jñānasya yaccharīraguṇatvaṃ sādhitaṃ tatra na vyāptiriti bhāvaḥ| nanu keyaṃ vyāptiḥ? na tāvadanyabhicaritaḥ sambandhaḥ avyabhicārasya sādhyātyantābhāvasāmānādhikaraṇyānadhikaraṇatvasya kevalānvayinyaprasiddheḥ| sādhyānadhikaraṇatvasyāpi kevalānvayinyasambhavāt dhūmāderapi yat‌kiñcitsādhyānadhikaraṇādhikaraṇatvāt| nāpyavinābhāvaḥ| sa hi sādhyaṃ vinā'bhāvo vā hetoḥ, avināsādhyānvaye sati bhāvo vā? dhūmasyāpi kvacidrāsabhābhāve'bhāvāt, rāsabhasattve sattvācca niyatavyatireko niyataścānvayo vivakṣita iti cet, na niyamasyaiva nirūpyamāṇatvāt| nāpi kārtsnena sambandhaḥ sa yadi kṛtsnasya sādhyasya sādhanasambandhaḥ, sa viṣamavyāpte dhūmādāvapi nāsti| atha kṛtssnasya sādhanasya sādhyasambandhaḥ, so'pyekasya sādhyasya kṛtsnasādhane sambandhābhāvādanupapannaḥ| atha kṛtsnasya sādhyasya kṛtsnena sādhanena sambandhaḥ, etadapyayuktam na hi kṛtsnena sādhanena kṛtsnasya sādhyasya kvacidapi sambandhaḥ sambhavati, pratyekameva sādhyasādhanayoḥ sambandhāt, viṣamavyāpte cāvyāpteḥ| nāpi svābhāvikaḥ sambandhaḥ| svabhāvī hi svasya bhāvo vā svameva bhāvo vā, tatra tajjanyatvañcettaddhitārthaḥ, tadā samavāyalakṣaṇāyāṃ vyāptāvavyāpteḥ| tadāśritatvañcettaddhitārthaḥ, tadāpi samavāye'vyāptiḥ, na hi samavāyaḥ kvacidāśritaḥ saṃyogasyāpi hetudharmadhūmatvādyajanyatvācca| nāpyanaupādhikaḥ sambandhaḥ| upādhereva durva catvāt| suvacatve'pi durgrahatvāt sugrahatve'pyantoneyāśrayāt| sādhyavyāpakatve sati sādhanāvyāpakatvādervyāptigrahādhīnagrahatvāt| nāpi sbandhamātraṃ vyāptiḥ| vyabhicārisambandhasyāpi deśaviśeṣakālaviśeṣagarbhatayā vyāptirūpatve'pi, tajajñānasyānumitāvatantratvāt anumitikāraṇībhūtajñānaviṣayavyāptereva nirūpayitumicitatvāt| nāpi sādhanavanniṣṭhātyantābhāvāpratiyogisādhyasāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ vyāptiḥ| vahnerapi dhūmavanniṣṭhātyantābhāvapratiyogitvāt na hi dhūmavati mahānase parvatoyavahnernātyantābhāvaḥ| idaṃ saṃyogi dravyatvādityādau saṃyogātyantābhāvasya sādhanasamānādhikaraṇatvādavyāpakatāprasaṅgāt| pratiyogiviruddhasvasamānādhikaraṇātyantābhāvāpratiyogisādhyasāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ vyāptiḥ saṃyogātyantābhāvasyapratiyogiviruddhatvābhāvāditi cenna saṃyogātyantābhāvasyāpi pratiyogiviruddhatvāt anyathā'vacchedabhedakalpanāvaiyarthyāt na hi kṛtakatvānityatvayorvṛttyarthamavacchedabhedaḥ kalpyate| nāpisādhyavaiyadhikaraṇyānadhikaraṇatvam| kevalānvayini sādhyavaiyadhikaraṇyāprasiddheḥsādhyānadhikaraṇādhikaraṇatvaṃ hi tat| nāpi yatsambandhitāvacchedakarūpavattvaṃ yasya tasya sā vyāptiḥ vahnivattvasyāpi dhūmasambandhitāvacchedakatvāt| adhikadeśavṛttitayā tanna tatheti cet vyāpakatāvacchedakasyādhikadeśavṛtterapyabhyupagamāt dhūmatvasyāpi gaganatalāvalambidhūmavṛttitayā'dhikadeśavṛttitvāt| ataeva tadvāraṇārthaṃ viśeṣaṇamiti cet, tarhi yad vyāpyatāvacchedakaṃ tadeva sambandhitāvacchedakatvenābhimatamityabhimataṃ tathā cātmāśrayaḥ| evañca yat sāmānādhikaraṇyāvacchedakarūpavattvaṃ yasya tasya sā vyāptirityapyuktadoṣākrāntamiti cet, atrocyate anaupādhikaḥ sambandho vyāptiḥ| anaupādhikatvantu yāvaḥ svavyabhicārivyabhicārisādhyasāmānādhikaraṇyam, yāvatsvasamānādhikaraṇātyātābhāvapratiyogikātyantābhāvasamānādhikaraṇasādhyasāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ vā| yāvat‌sādhanāvyāpakāvyāpyasādhyasāmānādhikaraṇyamiti niruktidvayārthaḥ| yāvatmādhyavyāpakāvyāpyasādhyasāmānādhikaraṇyamiti niruktidvayārthaḥ| yāvatmādhyavyāpakavyāpakatvaṃ vā bahuvrīhiṇā durgrahamidamiti cet ata eva tatra bhūyodarśanāpekṣā tarkāpekṣā ca| yadvā sādhanasamānādhikaraṇātyantābhāvāpratiyogisādhyasāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ vyāptiḥ| atyantābhāvaśca vahnitvādisāmānyāvacchinnapratiyogitāko vivakṣitaḥ tena mahānasīyadhūme parvatīyavahnyatyantābhāvasāmānādhikaraṇye'pi na deṣaḥ, dhūmavati vahnirnā stīti pratīteranudayāt| dravyatvantu saṃyogitvātyantābhāvāsamānādhikaraṇameva, na hi bhavati dravyaṃ na saṃyogīti pratītiḥ, saṃyogānāṃ pratyekamavyāpyavṛttitve'pi saṃyogitvasāmānaysya vyāpyavṛttitvāt tasyaiva ca vyāpakatvāt| nanvanaupādhikatvamupādhivirahaḥ upādhireva duṣparikalanīya iti cenna sādhyavyāpakatve sati sādhanāvyāpakasyopādhitvāt| taduktam -- sādhane sopādhisādhye nirupādhirupādhiḥ| nanu kevalasādhyavyāpakopādhyavyāpakametat| yathā vāyuḥ pratyakṣaḥ pratyakṣasparśāśrayatvādityatrod‌bhūtarūpavattvam, sa śyāmo mitrātanayatvādityatra śākapākajatvam, na hyud‌bhūtarūpavattva pratyakṣatvavyāpakam ātmani guṇakarmmādau ca pratyakṣe tadabhāvāt, nāpi śākapākajatvaṃ śyāmatvavyāpakam kākakokilajaladajambūphalādau śyāme tadabhāvāditi cenna paryyavasitasādhyavyāpakatve sati sādhanāvyāpakatvasya tathā vivakṣitatvāt| paryyavasitañca sādhyaṃ yaddharmāvacchedenopādhervyāpakatvamabhagnaṃ taddharmāvacchinnam, prakṛte bahirdravyatvāvacchedena pratyakṣatvasyod‌bhūtarūpavattva vyāpakam, anyavyatirekābhyāṃ gṛhītam, autpattikanaraśyāmatvāvacchinnaṃ sādhyaṃ prati carakasuśrutādau śākapākajatvasya vyāpakatvāvadhāraṇādevamanyatrāpyūhyam| nanu nāyamupādhipadavācyaḥ, yaddharmo'nyatra bhāsate sa upādhiḥ yatho sphaṭikādau javākusumādi viṣamavyāptopādhau ca vyāpyatvābhāvāttaddharmasya sādhanābhimate'navabhāsanāditi cet, satyam samavyāpta evārdrendhanaprabhavavahnimattvādau mukhya upādhipadaprayogaḥ, anyatra tu gauṇaḥ| guṇaśca vyabhicāronnāyakatvam, yaddhi yadvyāpakavyabhicāri tasya tadvyabhicāritvaniyamāt bhavati ca sādhyavyāpakasyopādhevyabhicāri sādhanam, ataḥ sādhyavyabhicārīti| yadvyāpakāvyāpyaṃ yat tat tadavyāpyam iti vyāpyatvāsid‌dhyunnāyakatvaṃ vā| satpratipakṣotthāpakatvaṃ vā pakṣe upādheḥ sādhyavyāpakasyābhāvāt sādhyābhāvasādhanāt| taduktaṃ -- vādyuktasādhyaniyamacyuto'pi kathakairupādhirudbhāvyaḥ| paryyavasitaṃ niyamayan dūṣakatābojasāmyāt || iti| unnoyate cāyaṃ bādhavyabhicārānukūlatarkābhāvapratikūlatarkaiḥ| yattu yadvyabhicāritvena sādhanasya sādhyavyabhicāritvaṃ sa upādhiriti| tatra tṛtīyā na karaṇe na hetau na prakāre na lakṣaṇe| na ca yadvyabhicāritvena jñātena sādhanasya sādhyavyabhicāritvaṃ jñāyate iti pūraṇīyam ajñāyamānopārdhyavyāpanāt sphuṭavyabhicārasthalopādhyavyāpanāt| yogyatāgarbhā tu durnirūpā, vyabhicāronnāyakatvamavyavasthāpya upādhyudbhāvanāśakyatvācca| pakṣetaratvantu upādhilakṣaṇākrāntamapi svavyādhātakatvānnopādhiḥ yathā pakṣe sandigdhānaikāntikatvam| yadi hi tatra na sandehastadā na pakṣatā, yadi pakṣatā tadā sandehasyāvaśyakatā sandigdhānaikāntikatvadhrauvyāt| avaśiṣṭaṃ mayūkhe'nveṣṭavyam || 14 || <3-1-15> idānīṃ vṛttānāṃ varttiṣyamāṇānāñca hetūnāṃ hetvābhāsādvivekāya hetvābhāsaprakaraṇamārabhamāṇa āha -- aprasiddho'napadeśo'san sandigdhaścānapadeśaḥ || 15 || aprasiddha iti| avyāpto'gṛhītavyāptiko viparītavyāptikaśca viruddhaḥ| etena vyāpyatvāsiddhaviruddhayoḥ saṃgrahaḥ| asan iti| pakṣe'san apakṣadharma ityarthaḥ| sa ca kvacit svarūpatirahāt kvacit sandehasiṣādhayiṣayorabhāvāt| siddhasādhane| sandigdha iti| pakṣe sādhyasadasattvakoṭikasaṃśayajanakaḥ| sa ca saṃśayaḥ samānadharmadarśanāt kvacidasādhāraṇadharmadarśanāt kvacit pakṣa eva hetoḥ sādhyatadabhāvasāhacaryyadarśanāt| ādyaḥ sādhāraṇānaikāntikaḥ| dvitīyastvasādhāraṇānaikāntikaḥ| tṛtīyo'nupasaṃhārī || 15 || <3-1-16> tatra vyāpyatvāsiddhaviruddhasvarūpāsiddhānāmudāharaṇamāha -- yasmādviṣāṇī tasmādaśvaḥ || 16 || yatra rāsabhapiṇḍaṃ pakṣīkṛtyāyamasāvaśyaḥ viṣāṇitvāt yastu nāśvo nāsau viṣāṇī, yathā śaśaśṛgālanaravānarādiriti vyatirekasahacāradarśanāhitavyāmohaḥ prayuṅkte| tatra vyāpyatvāsiddhasvarūpāsiddhaviruddhānāmudāharaṇamidam || 16 || <3-1-17> anaikāntikamudāharati -- yasmādviṣāṇī tasmād gauriti cānaikāntikasyodāharaṇam || 17 || yatra mahiṣaṃ pakṣayitvā ayaṃ gaurviṣāṇitvāditi sādhayati tatra sādhāraṇānaikāntikatā| yadā tvākāśaṃ nityaṃ śabdāśrayatvāditi sādhayati tadā'syāsādhāraṇānaikāntikatā evaṃ śabdo'nityaḥ śabdatvādityādyapyagṛhyamāṇadaśāyāmasādhāraṇānaikāntikameva, yadā tu vipakṣabādhakatarkāvatārāt pakṣa evaṃ sādhyaṃ sidhyet tadā sapakṣavṛttitājñānadaśāyāṃ saddhetureva pakṣasyāpi sapakṣatvāt| tatra vyāptapakṣadharmatayā'pramito'siddhaḥ| sa ca trividhaḥ vyāpyatvāsiddhaḥ svarūpāsiddhaḥ āśrayāsiddhaśca| tatrāgṛhītavyāptiko vyāpyatvāsiddhaḥ, satyā eva vyāpteragrahāt vyāpterabhāvācca ubhayathāpi| tenānukūlatarkābhāvādayo'siddhabhedāḥ| sa cāyamasamarthaviviśeṣaṇāsamarthaviśeṣyāsamarthobhayasaṃdigdhāsamarthaviśeṣaṇasandigdhāsamarthaviśeṣyasandigdhāsamarthobhayabhedaprapañcena sahasradhā bhidyate| sarvatra cātra siddhiviraha evodbhāvyaḥ| atredaṃ tattvam| hetustāvat kevalānvayyanvayavyatirekikevalavyatirekibhedāttrividhaḥ| tatra sarvadharmigato dharmaḥ kevalānvayo, yathā prameyatvābhidheyatvaviśeṣyatva viśeṣaṇatvanityadravyātyāntābhāvāśrayanāśyaguṇādidhvaṃsātyantābhāvādayaḥ| nahyasti tādṛśaṃ kiñcit, yatraite dharmā na vidyante| tathā ca savargatatvam atyantābhāvāpratiyogitvaṃ vā kevalānvayitvam| eteṣāñca svātmavṛttitve'pi na doṣaḥ taduktam -- pramāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ vṛttau na bhinnābhinnate yataḥ| iti| kevalānvayisādhyako hetuḥ kevalānvayī| asya ca pakṣasattvasapakṣasattvābādhitatvāsatpratipakṣitatvāni catvāri rūpāṇi gamakatvaupayikāni| anvayavyatirekiṇastuhetorvipakṣāsattvena saha pañca kevalavyatirekiṇaḥ sapakṣasattvavyatirekeṇa catvāri| tathāca yasya hetoryāvanti rūpāṇi gamakataupayikāni tadanaytararūpahīnaḥ sa heturābhāsaḥ| ebañca gamakataupayikānyatararūpaśūnyatvaṃ hetvābhāsatvam, tenānyatararūpaśūnyatvasya niścayavatsandeho'pyanumitipratibandhakaḥ vādihetorasādhakatāsādhakañca| na ca kevalānvayikevalavyatirekiṇorhetvoranyatararūpaśūnyatayā hetvābhāsatvāpattiḥ, kevalānvayini vipakṣāsattvāsya kevalavyaratirekiṇi sapakṣasattvasya gamakatvaupayikatvābhāvāt| evañcāśrayāsiddhasvarūpāsiddhabhāgāsiddhānāṃ pakṣasattvarūpavirahādābhāsatvam| vyāpyatvāsiddhaviruddhasādhāraṇānaikāntikānāṃ vipakṣāsattvarūpavaikalyāt| asādhāraṇānaikāntikānupasaṃhāriṇoḥ sapakṣasattvavaikalyāt| bādhitasatpratipakṣitayorabādhitatvāsatpratipakṣitatvavirahāt| evaṃ sopādhikatvāprayokajatvayorapi vipakṣāsattvaniścayābhāvādagamakatvam| anukūlasādhanavikalobhayavikaladṛṣṭāntābhāsānāṃ yadi hetvābhāsavidhayā doṣatvaṃ tadā sapakṣattvāniścayāt, yadi svātantryeṇa dṛṣṭāntābhāsatayā tathāpi dvāraṃ hetoḥ sapakṣasattvāniścaya eva| anupadarśitānvayānupadarśitavyatirekaviparītopadarśitānvayaviparītopadarśitavyatirekāstu nyūnā, prāptakālanigrahasthānaparyyavasannā eva ātmāśrayānyonyāśrayacakrakānavasthāstu vyāptiniścayaṃ vighaṭayantaḥ sapakṣasattvavipakṣāsattvānyatararūpavikalā eva hetvābhāsatāmāsādayanti| tatra pakṣe sādhyasadasattvakoṭikasaṃśayajanako hetvābhāsaḥ savyabhicāraḥ| pakṣe sādhyābhāvaniścayaphalako hetvābhāso viruddhaḥ| vyāptipakṣadharmatāpramitiviraho'siddhaḥ| bādhasatpratipakṣau tu kāśyapīye mate na svatantrau| tatra bādha āśrayāsiddhāvanaikāntike vā paryavasyati| taduktaṃ "bādhāyāmapakṣadharmo heturanaikāntiko vā" iti| satpratipakṣo'pyanyataratra vyāptyādisaṃśayamāpādayan anaikānti kādāveva paryavasyati| vṛttikārastu "aprasiddho'napadeśo'san sandigdhāścanapadeśaḥ" iti sūtrasthacakārasya bādhasatpratikṣasamuccayārthatāmāha| tena "savyabhicāraviruddhaprakaraṇasamasādhyasamātītakālāḥ pañca hetvābhāsāḥ" iti gautamīyameva matamanudāvati| parantu "viruddhāsiddhasandigdhamaliṅgaṃ kāśyapo'bravīt" ityādyabhidhānāt sūtrakārasvaraso hetvābhāsatritve, cakārastūktasamuccayārtha iti tattvam| granthagauravabhayāt prapañco na kṛto mayūkhe vistaro'nveṣṭavyaḥ || 17 || <3-1-18> idānīṃ hetvābhāsavivecanasya phalamāha -- ātmendrayārthasannikarṣādyanniṣpadyate tadanyat || 18 || ātmendriyārthasannikarṣāttāvajjñānamutpadyate taccātmani liṅgam asiddhaviruddhānaikāntikebhyo'nyat anābhāsamityarthaḥ| tathāhi jñānamātmanyubhayathā liṅgam, jñānaṃ kvacidāśritaṃ kāryatvādrūpādivaditi vā, pratyabhijñārūpatayāvā yo'hamadrākṣaṃ so'haṃ spṛśāmīti| tatra jñānagataṃ kāryatvaṃ nāsiddhaṃ yanniṣpadyata ityabhidhānāt| na viruddhaṃ sāmānyatoḥ dṛṣṭe'tra virodhābhāvāt| na cānaikāntikam tata eva| tathāca svagatakāryatvaguṇatvadvārā sāmānyatodṛṣṭena jñānamevātmani liṅgam| pratyabhijñānantu bhinnakartṛkebhyo vyāvarttamānamekakartṛkatāyāṃ paryavasyati| na ca buddhicaitanye'pi kāryakāraṇabhāvanibandhanameva pratisandhānam, śiṣyagurubuddhyorapi pratisandhānaprasaṅgāt| upādānopādeyabhāvastatra nāsti sa ca pratisandhānaprayojaka iti cedupādānatvasya dravyadharmatayā buddhāvasambhavāt, sambhave vā buddhīnāṃ kṣaṇikatayā pūrvānubhūtapratisandhānānupapatteḥ| na hi pūrvabuddhyā uttarāsu buddhiṣu kaścit saṃskāra ādhīyate, sthirasya tasya tvayā'nabhyupagamāt| kṣaṇikabuddhidhārārūpasya ca kālāntarasmṛtau pratisandhāne vā'sāmarthyāt| ālayavijñānasantānaḥ pravṛttivijñānasantānādanya eva smarttā ca pratisandhātā ceti cet, sa yadi sthiraḥ tadā siddhaṃ naḥ samīhitam| kṣaṇikabuddhidhārārūpaścet tadā pūrvadoṣānativṛtte, na hi tatrāpi sthiraḥ kaścit saṃskāraḥ| kiñca pravṛttivijñānātirikte tatra pramāṇābhāvaḥ| ahamiti buddhidhāraiva pramāṇamiti cet bhavatu tatra yadi pravṛttivijñānānyālayavijñānameva cedupādatte tadā pravṛttivijñānānāmupādānatāvirahe nimittatā'pi na syāt, upādānatāvyāptatvānnimittatāyāḥ| mā'stu nimittatā'pīti cet tarhi sattvamapi gatam, arthakriyākāritvasya sattvalakṣaṇatvāt. pravṛttisantānālayavitrānasantānābhyāṃ sambhūya santānadvayamupādīyata iti cet tarhi kimaparāddhamavayavisaṃyogādibhiḥ, vyāsajyavṛttitāyāstvayāpyabhyupagamāt| tasmājjñānenāśrayatayā'numitamātmānaṃ pratisandānaṃ sthiratvena sādhayatīti na kiñcidanupapannam| yadvā nityā buddhirnātmānaṃ kāraṇatvena gamayitumarhatītisāṅkhyamatanirāsāya sūtramidamupatiṣṭhate "ātmendriyārthasannikarṣād yanniṣpadyate tadanyat"| buddhitattvaṃ yattvayocyate tajjñānamva, buddhirupalabdhirjñānamiti hi paryyāyābhidhānaṃ taccātmādisannikarṣādutpannam, anyadeva tvadabhyupagatādantaḥkaraṇādityarthaḥ| tathāca bhavati tat ātmano liṅgamiti bhāvaḥ || 18 || <3-1-19> ātmanyanumānamabhidāya idānīṃ parātmānumānamāha -- pravṛttinivṛttī ca pratyagātmani dṛṣṭe paratra liṅgam || 19 || pratyagātmanīti| svātmanītyarthaḥ| icchādveṣajanite pravṛttinivṛttī prayatnaviśeṣau tābhyāñca hitāhitaprāptiparihāraphalake śarīrakarmaṇī ceṣṭālakṣaṇe janyete| tathāca paraśarīre ceṣṭā dṛṣṭvā iyaṃ ceṣṭā prayatnajanyāceṣṭātvāt madīyaceṣṭāvat sa ca prayatna ātmajanyaḥ ātmaniṣṭho vā prayatnatvāt madīyaprayatnavaditi paramātmānumānam || 19 || iti śāṅkare vaiśeṣikasūtropaskāre tṛtīyādhyāyasyādyamāhnikam| tṛtīyādhyāye dvitīyāhnikam <3-2-1> hetuhetvābhāsavivekaḥ āhnikārthaḥ| idānīmātmaparokṣāṃśe varttayiṣyan uddeśakramalaṅghanena manaḥparīkṣāmavatārayannāha -- ātmendriyārthasannikarṣe jñānasya bhāvo'bhāvaśca manaso liṅgam || 1 || manogatimātmano liṅgaṃ vakṣyati| tad yadi mano jñānakaraṇatvena mūrttatvena ca parīkṣitaṃ bhavati tadā yatpreritaṃ manaḥ indriyāntarādabhimataviṣayagrāhiṇi indriye sambandhate sa ātmeti siddhaṃ bhavatītyetadarthe kramalaṅghanam| ātmendriyārthasannikarṣesati yasmin indriyasannikṛṣṭe jñānasya bhāvaḥ utpādaḥ, asannikṛṣṭe jñānasyābhāvo'nutpādastanmana ityarthaḥ| nanu manovaibhave'pi karaṇadharmatvādeva jñānāsamavāyikāraṇasaṃyogādhāratvādātmavat, sparśātyantābhāvavattvādākāśavadityādi vaibhavasādhakaṃ pramāṇamiti cet, maivam yadi mano vibhu syāttadā sarvendriyasannikṛṣṭāttataḥ sarvendriyakamekameva jñānaṃ syāt| kāryyavirodhānnaivamiti cenna na hi sāmagrī virodhāvirodhamākalayati yena cākṣuṣatvarāsanatvādivirodhāya bibhyet, citrarūpavat citrākārameva vā syāt| bhavatyeva dīrghaśaṣkulībhakṣaṇasthale iti cenna tatrāpi vyāsaṅgadarśanāt| tarhi rūparasagandhasparśān yugapat pratyemīti kathamanuvyāvasāya iti cenna śīghrasaṃcārimanojaniteṣu paṃcasu smṛtyupanītajñāneṣu yaugapadyābhimānāt| vyāsaṅgo'pi karaṇadharmādhīna iti cenna uktottaratvāt| bubhutsādhono vyāsaṅga iti cenna sarvabubhutsāyāṃ sarvaviṣayakasarvodayaprasaṃgāt| bubhutsāyā api abhimatārthagrāhīndriyamanaḥsambandhamātraphalakatvāt, tasmājjñānāyaugapadyānyathānupapattyā sidhyati aṇu manaḥ| tato dharmigrāhakamānabāvitāḥ vaibhavahetavaḥ| kiṃca manovaibhave pāde me sukhaṃ śirasi me vedanetiprādeśikatvaṃ sukhādīnāṃ na syāt bibhukāryyāṇāmasamavāyikāraṇāvacchinnadeśe utpādaniyamāt| tathāpi sukhādīnāmaṇudeśāpattiriti cennā asamavāyikāriṇaṃ vibhukāryyaṃ svadeśe janayatyeveti niyamāt, tathāca nimittacandanādyavacchedādadhikadeśe'pi jananāvirodhāt| mamāpi nimittasamavadhānānurodha iti cenna uktaniyamabhaṃgaprasaṃgāt| kiṃcātmanā vibhunā manasaḥ saṃyogo'pi kathaṃ syāt| ajo'sāviti cenna vibhāgasyāpyajatvaprasaṃgāt| avacchedabhedenobhāvapyaviruddhāviti cenna saṃyogavibhāgayoravacchedabhedasya svakāraṇādhīnatvāt ajayostu tadabhāvāditi dik || 1 || <3-2-2> nanu sukhādyupalabdhiḥ karaṇasādhyā kriyātvāt rūpopalabdhivadityādyanumānāt yugapajjñānānutpattyā vā yanmanaḥ siddhaṃ tatkaraṇatayā tathāca tasya dravyatvaṃ nityatvañca kuta ityata āha -- tasya dravyatvanityatve vāyunā vyākhyāte || 2 || yathā'vayavidravyānumito vāyuparamāṇurguṇavattvāt kriyāvattvācca dravyam, tathā yugapajjñānātpattyā'numitaṃ mano guṇavattvād dravyaṃ, na hi tasya indriyasaṃyogamantareṇa jñānotpādakaṃ yena guṇavattvaṃ na syāt| kiñca sukhādisākṣātkāraḥ indriyakaraṇakaḥ sākṣātkāratvāt rūpādisākṣātkāravadatīndriyatvena manaḥ siddham| indriyatvañca jñānakaraṇamanaḥsaṃyogāśrayatvamityayatnasiddhameva manaso dravyatvam| nityatvañca tasyānāśritatvāt| tasyāvakalpanāyāṃ pramāṇābhāvādanāśritatvamiti || 2 || <3-2-3> tat kiṃ pratiśarīramekamanekaṃ veti sandehe nirṇāyakamāha -- prayatnāyaugapadyājjñānāyaugapadyāccaikam || 3 || manaḥ pratiśarīramiti śeṣaḥ| yadyekaikasminnapi śarīre bahūni manāṃsi syustadā jñānaprayatnānāṃ yaugapadyaṃsyāt| yattu narttakīkaracaraṇāṅgulīṣu yugapat karmadarśanād yugapadeva bahavaḥ prayatnā utpadyante iti matam| tadayuktam manasaḥ śīghrasañcārādeva tadupapatteḥ avinaśyadavasthayogyātmaviśeguṇānāṃ yaugapadyānabhyupagamāt| etenaikasminnapi śarīre paṃca manāṃsi teṣāṃ dvitricatuḥpaṃcānāṃ tattadindriyasaṃyoge dve trīṇi catvāri pañca vā jñānāni yugapajjñāyante iti mataṃ nirastama kalpanāgauravaprasaṃgāt| yaugapadyābhimānastu samarthita eva| rasanendriyāvacchedena tvagindriyasambandhena manasastikto guḍa iti jñānadvayayaugapadyāpattirapi karaṇadharmatvādeva nāsti| dvitricchinnagodhibhujagādāvapi avayavadūye karma khaḍgādyabhighātādvā manasa āśu saṃcārādvā tadānīmevādṛṣṭena paṇḍamanontaragrahaṇādvā| yattu mano'vayavyeva jalaukāvat tatsaṅkocavikāśābhyāṃ trānayaugapadyāyaugapadye iti, tat tadavayavakalpanāgauravapratihatamiti dik || 3 || <3-2-4> idānīṃ kramalaṅghanaprayojanamādarśayannevātmaparīkṣāśeṣaṃ varttayiṣyannāha -- prāṇāpānanimeṣonmeṣajīvanamanogatīndriyāntaravikārāḥ sukhaduḥkhecchādveṣaprayatnāścātmano liṅgāni || 4 || prasiddhirjñānameva kevalamātmano liṅgamiti na mantavyam prāṇādayo'pi santi ātmano liṃgāni| tathāhi śarīrāntaścāriṇi samīraṇe prāṇāpānakṣaṇe ūrdhvādhogatī ut‌kṣepaṇāvakṣepaṇe musalādāviva prayatnaṃ vinā'nupapadyamāne yasya prayatnād bhavataḥ sa nūnamātmā| na hi tiryaggamanasvabhāvasya vāyoreva svabāvaviparyayo vinā prayatnāt| na ca viruddhadik‌kriyayorvāyvoḥ salilayorivordhvagatiḥ syāditi vācyam evaṃ satyūrdhvagamanameva syānna tvadhogamanaṃ pūtkārādau vā tiryaggamanam| tathā cāsti kaścit, yaḥ prayatnena vāyumūrdhvamadho vā prerayati suṣuptidaśāyāṃ kathaṃ prāṇāpānayorūrdhvādhogatī iti cenna idānīṃ yogyaprayatnābhāve'pi prayatnāntarasya sadbhāvāt| sa eva jīvanayoniḥ prayatna ityucyate| evaṃ nimeṣonmeṣāvapi śarīrasyādhiṣṭhātāramanumāpayataḥ| tathāha nimeṣastāvat akṣipakṣmaṇoḥ saṃyogajanakaṃ karma| unmeṣastayoreva vibhāgajanakaṃ karma| ete ca karmaṇī nodanābhidhātādidṛṣṭakāraṇamantareṇa nirantaramutpadyamāne prayatnaṃ vinā notpadyete| yathā dāruputrakanartanaṃ kasyacit prayatnāt tathā'kṣipakṣmanartanamapi, tena prayatnavānanumīyate| evaṃ jīvanamapyātmaliṅgam| tathāhi jīvanapadena lakṣaṇayā jīvanakāryaṃ vṛddhikṣatabhagnasaṃrohaṇādi lakṣayati| tathā ca yathā gṛhapatirbhagnasya gṛhasya nirmmāṇaṃ karoti ladhīyo vā gṛhaṃ varddhayati, tathā dehādhiṣṭhātā gṛhasthānīyasya dehasyāhārādinā vṛddhimupacayaṃ karoti kṣatañja bheṣajādinā prarohayati bhagnañca karacaraṇādi saṃrohayati tathā ca gṛhapatiriva dehasyāpyadhiṣṭhātā sidhyatīti| evaṃ manogatirapyātmaliṅgam| tathāhi manastāvanmūrtamaṇu ceti pūrvaprakaraṇe sādhitam| tasya cābhimataviṣayagrāhiṇi indriye niveśanam icchāpraṇidhānādhīnam| tathāca yasyecchapraṇidhāne manaḥ prerayataḥ sa ātmetyanumīyate yathā gṛhakoṇāvasthito dārakaḥ kandukaṃ lākṣāguṭakaṃ vā gṛhābhyantara eva itastataḥ preyati| nanu dāruputranarttayitā gṛhapatirdārako vā na śarīrādanyo yo dṛṣṭāntaḥ kiñca śarīrameva caitanyāśrayaḥ ahaṅkārāspadatvāt, bhavati hi gauro'haṃ sthūlo'hamityādyahaṅkārasāmānādhikaraṇyena pratyayaḥ| yattu bālye'nubhūtaṃ yauvane vārddhakye vā smarati tatra caitramaitravaccharīrabhede'pi smaraṇaṃ na syāt `nānyadṛṣṭaṃ smaratyanyaḥ' iti| tatra caitramaitrayorbhinnasantānatvena pratisandhānaṃ mā'stu bālyakaumārabhede'pi santānaikatvāt kāryakāraṇabhāvena pratisandhānamupapatsyata iti| tatra brūmaḥ pitrā'nubhūtasya putreṇāpi smaraṇaprasaṅgaḥ| tatra śarīrabhedagraho bādhaka iti cet, vṛddhena bāliśarīrādbhedenaiva svaśarīrasya grahāt pratisandhānānupapatteḥ -- anupalabdhapitṛkasya bālasya śarīrabedāgrahasyāpi sattvāt| mama śarīramiti mamakārasāmānyenāhaṅkārasya bhānāt mamātmetyatrāpi tatheti cenna tatra mamakārasyaupacārikatvāt rāhoḥ śira itivadabhede'pi ṣaṣṭhyupapatteḥ, hisādiphalañca karttari na syāt śarīsyānyatvāt, pātakamicchato| bhūtacaitanikasya kṛtahānamakṛtābhyāgamaśca doṣa iti dik| indriyāntaravikārāt| rakhalvapi dṛśyate hi nāgaraṅgasya ciravilvasya vā rūpaviśeṣasahacaritaṃ rasaviśeṣamanubhūya punastādṛśaṃ phalamupalabhamāsya rasagarddhipravarttito dantodakasaṃplavaḥ| sa ca nāmlarasānumitimantareṇa, anumitirna vyāptismṛtimantareṇa, sā ca na saṃskāraṃ vinā, sa ca na vyāptyanubhavamantareṇa, sa ca na bhūyodarśanamantareṇeti iyaṃ jñānaparamparā naikaṃ tarttāramantareṇa kāryakāraṇabhūtā sambhavatīti| tathā ca gautamīyaṃ sūtram `indriyāntaravikārāt' iti| sukhādayaśac jñānavadevātmaliṅgāni draṣṭavyāḥ| tatāhi sukhādikaṃ kvacidāśritaṃ dravyāśrita vā kāryavastutvāt guṇatvādvā rūpādivaditītarabādhasahakṛtaṃ sāmānyato dṛṣṭameva aṣṭadravyātiriktadravyāśritatvaṃ viṣayīkaroti| na hi `pṛthivyādyaṣṭakānāśritā icchā dravyāśriteti' pratijñā aṣṭadravyātiriktadravyāśritatvaṃ prakāramanādāyaparyyavasyati| yatra tu prathamaṃ na vādhāvatārastatrāṣṭadravyātariktadravyāśritatvaṃ vyatirekisādhyamiti vibhāgaḥ| vyāpakatāvacchedakaprakārikaivānumitiriti tu tuccham, yena vinā pratītirna paryyavasyati tasyaiva tatra prakāratvāt| anyathā dvyapukaṃ kāryyānāśritaṃ sat kvacidāśritam avayavitvādityādāvakāryyāśritatvaprakārikā'numitirna syāt || 4 || <3-2-5> nanu sidhyatu ātmā sthiraḥ, satu nitya iti kutaḥ, kutaśca dravyamityata āha -- tasya dravyatvanityatve vāyunā vyākhyāte || 5 || yathā vāyuparamāṇoravayavakalpanāyāṃ na pramāṇamato nityatvaṃ tathātmano'pi| yathā guṇavattvādvāyuparamāṇurdravyaṃ tathātmā'pītyarthaḥ || 5 || <3-2-6> pūrvapakṣamāha -- yajñadatta iti sannikarṣe pratyakṣābhāvād dṛṣṭaṃ liṅgaṃ na vidyate || 6 || sannikarṣe sati ayaṃ yajñadatta iti cet pratyakṣaṃ nāsti tadā dṛṣṭaṃ pratyakṣato gṛhītavyāptikaṃ liṅgaṃ nāsti| yathā vahninā pratyakṣeṇa sahacarito gṛhīto dhūmo vahnau dṛṣṭaṃ liṅgaṃ tathātmasādhakaṃ liṅgaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ nāstītyarthaḥ || 6 || <3-2-7> nanu pratyakṣadṛṣṭavyāptikasya dṛṣṭaliṅgasyābhāve'pi sāmānyato dṛṣṭameva liṅgaṃ bhaviṣyati, na hi tato nānumitirityāśaṅkya punaḥ pūrvapakṣī āha -- sāmānyato dṛṣṭāccāviśeṣaḥ || 7 || sāmānyato dṛṣṭamapi liṅgaṃ bhavati na tu tata ātmatvena aṣṭadravyātiriktadravyatvena vā syādātmasiddhiḥ, kintu tenecchādīnāṃ kvacidāśritatvamātraṃ sidhyet tatha nātmamananaupayikamityarthaḥ| tadetadāha aviśeṣa iti || 7 || <3-2-8-9> tat kiṃ `yo'pahatapāpmā sa ātmā' ityādyāgamo'narthaka evetyāśaṅkya sa evāha -- tasmādāgamikaḥ || 8 || āgamamātrasiddha evātmā natvanumeyaḥ dṛṣṭasāmānyatodṛṣṭayorliṅgayorabhāvāt| tasmāt samyagupaniṣadāṃ śravaṇāt tattvasākṣātkāra utpadyate na tu mananapraṇālikayā| tathā ca mananaprayojanakamidaṃ tantramatantram| dṛṣṭa hi bhūtadaśakanadosantaraṇādāvupadeśamātrādeva sākṣātkāri jñānam| tadevaṃ tribhiḥ sūtraiḥ pūrvapakṣe siddhāntavādyāha -- ahamitiśabdasya vyatirekānnāgamikam || 9 || nāmamātraṃ pramāṇamātmani kintvahamitipadamātmapadaṃ vā sābhidheyaṃ padatvāt ghaṭādipadavad ityanumānādapyātmasiddhiḥ| nanu pṛthivyādyeva tadabhidheyaṃ syādityata āha vyatirekāditi| pṛthivyādito'hamiti padasya vyatirekāditi| pṛthivyādito'hamiti padasya vyatirekādvyāvṛtterityarthaḥ| na hi bhavatyaha pṛthivī ahamāpaḥ ahantejaḥ ahaṃ vāyuḥ ahamākāśam ahaṃ kālaḥ ahaṃ dik ahaṃ mana iti vyapadeśaḥ pratyayo vā| śarīre bhavatīti cenna paraśarīre'pi tatprasaṅgāt| svaśarīre bhavatīti cenna svasyātmabhinnasyānirukteḥ mama śarīramiti vaiyadhikaraṇyena pratyayācca| nanvidamapi sāmānyatodṛṣṭameva tacca viśeṣāparyavasannamiti dūṣatameveti cenna ahampade'hantvamātmatvameva prakāraḥ, tathāca pakṣadharmatābalādevāhantvasya pravṛttanimittaḥ paryavasannaṃ taccānanyasādhāraṇamegheti viśeṣasiddheḥ| evaṃ sāmānyato dṛṣṭādapi bādhasahakṛtādviśeṣasiddhiḥ| yaccoktaṃ `śravaṇādeva sākṣātkāraḥ kimaneneti' tadayuktam, na hi mananamantareṇa saṅkasukasyāśraddhāmalakṣālanam, na ca tadantareṇa tatra nididhyāsanādhikāraḥ, na ca nididhyāsanamantareṇa savāsanamithyājñānonmūlanakṣamastattvasākṣātkāraḥ| abyāsādeva hi kāmāturasyākasmāt kāminīsākṣātkāraḥ| na hi śābdamānumānikaṃ vā jñānaṃ mithyājñānonmūlanakṣamaṃ diṅyohādau dṛṣṭamiti bhāvaḥ| nanu tathāpi parokṣe ātmani kathaṃ saṃketagrahaḥ (dṛṣṭo hyayaṃ ghaṭapadevācya iti pratyakṣe saṃketagraha) iti cet? ka evamāha nātmā pratyakṣa iti, kintu manasā saṃyogapratyāsattyātmagrahaḥ| kathamanyathā'haṃ sukhī jānāmīcchāmi yate duḥkhītyādipratyayaḥ| nahyayamavastukaḥ sandigdhavastuko vā nīlādipratyayavat asyāpi niścitavastukatvāt| na ca laiṅgikaḥ, liṅgajñānamantareṇāpi jāyamānatvāt| nāṣi śabdaḥ, tadanusandānānanuvidhānāt| pratyakṣābhāso'yamiti cet, tarhi kvacidanābhāsaviṣayo'pi nahyapramitamāropyate ityāvedayiṣyate || 9 || <3-2-10> evañcet kimanumāneneti pūrvapakṣavādī āha -- yadi dṛṣṭamanvakṣamahaṃ devadatto'haṃ yajñadatta iti || 10 || iti śabdo jñānaprakāramāha| dṛṣṭamiti bhāvektapratyayāntam, anvakṣamityadhyakṣam| tenāyamarthaḥ -- ayaṃ devadattaḥ ayaṃ yajñadatta iti prakārakaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ daśanaṃ adhyakṣamevāsti yadi kimanumānaprayāsena `na hi kariṇi dṛṣṭe cītkāreṇa tamanumimate'mumātāraḥ" || 10 || <3-2-11> atra siddhāntyāha -- dṛṣṭayātmani liṃge eka eva dṛḍhatvāt pratyakṣavat pratyayaḥ || 11 || dṛṣṭe pratyakṣeṇa gṛhīte ātmani liṅge sambhūtasāmagrīke sati eka eva ekavaiṣayika eva pratyayaḥ| pratyaya iti nirastasamastavibhramāśaṅkitvamāha| kuta evamityata āha -- dṛḍhatvāt pramāṇasaṃplavenānyathābhāvaśaṅkānirktanapaṭutvāt| tatra dṛṣṭāntamāha -- pratyakṣavaditi| yathā dūrāttoyapratyakṣe satyapi saṃvādārthaṃ balākāliṅgenāpi tadanumānam| taduktam "pratyakṣaparikalitamapyanumānena bubhutsamte tarkarasikāḥ" iti| idamatrākūtam -- yadyātmā kadācit pratyakṣe caitasa bhāsata eva tathāpi ahaṃ gauraḥ ahaṃ kṛśaḥ ityādivirodhipratyayāntaratiraskṛto na tathā sthemānamāsādayati vidyutsampātasañjātajñānavat, tatra liṃgena ananyayāsiddhena jñānāntaramutpadyamānaṃ pūrvajñāna(viṣaya)meva sthirīkaroti| kiñca `śrotavyo mantavyaḥ' ityādividhibodhitasyātmamananasya iṣṭasādhanatvāvagatau anumitsayā'vaśyamātmānumānapravṛttiḥ tadvyatireke nididhyāsanāsambhave sākṣātkārābhāve'pavargāsambhavāditi bhāvaḥ| ahaṃ devadatto'haṃ yajñadatta iti pratītidvayāmidhānamātmanaḥ pratyātmavedanīyatvaṃ sūcayitum || 11 || <3-2-12> nanu yadi yajñadatto'hamiti pratyaya ātmani tadā yajñadatto gacchatīti gamanasāmānādhikaraṇyabhānamanupapannamityata āha -- devadatto gacchati yajñadattau gacchatītyupacārāccharīre pratyayaḥ || 12 || asti hi ahaṃ gauraḥ ahaṃ sthūla iti pratyayaḥ, asti ca mama śarīramiti bhedapratyayaḥ| tatra devadatto gacchatīti gatisāmānādhikaraṇyānubhavo vyavahāraśca bhāktaḥ, mameti pratyayasya yathārthatvāt| yadyapi devadattatvaṃ śarīravṛttirjātistena devadatto gacchatīti mukhya eva prayogo yathārtha eva ca pratyayaḥ tathāpidevadattapadaṃ tadavacchinnātmani pratyuktañcet tadaupacāriko boddhavyaḥ || 12 || <3-2-13> atra śaṅkate -- sandig‌dhastūpacāraḥ || 13 || tuśabdaḥ pūrvapakṣadyotakaḥ| ātmaśarīrayostāvadahamitipratyayaḥ grayogaścet dṛśyate tatra kva mukhyaḥ kva vaupacārika iti sandehaḥ || 13 || <3-2-14> samādhatte -- ahamiti pratyagātmani bhāvāt paratrābhāvādarthāntarapratyakṣaḥ || 14 || arthāntarabhātmatvarūpaṃ pratyakṣa yatra pratyaye sa pratyayo'rthāntarapratyakṣaḥ| ayamarthaḥ -- ahamiti pratyayasya pratyagātmani svātmani bhāvāt paratra parātmani abhāvāt arthāntare svātmanyeva mukhyaḥ kalpayitumucitaḥ| yadi tu śarīre mukhyaḥ syāt tadā bahirindriyajaḥ syāt| na hi śarīraṃ mānasapratyakṣaṃ mānasaścāyamahamiti pratyayaḥ bahirindriyavyāpāramantareṇāpi jāyamānatvāt, ahaṃ sukhī jāne yate icchāmyahamiti yogyaviśeṣaguṇopahitasyātmano manasā viṣayokaraṇāt| nāyaṃ laiṅgiko liṅgānusandhānamantareṇāpi jāyabhānatvāt| na śabdaḥ śabdākalanamantareṇāpi jāyamānatvāt| tasmānmānasa eva, manasaśca bahirasvātantryeṇa śarīrādāvapravṛtteriti bhāvaḥ| kiñca yadi śarīre syāt paraśarīre syāt, svātmani yadi syāt tadāpi parātmani syāditi cenna parātmanaḥ parasyātīndriyatvāt tadviśeṣaguṇānāmayogyatvāt, yogyaviśeṣaguṇopagraheṇa tasya yogyatvāt| na kevalamātmana idaṃ śīlaṃ kintu dravyamātrasya, dravyaṃ hi yogyaviśeṣaguṇopagraheṇaiva pratyakṣaṃ bhavati| ākāśamapi tarhi śabdopagrahaṇe vā rūpavat syāt| ātmano'pi nīrūpatve tulyamiti cet, vahirdravyamātra eva pratyakṣatāṃ prati rūpavattvasya tantratvāt| pratyagityayaṃ śabdo'nyavyāvṛttamāha || 14 || <3-2-15> punaḥ śaṅkate -- devadatto gacchatītyupacārādabhimānāttāvaccharīrapratyakṣe'haṅkāraḥ || 15 || ahaṅkāro'hamiti pratyayaḥ| sa ca śarīrapratyakṣaḥ śarīraṃ pratyakṣaṃ viṣayo yatra sa śarīrapratyakṣaḥ| devadatto gacchatītyupacārāttāvat prayogaḥ pratyayo vā tvayā samāhitaḥ| sa copacāra ābhimānikaḥ yato'haṃ gauraḥ ahaṃ kṛśaḥ saubhāgino'ha punaruktajanmetyādayaḥ pratyayāḥ prayogāścopacāreṇa samanvayitumaśavayā ityarthaḥ || 15 || <3-2-16> siddhāntamāha -- sandigdhastūpacāraḥ || 16 || tuśabdo'yaṃ siddhāntamabhivyanakti| upacāro'yamābhimānikaḥ kintu śarīra evāyamahampratyaya iti yaduktaṃ tatrāpi sandeha evetyarthaḥ| tathāca pratyayasyobhayatrāpi kūṭasākṣitvena viśeṣāvadhāraṇāya yatitavyam natra yatne kriyamāṇe nimīlitākṣasyāpyahamiti -- pratyayadaśanāt śarīrabhinne bahirindriyāgocare vastuni sa mantavyaḥ| śarīre bhavan paraśarīre'pi syāt, cakṣurnairapekṣyeṇa ca na syāt| ahaṃ kṛśaḥ sthūlo vā sukhīti kathaṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyamiti cenna tukhādyavacchedakatvenāpi tatra śarīrabhānasambhavāt siṃhanādavadida gahanamitivat, ahantvamātraṃ śarīre samāropyate manasopasthitam, tvagindriyopanotamauṣṇyam uṣṇaṃ śarīramitivat || 16 || <3-2-17> siddhāntamupabṛṃhayannāha -- na tu śarīraviśeṣād yajñadattaviṣṇumitrayorjñānaṃ viṣayaḥ || 17 || jñānamiti yogyaṃ sukhaduḥkhādikamātmaguṇamupalakṣayati| yathā yajñadattaviṣṇumitrayoḥ śarīraṃ paramparabhinna tathā jñānasukhādikamapi bhinnameva| tathāca yathā yajñadattasyedaṃ śaroraṃ tathā yajñadattasya jñāne sukhādau vā'nutpanne aha sukhī jani yate icchāmāti jñānādikaṃ viṣayo bhavati yogyaśarīraviṣayakatvena tadīyarūpādivattadīyajñānādīnāmapi pratyakṣatvasambhavāt| na ca sambhavati, tasmāt jñānasukhādīnāṃ śarorādanya evāśrayo vaktavya iti bhāvaḥ| śarīraviśeṣāt śarīrasya bhedādityarthaḥ| tathāca śarīrabhedaṃ prāpya jñāna na tu viṣaya iti' lyablope pañcamī || 17 || <3-2-18> nanvātmā na pratyakṣaḥ nīrūpadravyatvāt niravayavadravyatvādvā ākāśavat, tathācāhaṃ kṛśo gaura iti buddheḥ śarīrameva viṣayo vācyaḥ, kvacidahaṃ sukhītyādivīrapi yadyapyasti tathāpyaśrayamantareṇa bhāsamānānāṃ sukhādīnāṃ śarīre samārāpa ityeva kalpayitamucitam, yathoṣṇaṃ sūrabhi jalam ityāśrayamantareṇa pratīyamānayorauṣṇyasaurabhayorjale samāropaḥ| na tvetadanurodhena jalapratyayasyāpi prasiddhajalamantareṇānyaviṣayatvam, tathā'hamityapyahantvaṃ śarīra eva vāstavam, sukhādikantu kadācittatrāropyate tenātmani pratyakṣākāraṃ jñānaṃ nāstyeva| sukhādyādhāratvena yatkalpanīyaṃ tadāgamasiddhaṃ bhavatu na tatrāpi graha ityat āha -- ahamiti mukhyayogyābhyāṃ śabdavadvyatire vyabhicārādviśeṣasiddhernāgamikaḥ || 18 || ayamarthaḥ| ahaṃ sukhī ahaṃ duḥkhītipratyayo nāgamiko na śābdo nāpi laiṅgikaḥ śabdaliṅgayāranusandhānamantareṇāpi tāyamānatvāt| pratyakṣatve ca nīrūpatvaṃ niravayavatvañcayad‌bādhakamuktaṃ tad‌bahirindriyapratyakṣatāyāṃ bhavati tatra hi rūpavattvānekadravyasattvayoḥ prayojakatvāt, mānasapratyakṣatā ca tadantareṇāpi| nanu syādevaṃ yadyātmani pramāṇaṃ syāt tadeva tu nāstītyata āha -- śabdavadvyatirekāvyabhicārādviśeṣasiddheriti| yathā kṣityādiṣu dravyeṣu śabdasya vyatireko'vyabhicāro niyatastena tadāśrayasyāṣṭadravyātiriktasyākāśarūpa(sya) viśeṣasya siddhiḥ evamicchāyāḥ pṛthivyādiṣu vyatirekasyāvyabhicārāt tadāśrayeṇāpi aṣṭadravyātiriktena bhavitavyam| nanvetāvatā'pyānumānika eva ātmā na tu pratyakṣa ityata āha -- aha miti| mukhyayogyāmyāmiti| ahamitītikāreṇa jñānakāramāha, tenāhamiti jñānaṃ śabdaliṅgānusandhānamantareṇa nimīlitākṣasya yadutpadyate tanmukhyena ahantvavatā yogyena pramāṇasiddhena upapādanīyam, natu śarīrādinā tatrecchāyā vyatirekāvyabhicārāt| mukhyayogyābhyāmityanantaram upapādanīyamiti pūraṇīyam| ātmani pramāṇāni bahūni grandhagauravapriyā tyaktāni mayūkhe'nveṣṭavyāni || 18 || <3-2-19> ātmaparīkṣāprakaraṇaṃ samāpya idānīmātmanānātvaprakaraṇamārabhate tatra pūrvapakṣasūvam -- sukhaḥdukhajñānaniṣpattyaviśeṣādaikātmyam || 19 || eka eva ātmā caitrādidehabhede'pi| kutaḥ sukhaduḥkhajñānāṃ niṣpatterutpatteraviśeṣāt, sarvaśarīrāvacchedena sukhaduḥkhajñānānāmutpattiraviśiṣṭaiva yataḥ| yadyātmabhedasādhakaṃ liṅgāntaraṃ bhavettadā sidhyedātmabhedaḥ na ca tadasti, yathā tattatpradeśāvacchedena śabdaniṣpattāvapi śabdaliṅgāviśeṣādekamevākāśam, yaugapadyādipratyayaliṅgāviśeṣādeka eva kālaḥ, pūrvāparādipratyayaliṅgāviśeṣādekaiva dik || 19 || <3-2-20> siddhāntamāha -- vyavasthāto nānā || 20 || nānāātmānaḥ| kutaḥ? vyavasthātaḥ| vyavasthā pratiniyamaḥ yathā kaścidāḍhyaḥ kaścit raṅkaḥ' kaścit sūkhī, kaścid dūḥkhī, kaściduccāmijanaḥ, kaścinnīcābhijanaḥ, kaścidvidvān kaścit jālma itīyaṃ vyavasthā ātmabhedamanatreṇānupapadyamānā sādhayatyātmanāṃ bhedam| na ca janmabhedena bālyakaumāravārddhakyabhedena vā, ekasyāpyātmano yathā vyavasthā tathā caitramaitrādidehabhede'pi syāditi vanyam kālabhedena viruddhadhamādhyāsasambhavāt || 20 || <3-2-21> pramāṇāntaramāha -- śāstrasāmarthyācca || 21 || śāstraṃ śrutiḥ, nayā'pyātmano bhedapratipādanāt| śrūyate hi `dvebrahmaṇo veditavye' ityādi tathā `dvā suparṇā sayujā sakhāyā samānaṃ vṛkṣaṃ pariṣasvajāte' ityādi ca || 21 || iti śrāśāṅkare kaṇādasūtropaskāre tṛtīyādhyāyasya dvitīyāhnikam| samāptaścāyaṃ tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ| <4> <4-1-1> pṛthivyādīnā navānāmuddeśaṃ lakṣaṇaparīkṣāṃ nivartya prakṛtermūlakāraṇatāṃ sāṅkhyā bhigatāṃ nirācikīrṣuḥ paramāṇūnāṃ mūlakāraṇatvaṃ pṛthivyādyantarbhāvañca siṣādhayiṣurnityatvasāmānyalakṣaṇaṃ tāvadāha -- sadakāraṇavannityam || 1 || na kāraṇavadakāraṇavat padasaṃskārāt| tadevaṃ ghaṭādīnāṃ vyavacchedaḥ| tathāpi prāgabhāve'tivyāptirityata āha -- saditi| sattāyogītyarthaḥ| samavāyaviśeṣapadārthayoḥ sattaikārthasamavāya eva sattāyogaḥ, sāmānyāntarasya sattāyāśca satpratyayaviṣayataiva sattāyogaḥ, sa ca pratyayo vastusvarūpamātranibandhana ityanyadetat| na cānyatrāpi tathaivāstu ki sattayeti vācyam anugatamatestat‌siddheruktatvāt || 1 || <4-1-2> nityasāmānyamabhidhāyedānīṃ paramāṇumadhikṛtyāha -- tasya kāryaṃ liṅgam || 2 || tasya paramāṇoḥ kāryaṃ ghaṭādi liṅgam| tathāca gautamoyaṃ sūtram -- `vyaktāt vyaktasya niṣpattiḥ pratyakṣaprāmāṇyāt' iti| avayavāvayaviprasaṅgastāvadanubhūyate sa yadi rniravadhiḥ syāt tadā merusarṣapayoḥ pariṇāmabhedo na syāt, anantāvayavārabdhatvāviśeṣāt| na ca parimāṇapracayaviśeṣādhīno viśeṣaḥ syāditi vācyam saṅkhyāviśeṣābhāvāttayorapyanupapatteḥ| pralayāvadhiḥ syāditi cet antyasya kasyacinniravayavatve pralayasyaivānupapatteḥ, avayavavibhāgavināśayoreva dravyanāśakatvāt| vibhāgaśca nāvadhiḥ tasyaikāśrayatvānupapatteḥ| tasmānniravayavaṃ dravyamavadhiḥ sa eva paramāṇuḥ| na ca trasareṇurevāvadhiḥ, tasya cākṣuṣadravyatvena mahattvādanekadravyavattvācca, mahattvasya cākṣuṣapratyakṣatve kāraṇatvām anekadravyavattvamādāyaiva, anyathā mahattvameva na syāt kasya kāraṇatvambhavet| na ca trasareṇoravayavā eva paramāṇavaḥ, mahaddravyārambhakatvena teṣāmapi sāvayavatvānumānāt tantuvat kapālavacca| tasmāt yat kāryyadravyaṃ tat sāvayavam, yacca sāvayavaṃ tat kāryyaṃ dravyam| tathāca yato'vayavāt kāryyatvaṃ nivarttate tatra sāvayavatvamapīti niravayavaparamāṇusiddhiḥ| taduktaṃ praśastadevācāryyaiḥ `sā ca dvividhā nityā cānityā ca' iti || 2 || <4-1-3> idānīṃ paramāṇau rūpādisiddhaye pramāṇamāha -- kāraṇabhāvāt kāryyabhāvaḥ || 3 || rūpādīnāṃ kāraṇe sadbhāvāt kāryye sadbhāvaḥ, kāraṇaguṇapūrvakā hi kāryyaguṇā bhavanti ghaṭapaṭādau tathā darśanādityarthaḥ || 3 || <4-1-4> idānīṃ sarvānityatāvādinirākaraṇāyāha -- anitya iti viseṣataḥ pratiṣedhabhāvaḥ || 4 || viśeṣata iti paṣṭhyantāttasiḥ| (tathāca) viśeṣasya nityasya pratiṣedhastadā syāt yadyanitya iti pratyayaḥ śabdaprayogaśca na syāt naña uttarapadārthaniṣevārthatvāt tat kathaṃ nityābhāve'nitya iti syāt, bhavati ca tato nityamastīti siddham| yadvā anitya iti na nityaḥ paramāṇurityanena prakāreṇa nityasya tvayā pratiṣedhaḥ katavyaḥ| anena ca prakāreṇa pratiṣedho na sidhyati siddhayasidvipratihatatvāt| sūtrañcaivaṃ yojanīyam akāraḥ svatantra eva pratiṣedhavacanaḥ `amānonāḥ pratipedhavacanāḥ' iti tathā cānitya iti na nitya ityarthaḥ| prasiṣevabhāvaḥ pratiṣedhasvarūpaṃ tena na nitya iti viśeṣasya nityasya pratiṣedhasvarūpam, tacca na sambhavatīti śeṣaḥ || 4 || <4-1-5> nanu paramāṇurna nityaḥ mūrtatvāt ghaṭavat, evaṃ rūpavattvarasavattvādayaḥ pratyekaṃ hetava unneyāḥ, evaṃ ṣaṭ‌kena yugapad‌yogāt paramāṇoḥ ṣaḍaṃśatā tathā ca sāvayavatvāt avyāpyavṛttisaṃyogāśrayatvāt| kiñca paramāṇormavye yadyākāśamasti tadā sacchidratvenaiva sāvayavatvam, atha nāsti, tadākāśasyāsarvagatatvaprasaṅgaḥ| kiñca chāyāvattvāt āvṛttimattvāt| apica yat sat tat kṣaṇikamityādikṣaṇiktvasādhakānumānādapi paramāṇoranityatā, tathā caitāvatī cedanumitiparamparā tadā kathamucyate paramāṇurnitya ityata āha -- avidyā || 5 || paramāṇoranityatvaviṣayā sarvāpyanumitiḥ avidyā bhramarūpā ābhāsaprabhavatvāt| āpātato dharmigrāhakamānabādhaḥ sarvatra vipakṣabādhakapramāṇaśanyatvādvyapyatvāsiddhiḥ kvacit svarūpāsiddhirityādi samānatantre'nveṣṭavyam || 5 || <4-1-6> nanu yadi paramāṇurasti kathamindriyeṇa na gṛhyate rūpavattvasparśava ttvādayaścaindriyakatvaprayojakāstvayaivopapāditā ityata āha -- mahatyanekadravyavattvāt rūpāccopalabdhiḥ || 6 || mahati mahattvavati dravye mahacchabdāt parimāṇavācakāt guṇa vācakāna matupo lopāt| anekadravyavattvāditi| anekaṃ dravyamāśrayo yasya tadanekadravyam tad yasyāsti tadanekadravyavat tadbhāvastasmāt anekadravyavattvāt| eva sati vāyurapi pratyakṣaḥ syādata uktaṃ rūpācceti| ud‌bhūtādanabhibhūtāditi vakṣyate| upalabdhariti| bahirindriyeṇeti śeṣaḥ| tathāca paramāṇormahattvābhāvādanupalabdhirityuktaṃ bhavati| anekadravyavattvañca anekadravyāśritatvam, avayavabahutvādhīnamahattvāśrayatvaṃ vā| na ca mahattvenaivānekadravyavattvamanyathāsiddhamiti vācyam, vaiparatyasyāpi sambhavāt| janyena janakasyānyathāsiddhirna tu janyasyeti cenna janyajanakayoryugapadanvayavyatirekagrahe'nyathāsiddhyābhāvāt, anyathā bhrāmaṇādinā daṇḍādīnāmanyathāsiddhiprasaṅgāt| mahattvotkarṣāt pratyakṣatotkarṣo dūrādāviti cenna anekadravyavattyotkarṣasyāpi tatra sambhavādvinigamanāvirahāt| kiñca markaṭakīṭasūtrajāle hastacatuṣṭayādimite dūrādapratyakṣe markaṭamātrapratyakṣatā'nekadravyavattvotkarṣādhīnaiva mahattvītkarṣasya jāle varttamānatvāt| evaṃ sūkṣmatantughaṭitapaṭādau dūratve mahattvotkarṣe'pi svalpaparimāṇamudgarādipratyakṣe draṣṭavyam || 6 || <4-1-7> rūpasamavāyino mahataścopalambhaḥ syāt ata āha -- satyapi dravyatve mahattve rūpasaṃskārābhāvādvāyoranupalabdhiḥ || 7 || rūpasaṃskārapadena rūpasamavāyo rūpodbhavo rūpānabhibhavaśca vivakṣitaḥ| tena yadyapi vāyau ya eva sparśasamavāyaḥ sa eva rūpasamavāyaḥ tathāpi rūpanirūpito nāsti tatra rūpātyantābhāvasattvāt| cākṣuṣe ca raśmau rūpasaṃskāraḥ rūpodbhavo nāsti, madhyandinolkāprakāśe ca rūpasaṃskāro rūpānibhibhavo nāsti iti na teṣāṃ pratyakṣatā| evaṃ grīṣmoṣmabharjanakapālānalakanakādiṣu rūpasaṃskārābhāva unneyaḥ| vṛttikṛtistu rūpañca rūpasaṃskāraścetyekarūpapadalopaḥ tena rūpābhāvādvāyoranupalabdhiḥ rūpasaṃskārābhāvāccakṣurādīnāmanupalabdhirityāhuḥ || 7 || <4-1-8> evaṃ paramāṇunityatāprakaraṇānantaraṃ paramāṇuliṅgatayopoddhātasaṅgatyā vahirdravyapratyakṣatāprakaraṇaṃ samāpya upoddhātena guṇapratyakṣatāprakaraṇaṃ vartayiṣyannāha -- anekadravyasamavāyāt rūpaviśeṣācca rūpopalabdhiḥ || 8 || rūpagato viśeṣo rūpaviśeṣaḥ taccodbhūtatvamanabhibhūtatvaṃ rūpatvañca tasmādrūpasyolabdhiḥ| nanvevaṃ paramāṇordvyaṇukasya ca rūpaṃ gṛhyetetyata uktamanekadravyasamavāyāditi| anekapadaṃ bhūyastvaparaṃ tenānekāni bhūyāṃsi dravyāṇi āśrayatayā yasya tadanekadravyaṃ trasareṇuprabhṛti tatsamavāyāt ghaṭādayo'pyavayavadvayārabdhāḥ paramparayā'nekadravyāśrayā eva, rasasparśādau rūpādiviśeṣaguṇagato jātiviśeṣa eva rūpatvādivyāpyaḥ| nanvevaṃ śuklatvasurabhitvaśītatvakaṭutvādibhirapi parāparabhāvānupapattireva, tatdvyāpyatannānātvakalpane tu kalpanāgauravam udbhavapadasya nānārthatvañceti cenna bāhyaikaikendriyagrahaṇayogyaguṇatvasyaivopādherudbhavatvāt tadupādhivirahasyaivānudbhavatvāt| anudbhavābhāva eva udbhava iti kecit| taccintyam anudbhavatyāpvevaṃ vvasthāpayitumaśakyatvāt| atīndriyaviśeṣaguṇatvamanudbhūtatvamiti cet, evaṃ tarhiṃ aindriyakaviśeṣaguṇatvasyaivodbhavatvāpatteḥ| aindriyakatvāvacchedakaṃ kimiti cet, tulyam| viśeṣaguṇeṣvekaivodbhūtatvaṃ jātiḥ guṇagatajātau parāparabhāvānupapattirna doṣāyetyapi vadanti || 8 || <4-1-9> sparśātiriktānāṃ rūpasāmānādhikaraṇyameva bahirindriyagrāhyatāprayojakamiti rūpapratyakṣasāmagrīmabhidhāya tāmanyatrātidiśannāha -- tena rasagandhasparśeṣu jñānaṃ vyākhyātam || 9 || teneti rūpapratyakṣajñānenetyarthaḥ| yathā rūpaviśeṣāt rūpatvānabhibhūtatvodbūtatvādrūpopalabdhistathā rasaviśeṣāt rasatvānabhibhūtatvodbhūtatvalakṣaṇāt rasopalabdhiḥ, evamitaratrāmi yojyam| anekadravyasamavāyaścātideśyaḥ| ghrāṇarasanatvagindriyāṇāmanudbhavādgandharasasparśānāmagrahaṇam, pāṣāṇādāvanudbhavādgandharasayoḥ -- tadbhasmanitayorupalambhāt| tayoḥ pāṣāṇādāvupalambha eva na tu spaṣṭaityeke| vibhaktāvayavāpyadravyarūpānudbhavāttadagrahaṇam| evaṃ rasasyāpi| uṣṇa jale tejorūpasyānudbhavāt sparśasya cābhibhavāt, vitatakarpūracampakādau rūparasasparśānāmanudbhavādanupalambhaḥ| kanakādau rūpamudbhūtameva śuklatvabhāsvaratve paramabhibhūte| rūpamapyabhibhūtamityeke| kanakagrahaṇantu rūpāntarasāhacaryāt| abhibhavaśca balavatsajātīyagrahaṇakṛtamagrahaṇaṃ na tu balavatsajātīyasambandhamātram, balavatsajātīyasambandhasyāpyagrahaṇanirūpyatayā agrahaṇasyaivopajīvyatvāt| na cāgrahaṇaprayojakatvena balavatsajātīya evopajīvyaḥ, agrahaṇasya grahaṇapāgabhāvasya tadatyantābhāvasya vā tadaprayojyatvāt, grahaṇadhvaṃsasya ca tatrābhāvāt| tavāpi tarhi balavatsajātīyagrahaṇakṛtamagrahaṇamanupapannameveti cet, astvevam, tathāpi sajātīyasya balavattve durbalatve vā tādṛśasambandhasatve vā grahaṇāgrahaṇe eva prayojake iti sa evābhibhavapadārthaḥ || 9 || <4-1-10> nanu gurutvamapyanekadravyasamavetaṃ rūpamahattvasamānādhikaraṇañceti kathaṃ na pratyamata āha -- tasyābhāvādavyabhicāraḥ || 10 || tasya rūpatvādeḥ sāmānyasya udbhavasya ca gurutve'bhāvānna gurutvaṃ pratyakṣam| nanu mābhūt tatra rūpatvādikaṃ tathāpi tatpratyakṣaṃ syādata āha avyabhicāra iti| ekaikendriyagrāhyatvaṃ prati rūpatvādīnāṃ pañcānāṃ jātīnām avyabhicāro niyama eva| yatraiva rūpatvādipañcakānyatamaṃ tatraiva vāhyaikaikendriyagrāhyatvaṃ tadvyatirekādityarthaḥ| sūtre tu gurutvādikārasyāsphuṭatvāt praśastadevairatīndriyeṣu madhye parigaṇitamapi vallabhācāryyaiḥ spārśanamuktaṃ gurutvam || 10 || <4-1-11> evamekaikendriyagrāhyānabhidhāya dvīnadriyagrāhyānāha -- saṃkhyāḥ parimāṇāni pṛthak‌tvaṃ saṃyogavibhāgau paratvāparatve karma ca rūpidravyasamavāyāt cākṣuṣāṇi || 11 || eteṣāṃ cākṣuṣatve spārśanatve vā parasparānapekṣatvasūcanāyāsamāsaḥ| yadyapi mahattvāpekṣā'rita tathāpi na paribhāṇatvena| cakāraḥ snehadravatvavegānāmupasaṅgrahārthaḥ| cākṣuṣāṇīti sparśanatvamapyupalakṣayati| yadā cakāra eva cākṣuṣāṇi cetyatrāpi yojyaḥ| saṅkhyā -- iti bahuvacanam ekatvādikāḥ sarvā eva saṅkhyāḥ saṅgṛhṇāti| ekatvaṃ sāmānyameva na tu guṇa iti cet tad yadi dravyamātravṛtti tadā dravyatvena sahānyūnānatiriktavṛttitvam| atha guṇakarmaṇorapi vartate tadā sattayā sahā nyūnānatiriktavṛttitvam| kathaṃ tarhi guṇādāvapyekatvādi pratyaya iti cet, āropitenaikatvana, ekārthasamavāyapratyāsattyāsamyagevaikatvapratyayī vā tadetadekatvaṃ nityadravyeṣu nityam anityeṣu ca kāraṇaikatvāsamavāyikāraṇakam| dvitvādikantu apekṣābuddhijanyam| apekṣābuddhiśca nānaikatvasamūhālambanarūpā, sajātīyayorvijātīyayorvā dravyayoścakṣuṣā sannikarṣe || 11 || <4-1-12> etāvantyeva karmaparyantāni abhipretyāha -- arūpiṣvacākṣuṣāṇi || 12 || rūparahitadravyeṣu varttamānāni karmaparyantāni saṅkhyādīnyacākṣuṣāṇi, na spārśanānītyapi draṣṭavyam| apratyakṣāṇīti noktam, tathā satyātmaikatvamapi pratyakṣaṃ na syāt || 12 || <4-1-13> rūpādīnāmekaikendriyagrāhyatvaṃ saṅkhyādīnāṃ dvindviyagrāhyatvaṃ sukhādīnāṃ mānasatvaṃ, tathā ca sattāguṇatvayoḥ sāmānyayoḥ sarvendriyagrāhyatvamāyātamityāha -- etena guṇatve bhāve ca sarvendriyaṃ vyākhyātam || 13 || vyaktigrahaṇayogyataiva jātigrahaṇayogyatā| vyaktayaśya yathāyathaṃ yadi sarve ndriyaigṛhyante tadā jātyorapi guṇatvasattayoḥ sarvendriyagrāhyatvaṃ paryyavasannamityarthaḥ || 13 || iti śrīśāṅkare vaiśeṣikasūtropaskāre caturthādhyāyasyādyamāhnikam| caturthādhyāye dvitīyamāhnikam <4-2-1> sparśavaddravyaparīkṣārthe caturthādhyāye mūlakāraṇaparamāṇuparīkṣānantaraṃ kāryadvārā sparśavantyeva dravyāṇi parīcikṣiṣurāha -- tat punaḥ pṛthivyādikāryadravyaṃ trividhaṃ śarīrendriyaviṣayasaṃjñakam || 1 || tatra śarīratvaṃ prayatnavadātmasaṃyogāsamavāyikāraṇavat kriyāvadantyāvayavitvam upādhibhedaḥ, na tu śarīratvaṃ jātiḥ pṛthivītvādinā parāparabhāvānupapatteḥ| indriyatvañca smṛtyajanakajñānakāraṇamanaḥ saṃyogāśrayatvam, śabdetarodbhūtaviśeṣaguṇānāśrayatve sati jñānakāraṇamanaḥsaṃyogāśrayatvaṃ vā| naktañcaranayanaraśmistu tejo'ntarameva| cukṣuṣṭve tu śabdarūpetarodbūtaviśeṣaguṇānāśrayatve satīti deyam, na tvindriyatvaṃ jātiḥ, pṛthivītvādinā parāparabhāvānupapatteḥ| viṣayatvañca yadyapi pratīyamānatayā bhogasādhanatvam, tacca laukikasākṣāt‌kāraviṣayatvameva dravyaguṇakarmasāmānyābhāvasādhāraṇam, tathāpi sūtrānurodhāt laukikasākṣātkāraviṣayakakāryadravyatvaṃ draṣṭavyam| trividhamiti hi sūtram, tathā ca viṣayatvamapi na jātiḥ || 1 || <4-2-2> idānīṃ śarīrasya traibhautikatvacāturbhautikatvapravādaṃ nirākarttumāha -- pratyakṣāpratyakṣāṇāṃ saṃyogasyāpratyakṣatvāt pañcātmakaṃ na vidyate || 2 || `gandhakledapākavyūhāvakāśadānebhyaḥ pāñcabhautikaṃ' a.3 ā.1 sū.3. yadi śarīraṃ bhavet tadā'pratyakṣaṃ bhavet yathā pratyakṣāpratyakṣāṇāṃ vāyuvanaspatīnāṃsaṃyogo'pratyakṣastathā śarīramapyapratyakṣaṃ syāditi dṛṣṭāntadvārakaṃ sūtram| pañcātmakaṃ na vidyate iti| śarīramiti śeṣaḥ| kledapākādayastu upaṣṭambhakajalānalagatā eva| cāturbhautiko'pyevam| nanvastu traibhautikam trayāṇāṃ bhūtānāṃ pratyakṣatvāditi cenna vijātīyārambhasya pratiṣedhāt| ekasya guṇasyāvayavini guṇānārambhakatvāt| tad yadi pṛthivījalābhyāmārambhaḥ syāt tadā tadārabdhamagandhamarasañca syāt, evaṃ pṛthivyanalābhyāmagandhamarūpamarasañca syāt pṛthivyanilābhyāmagandhamarasamarūpamasparśañca syādityād‌yūhyam || 2 || <4-2-3> etadevāha -- guṇāntarāprādurbhāvācca na tryātmakam || 3 || pṛthivyaptejasāṃ pratyakṣāṇāmevārabdhaṃ śarīraṃ pratyakṣaṃ syādapi, yadi tatra guṇāntaraṃ kāraṇaguṇapūrvakaṃ prādurbhavet, na tvetadasti ekasya gandhāderanārambhakatvasyoktatvāt| tathā ca na tryātmakamapi śarīraṃ na rūpavadabhūtatrayārabdhamapītyarthaḥ || 3 || <4-2-4> kathaṃ tarhyekasminneva śarīre pākādīnāmupalambhaḥ? ityata āha -- aṇusaṃyogastvapratiṣiddhaḥ || 4 || mithaḥ pañcānāṃ bhūtānāṃ parasparamupaṣṭambhakatayā saṃyogo na niṣidhyate, kintu vijātīyayoraṇvordravyaṃ pratyasamavāyikāraṇaṃ saṃyogo neṣyate, tathā ca tadupaṣṭambhāt pākādīnāṃ śarīre bhavatyupalambha iti| tarhi kimprakṛtikamidaṃ mānuṣaśarīramityatra gautamīyaṃ sūtramupatiṣṭhate `pārthivaṃ tad viśeṣaguṇepalabdheḥ a. 3 ā. 1 sū. 31| pṛthivīviśeṣaguṇo gandho mānuṣaśarīre ānāśamanapāyī dṛśyate, pākādayastu
