śuṣkaśarīre nopalabhyante iti teṣāmaupādhikatvaṃ gandhasya svābhāvikatvamiti pārthivatvavyavasthiteḥ || 4 || <4-2-5> śarīraṃ vibhajate -- tatra śarīraṃ dvividhaṃ yonijamayonijañca || 5 || tatra pārthivāpyādiśarīreṣu madhye pārthivaṃ śarīraṃ dvividham| ke te dve vidhe ityatrāha yonijamayonijañceti| āpyataijasavāyavīyaśarīrāṇāṃ varuṇādityavāyulokeṣu prasiddhānāmayonijatvameva| ayonijatvaṃ śukraśoṇitasannipātānapekṣatvam| ayonijañca devānāmṛṣīṇāñca, śrūyate hi `brahmaṇo mānasā manvādayaḥ' iti| kāraṇamantareṇa kathaṃ kāryyamiti cet yoneḥ śarīratvāvacchedenākāraṇatvāt uṣmajakṛmimaśakādiśarīre vyabhicārāt, saṃsthānaviśeṣavattvasya cāsiddheḥ devarṣiśarīrāpekṣayā'smadādiśarīrāṇāmanyādṛśatvāt| yonijamapi dvividhaṃ jarāyujamaṇḍajañja| jarāyujaṃ mānuṣapaśumṛgāṇāṃ garbhāśayasya jarāyutvāt pakṣisarīsṛpāṇāmaṇḍajaṃ paritaḥ sarpaṇaśīlatvāt, sarpakīṭamatsyādayo'pi sarīsṛpā eva| yadyapi vṛkṣādayo'pi śarīrabhedā eva bhogādhiṣṭhānatvāt, na khalu bhogādhiṣṭhānatvamantareṇajīvanamaraṇasvapnajāgaraṇabheṣajaprayogabījasajātīyānubandhānukūlopagamapratikūlopagamādayaḥ sambhavanti| vṛddhikṣatabhagnasaṃrohaṇe ca bhogopapādake sphuṭe eva, āgamo'pyasti -- narmadātīrasambhūtāḥ saralārjunapādapāḥ| narmadātoyasaṃsparśād ye yānti paramāṃ gatim || ityādiḥ| śmaśāne jāyate vṛkṣaḥ kahkagṛdhrādisevitaḥ| ityādiśca, tathāpi ceṣṭāvattvamindriyavattvañca nodbhidāṃ sphuṭataramato na śarīravyavahāraḥ || 5 || <4-2-6> ayonijaśarīrotpattikāraṇamāha -- aniyatadigdeśapūrvakatvāt || 6 || aniyatadigdeśāḥ paramāṇavo dharmaviśeṣajanitakarmāṇastat‌pūrvakatvādayonijaśarīrāṇām || 6 || <4-2-7> nanu paramāṇūnāṃ karmavinā kathaṃ dravyāsamavāyikāraṇaṃ saṃyogaḥ, kathaṃ vā saṃyogamantareṇa dravyotpattirata āha -- dharmaviśeṣācca adṛṣṭavadātmasaṃyogādeva sargādau paramāṇūnāṃ karma tena ca karmaṇā sambhūya paramāṇavo dvyaṇukādiprakrameṇa ayonijaṃ devarṣīṇāṃ śarīramārabhante ityarthaḥ| upalakṣaṇañcaitat adharmaviśeṣācca kṣudrajantūnāmūṣmajānāṃ maśakādīnāṃ yātanāmayāni śarīrāṇyutpadyante ityapi draṣṭavyam || 7 || <4-2-8> devarṣīṇāmayonije śarīre pramāṇāntaramāha -- samākhyābhāvācca || 8 || samākhyā anvarthā saṃjñā śrutismṛtītihāsapurāṇādiṣu prasiddhā| tathāhi"durvāsaḥprabhṛtayomānasāḥ, ahahkārebhyaḥ samabhavadaṅgirā" ityādikā, tathā'pi jñāyate santyayonijāni śarīrāṇi devarṣīṇāmiti || 8 || <4-2-9> pramāṇāntaramāha -- saṃjñāyā āditvāt || 9 || sargādau yā brahmādisaṃjñā ādibhūtā prāthamikī tayā jñāyate astyayonijaṃ śarīramiti, nahi tadā brahmaṇo mātāpitarau staḥ yābhyāṃ brahmādisajñā kṛtā syāditi bhāvaḥ || 9 || <4-2-10> upasaṃharita -- santyayonijāḥ || 10 || śarīraviśeṣā iti śeṣaḥ || 10 || <4-2-11> upasaṃhṛte'tidāḍharyārthaṃ pramāṇāntaramāha -- vedaliṅgācca || 11 || vedo mantraḥ sa ca liṅgyate jñāpyate'neneti vedaliṅgaṃ brāhmaṇam, tato'pyayonijaṃ śarīraṃ pratipadyate ityarthaḥ| tathāhi brāhmaṇam -- prajāpatiḥ prajā anekā asṛjat sa tapo'tapyata prajāḥ sṛjeyamiti sa mukhato brāhmaṇamasṛjat bāhubhyāṃrājanya mūrubhyāṃ vaiśyam pad‌bhyāṃ śūdram' iti| vedo'pi `brāhmaṇo'sya mukhamāsīt bāhū rājanyaḥ kṛtaḥ| ūrū tadasya yadvaiśyaḥ padbhyāṃ śūdro ajāyata' ityādiḥ| tadeva yonijamayonijañca pārthivaśarīramuktam| āpyaṃ taijasaṃ vāyavoyañcāyonijamaiva śukraśoṇitayorniyamena pārthivatvāt, pārthivena ca pāthasīyānārambhāt| indriyantu pārthivaṃ ghrāṇaṃ sarvaprāṇabhṛt‌sādhāraṇaṃ jalādyanabhibhūtaiḥ pārthivabhāgairārabdhraṃ ghrāṇam| ghrāṇaṃ pārthivaṃ rasādyavyañjakatve sati gandhavyañjakatvāt mṛgamadagandhavyañjakakukkuṭoccāravat| evaṃ rasanamāpyaṃ rūpādyavyañjakatve sati rasasyaiva vyañjakatvāt sakturasābhivyañjakasalilavat| evañcakṣustaijasaṃ rasādyavyañjakatve sati rūpasyaiva vyañjakatvādālokavat| tvagindriyaṃ vāyavīyaṃ gandhādyavyañjakatve sati sparśasyaiva vyañjakatvāt aṅgasaṅgisalilaśaityābhivyañjakavyajanavātavat| viṣayastu pārthiyo mṛtpāṣāṇasthāvaralakṣaṇaḥ| tatra bhūpradeśāḥ prākāreṣṭakādayo mṛdvikārāḥ, adrimaṇihīrakagairikādayaḥ pāṣāṇāḥ, sthāvarāstṛṇauṣadhivṛkṣagulmalatāvatānavanaspatayaḥ| āpyāstu viṣayāḥ saritsamudrahimakarakādayaḥ| taijasastu viṣayo bhaumadivyodaryākarajabhedāccaturvidhaḥ| bhaumaṃ kāṣṭhendhanaprabhavam| divyam abindhanaṃ vidyudādi| udaryyam annādirasārjanakṣamaṃ jāṭharam| ākarajañja hiraṇyādi| vāyavīyastu viṣayaḥ upalabhyamānasparśāśrayo vāyuḥ| vāyoścaturthaḥ kāryaḥ prāṇākhyaḥ śarīre rasamaladhātūnāṃ preraṇādiheturekaḥ san kriyābhedādapānādisaṃjñāṃ labhata iti || 11 || iti śrīśāṅkare vaiśeṣikasūtropaskāre caturthādhyāyasya dvitīyamāhnikam| samāptaścāyaṃ caturthodhyāyaḥ| <5> <5-1-1> karmaparīkṣā pañcamādhyāyārthaḥ| prayatnaniṣpādyakamaparīkṣā prathamāhnikārthaḥ| tatrāpyutkṣepaṇaprakaraṇam, aprayatnasiddhotkṣepaṇaprakaraṇam, puṇyahetukamaprakaraṇam, puṇyapāpodāsīnakarmaprakaraṇañca| ceṣṭāviśeṣamadhikṛtyāha -- ātmasaṃyogaprayatnābhyāṃ haste karma || 1 || saṃyogaśca prayatnaśca saṃyogaprayatnau ātmanaḥ saṃyogaprayatnau tābhyāṃ haste samavāyikāraṇe karma| tasya ca karmaṇaḥ prayatnavadātmasaṃyogo'samavāyikāraṇam, prayatnaśca nimittakāraṇam| iyameva ceṣṭā, prayatnavadātmasaṃyogāsamavāyikāraṇakriyāyāśceṣṭātvāt, svāsamavetasvātiriktasparśavadanyaprayatnajanyakriyāyā vā || 1 || <5-1-2> hastotkṣepaṇamukvā tadadhīnaṃ musalotkṣepaṇamāha -- tathā hastasaṃyogācca musale karma || 2 || cakāreṇa gurutvaṃ nimittakāraṇāntaraṃ samuccinoti| tatheti| tādṛśamutkṣepaṇarūpamevetyarthaḥ| yadvā tathā hastasaṃyogādutkṣepaṇavaddhastasaṃyogādityarthaḥ| atra ca prayatnavadātmasaṃyuktena hastena musalasya saṃyogo'samavāyikāraṇam, musalaṃ samavāyikāraṇam, prayatnagurutve nimittakāraṇe || 2 || <5-1-3> udūkhalābhihatasya musalasyākasmād yadutpatanaṃ jāyate tatra kāraṇamāha -- abhighātaje musalādau karmaṇi vyatirekādakāraṇaṃ hastasaṃyogaḥ || 3 || atra yadyapi musalena utpatatā hastasya saṃyogo'pyasti tathā'pi sa saṃyogo'nyathāsiddhaḥ kintu udūkhalābhighāta eva asamavāyikāraṇam| kuta evamityata āha vyatirekāditi| prayatnasya vyabhicārādityarthaḥ| yadi tadā prayatnaḥ syāt musalasyaivākasmikamutpatanaṃ na bhavet vidhārakeṇa prayatnena musalasya dhāraṇameva bhavet ceṣṭādhīnaṃ musalasya punarutpatanaṃ vā bhavet iti bhāvaḥ || 3 || <5-1-4> saṃyogasyāsamavāyikāraṇatvaṃ nirākartumāha -- tathātmasaṃyogo hastakarmaṇi || 4 || musalena sahotpatato hastasya karmaṇi ātmasaṃyogaḥ prayatnavadātmasaṃyogastathā akāraṇamityarthaḥ| akāraṇamiti pūrvasūtrasthaṃ tathetyatediśyate || 4 || <5-1-5> kutastarhi haste tadotpatanamata āha -- abhidhātānmusalasaṃyogāddhaste karma || 5 || yathā musale utpatati musalamukhasthaṃ lohamutpatati tathā hasto'pi tadotpatati| atrābhighātaśabdena abhighātajanitaḥ saṃskāra ucyate upacārāt| utpatato musalasya paṭutareṇa karmaṇā abhighātasahakṛtena svāśraye musale saṃskāro janitastatkṛtaṃ saṃskāramapekṣya hastamusalasaṃyogādasamavāyikāraṇāddhaste'pyutpatanaṃ na tu tadutpatanaṃ prayatnavadātmasaṃyogāsamavāyikāraṇakam, avaśo hi hasto musalena sahītpatatīti bhāvaḥ || 5 || <5-1-6> nanu śarīre śarīrāvayave vā yat karmotpadyate tatra prayatnavadātmasaṃyogaḥ kāraṇaṃ prakṛte kathaṃ na tathetyata āha -- ātmakarma hastasaṃyogācca || 6 || ātmaśabdaḥ śarīrāvayavapara upacārāt| anvayānupapattirevopacārabījam| tathā cātmanaḥ śarīrāvayavasyāpi hastasya yat karma tat hastamusalasaṃyogāt| cakārācca vegasamuccayaḥ| hastakarmaṇi hastasaṃyogastāvadasamavāyikāraṇaṃ tatra vyabhicāro nāsti| sa ca kvicit prayatnavadātmahastasaṃyogaḥ, kvacidvegavanmusalādihastasaṃyogo yathā vātulasya śarīrāvayavakarmeti bhāvaḥ || 6 || <5-1-7> prayatnānadhīnakarmaprakaraṇamārabhate -- saṃyogābhāve gurutvāt patanam || 7 || saṃyogapadena pratibandhakamātramupalakṣayati, tena pratibandhakābhāve gurutvādasamavāyikāraṇāt patanam adhaḥsaṃyogaphalikā kriyā jāyate| tatra gurutvavati phalādau pratibandhakaḥ saṃyogaḥ, vihaṅgamādau tu vidhārakaḥ prayatnaḥ patanapratibandhakaḥ, kāṇḍādau kṣipte saṃskāra eva patatapratibandhakaḥ| eteṣāmabhāve gurutvādīnaṃ patanamityarthaḥ| abhidhyānādinā viṣāderantarikṣasthāpane adṛṣṭavadātmasaṃyogo mantrādireva vā pratibandhakasteṣāmapi saṃyogapadena saṃgrahaḥ || 7 || <5-1-8> nanu gurutvād yadi patanaṃ tadā loṣṭāderut‌kṣiptasya kacidūrdhvaṃ kvacicca tiryyaggamanaṃ kathambhavedityata āha -- nodanaviśeṣābhāvānnordhvaṃ na tiryyaggamanam || 8 || gurutvatato'pi loṣṭakāṇḍāderyadūrdhvaṃ tirthyak ca gamanaṃ tannodanaviśeṣāt tīvratarānnodanāt| tathāca phalapakṣibāṇādau saṃyogaprayatnasaṃskārābhāve yat patanaṃ tatra nodanaviśeṣo nāsti tena na tiryyaṅna vordhvaṃ gamanamiti bhāvaḥ || 8 || <5-1-9-10> nanu nodanaviśeṣa eva kuta utpadyate tatrāha -- prayatnaviśeṣānnodanaviśeṣaḥ || 9 || nodanaviśeṣādudasanaviśeṣaḥ || 10 || tiryyake ūrdhvaṃ dūram āsanne vā kṣipamītīcchākāraṇakaḥ prayatnaviśeṣaḥ tajjanito nodanaviśeṣastato gurutvavato dravyasya loṣṭāderūrdhvaṃ tiryak ca gamanamupapadyate| udasanaṃdūrotkṣepaṇam || 9 || 10 || <5-1-11> udūkhalābighātāt musalena saha haste yat karma utpannaṃ tattāvat prayatnapūrvakaṃ na bhavati, nāpi puṇyapāpaheturatastattulyāṃ bālakasya krīḍākaracaraṇādicālanaṃ yattatrātidiśati -- hastakarmaṇā dārakakarma vyākhyātam || 11 || bālakasya yadyapi karacaraṇādicālanaṃ prayatnapūrvakameva tathāpi hitāhitaprāptiphalakaṃ na bhavati na vā puṇyapāpaheturityatideśārthaḥ || 11 || <5-1-12> idānīṃ prayatnapūrvake'pi karmaṇi yatra na puṇyapāpahetutvaṃ tatra dārakakarmatulyatāmatidiśannāha -- tathā dagdhasya visphoṭane || 12 || ātatāyinā kenā'pyagāre dāhyamāne tatra dagdhasya puruṣasya visphoṭe vahnikṛte jāte sati tasyātatāyino vadhānukūlena prayatnena hastādau yat karma janitaṃ tanna puṇyaheturma vā pāpahetuḥ| yathāhuḥ -- nātatāyivaghe doṣo hanturbhavati kaścana| prakāśaṃ vā'prakāśaṃ vā manyustanmanyumṛcchati agnido garadaścaiva śastrapāṇirdhanāpahā| kṣetradārāpahārī ca ṣaḍete ātatāyinaḥ || 12 || <5-1-13> idānīṃ yatnaṃ vinā yāni karmāṇi bhavanti tānyāha -- yatnābhāve prasuptasya calanam || 13 || prasuptasyeti caitanyābhāvadaśāmupalakṣayati| tena mūrcchitasya jīvato'caitanye'pi vāyukṛtaṃ calanaṃ draṣṭavyamatra || 13 || <5-1-14> śarīrakarmāṇi vyākhyāya taditarāṇyāha -- tṛṇe karma vāyusaṃyogāt || 14 || tṛṇapadena vṛkṣagulmalatāvatānādikaṃ sarvamupalakṣayati || 14 || <5-1-15> adṛṣṭādhīnaṃ karma parigaṇayannāha -- maṇigamanaṃ sūcyabhisarpaṇamadṛṣṭakāraṇakam || 15 || maṇipadena kāsyādikamupalakṣayati| tenābhimantritaṃ maṇikāṃsyādi taskarābhimukhaṃ yad gacchati tatra gamane maṇyādi samavāyikāraṇam, adṛṣṭavattaskarātmamaṇisaṃyogo'samavāyikāraṇam, taskarasya pāpaṃ nimittakāraṇam| sūcyabhisarpaṇamiti| sūcīpadena lohamātraṃ tṛṇañcopalakṣayati| tathā cāyaskāntābhimukha yat sūcyādergamanaṃ tatra sūcyādi samavāyikāraṇam, yasya hitamahita vā tena tṛṇasūcyādigamanena tadadṛṣṭavadātmasaṃyogo'samavāyikāraṇam, tadadṛṣṭameva nimittakāraṇam| evamanyadapyūhyam| tad yathā vahnerūrdhvajvalanaṃ vāyostiryaggamanaṃ sargādau paramāṇukarmādi || 15 || <5-1-16> nanu śaravihaṅgamālātacakrādīnāmuparamaparyyantamekameva karma nānā veti saṃśaye nirṇayahetumāha -- iṣāvayugapatsaṃyogaviśeṣāḥ karmānyatve hetuḥ || 16 || iṣāviti ṣaṣṭhyarthe saptamī| idamatrākūtamvegena gacchatāṃ śarādīnāṃ kṛḍyādisaṃyogānantaraṃ śarādau satyeva gatyuparamo dṛśyate atrāśrayanāśastāvanna tannāśakaḥ āśrayasya vidyamānatvāt| virodhiguṇāntarañca nopalabhyate, tena svajanyaḥ saṃyoga eva karmanāśaka ityunnīyate| sa ca saṃyogaścaturthakṣaṇe jātaḥ pañcamakṣaṇe karma nāśayati| tathāhi karmotpattiratha vibhāgaḥ atha pūrvasaṃyoganāśaḥ uttarasaṃyogaḥ karmanāśaḥ| tenāyugapatsaṃyogaviśeṣaḥ karmanānātvajñāpakā ityarthaḥ| saṃyogaviśeṣā iti| saṃyoge viśeṣa svajanyatvameva anyathā saṃyogamātrasya karmanāśakatve karma kvacidapi na tiṣṭhet || 16 || <5-1-17> nodananiṣpādyakarmaprakaraṇānantaraṃ saṃskāraniṣpādyakarmaprakaraṇamārabhate -- nodanādādyamiṣoḥ karma tat‌karmakāritācca saṃskārāduttaraṃ tathottaramuttarañca || 17 || puruṣaprayatnenākṛṣṭayā patañjikayā nunnasyeṣorādya karma jāyate, tatra nodanamasamavāyikāraṇam, iṣuḥ samavāyikāraṇam, prayatnagurutve nimittakāraṇe tena cādyena karmaṇā samānādhikaraṇo vegākhyaḥ saṃskāro janyate| sa ca vegena gacchatīti pratyakṣasiddha eva| tena saṃskāreṇa tatreṣau karma jāyate tatrāsamavāyikāraṇaṃ saṃskāraḥ, samavāyikāraṇamiṣuḥ, nimittakāraṇantu tīvro nodanaviśeṣaḥ| evañca yāvadiṣu patanamanuvarttamānena saṃskāreṇa uttarottaraḥ karmasantāno jāyate svajanyottarasaṃyogena karmaṇi naṣṭe saṃskāreṇa karmāntarajananādeka eva saṃskāraḥ karmasantānajanakaḥ na tu karmasantānavat saṃskārasantāno'pyabhyupagantumucito gauravāditi darśayitumāha -- tathottaramuttarañceti, tat‌karmakāritācca saṃskārādityekavacanañca| nyāyanaye tu karmasaṃtānavat saṃskārasantānasvīkāre gauravam| yattu yugapat prakṣiptaśarayorekasya tībro vego'parasya tu mandaḥ, tatra nodanatīvratvamandatve nimittam || 17 || <5-1-18> nanu saṃskāra eka eva cet karmasantānajanakastadā kadācidapi śarapāto na syāt karmajanakasya saṃskārasya sattvādityata āha -- saṃskārābhāvo gurutvāt patanam || 18 || gurutvantāvat patanakāraṇamanuvarttamānameva| tacca gurutvaṃ saṃskāreṇa pratiruddhaṃ patanaṃ nājījanat| atha pratibandhakābhāve tadeva gurutvaṃ patanaṃ karotītyarthaḥ | 18 || iti śrīśaṅkare vaiśeṣikasutropaskāre pañcamādhyāyasya prathamamāhnikam| pañcamādhyāye dvitīyāhnikam <5-2-1> nodanādiniṣpādyakarmaparīkṣāprakaraṇam| tatrāha -- nodanābhighātāt saṃyuktasaṃyogācca pṛthivyāṃ karma || 1 || nodanaṃ saṃyogaviśeṣaḥ -- yena saṃyogena janitaṃ karma saṃyoginoḥ parasparaṃ vibhāgaheturna bhavati, yaḥ saṃyogaḥ śabdanimittakāraṇaṃ na bhavati vā| yaḥ saṃyogaḥ śabdanimittakāraṇaṃ bhavati yajjanitaṃ karma saṃyoginoḥ parasparavigāgahetuśca bhavati sa saṃyogaviśeṣo'bhighātaḥ| tābhyāmapi pratyekaṃ karma janyate| paṅkākhyāyāṃ pṛthivyāñcaraṇena nodanāt caraṇābhighātācca karma jāyate tatra paṅkaḥ samavāyikāraṇam, nodanābhighātau yathāyathamasamavāyikāraṇam, gurutvavegaprayatnā yathāsambhavaṃ nimittakāraṇam| saṃyuktasaṃyogāditi| nodanādabhighātādvā paṅke karma tat‌paṅkasthite ghaṭādāvapi tat‌samakālameva karmadarśanāt || 1 || <5-2-2> nanu bhūkampādau nodanābhighātavantareṇa jāyamāne kimasamavāyikāraṇamata āha -- tad viśeṣeṇādṛṣṭakāritam || 2 || taditi pṛthivīkarma parāmṛśati| pṛthivyāmeva karma yadi viśeṣeṇa āśayena bhavati tadā'dṛṣṭakāritam, tena bhūkampena yasya duḥkhaṃ sukhaṃ vā bhavati avadṛṣṭattadātmasaṃyogastatrāsamavāyikāraṇam, bhūḥ samavāyikāraṇam, adṛṣṭaṃ nimittakāraṇam| yadvā tadā nodanābhighāto parāmṛśati| viśeṣo vyatirekaḥ| tathāca nodanābhighātavyatirekeṇa yat pṛthivyāṃ karma tadadṛṣṭakāritamityarthaḥ || 2 || <5-2-3> idānīṃ dravadravyasamavetakarmaparīkṣāprakaraṇam| tatrāha -- apāṃ saṃyogābhāve gurutvāt patanam || 3 || apāṃ yat patanaṃ varṣaṇarūpaṃ tadgurutvāsamavāyikāraṇakam| tat saṃyogasya meghasaṃyogasyābhāve sati bhavati, tena saṃyogābhāvastannimittakāraṇamityarthaḥ || 3 || <5-2-4> teṣāmeva vṛṣṭibindūnāmanyonayasaṃyogajanakaṃ karma kathamata āha -- dravatvāt syandanam || 4 || kṣitau patitānāmapāṃ vindūnāṃ parasparaṃ saṃyogena mahajjalāvayavisrotorūpaṃ yajjāyate tasya yat syandanaṃ dūrasaṃsaraṇaṃ tat dravatvādasamavāyikāraṇādutpadyate gurutvānnimittakāraṇādapsu samavāyikāraṇeṣu || 4 || <5-2-5> nanu yadi bhūmiṣṭhānāmapām ūrddhvaṃ gamanaṃ bhavati tadā gurutvāt patanavarṣaṇaṃ sambhāvyate, tadeva tu kuta ityata āha -- nāḍyo vāyusaṃyogādārohaṇam || 5 || kārayantīti śeṣaḥ| yadapāmūrdhvamārohaṇaṃ tat nāḍyaḥ sūryyaraśmaya eva ārohayantyapa ityarthaḥ| kvacit pāṭho nāḍyavāyusaṃyogāditi| sa ca nāḍyo nāḍīsambandhī yo vāyusaṃyoga ityupapādanīyaḥ || 5 || <5-2-6> nanu sūryyaraśmīnāṃ kathamayaṃ mahimā yat bhūmiṣṭhā apa ūrdhva nayantītyata āha -- nodanāpīḍanāt saṃyuktasaṃyogācca || 6 || nodanena balavadvāyunodanena āpīḍanādāskandanāt vāyusaṃyuktā raśmayastatsaṃyuktā āpa ūrdhvaṃ dhāvanti yathā sthālīsthā apaḥ kvathyamānāḥ vāyuninnavahniraśmaya ūrdhvaṃ nayanti| cakāra ivārthastatra ca upamānaṃ sthālīsthā evāpo draṣṭavyāḥ || 6 || <5-2-7> bhighātau na vā''dityaraśmayaḥ prabhavanti, tat kathaṃ tadityatrāha -- vṛkṣābhisarpaṇamityadṛṣṭakāritam || 7 || abhitaḥ sarpaṇamabhisarpaṇaṃ tadabhisarpaṇaṃ mūle niṣiktānāmapāṃ vṛkṣe tadadṛṣṭakāritaṃ patrakāṇḍaphalapuṣpādivṛddhikṛtaṃ sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ vā yeṣāmātmanām adṛṣṭavattadātmasaṃyogādasamavāyikāraṇāt adṛṣṭānnimittādapsu samavāyikāraṇeṣu tat karma bhavati yena karmaṇā āpa ūrdhve gatvā vṛkṣaṃ varddhayantītyarthaḥ || 7 || <5-2-8> nanvapāṃ sāṃsiddhikadravatvaṃ lakṣaṇamuktaṃ tādṛśānāmevāpāmūrdhvamadhastiryyak ca gamanamupapāditaṃ himakarakādīnāñca śaityādaptvamavivādasiddham, tat kathaṃ teṣāṃ saṃghātaḥ kāṭhinyam, kathañca vilayanamityata āha -- apāṃ saṃghāto vilayanañca tejaḥ saṃyogāt || 8 || divyena tejasā pratibandhādāpyāḥ paramāṇavo dvyaṇukamārabhamāṇā dvyaṇukeṣu dravatvaṃ nārabhante tato dravatvaśūnyairavayavairdvyaṇukādiprakrameṇa dravatvaśūnyā himakarakādaya ārabhyante tena teṣāṃ kāṭhinyamupalabhyate| nanvevaṃ himakarakādīnāmāpyatve kiṃ pramāṇamata uktaḥvilayanañca tejaḥsaṃyogāditi| tejaḥsayogena balavatā himakarakārambhakaparamāṇūnāṃ kriyā kriyāto vibhāgastata ārambhakasaṃyoganāśaparamparayā himakarakādimahāvayavināśastatra dravatvapratibandhakatejaḥ saṃyogavigamāt ta eva paramāṇavaḥ dvyaṇukeṣu dravatvamārabhante| tato dravatvavatā himakarakādīnāṃ vilayanaṃ tatra ca balavattejo'nupraveśo nimittam || 8 || <5-2-9> nanu balavaddivyatejo'nupraveśastatra ityatra kiṃ pramāṇamityata āha -- tatra visphūrjathurliṅgam || 9 || tatra divyāsu apsu divyānāṃ tejasāmanupravese visphūrjathurliṅgaṃ vajranirghoṣa eva liṅgamityarthaḥ| ātyantikavidyut‌prakāśastāvatpratyakṣa eva tadanupadañca sphūrjathuḥ so'pi pratyakṣa eva, tenānumīyate yasmānmeghāt karakāḥ prādurbha vanti tatra divyantejo vid‌yudrūpamanupraviṣṭaṃ tadupaṣṭambhena karakārambhikāṇāmapāṃ dravatvapratibandha iti || 9 || <5-2-10> atraiva pramāṇāntaramāha -- vaidikañca || 10 || apāṃ madhye tejo'nupraveśa āgamasiddha evetyarthaḥ| tathāhi "āpastā agniṃ garbhamādadhīran, yā agniṃ garbhaṃ dadhire muvarṇam" ityādi || 10 || <5-2-11> nanu visphūrjathuḥ kathamutpadyate saṃyogavibāgau śabdayonī tau ca nānubhūyete ityaha āha -- apāṃ saṃyogādvibhāgācca stanayitnoḥ || 11 || visphūrjathariti śeṣaḥ| adbhiḥ stanayitnoḥ saṃyogavibhāgau nimittakāraṇībhūya stanayitnorevākāśena saṃyogādasamavāyikāraṇādākāśe samavāyikāraṇe śabdaṃ garjitaṃ janayataḥ| kvacicca vāyuvalāhakasaṃyogavibhāgau nimittakāraṇe| balāhakaviyatsaṃyogavibhāgāvasamavāyikāre| karmakāraṇādhikāre'pi prāsaṅgikramidamuktam| yadvā meghākāśasaṃyoge vibhāge vā śabdāsamavāyikāraṇe kāraṇam apāmeva nodanābhighātajanitaṃ karmeti sūcitaṃ, karmaṇa evādhikāraprāptatvāt || 11 || <5-2-12> pṛthivīkarmaṇā tejaḥkarma vāyukarma ca vyākhyātam || 12 || bhūkampaṃpratyadṛṣṭavadātmasaṃyogaḥ kāraṇamuktam, tatrevākasmikadigdāhahetostejasaḥ ākasmikavṛkṣādikṣobhahetośca prabhañcanasya karma yat saṃjāyate tatrāpyadṛṣṭavadātmasaṃyogo'samavāyikāraṇam, vāyutejasī samavāyikāraṇam, adṛṣṭaṃ nimittakāraṇamityarthaḥ| karmaśabdasya dvyāvṛttirmaholkādikarmasūcanārthā || 12 || <5-2-13> adṛṣṭavadātmasaṃyogāsamavāyikāraṇakaṃ karmāntaramāha -- agnerūrdhvajvalanaṃ vāyostiryyak‌pavanamaṇūnāṃ manasaścādyaṃ karmādṛṣṭakāritam || 13 || ādyamiti| sargādyakālīnamityarthaḥ| tadā nodanābhighātādīnāmabhāvāt adṛṣṭavadātmasaṃyoga eva tatrāsabhavāyikāraṇam| ādyamūrdhvajvalanam ādyaṃ tiryyakapavanamiti| itareṣāṃ jvalanapavanakarmaṇāṃ vegāsamavāyikāraṇakatvameva mantumucitaṃ dṛṣṭe kāraṇe satyadṛṣṭakalpanānavakāśāt || 13 || <5-2-14> anādyaṃ (manaḥ) karmādhikṛtyāha -- hastakarmaṇā manasaḥ karma vyākhyātam || 14 || musalotkṣepaṇādau yathā prayatnavadātmasaṃyogāsamavāyikāraṇakaṃ hastakarma tathā'bhimataviṣayagrāhiṇīndriye sannikarṣārthaṃ yanmanasaḥ karma tadapi prayatnavadātmasaṃyogāsamavāyikāraṇakameva| yadyapīndriyaṃ mano na sākṣātprayatnaviṣayastathāpi manovahanāḍīgocareṇa prayatnena manasi karmotpattirdraṣṭavyā| nāḍyāstu tvagindriyagrāhyatvamaṅgīkarttavyam, anyathā prāṇavahanāḍīcareṇa prayatnenāśitapītādyabhyavaharaṇamapi na sambhavet || 14 || <5-2-15> nanu manasi karma utpadyata ityatraiva na prabhāṇamata āha -- ātmendriyamano'rthasannikarṣāt sukhaduḥkhe || 15 || sukhaduḥkhe ityupalakṣaṇaṃ jñānaprayatnādyapi draṣṭavyam| manaso vaibhavaṃ pūrvameva nirākṛtam, aṇutvañca sādhitam, yugapañjñānānutpattiśca manaso liṅgāmityuktam, tena tattadindriyapradeśena manaḥsaṃyogamantareṇa sukhaduḥkhe na syātāmeva yadi manasi karma na bhavet, na bhavecca pāde me sukhaṃ śirasi me vedanetyādyākāro'nubhava ityarthaḥ| yadyapi manaḥsannikarṣādhīnaḥ sarvo'pyātmaviśeṣaguṇastathāpi sukhaduḥkhe tīvrasaṃvegitayā'tisphuṭatvādukte || 15 || <5-2-16> nanvevaṃ yadi capalaṃ manastadā cittanirodhābhavādyogaṃ vinā nātmasākṣātkāro, na vā tamantareṇa mokṣa iti śāstrarambhavaiphalyamata āha -- tadanārambha ātbhasthe manasi śarīrasya duḥkhābhāvaḥ saṃyogaḥ || 16 || viṣayeṣvalampratyayavata udāsīnasya bahirindriyebhyo vyāvṛttaṃ mano yadātmasthāmātmamātraniṣṭhaṃ bhavati tadā tat‌karmānuguṇaprayatnābhāvāt karma bhanasi notpadyate sthirataraṃ mano bhavati sa eva yogaḥ| cittanirodhalakṣaṇatvād yogasya| tadanārambha iti| manasaḥ karmānārambha ityarthaḥ| yadvā tatpadena sukhaduḥkhe evāmidhīyete prakrāntatvāt| duḥkhābhāva iti| duḥkhābhāvasādhanatvādyoga eva duḥkhābhāvaḥ "annaṃ vai prāṇā" itivat| yadvā duḥkhasyābhāvo yatreti bahuvrīhiḥ, śarīrasyeti śarīrāvacchinnasyātmanaḥ sa yoga iti prasiddhisiddhatayā tatpadam, ayaṃ sa yogaḥ| yadvātmapadenātra prāṇa ucyate upacārāt prāṇānumeyatvādātmanaḥ| tathāca prāṇavahanāḍyāṃ karmaṇā prāṇakarmāpi jāyate| yadvā jīvanayoniyatnavadātmaprāṇasaṃyogāsamavāyikāraṇakaṃ prāṇakarma| jīvanayoniśca yatno'tīndriyaḥ prāṇasañcārānumeyaḥ, kathamanyathā suṣuptyavasthāyāmapi śvāsapraśvāsagatāgatamiti bhāvaḥ || 16 || <5-2-17> nanu prāṇasya manasaśca karma yadi prayatnanimittikaṃ tadā prāṇamanasī yadā maraṇāvasthāyāmapasarpataḥ -- dehādvahirbhavatuḥ dehāntarotpattau tatra punarupasarpataḥpraviśataḥ, tatra prayatnābhāvāttadubhayamanupapannam, aśitapītaṃ bhaktapānīyādi tasyāpi śarīrāvayavopacayaheturyaḥ saṃyogastajjanakaṃ yat karma yacca garbhavāsadaśāyāṃ saṃyogavibhāgajanakaṃ karma teṣāṃ kathamutpattirata āha -- apasarpamamupasarpaṇamaśitapītasaṃyogāḥ kāryāntarasaṃyogāścetyadṛṣṭakāritāni || 17 || atra `napuṃsakamanapuṃsakenaikavaccāsyānyatarasyāmi'ti napuṃsakanirdeśaḥ saṃyogapadañca tatkāraṇe karmaṇi lākṣaṇikam| apasarpaṇaṃ dehārambhakakarmakṣaye dehādeva prāṇamanasorutkramaṇam, upasarpaṇañca dehāntarotpattau tatra prāṇāmanasoḥ praveśānam, aśitapītādisaṃyogahetuśca karma, kāryāntaraṃ garbhaśarīraṃ tatsaṃyogahetuśca yat karma tat sarvamadṛṣṭavadātmasaṃyogāsamavāyikāraṇakam| itikāreṇa dhātumalakarmaṇāmapyadṛṣṭavadātmasaṃyogāsamavāyikāraṇakatvaṃ sūcayati || 17 | <5-2-18> nanu dehāntarotpatterāvaśyakatvañcettadā kataṃ mokṣa ityata āha -- tadabhāve saṃyogābāvo'prādurbhāvaśca mokṣaḥ || 18 || idamatrākūtaṃ -- yogabalenātmatattvasākṣātkāre sati tena ca savāsanamityājñāne dhvaste tannibandhanānāṃ rāgad‌veṣamohānāṃ doṣāṇāmapāyāt pravṛtterapāye tannibandhana sya janmano'pāye tannibandhanasya duḥkhasyāpāya iti tāvadvastugatiḥ| tatra yogino yogajadharmabalena tattaddeśakālatattatturagamataṅgajavihaṅgamādidehopabhogyamukhaduḥkhāsādhāraṇakāraṇadharmanikurambamālocya tattatkāyavyūhaṃ nirvāhya bhogena pūrvotpannadharmā dharmayoḥ kṣayaḥ, nivṛttadoṣasya dharmādharmāntarānutpattāvapūrvaśarīrāntarānutpattau pūrvaśarīreṇa sahātmano yaḥ saṃyogābhāvaḥ sa eva mokṣaḥ tadabhāva iti| anāgataśarīrānutpāde saṃyogābhāva ityarthaḥ| nanviyamavasthā pralayasādhāraṇītyata āha -- aprādurbhāva iti| yadanantaraṃ śarīrādeḥ punaḥ prādurbhāvo na bhavatītyarthaḥ sa mokṣa iti| tasyāmavasthāyāṃ yo duḥkhadhvaṃsaḥ sa mokṣa ityarthaḥ || 18 || <5-2-19> nanu tamaso'pi dravyasya karma dṛśyate calati chāyetipratyayāt, tatra na prayatno na vā nodanābhighātau na vā gurutvadravatve na vā saṃskārastathā ca nimittāntaraṃ vaktavyaṃ tacca nānubhūyamānamityata āha -- dravyaguṇakarmaniṣpattidharmyādabhāvastamaḥ || 19 || etena navaiva dravyāṇītyavadhāraṇamapyupapāditam| dravyaniṣpattistāvat sparśavaddravyādhīnā| na ca tamasi sparśo'nubhūyate| na cānudbhūta eva sparśaḥ, rūpodbhave sparśodbhavasyāvaśyakatvāt| pṛthivyāmaya niyamaḥ tamastu daśamaṃ dravyamiti cenna dravyāntarasya nīlarūpānadhikaraṇatvāt nīlarūpasya ca gurutvenāntarīyakatvāt, rasagandhanāntarīyakatvācca| yathā''kāśa śabdamātraviśeṣaguṇaṃ tathā tamo'pi nīlarūpamātraviśeṣaguṇaṃ syāditi cenna cākṣuṣatvavirodhāt| yadi hi nīlarūpavannīlaṃ rūpameva vā tamaḥ syāt bāhyalokapragrahamantareṇa cakṣuṣā na gṛhyeta || 19 || <5-2-20> tarhi gatipratītiḥ kinnibandhanetyata āha -- tejaso dravyāntareṇāvaraṇācca || 20 || gacchatā dravyāntareṇāvṛte tejasi pūrvadeśānupalambhādagrimadeśe copalambhātte jo'bhavasya gacchaddravyasādharmyād matibhramo na tu vāstavī tava matirityarthaḥ, anvayavyatirekābhyāṃ tathā pratīteḥ udbhūtarūpavadyāvattejaḥsaṃsargābhāvastamaḥ || 20 || <5-2-21> evaṃ dvisūtrakaṃ prāsaṅgikaṃ tamaḥprakaraṇaṃ samāpya karmaśūnyatāprakaraṇamāha -- dikkālāvākāśañca kriyāvadvaidharmyānniṣkriyāṇi || 21 || cakārādātmasaṃgrahaḥ| kriyāvatā vaidharmyaṃ digādīnāmamūrtatvaṃ mūrttyanuvidhānāt kriyāyāḥ || 21 || <5-2-22> guṇakarmaṇorniṣkriyatvamāha -- etena karmāṇi guṇāśca vyākhyātāḥ || 22 || eteneti| kriyāvadvaidharmyeṇetyarthaḥ kriyāvadvaidharmyamamūrtatvaṃ guṇakarmaṇorapīti te api niṣkriyatvena vyākhyāte ityarthaḥ || 22 || <5-2-23> nanu guṇakarmaṇī yadi niṣkriye tadā tābhyāṃ dravyasya kathaṃ sambandhaḥ? saṃyogasambandhaḥ sambhāvyeta sa ca karmādhīna evetyata āha -- niṣkriyāṇāṃ samavāyaḥ karmabhyo niṣiddhaḥ || 23 || niṣkriyāṇāṃ guṇakarmaṇāṃ samavāya eva sambandhaḥ, sa ca karmabhyo niṣddhaḥ tasya sambandhasya utpattireva nāsti dūre tu karmādhīnatetyarthaḥ || 23 || <5-2-24> nanu yadyamūrttatvāt guṇāḥ karmasamavāyikāraṇaṃ na bhavanti tadā guṇairguṇāḥ karmāṇi ca kathamutpadyante na hi samavāyikāraṇātiriktatvarūpeṇāpi kāraṇatā sambhavatītyata āha -- kāraṇantvasamavāyino guṇāḥ || 24 || guṇā asamavāyikāraṇaṃ na tu samavāyikāraṇamapi yena karmādhārāḥ syuḥ| sā cāsamavāyikāraṇatā kvacit kāryaikārthaṃsamavāyāt yathā''tmanaḥ saṃyogasyātmaviśeṣaguṇeṣu saṃyogavibhāgaśabdānāṃ śabde| kvacit kāraṇaikārthasamavāyāt yathā''tmamanaḥ saṃyogasyātmaviśeṣaguṇeṣu saṃyogavibhāgaśabdānāṃ śabde| kvacit kāraṇaikārthasamavāyāt yathā kapālādirūpādīnāṃ ghaṭādirūpādiṣu || 24 || <5-2-25> nanu iha karmotpadyate idānīṃ karmotpadyate ityādipratītibalāt dikkālāvapi karmasamavāyikāraṇe eva, kathamanyathā tatra tayorādhāratetyata āha -- guṇairdig vyākhyātā || 25 || yathā gurutvādayo guṇā na karmasamavāyikāraṇamamūrtatvāt tathā digapi na karmasamavāyikāraṇamūrttatvādevetyarthaḥ| ādhāratā tu samavāyitāmantareṇāpi, kuṇḍe badarāṇi, kuṇḍe dadhi, vane siṃhanāda ityādivadupapadyata iti bhāvaḥ || 25 || <5-2-26> uktenaivābiprāyeṇāha -- kāraṇaena kālaḥ || 26 || niṣkriyatvena vyākhyāta iti pariṇamyānuṣaṅgaḥ| kāraṇeneti bhāvapradhāno nirdeśaḥ tena nimittakāraṇatvenādhāramātraṃ karmaṇaḥ kālo na tu samavāyītyarthaḥ || 26 || iti śrīśāṅkare vaiśeṣikasūtropaskāre pañcamādhyāyasya dvitīyamāhnikam| samāpraścāyaṃ pañcamādhyāyaḥ| <6> <6-1-1> saṃsāramūlakāraṇayordharmādharmayoḥ parīkṣā ṣaṣṭhyādhyāyārthaḥ| dharmādharmau ca "svargakāmo yajeta" `na kalañjaṃ bhakṣayet' ityādividhiniṣedhabalakalpanīyau vidhiniṣedhavākyayoḥ prāmāṇye sati syātām| tatprāmāṇyañca vakturyathārthavākyārthajñānalakṣaṇaguṇapūrvakatvādupapadyate svataḥ prāmāṇyasya niṣedhādataḥ prathamaṃ vedaprāmāṇyaprayojakaguṇasādhanamupakramate -- buddhipūrvā vākyakṛtirvede || 1 || vākyakṛtirvākyaracanā sā buddhipūrvāvaktṛyathārthavākyārthajñānapūrvā vākyaracanātvāt nadītīre pañcaphalāni santītyasmadādivākyaracanāvat| veda itivākyasamudāya ityarthaḥ| tatra samudāyināṃ vākyānāṃ kṛtiḥ pakṣaḥ| na cāsmadādibuddhipūrvakatvenānyathāsiddhiḥ, "svargakāmo yajeta" ityādāviṣṭasādhanatāyāḥ kāryyatāyā vā asmadādibuddhyocaratvāt| tena svatantrapuruṣapūrvakatvaṃ vede siddhyati| vedatvañcaśabdatadupajīvipramāṇātiriktapramāṇajanyapramityaviṣayārthakatve sati śabdajanyavākyārthajñānājanyapramāṇaśabdatvam || 1 || <6-1-2> prakārāntareṇa vedavākyānāṃ buddhipūrvakatvamāha -- brāhmaṇe saṃjñākarma siddhiliṅgam || 2 || brāhmaṇamiha vedabhāgastatra yat‌ saṃjñākarma nāmakaraṇaṃ tat vyutpādakasya buddhimākṣipati, yathā loke lambakarṇadīrghanāsalambagrīvādināmakaraṇam || 2 || <6-1-3> prakārāntaramāha -- buddhipūrvo dadātiḥ || 3 || "svargakāmo gāṃ dadyāt" ityādau yaddānapratipādanaṃ taddāneṣṭasādhanatājñānajanyam| dadātiriti dhātanirddeśo dhātvarthaṃ dānamupalakṣayati || 3 || <6-1-4> pramāṇāntaramāha -- tathā pratigrahaḥ || 4 || pratigrahapratipādikā api śrutayo buddhipūrvikāḥ| pratigrahapadaṃ svaviṣayāṃ śrutimupalakṣayati| tena bhūmyādipratigrahapratipādikāḥ śrutayaḥ pratigrahītuḥ śreyaḥsādhanatāparāḥ| kṛṣṇasāracarmādipratigrahapratipādikāḥ śrutayaḥ pratigrahīturaniṣṭasādhanatābodhikāḥ| na ceṣṭāniṣṭasādhanate arvācīnapuruṣabuddhigocarau bhavitumarhataḥ || 4 || <6-1-5> idānīṃ "śāstradeśitaṃ phalabhanuṣṭhātari" iti jaiminīyaṃ sūtraṃ saṃvādayannāha -- ātmāntaraguṇānāmātgāntare'kāraṇatvāt || 5 || ātmantaraguṇānāṃ yāgahiṃsādipuṇyapāpānām ātmāntare yau sukhaduḥkhātmakau guṇau tayorakāraṇatvāt| evañca pratyātmaniṣṭhābhyāmeva dharmādharmābhyāṃ suḥkhadukhe na vyadhikaraṇāmyāmanyathā yena yāgahiṃsādikaṃ na kṛtaṃ tasya tat phalaṃ syāditi kṛtahānirakṛtābhyāgamaśca prasajyate| nanu nāyaṃ niyamaḥ putreṣṭipitṛyajñādau vyabhicārāt| tathāhi putreṇa kṛtasya śrāddhādeḥ pitari phalaśravaṇāt, pitrā ca kṛtāyāḥ putreṣṭeḥ putre phalaśravaṇāt| na ca svargabhāgipitṛkatvasya tejasviputrakatvasya ca phalasya putrapitṛgāmitayā sāmānādhikaraṇyameveti vācyam, śrutivirodhāt pitṛtṛptyādeḥ putratejasvitādereva phalasya śravaṇāt phalāntarasya ca gauravaparāhatatvāt| astu tarhyapūrvaṃ phalaṃ karttari svargastu pitarīti cenna, vyāpārasya phalasāmānādhikaraṇyaniyamāt, anyathā śrāddhānantaraṃ mukte putre pituḥ svargo na syāt| na syāditi cenna mukte pitari sāṅgādapi śrāddhāt phalaṃ na syāditi tulyatvāt| maivam| `śāstradeśita phalamanuṣṭhātari' ityasyotsargatvāt kvacid balavatā vādhakenāpodyatvāt, prakṛte ca pitṛputragataphalaśravaṇasyaiva bādhakatvāt| tathā satyatiprasahga iti cenna tādṛśaśruterevātiprasaṅganivārakatvāt| yattu mahādānādau svargamātrameva phalaṃ tacca yaduddeśena kriyate tadgatamapi phalaṃ janayatīti| tattuccham, tatrotsarge bādhakābhāvāt bādhakābhāvasahitotsargasyaniyamatvāt, rājādīnāmupavāsādyanuṣṭhānānāpatteḥ paridvāraitra tattatkarmaṇāṃ svagataphalamuddiśyānuṣṭhānasambhavāt| samyaggṛhasthāśramaparipālanāya brahmalokāvāptikape ca phale niyama eva prātisvikaphalābhiprāyeṇa tūtsargābidhānāt| 3bṛttikārāstu `śāstradeśitam' ityādirniyama eva| pitrādīnāntu yat phalaṃ tacchrāddhādau brāhmaṇānāmāśīrmantrānubhāvāt, `kṛtārthāste pitaro bhūyāsuḥ' iti pitṛyajñe| putreṣṭau tu santuṣṭānāmṛtvijāmāśīrdānāt `tejasvī varcasvyannādaste putro bhūyāt' ityādeḥ, -- jāhgalikamantrapāṭhādiva sarpadaṣṭasya viṣāpahāraṇamityāhuḥ || 5 || <6-1-6> aduṣṭānāṃ yathāśāstramanuvartamānānāṃ bhojanāt tṛptānāmāśīrdānāt tat phalaṃ na tu duṣṭānāṃ pātratvena niṣiddhānāmapi kuṇḍagolakaprabhṛtīnāmityāha -- tad‌duṣṭabhojane na vidyate || 6 | tadityāśīrdānaphalaṃ parāmṛśati, duṣṭā brāhmaṇāḥ pātrānadhikāriṇoyatra śrāddhe bhojyante tatra pitari tat phalaṃ na vidyate na bhavatītyarthaḥ| śrāddhaphalameva vā na bhavati pitarītyarthaḥ || 6 || <6-1-7> ke te duṣṭā iti duṣṭalakṣaṇamāha -- duṣṭaṃ hiṃsāyām || 7 || hiṃsāyāmiti niṣiddhakarmamātropalakṣaṇam| tena niṣiddhe karmaṇi pravṛttaṃ puruṣaṃ duṣṭaṃ vijānīyādityarthaḥ || 7 || <6-1-8> na kevalaṃ duṣṭabrāhmaṇasya śrāddhe nimantritasya bhojanena phalābhāvaḥ kintu pāpamapi bhavatītyāha -- tasya samabhivyāhārato doṣaḥ || 8 || tasya niṣiddhe karmaṇi pravṛttasya brāhmaṇasya samabhivyāhārāt ekapaṅ‌ktibhojanasahaśayanasahādhyayānādilakṣaṇāt doṣaḥ pāpamityarthaḥ || 8 || <6-1-9> tat kimaduṣṭasamabhivyāhārādapi doṣa eva? netyāha -- tadaduṣṭe na vidyate || 9 || tat pāpamaduṣṭe yathāśāstraṃ vyavaharamāṇe brāhmaṇe śrāddhe bhojite na vidyate na bhavatītyarthaḥ || 9 || <6-1-10> nanu satpātrāpratilambho yatra śrāddhadānādau prathamaṃ duṣṭā eva nimantritāḥ krameṇa tu satpātrapratilambhe kiṃ vidheyabhityatrāha -- punarviśiṣṭe pravṛttiḥ || 10 || śrāddhe pratigrahe vā viśiṣṭā yathāśāstramanuvartamānā yadi lamyante tadā nimantritānapi nindyān parihṛtya tāneva bhojayet| `na nimantritān‌pratyācakṣīta' iti tu satpātraparam| nindyāṃstu nimantritān draviṇadānādinā santoṣayet || 10 || <6-1-11> yatra svāpekṣayā viśiṣṭā na labhyante śrāddhadānādau tatrāha -- same hīne vā pravṛttiḥ || 11 || same svasadṛśe, hīne svāpekṣayā guṇādinā nyūne, aduṣṭe pātre śrāddhadānādau pravṛttisteṣāmevāśīrdānāt pitari sukhamityarthaḥ| niṣiddhānāṃ paraṃ tyāgo na tvaduṣṭānāṃ samahīnānāmapīti bhāvaḥ || 11 || <6-1-12> śrāddhe dānādau ca sampradānasādguṇyena dharmotpattimabhidhāya tādṛśādapādānādapi dharmotpattimatidiśati -- etena hīnasamaviśiṣṭadhārmikebhyaḥ parasvādānaṃ vyākhyātam || 12 || yathottaraṃ dharmotkarṣaḥ, hīnagdapi bhūmyādipratigrahe, samādapi, svāpekṣayā viśiṣṭādapi dhārmikāt dharma ityarthaḥ| parasvādānaṃ parasmāt svasya dhanasyādānaṃ pratigrahaḥ| vṛttikārāstu parasvādānaṃ cauryādinā parasvagrahaṇaṃ vyākhyātam| tathāca śrutiḥ `śūdrāt saptame vaiśyāddaśame kṣatriyāt pañcadaśe brāhmaṇāt prāṇasaṃśaye'iti| kṣudhāpīḍitamātmānaṃ kuṭumbaṃ pā rakṣituṃ sapta dinānyāhāramaprāpya śūdrabhakṣyāpahāraḥ kāryaḥ, evaṃ daśadinānyāhāramaprāpya vaiśyāt, pañcadaśa dinānyāhāramaprāpya kṣatriyāt, prāṇasaṃśaye brāhmaṇāt bhakṣyāpaharaṇaṃ na doṣāyetyāhuḥ || 12 || <6-1-13> na kevalaṃ prāṇasaṃśaye parasvādānaṃ na niṣiddhaṃ kintu tasyāṃ daśāyāmapahartuṃ ye na prayacchanti teṣāṃ vadho'pi kāryo na tāvatā dharmahāniradharmaprādurbhāvo vetyāha -- tathā viruddhānāṃ tyāgaḥ || 13 || tasyāṃ daśāyāṃ viruddhānāṃ viparītamācaratāṃ tyāgo vadhaḥ kāryaṃ ityarthaḥ| taduktam -- karmaṇā yena kenāpi mṛdunā dāruṇena vā| uddhareddīnamātmānaṃ samartho dharmamācaret || iti 13|| <6-1-14> nanu cāviśeṣeṇaiva parasya vadhaḥ, netyāha -- hīne pare tyāgaḥ || 14 || yadi svasmāddhīnaḥ paro bhavati yo'pahartu na dadāti tasya śūdrādestyāgo vadhaḥ || 14 || <6-1-15> samamadhikṛtyāha -- same ātmatyāgaḥ paratyāgo vā || 15 || yadi svasadṛśo brāhmaṇa eva virodhī bhavati tadātmana evopavāsādinā tyāgo'vasādaḥ kartavyaḥ| yadi svasya kuṭumbasya vā rakṣāprakāro na dṛśyate virodhaśca samo bhavati tadā tasyaiva tyāgo vadha ityarthaḥ || 15 || <6-1-16> tat kiṃ svāpekṣayā yadi viśiṣṭo bhavati virodhī tadā tasyāpi vadha eva kāryaḥ! netyāha -- viśiṣṭe ātmatyāga iti || 16 || svāpekṣayā viśiṣṭe vedādhyayanādinā utkṛṣṭe virodhini ātmana eva tyāgo vidheyaḥ| prāṇasaṃśaye satyapyātmamaraṇamevābhipreyāt na tu brāhmaṇaṃ hanyādityarthaḥ| iti rāhnikaparisamāptau || 16 || iti śrīśāṅkare vyaiśeṣikasūtropaskāre ṣaṣṭhādhyāyasya prathamamāhnikam| ṣaṣṭhādhyāye dvitīyāhnikam <5-2-1> evaṃ pūrvāhnike vaidikī pramā guṇajanyeti tadutpattau guṇābhidhānam, `śāsatradeśitaṃ phalamanuṣṭhātari' iti vivecanam, niṣiddhācaraṇe'pi pratyavāyānutpattiḥ kasyāñciddaśāyāmityasya vivecanañca vṛttam| adhunā `yato'bhyudayaniḥśreyasasiddhiḥ' iti dvitīyaṃ sūtraṃ vyācikhyāsurviśeṣato dharmātpattiparīkṣāyāṃ varttiṣyamāṇāyāmāha -- dṛṣṭādṛṣṭaprayojanānāṃ dṛṣṭābhāve prayojanamabhyudayāya || 1 || dṛṣṭaprayojanāni kṛṣivāṇijyarājasevādīni, adṛṣṭaprayojanāni yāgadānabrahmacaryādīni, eteṣāṃ karmaṇāṃ madhye yatra dṛṣṭaṃ prayojanaṃ nopalabhyate tatrādṛṣṭaṃ prayojana ṃkalpanīyaṃ, taccābhyudayāya tattvajñānāya| yadvā abhyadayāyeti caturthī prathamārthe tena phalamabhyudaya ityarthaḥ| adṛṣṭaṃ phalamapūrvameva tad yadi yogajaṃ tadā'bhyudaya ātmasākṣātkāraḥ| yadi ca yāgadānādijaṃ tadā'bhyudayaḥ svargaḥ| tatrāpi yathā dogdhi pacatītyādikriyā sadyaḥphalikā, vapati karṣatītyādikriyā ca vilambabhāviphalā tathā yajati dadāti brahmacaryaṃ caratītyādikriyā tāvat sadyaḥphalikā na bhavati tādṛśasya phalasyānupalabdheḥ| na ca dhārmikatayā jñānāñjābhādikameva phalam, pracchanna brahmacaryādi caratāṃ tat‌phalānuddeśāt tasmāccirabhāvisvargādikameva phalaṃ taccāśutaravināśinyāḥ kriyāyā na sākṣādityāntarālikaṃ kriyāphavayoḥ samānādhikaraṇamapūrva paryavasyati || 1 || <5-2-2> adṛṣṭaphalāni karmāṇi parisañcaṣṭe -- abhiṣecanopavāsabrahmacaryagurukulavāsavānaprasthayajñadānaprokṣaṇadiṅnakṣatramantarkālaniyamāścādṛṣṭāya || 2 || adṛṣṭāyetyadṛṣṭalakṣaṇāya phalāya, adṛṣṭadvārā svargāpavargalakṣaṇāya phalāya vā| etenādṛṣṭaphalakaśrautasmāttasakalakarmopasaṃgrahaḥ| tatrābhiṣecanaṃ snānaṃ `gaṅgāyāṃ snāyāt' ityādividhividheyaḥ brahmacaryaḥ sāmānyata eva dharmasādhanam| gurukalavāso brahmacāriṇāṃ vedādhyayanamahānāmnyādivratārthaḥ| vānaprasthaṃ vayaḥ pariṇāme vanaṃ prasthitānāṃ yat karma| yajño `rājasūyavājapeyādiḥ'| dānaṃ `gāṃ dadyāt' ityādividhividheyam| prokṣaṇaṃ `vrīhīn prokṣati' ityādividhividheyam| dik `prāconaplavane yajeta' `prāṅmukho'nnāni bhuñjīta' ityādividhividheyā| nakṣatraṃ śrāddhādau maghādi| mantra -- āpohiṣṭhetyādiḥ| kālaḥ -- `māsi māsi vo'śanam' `amāvāsyāyāmaparāhṇe dadyāt' `grīṣme pañcatapāḥ' `vasante'gnīnādadhīta' ityādividhividheyaḥ| niyamoḥ varṇāśramiṇāṃ yathāśāstramanuṣṭhānam| tadevaṃ dharmasya ātmā samavāyikāraṇam, śraddhā svargādilakṣaṇaprayojanajñānañca nimittakāraṇamanusandheyam || 2 || <5-2-3> evaṃ dharmasādhanamabhidhāya adharmasādhanamapi samuccinvannāha -- cāturāśramyamupadhā anupadhāśca caturṇāmāśramāṇāṃ samānaṃ yaddharmasādhanaṃ tattāvat pūrvasūtreṇaivoktamiti śeṣaḥ| upadhāḥ bhāvasya śraddhāyā doṣāḥ, anupadhāḥ śraddhāyā bhāvasyādoṣāḥ te'pi dharmādharmayoḥ sādhanāni yathāsvamūhanīyāni| upadhāpadenādharmasādhanāni sarvāṇyupasaṃgṛhītāni || 3 || <5-2-4> upādānupadhe lakṣaṇato vivecayannāha -- bhāvadoṣa upadhā'doṣo'nupadhā || 4 || bhāvaḥ -- icchā -- rāgaḥ pramādo'śraddhāmadamānāsūyāprabhṛtayo bhāvadoṣā upadhāpadenocyante, śraddhā manaḥprasādo deśitakarmānuṣṭhānādhyavasāya itikartavyatāparicchedaścānupadhā| tadetayordharmādharmanimittakāraṇatvamuktam || 4 || <5-2-5> śucyaśucinī copadhānupadhe| tatra śucyaśucinī vivecayati -- yadiṣṭarūparasagandhasparśaṃ prokṣitamabhyukṣitañca tacchuci || 5 || iṣṭaṃ śrutyā smṛtyā ca yadrūpādikaṃ vihitaṃ yasya dravyasya tattathā| tatra rūpam `aruṇayā ekahāyanyā piṅgākṣyā gavā somaṃ krīṇāti' `śvetaṃ chāgalamālabheta' ityādau| prokṣitaṃ mantreṇodakasiktam| abhyukṣitaṃ vinā mantramudakasiktam| cakārāntyāyato labdham tacca `yājanādhyāpanapratigrahairbrāhmaṇo ghanamarjayet' ityādiniyamavidhibodhitam || 5 || <5-2-6> aśucilakṣaṇamāha -- aśucīti śucipratiṣedhaḥ || 6 || yaddravyaṃ śuci tadviparītamaśucītyarthaḥ| aśastarūparasagandhasparśamamantraprokṣitamanabhyukṣitaṃ niṣiddhajalābhyukṣitaṃ vā anyāyāgatam kṛṣivāṇijyāgataṃ brāhmaṇasya dravyamaśucītyarthaḥ || 6 || <5-2-7> aśucyantaramāha -- arthāntarañca || 7 || praśastarūparasagandhasparśamapi prokṣitamabhyukṣitaṃ nyāyārjitañca yattatrāpi vāgaduṣṭañca bhāvaduṣṭaṃ ca yattadapyaśucītyarthaḥ || 7 || <5-2-8> idānīṃ dharmādharmau prati sahakāryantaramāha -- ayatasya śucibhojanādabhyudayo na vidyate niyamābhāvāt vidyate vā'rthāntaratvāt yamasya || 8 || ayatasya yamarahitasyāsaṃyatasyeti yāvat| "hastau pādau prakṣālyācamya vāgyato bhuñjīta, bhokṣyamāṇaḥ prayato'pi dvirācāmet" ityādibodhitayamarahitasya bhojanaṃ nābhyudayāya kintu pāpāya| kuta evamityata āha -- niṃyamābhāvāt| niyamasya sahakāriṇo'bāvāt| niyame sati yattadāha -- vidyate vā| yathoktayamasāhityena bhojane bhavatyevābhyudayaḥ| kuta ityata āha -- arthāntaratvād yamasya| bhojanādarthāntaraṃ yato yamaḥ| tathā ca sahakārikāraṇaṃ vinā na phalasiddhistasmin sati phalasiddhirityarthaḥ || 8 || <5-2-9> nanu yamamātrameva tantraṃ tarhi bhojanamatantramevetyata āha -- asati cābhāvāt || 9 || yame satyapi śucibhojane'sati abhāvādabhyudayasyeti śeṣaḥ| tathā ca yamo bhojanañca dvayameva puṇyakāraṇamityarthaḥ| bhojanamityupalakṣaṇam yāgadānasnānahomādīnāmapi śrautasmārtakarmaṇāṃ yamaniyamau sahakāriṇau || 9 || <5-2-10> dhātuṃ doṣanidānamāha -- sukhādrāgaḥ || 10 || srakcandanavanitādiviṣayasevanajanmanaḥ sukhāduttarottaraṃ tajjātīye sukhe tatsādhane vā rāga icchā sañjāyate| ahikaṇṭakādijanmano duḥkhāt tatra tatsādhane vā dveṣa ityapi draṣṭavyam| rāgadveṣamīhāḥ pravartakatvena doṣā ityabhidhīyante| tathā ca gautamīyaṃ sūtram -- `pravarttanālakṣaṇā doṣāḥ' iti || 10 || <5-2-11> atra sukhaduḥkhe eva yadi rāgadveṣau janayataḥ tadā tayornāśe kathaṃ tau syātāmata āha -- tanmayatvācca || 11 || rāgadveṣau bhavata iti śeṣaḥ| viṣayābhyāsajanito dṛḍhataraḥ saṃskāraviśeṣastanmayatvaṃ yadvaśāt kāmāturasya kāminīmalabhamānasya sarvatra kāminīdarśanam| ekadā bhūjaṅgadṛṣṭasya tatra dṛḍhatarasaṃskārataḥ sarvatra bhujaṅgadarśanam| taduktam -- tanmayatvaṃ tatprakāśo bāhyābhyantaratastathā| iti || 11 || <5-2-12> hetvantaraṃ samuccinoti -- adṛṣṭācca || 12 || rāgadveṣāviti śeṣaḥ| yadyapyadṛṣṭaṃ sādhāraṇakāraṇam tathāpi kvacittau prati asādhāraṇatāmapyanubhajati| yathā tajjanmānubhūtakāminīsukhasyāpi yauvanodbhede kāminīrāgaḥ, ananubhūtabhuñjaṅgadaṃśaduḥkhānāmapi bhujaṅgeṣu dveṣa ityād‌yunneyam| na ca prāgbhavīyaḥ saṃskāra evātra nibandhanam, tatkalpane tadudbodhakalpane ca prāmāṇābhāvāt adṛṣṭasyāvaśyakalpanīyatvāt || 12 || <5-2-13> sahakāryantaramāha -- jātiviśeṣācca || 13 || tathāhi manuṣyajātīyānāmannādau rāgaḥ, mṛgajātīyānāṃ tṛṇādau, karabhajātīyānāṃ kaṇṭakādau| tatrāpi tattajjātitiṣpādakamadṛṣṭameva tantram dvāramātrantu jātirjanmaviśeṣaḥ| evaṃ pārāvatādīnāmutkare rāgaḥ| tathā mahiṣajātīyānāṃ turaṅgame dveṣaḥ sārameyāṇāṃ śṛgāle nakulānāṃ bhujaṅgame ityād‌yunneyam || 13 || <5-2-14> dharmādharmakāraṇatvaṃ pravṛttidvāretyāha -- icchādveṣapūrvikā dharmādharmapravṛttiḥ || 14 || vihite karmaṇi rāganibandhanāniṣiddhe karmaṇi hiṃsādau dveṣanibandhanā pravṛttiḥ, rāganibandhanā yāgādau pravṛttirdharma prasūte dveṣanibandhanā hiṃsādau pravṛttiradharmam| tāvetau rāgadveṣau saṃsāramanuvartayataḥ| tathāca gautamīyaṃ sūtram -- `gravṛttirvāgbuddhiśarīrārambhaḥ' iti| vāgārambho vācikī pravṛttiḥ, satyaṃ priyaṃ hitamiti puṇyā, asatyamapriyamahitamiti pāpā| buddhiḥ budhyate jñāyate'neneti mana ucyate, tena mānasī pravṛttirbhūtadayādiḥ| śārīrī pravṛttirdāna paricaraṇamityādikā daśavidhā pāpā daśavidhā puṇyā ceti || 14 || <5-2-15> idānīṃ dharmādharmayoḥ prayojanaṃ protyābāvamāha -- tatsaṃyogo vibhāgaḥ || 15 || tābhyāṃ dharmādharmābhyāṃ saṃyogo janma apūrvābhiḥ śarīrendriyavedanābhiḥ sambandhaḥ saṃyoga ihocyate| vibhāgastu śarīramanovibhāgo maraṇalakṣaṇaḥ| tathā cāyaṃ janmamaraṇaprabandhaḥ saṃsāraḥ pretyabhāvāparanāmā dharmādharmābhyāmityarthaḥ| asyaiva ca pretyabhāvasyājarañjarībhāva iti vaidikī saṃjñā || 15 || <5-2-16> mokṣaṃ nirūpayitumāha -- ātmakarmasu mokṣo vyākhyātaḥ || 16 || ayameva śarīramanovibhāgaḥ ātmakarmasu satsu mokṣo bhavatītyarthaḥ| tatrātmakarmāṇi tāvat‌ śravaṇaṃ mananaṃ yogābhyāso nididhyāsanamāsanaṃ prāṇāyāmaḥ śamadamasampattiḥ ātmaparātmasākṣātkāro dehadeśāntaropabhogyapūrvotpannadharmādharmaparijñānaṃ tadbhogānurūpanānādehanirmāṇaṃ tayorbhogena prakṣayo rāgadveṣalakṣaṇadoṣatuṣāradamādagrimadharmādharmayoranutpādāt duḥkhāpāyalakṣaṇo'pavargastatra ṣaṭ‌padārthoyatattvajñānamādyamātmakam || 16 || iti śrīśāhkare vaiśeṣikasūtropaskāre ṣaṣṭhādhyāyasya dvitīyamāhnikam| samāptaścāyaṃ ṣaṣṭhādhyāyaḥ| <7> <7-1-1> saṃsāramūlakāraṇatayā sarvotpattimannimittakāraṇatayā bhogasādhanatayā cotpattitaḥ pratyātmaniyatatvena parādṛṣṭasyāpi parasyopayogitvena ca dharmādharmau parīkṣyedānīṃ guṇān parīkṣiṣusteṣāmuddeśaṃ lakṣaṇañca smārayannāha -- uktā guṇāḥ || 1 || uddiṣṭā lakṣitā guṇāścetyarthaḥ| tatra rūpādayaḥ saptadaśa kaṇṭharaveṇoktāḥ caśabdasamuccitāḥ sapta, tena caturviśatirapi guṇā uktāḥ| tatra nityavṛttinityavṛttisattāsākṣād‌vyāpyajātimattvaṃ guṇatvam, samavāyikāraṇāvṛttinityavṛttisattāsākṣādvyāpyajātimattvaṃ vā, asamavāyikāraṇavṛttinityavṛttisākṣādvyāpyajātimattvaṃ vā, kāryyāsamānādhikaraṇakarmāvṛttijātimattvaṃ vā || 1 || <7-1-2> tatra guṇatvena guṇaparīkṣā saptamādhyāyārthaḥ| tatra prathamāhnike nityatayā guṇaparīkṣā, anityatayā guṇaparīkṣā, pākajaguṇaparīkṣā, saṅkhyādyanekavṛttiguṇaparīkṣā, parimāṇaparīkṣā, ceti pañcaprakaraṇāni, tatra rūpādīnāñcaturṇāmanityatvamāha -- pṛthivyādirūparasagandhasparśā dravyānityatvādanityāśca || 2 || pṛthivyādīnāṃ vāyavantānāmavayavināṃ rūpādayaścatvāro guṇā anityāḥ| yadyapyanye'pi guṇā avayaviṣu varttamānā anityā eva, tathāpi teṣāmanyato'pi vināśaḥ| rūpādayaścatvāro guṇā āśrayanāśādeva naśyanti na tu virodhiguṇāntarāt| dravyānityatvāditi| dravyasyāśrayabhūtasyānityatvādāśritānāmanityatvamimityarthaḥ || 2 || <7-1-3> mityākṣepabalalabhyamityāha -- etena nityeṣu nityatvamuktam || 3 || rūpādīnāmeva caturṇāṃ nityeṣvāśrayeṣu varttamānānāṃ nityatvamuktam| eteneti| āśrayānityatvenānityatvābhidhānenetyarthaḥ| vṛttikṛtastu nityeṣvanityatvamuktamityakārapraśleṣastathāca pārthivaparamāṇuṣvarinasaṃyogānnāśa iti vyācakruḥ || 3 || <7-1-4> tat kiṃ pārthive'pi nityavṛttirūpādīnāṃ nityatvamevetyato viśinaṣṭi -- apsu tejasi vāyau ca nityā dravyanityatvāt || 4 || āpyaparamāṇau rūparasasparśā nityāḥ, taijasaparamāṇau rūpasparśau, vāyuparamāṇau sparśo nityaḥ| nanu nitye'pi vartamānānāṃ rūpādīnāmanityatve ko virodhaḥ śabdabuddhyādīnābhiva, ityataścakāreṇa guṇāntarāprādurbhāvo hetvantaraṃ sūcitam| śabde hi tīvramandādibhāvena guṇāntaraprādurbhāvo'nuyate, jñānādau ca jñānādivirodhī saṃskārādiḥ. āpyataijasavāyavīyaparamāṇuṣu rūpādivirodhi guṇāntaraṃ na prādurbhavati, yadi prādurbhavettadā tadaribdheṣvapi dvyaṇukādiprakrameṇā''pyādyavayaviṣvapi pūrvavijātīyaṃ rūpādyanubhūyeta| nahi śuklarūpavijātīyaṃ rūpaṃ toyatejasonaṃ vā śītoṣṇasparśavijātīyau sparśau, uṣṇaṃ jalaṃ śīto vāyurityādipratītistūpādhinibandhaneti bhāvaḥ || 4 || <7-1-5> pūrvaṃ pṛthivīmantarbhāvyānityeṣvanityā ityuktamidānīmāpyādiṣvevāha -- anityeṣvanityā dravyānityatvāt || 5 || abādyavayavirūpādaya āśrayanāśādeva naśyanti na tu virodhiguṇāntarādapītyarthaḥ |. 5 || <7-1-6> nanu pṛthivyāmayavirūpāyāmapi rūpādayo'gnisaṃyogādevotpadyante naśyanti ca, tat kathamāśrayanāśamātranāśyā ityata āha -- kāraṇaguṇapūrvakāḥ pṛthivyāṃ pākajāḥ || 6 || pākajā iti| rūparasagandhasparśā ityarthaḥ| kāraṇaguṇapūrvakā iti| rūpāayasya ghaṭāderyat samavāyikāraṇaṃ kapālādi tadguṇapūrvakā| tathāca kapālarūpaṃ kāraṇaikārthasamavāyapratyāsattyā ghaṭarūpādyasamavāyikāraṇam| evaṃ rasādāvapi| rūparasagandhamparśāḥ rūpatvādiguṇatvasākṣādvyāpyajātimantaḥ| nanu cakṣurgrāhyatvameva rūpatvamupādhiriti cet indriyapātamātreṇa rūpamiti pratyayānudayaprasaṅgāt| ananusaṃhitopādherupahitapratyayāyogāditi| upādhiścātra cakṣustaccātīndriyaṃ grāhyatvañca grahaṇaviṣayatvaṃ tadapyacākṣuṣaṃ rūpatvaviśiṣṭapratīteśca cākṣuṣatvāt. cakṣurmātrabahirindriyagrāhyaguṇatvaṃ rūpatvam| atīndriyarūpāvyāptiriti cenna cakṣurmātrabahirindriyagrāhyajātimattvasya vivakṣitatvāt tādṛśī ca jātī rapatvaṃ nīlatvādikā ceti| nanvekaikā eva nīlapītādivyaktayo nityā na tu tatra nīlatvādijātaya ekavyaktikatvāditi cenna nīlataranīlatamādipratyayānudayaprasaṅgāt| dāvalyādisambhedābhāvakṛtastatra tāratamyavyavahāra iti cenna pramāṇābhāvāt, śyāmaṃ rūpaṃ naṣṭaṃ raktamutpannamiti pratīteśca| na ca sā samavāyotpattivināśakṛteti vācyam samavāyasya tatrānullekhāt, tasya nitvatvācca ghaṭāderapyanityatāyāmevaṃsatyanāśvāsāpatteḥ samavāyānityatvenaiva tatrāpyanyathāsiddheḥ suvacatvāt| nanu nīlapītādayo guṇā dravyābhinnā eva dharmadharmiṇorabhedāditi cenna rūpaṃ ghaṭaḥ sparśo ghaṭa ityādivyavahāraprasaṅgāt| nanu nedamaniṣṭaṃ yato bhavatyeva śuklaḥ paṭo nīlaḥ paṭa ityādipratītiriti cenna matublopādabhedopacārādvā pratītyupapatteḥ| bhede pramāṇe sati kalpaneyaṃ yathākathañcidupapadyate iti cenna candanasya rūpaṃ candanasya gandha ityādivyapadeśabalādbhedasiddheḥ, paṭasya rūpābhede paṭavadrūpamapi tvagindriyeṇa gṛhyeta, paṭamānayetyukte yat‌kiñcidrūpamānayet rūpamānayotyukte yat‌kiñcid dravyamānayet| astu tarhi bhedābheda; atyantabhede'tyantābhede ca sāmānādhikaraṇyānupapatteriti cenna avacchedabhedaṃ vinā viruddhayorbhedābhedayorekatrāsambhavāt| anyonyābhāvatvamavyāpyavṛttivṛttinityābhāvavṛttadharmatvādatyantābhāvatvavaditi cenna ekatra saṃyogatadatyantābhāvayoḥ pratītibalādatyantābhāvasyāvyāpyavṛttitvābhyupagamāt, anyonyābāve tu tathāpratīterabhāvāt| tadetadrūpaṃ pṛthivyāṃ nānāprakārakam, pāthasi tejasi ca śuklameva| kvacit paṭādau ca citramapi rūpamadhikam anyathā tadacākṣuṣatvāpātāt napavata eva cākṣuṣadravyatvāt| na ca vijātīyarūpai rūpānārambhaḥ, nolapītādīnāmārambhe rūpatvenaiva sājātyasyāpekṣitatvāt anyathā tacākṣuṣatvāpatteruktatvāt| na cāvayavarūpopagraheṇaivāvayavigrahaḥ avayavānāmapi citratayā nīrūpatvaprasaṅgāt, yatra vā pākāt paramāṇuṣu citraṃ rūpaṃ tatraiva tatparamparārabdhapaṭādau citrarūpopapatteḥ| na ca harītakyāṃ raso'pi citra iti vācyam harītakyā nīrasatve'pi doṣābhāvāt, ṣaḍrasatvavyavahārastu tattadrasaguṇakāritayā| evaṃ gandho'pi na citraḥ saurabhāsaurabhavadavayavadvayasyānārambhakatvāt| karkaṭyādau kvacidavayave taiktyaṃ kvacinmādhuryaṃ tathāca katamo rasaḥ karkaṭyāmiti cenmādhuryameva| guṇavirodhena kathaṃ tathā syāditi cet tadavayave taiktyābhāvāt| tathā'nubhavaḥ kathamiti cet karkaṭībhakṣaṇakṣubhitarasanāgravarttipittadravyasya tiktatāpalasmāt, tata eva kadācinmukhamapi tiktāyate| harītakyāmapi kathamiyaṃ na gatiriti cenna tadavayaveṣu kaṣāyamādhuryalavaṇādinānārasānubhavādityalaṃ pallavena| tacca rūpaṃ nayanasahakāri| nanvevaṃ vāyau rūpābhāvasya tamasaśca kathaṃ cākṣuṣateti cenna bhāvagraha eva rūpasya nayanasahakāritvāt, viṣayālokacakṣuṣāṃ trayāṇāmapi rūpāṇi cākṣuṣapratītiprayojakāni| raso'pi rasatvajātimān| rasasvaṃ rasanendriyamātrajanyasākṣātkāraviṣayajātiḥ tādṛśajātimattvañca rasatvam| so'yaṃ jīvanapuṣṭibalārogyahetuḥ rasanasahakārī| rasanendriyagrāhyaguṇatvavyāpyajātimattvaṃ rasatvam, tathāsati nātīndriyarasāvyāptiḥ| ghrāṇaṇātragrāhyo guṇo gandhaḥ| ghrāṇamātragrāhyaguṇatvavyāpyajātimattvaṃ gandhatvam, sa ca surabhirasurabhiśceti dvividhaḥ| yadvā pṛthivīvṛttimātravṛttiguṇatvasākṣād‌vyāpyajātimattvaṃ gandhatvam| evaṃ sparśo'pi sparśatvajātimān guṇaḥ| tvagindriyamātragrāhyaguṇatvasākṣād‌vyāpya jātimattvaṃ sparśatvam| dravyacatuṣṭayavṛttiścāyam| anuṣṇāśītaśītoṣṇabhedāt trividhaḥ| idānīṃ prasaṅgāt pākajaprakriyā cintyate -- tatra kāryakāraṇasamudāya eva pacyate iti piṭharapākavādinaḥ| pālavaḥ -- paramāṇava eva svatanatrāḥ pacyante, tatraiva pūrvarūpanāśāgrimarūpādyutyattiḥ kāraṇaguṇapakrameṇa cāvayavini rūpād‌yutpadyate iti pīlupākavādinaḥ| atredaṃ tattvam| āpāke niḥkṣiptasya ghaṭāderāmadravyasya vahninā nodanādabhighātādvā tadārambhakeṣu paramāṇuṣu dravyārambhakasaṃyogavirodhivibhāgenārambhakasaṃyoganāśe dravyanāśāvaśyambhāvāt| dṛśyate hi sthālyāmāhitānāṃ taṇḍu lādīnāmapyadhaḥsantāpanamātreṇa bharjanāttadānīmeva nāśaḥ, kṣīranīrādīnāñcātyantamulbaṇatā| tathā cāpāke vahnijvālājālābhihatānāṃ dravyāṇāmavasthānamiti mahatī pratyāśā| kiñca yadi dravyanāśastadā madhyabhāge pākānupattiḥ, na hi dṛḍhatarāvayavāntarāvaruddhe madhyabhāge tejaḥsaṃyogāsambhāvanā yena tatra śyāmādinivṛttiḥ syāt, tathā ca śyāmā avayavāḥ avayavī ca rakta iti mahadvaiśasam| nanu sacchidrāṇyevāvayavidravyāṇi, kathamanyathā kumbhādāvantarnihitānāṃ tailaghṛtādīnāṃ syandanaṃ śrapaṇañca, tathā ca madhyabhāge'pi tejaḥsaṃyogaḥ syādeveti cenna mūrttānāṃ samānadeśatāvirodhāt, avayavāntarasaṃyukte madhyabhāge tejaḥsaṃyogāsambhavāt| nanu yadi dravyanāśaḥ kathaṃ tarhi sa evāyaṃ ghaṭa iti pratyabhijñā, kathaṃ vā sarvāsvavasthās āpākādau ghaṭādestādṛśasyaiva darśanam, ghaṭāderupari nihitānāṃ śarāvodañcanādīnāṃ tathaiva darśanaṃ ghaṭādisphuṭane hi teṣāṃ pātaḥ syāt, kathaṃ vā yāvanta evāpāke nihitāstāvanta eva punaḥ prāpyante paramāṇubhirdvyaṇukādiprakraneṇa nyūnānāmidhakānāṃ vā tadānīmārambhasambhavāt, kathaṃ vā tāvatparimāṇānyeva ghaṭādīnyāpākottorṇānyupalabhyante, rekhoparekhādicihnivilopo vā kathaṃ na bhavet,? tathā cāvayaviṣveva pāka iti cet maivam, sūcyagreṇa ghaṭādau tricaturatrasareṇuvibhāge sati dravyārambhakasaṃyoganāśe dravyanāśe sarvāsāmanupapattīnāmubhayasamādheyatvāt na hi tatra dravyaṃ na naśyatīti piṭharapākavādino'pi vaktumutsahante| tatrāpi ghaṭādayo na naśyanti katipayāvayavanāśe'pyavaśiṣṭāvayavamāśritya kāryāvasthānasambhavādanyathā pratyabhijñānādyanupapattireveti mīmāṃsakāḥ| te tu tāvadavayavāsthānayogyasya ghaṭādeḥ svalpeṣvavayaveṣu kathaṃ vṛttiḥ syāditi praṣṭavyāḥ| avinaṣṭa eva paṭe parimāṇasaṅkocavadetadupapatsyate iti teṣāmuttaramiti cenna kaṭhinatarāvayavānāṃ kāṣṭhapāṣāṇastambhakumbhakumbhādīnāṃ saṅkocavikāśayoradarśanāt| ghaṭādināśakābhimatena tatparimāṇameva naśyatīti cenna parimāṇamyāśrayanāśaikanāśyatvāt ghaṭādipratyabhijñānavat sūcīdalanasthale parimāṇasyāpi pratyabhijñāyamānatvāt, tvanmate tannāśasyāpyanupapatteriti dik| yeṣā mate dravyārambhakasaṃyogapratidvandvītadapratidvandvī ca vibhāga ekayaivāvayavaprakriyayā janmate teṣāṃ dvyaṇukanāśamārabhya navamakṣaṇe dvaṇukāntare raktādyutpattirekasminneva paramāṇau kriyācintanāt| tathā hivahninā nodanād dvyaṇukārambhake paramāṇau karma, tato vibhāgastato dravyārambhakasaṃyoganāśastato dvyaṇukanāśaḥ naṣṭe dvyaṇuke kevale paramāṇāvagnisaṃyogācchyāmādinivṛttiḥ| śyāmādau nivṛtte anyasmādagnisaṃyogādraktādyutpattiḥ| raktādāvutpanne paramāṇukriyānivṛttiyānivṛttistadanantaramadṛṣṭavadātmasaṃyogāt paramāṇau karma tato vibhāgaḥ tato dvyaṇukotpattiḥ utpanne dvyaṇuke kāraṇaguṇaprakrameṇa raktādyutpattiḥ iti nava kṣaṇāḥ| yadi pūrvakriyānivṛttikṣaṇa eva kriyāntaramutpadyate tadā, yadi tu pūrvakriyānivṛttyanantarakāle kriyāntaramutpadyate tadā daśa kṣaṇāḥ| vibhāgajavibhāgādyupagame'pi yadi dravyārambhakasaṃyoganāśaviśiṣṭaṃ kālamapekṣya vibhāgajo vibhāgastadā daśakṣaṇāḥ yadi tu dravyanāśaviśiṣṭaṃ kālamapekṣya vibhāgena vibhāgāntaraṃ janyate tadaikādaśakṣaṇā prakriyā| tathā hi -- dvyaṇukanāśavibhāgajavibhāgāvityekaḥ kālaḥtataḥpūrvasaṃyoganāśasyāmādinivṛttī uttarasaṃyogaraktādyutpattī uttarasaṃyogena vibhāgajavibhāgakriyānivṛttī tato dravyārambhānuguṇā paramāṇukriyā, kriyāto vibhāgo vibhāgāt pūrvasaṃyoganivṛttistato dravyārambhakaḥ saṃyogastato dravyotpattiḥ utpanne dravye raktīdyatpattiḥ iti daśakṣaṇāḥ| yadā tu dravyavināśaviśiṣṭaṃ kālamapekṣya vibhāgena vibhāgo janyate tadaikakṣaṇavṛddhyā ekādaśa kṣaṇāḥ| tathā hi -- dravyavināśaḥ tato vibhāgajavibhāgaśyāmādinivṛttī tataḥ pūrvasaṃyoganāśaḥ tata uttarasaṃyogaraktādyutpattī tato vibhāgajavibhāgakarmaṇīrnivṛttiḥ tataḥ paramāṇau dravyārambhānuguṇā kriyā tato vibhāgaḥ pūrvasaṃyoganivṛttiḥ dravyārambhakasaṃyogotpattiḥ dvyaṇukotpattiḥ raktādyutpattiścetyekādaśa kṣaṇāḥ| ekasminneva paramāṇau kriyākriyoparamacintanādevam| paramāṇvantare yadi dravyārambhānuguṇā kriyā cintyate tadā dvyaṇukavināśamārabhya pañcame ṣaṣṭhe saptame'ṣṭame vā raktādyatpattirūpanīyā| vivṛñcaitat kaṇādarahasye || 6 || <7-1-7> pārthivaparamāṇurūpādīnāṃ tejaḥsaṃyogāsamavāyikāraṇakatvaṃ sādhayitumāha -- ekadravyatvāt || 7 || pākajānāmiti śeṣaḥ| atra ca guṇatve kāryatve satīti vivakṣitam| tadayaṃ prayogaḥ -- pārthivaparamāṇurūpādayaḥ saṃyogāsamavāyitakāraṇakāḥ kāryaguṇatve sati nityaniṣṭhādviṣṭhaguṇatvāt śabdavat, buddhadyādivacca| saṃyogajatvamātraṃ vā sādhyaṃ tena vibhāgajaśabde na vyabhicāraḥ vāyusaṃyogasya śabdamātre nimittakāraṇatvāt| pārthivarūpādīnāñca tejo'nvayavyatirekadarśanāt tejaḥsaṃyogāsamavāyikāraṇakatvaṃ pakṣadharmatābalāt sidhyati || 7 || <7-1-8> rūparasagandhasparśānekagranthena vyutpādya parimāṇasya sarvasiddhatvena saṅkhyāyāñca vipratipattibāhulyāduddaśakramamatikramya sūcīkaṭāhanyāyena prathamaṃ parimāṇaparīkṣāmārabhamāṇa āha -- aṇormahataścopalabdhyanupalabdhī nitye vyākhyāte || 8 || nitye,-iti viṣayeṇa viṣayiṇaṃ nityatvapratipādakaṃ caturthādhyāyamupalakṣayati| upalabdhyanupalabdhī iti yathāyogamanvayaḥ `yena yasyābhisambandho dūrasthasyāpi tasya saḥ' iti nyāyena| tathā cāṇoranupalabdhiriti labhyate| tadevaṃ sthūlo nīlaḥ kalaśa iti prātyakṣikapratyaye yathā nīlaṃ rūpaṃ viṣayastathā parimāṇamapi, tena ca parimāṇena paramāṇuparyantaṃ parimāṇamunnīyate dravyatvācca| kiñca dravyapratyakṣatāyāṃ rūpavat parimāṇamapi kāraṇaṃ, na hi mahattvamantareṇa dravyaṃ pratyakṣaṃ bhavati| tathā ca dravyapratyakṣakāraṇatvena svayañca pratyatayāparimāṇaṃ guṇī'stīti niścīyate| yadi hi ghaṭādisvarūpa parimāṇaṃ syāt tadā mahadānayetyukte ghaṭamātramānayet tathā ca praiṣasaṃpratipattī virudhyetām| evaṃ ghaṭapadāt parimāṇaṃ pratīyeta parimāṇapadādvā ghaṭa iti| mānavyavahārāsādhāraṇakāraṇatvam, dravyasākṣātkārakāraṇaviṣayaniṣṭhasāmānyaguṇatvaṃ vā mahattvatvam| mānavyavahāro hastavitastyādivyavahāro na tu palasaṅkhyādivyavahāraḥ| tacca parimāṇañcaturvidhaṃ -- mahattvamaṇutvaṃ dīrghatvaṃ hrasvatvañca| tatra paramamahattvaparamadīrghatve vibhucatuṣṭayavarttinī, paramāṇutvaparamahrasvatve paramāṇuvarttinī, avāntarāṇutvāvāntarahrasvatve dvyaṇukavarttinī, trasareṇumārabhya mahāvayaviparyantaṃ mahattvadīrghatve| evañca sarvāṇyapi dravyāṇi paramāṇudvayavanti| bilvāmalakādāvaṇutvavyāvahāraḥ samidikṣudaṇḍādiṣu ca hrasvatvavyahāro bhāktaḥ| bhaktiścātre prakarṣabhāvābhāvaḥ| āmalake yaḥ prakarṣabhāvastasyābhāvaḥ kuvale, bilve yaḥ prakarṣabhāvastasyābhāva āmalake, sa ca gauṇamukhyobhayabhāgitvād bhaktipadavācya| dīrghatvahrasvatve nitye na varttete ityeke| parimāṇa eva te na bhavata ityapare| mahatsu dīrghamānīyatāmitivad mahatsu varttalaṃ trikoṇañcānīyatāmitinirdhāraṇa balādvartulatvādīnāmapyāpatteriti teṣāmāśayāt || 8 || <7-1-9> idānīṃ parimāṇakāraṇāni parisañcaṣṭe -- kāraṇabahutvācca || 9 || cakāro mahattvapracayau samuccinoti| parimāṇamutpadyate iti sūtraśeṣaḥ| tatra kāraṇavahutvaṃ tryaṇuke mahattvadaurghatve janayati mahattvapracayayostatkāraṇe'bhāvāt| tacca bahutvamīśvarāpekṣābuddhijanyaṃ tad‌buddheranekaviṣayatve'pyadṛṣṭaviśeṣopagraho niyāmakaḥ| evaṃ paramāṇudvayagataṃ dvitvaṃ dvyaṇuke parimāṇotpādakaṃ vakṣyate| dvābhyāṃ tantumyāmapracitābhyāmārabdhe paṭe kevalaṃ mahattvamevāsamavāyikāraṇaṃ bahutvapracayayostatrābhāvāt yatra ca dvābhyāṃ tūlakapiṇḍābhyāṃ tūlakapiṇḍārambhastatra parimāṇotkarṣadarśanāt pracayaḥ kāraṇaṃ bahutvasyābhāvāt, mahattvasya sattve'pi parimāṇotkarṣaṃ pratyaprayojakatvāt| enañca sati yadi mahattva tatra kāraṇaṃ tadā na doṣaḥ| taduktaṃ -- `dvābhyāmekena sarvairvā' iti| pracayaśca ārambhakaḥ saṃyogaḥ| sa ca svābhimukhakiñcidavayavāsaṃyuktatve sati svābhimukhakiñcidavayavasaṃyogalakṣaṇaḥ| sa cāvayavasaṃyogaḥ svāvayavapraśithilasaṃyogāpekṣaḥ parimāṇajanakaḥ `guṇakarmārambhe sāpekṣa' iti vacanāt || 9 || <7-1-10> mahattvadīrghatve vyutpādyāṇutvaṃ vyutpādayati -- ato viparītamaṇu || 10 || ataḥ pratyakṣasiddhānmahataḥ parimāṇādyadviparītaṃ tadaṇuparimāṇamityarthaḥ| vaiparītyañcāpratyakṣatvāt kāraṇavaiparītyācca| mahattve hi mahattvabahutvapracayānāṃ kāraṇatvam| aṇutve ca kāraṇagatasya dvitvasyeśvarāpekṣābuddhijanyasya kāraṇatvam| etena dīrghatvaviparītaṃ hrasvatvamityapi draṣṭavyam| vaiparītyañcātrāpi pūrvavat || 10 || <7-1-11> idānīṃ kuvalāmalakādāvaṇutvavyavahāro bhākta iti darśayati -- aṇu mahāditi tasmin viśeṣabhāvād viśeṣābhāvācca || 11 || iti śabdo vyavahāraparatāṃ darśayati| tena bilvāpekṣayā kuvalamaṇu kuvalāpekṣayāmalakaṃ mahat āmalakāpekṣayā bilvaṃ mahaditi tāvad‌vyavahāro'sti, tatra mahati teṣu dhyavahāro mukhyaḥ| kuta evamata āha -- viśeṣabhāvāt mahattvaviśeṣasyaiva taratamādibhāvena bhāvāt, aṇuvyavahārastu teṣu bhāktaḥ| kuta evamata āha -- viśeṣabhāvāt aṇutvaviśeṣasya tatrābhāvāt| aṇutvaṃ hi kāryaṃ dvyaṇukamātravṛtti, nityaṃ tu paramāṇuvṛtti, kuvalādau tadabhāvāt| yadvā viśeṣasya mahattvakāraṇasvaivāvayavabahutvamahattvapracayānāṃ kuvalādyavavayaveyu rūpāvāt sadbhāvāt, viśeṣābhāvād viśeṣasya aṇutvakāraṇasya mahattvāsamānādhikaraṇadvitvasya kuvalādyavayaveṣvabhāvādasadbhāvādityarthaḥ || 11 || <7-1-12> aṇutvavyavahāro bhākta ityatra hetumāha -- ekakālatvāt || 12 || mahattvamaṇutvañca dvayamapyekasmin kāle'nubhūyate, te ca mahattvāṇutve parasparavirodhinī naikatrāśraye saha sambhavataḥ, ato mahattvakāraṇasad‌bhāvānmahattvapratyayastatra mukhyo'ṇutvapratyayaprayogau ca bhāktāvityarthaḥ || 12 || <7-1-13> mahattvapratyayasya mukhyatve hetamāha -- dṛṣṭāntācca || 13 || dṛśyate tathā vastugatyā mahatsveva kuvalāmalakabilveṣu sthūlarathūlatarasthūlatamavyavahāreṇa bhavitavyamityarthaḥ| yathā vastugatyā śukleṣveva paṭaśaṅkhasphaṭikādi ṣuśuklaśuklataraśuklatamavyavahāraḥ || 13 || <7-1-14> nanvaṇu mahatparimāṇamiti vyavahārabalānmahattve api parimāṇe mahattvama ṇutve'pyaṇutvamastīti jñāyate tat kayaṃ dravyamātravṛttitvamanayoḥ kathaṃ vā guṇe guṇavṛttitvavirodho nāpadyata ityata āha -- aṇutvamahattvayoraṇutvamahattvābhāvaḥ karmaguṇairvyākhyātaḥ || 14 || yathā guṇakarmaṇī nāṇutvaprahattvavatī nathā'ṇutvakahattve api nāṇutvamahatvavatī ityarthaḥ| prayogaśca bhākto draṣṭavyaḥ || 14 || <7-1-15> nanu yathā guṇā guṇavantaḥ,-kathamanyathā mahān śabdaḥ dvau śabdau ekaḥ śabdaḥ caturviśatirguṇā ityādivyavahāraḥ| karmāṇyapi ca karmavanti pratīyante kathamanaythā śīghraṃ gacti drutaṃ gacchatīti vyavahāraḥ tathā cāṇutvamahattve api tadvatī syātāmityata āha -- karmabhiḥ karmāṇi guṇaiśca guṇā vyākhyātāḥ || 15 || karmabhiḥ karmāṇi na tadvanti guṇaiśca guṇā na tadvanatstathā'ṇutvamahatatvepi na na tadratī| vyavahārast sarvatra bhākta ityarthaḥ || 15 || <7-1-16> nanu mahānti karmāṇi aṇūni karmāṇi mahānto guṇāḥ aṇavā guṇā ityādivyavahārādaṇutvamahattvavanti karmāṇi tadubhayavantaśca guṇāḥ prasaktā ityata āha -- aṇutvamahattvābhyāṃ karmaguṇāśca vyākhyātāḥ || 16 || yathā'ṇutvamahattve nāṇutvamahattvavatī tathā na karmāṇi tadubhayavanti na vavā guṇāstadubhayavanta ityarthaḥ| prayogastu pūvadbhākta iti bhāvaḥ || 16 || <7-1-17> aṇutvamahattvaprakriyāṃ dorghatvahasvatvayoratidiśati -- etena dīrghatvahrasvatve vyākhyāte || 17 || hrasvatvadīrghatve api na hrasvatvadīrghatvavatī mahattvotpādakameva dīrghatvotpādakamaṇutvotpādakameva hrasvatvotpādakam| kāraṇekyāt kathaṃ kāryyabheda iti cenna, prāgabhāvabhedena pākajavadupapatteḥ| yatraiva mahattvaṃ tatra dorghatvaṃ yatrāṇutvaṃ tatra hrasvatvaṃ yatra nityamaṇutvaṃ tatra nityahrasvatvamityādyatideśārthaḥ || 17 || <7-1-18> idānīṃ vināśakamāha -- anitye'nityam || 18 || etaccaturvidhamapi parimāṇaṃ vināśini dravye varttamānamāśrayanāśādeva naśyati na tu virodhiguṇāntarāt| ghaṭe satyapi tatparimāṇaṃ vinaśyati kathamanyathā kambubhaṅge'pi sa evāyaṃ ghaṭa iti pratyabhijñeti cenna| āśrayanāśena tatra ghaṭanāśāvaśyakatvāt na hi paramāṇudvayasaṃyoganāśād dvyaṇuke naṣṭe tadāśritasya trasareṇostadāśritasya cūrṇaśarkarāderavināśa iti yuktirabhyupagamo vā| kathaṃ tarhi pratyabijñeti cet? saiveyaṃ dīpakaliketipratyabhijñānavad bhrāntatvāt| pradīpapratyabhijñā'pi pramaiva hrasvatvadīrghatvaṃ paramutpādavināśaśālinī iti cenna tadvināśasyāśrayavināśamantareṇānupapatteruktatvāt || 18 || <7-1-19> tat kiṃ pārthivaparamāṇurūpādivat paramāṇugatamaṇutvaṃ rābdabudvyādivadākāśādigataṃ mahattvamapi mahattvamapi naśyatītyata āha -- nitye nityam || 19 || nityeṣvākāśādiṣu paramāṇuṣu ca yat parimāṇaṃ tannityaṃ vināśakābhāvāt || 19 || <7-1-20> paramāṇuparimāṇasya vaiśeṣikasiddhāṃ saṃjñāmāha -- nityaṃ parimaṇḍalam || 20 || parimaṇḍalameva pārimāṇḍalyam, taduktam "anyatrapārimāṇḍalyādibhyaḥ" iti || 20 || <7-1-21> nanu kuvalāmalakādiṣu samidikṣuprabhṛtiṣu ca vyavahriyamāṇamaṇutvaṃ hrasvatvaṃ vā yadi na pāramārthikaṃ tadā parimārthikayostayoḥ ki pramāṇagata āha -- avidyā ca vidyāliṃgam || 21 || vidyāliṅgamavidyā| tadayamarthaḥ kuvalāmalakādāvaṇutvajñānaṃ samidikṣuprabhṛtiṣu hrasvatvajñānaṃ tāvadavidyā tatra pāramārthikāṇutavahrasvatvayorabhāvāt| sarvatrāpramā pramāpūrvikaiva bhavatītyanyathākhyātivādibhirabhyupagamāt, tathāca satyamaṇutvajñānaṃ satyañca hrasvatvajñānamanumeyamityarthaḥ| evañca bhāktaḥ śabdaprayogo mukhyamantareṇa na bhavatīti mukhye'ṇutvahrasvatve kvacidavaśyaṃ mantavye || 21 || <7-1-22> dravyatvena hetunā''kāśādīnāmanumitasya parimāṇasya svarūpamāha -- vibhavānmahānākāśastathā cātmā || 22 || vibhavaḥ sarvamūrttasaṃyogitvaṃ tacca paramamahattvamantareṇānupapadyamānaṃ paramamahattvamanumāpayati| dṛśyate ceha vārāṇasyāṃ pāṭaliputre ca yugapadeva śabdotpattistatra caikamevākāśaṃ samavāyikāraṇamityākāśasya vyāpakatvaṃ siddham| vyāpakatvañca paramamahatparimāṇayoga eva, nānā''kāśakalpane gauravamityeka evākāśo'bhyupagantavyaḥ| ākāśasya pradeśa iti tu vyapadeśaḥ pradeśavadbhirghaṭādibhiḥ sayoganibandhano bhāktaḥ| bhaktiśca pradeśavaddravyasaṃyogitvam| tathātmeti| yathākāśaṃvibhavāt sarvamūrttasayogitvāt paramamahat tathātmāpi paramamahān| yadyātmanaḥ sakalamūrtasaṃyogitvaṃ na bhavet tadā teṣu teṣu mūrtteṣu adṛṣṭavadātmasaṃyogāt kriyā notpadyeta vyadhikaraṇamyādṛṣṭasya pratyāsattyapekṣayā kriyājanakatvāt. sā ca pratyāsattiradṛṣṭavadātmasaṃyoga eva| evaṃ saṃñcāriṇi śarīre tatra tatra jñānasukhādīnāmutpattirātmano vaibhavamantareṇānupapannetyātmā'pi vyāpakaḥ| sa ca nākāśavadeka eva vyavasthādarśanādityuktamiti bhāvaḥ| tacca mahattvaṃ sātiśayaṃ nityañca paramāṇvaṇutvavat| evamākāśādau paramadīrghatvaṃ paramāṇuṣu ca paramahasvatvamūhanīyam || 22 || <7-1-23> nanu mano vibhu sarvadā niḥsparśadravyatvādākāśavat jñānādyamamavāyikāraṇasaṃyogādhāratvādātmavadityākāśātmanoḥ sāhacaryeṇa mano'pikiṃ noktamata āha -- tadabhāvādaṇu manaḥ || 23 || tasya vibhavasya sarvamūrtasaṃyogitvasyābhāvādaṇu manaḥ| sakalamūrttasaṃyogitve tu yugapadanekendriyasaṃyoge jñānayaugapadyaṃ syāt, tathā ca vyāsaṃgo na syāt| anumāne tu mano yāvanna siddhaṃ tāvadāśrayāsiddhe manaḥsiddhidaśāyāntu dharmigrāhakamānabādhite| nanu vibhavābhāvādeva nāṇutvaṃ sidhyati dhaṭādau vyabhicārāditi cenna vibhavābhāvenāvyāpakatvasādhanāt| tathā caikasmindehe manastāvadekaṃ nānākalpane gauravāpatteḥ| ekasyāpyavayavakalpane kalpanāgauravānniḥ| sparśatvenānārambhakatvāccetyādiyukteraṇutvasiddheriti bhāva || 23 || <7-1-24> diśaḥ paramamahattve yuktimāha -- guṇairdig vyākhyātā || 24 || gurṇaiḥ sakaladvīpavarttipuruṣasādhāraṇapūrvāparādipratyayarūpaiḥ sakalamūrtaniṣṭhāparatvāparatvalakṣaṇaiḥ dirgāpi vyāpakatvena vyākhyātetyarthaḥ| paratvāparatvayorutpattau saṃyuktasaṃyogabhūyastvālpīyastvaviṣayāpekṣā buddheḥ kāraṇatvasya vakṣyamāṇatvāt| nānādikkalpanasya kalpanāgauravapratihatatvāt| kathaṃ tarhi daśa diśa iti pratītivyapadeśāviti cenna tattadupādhinibandhanatvādityuktatvāt || 24 || <7-1-25> kālasya vyāpakatvamāha -- kāraṇe kālaḥ || 25 || parāparavyatikarayaugapadyāyaugapadyacirakṣiprapratyayakāraṇe dravye kāla iti samākhyā| na caitādṛśaḥ pratyaya sarvadeśapuruṣasādhāraṇaḥ kālasya vyāpakatāmantareṇa sambhavatīti tasya vyāpakatvaṃ paramamahattvayoga ityarthaḥ| yadvā idānīṃ jāta ityādipratītibalāt sarvotpattimannimittakāraṇatvaṃ kālasya pratīyate tadapi vyāpakatvādhīnaṃ nimittakāraṇasya samavāyyasamavāyikāraṇapratyāsannatvaniyamāt| yadvā atītānāgatavartamānavyavahāraḥ sārvatrika iti sarvagata eva kālaḥ| yadvā kṣaṇalavamuhūrttayāmadināhorātrapakṣamāsartvayanasaṃvatsarādivyavahārakāraṇe dravye kālākyeti vyavahārasya sārvatrikatvāt kālaḥ sārvatrika iti paramamahān, tasya nānātvakalpanā ca kalpanāgauravapratihatetyuktam || 25 || iti śrīśāṅkare vaiśeṣikasūtropaskāre saptamādhyāyasya ādyamāhnikam| saptamādhyāye dvitīyāhnikam <7-2-1> dvitīyāhnike ekānekavṛttiguṇaparīkṣāpkaraṇam anekamātravṛttiguṇaparīkṣāprakaraṇam| prasaṅgācchabdārthasambandhaparīkṣāprakaraṇam| viśeṣaguṇarahitavibhusaṃyogāsamavāyikāraṇakaikavṛttiguṇaparokṣāprakaraṇam samavāyaparīkṣāprakaraṇañceti| tatra mahattvaikārthasamavāyādhīnaṃ saṃkhyādīnāmapi pratyakṣatvamiti coddeśakramamatikramya parimāṇanirūpaṇānantaraṃ saṃkhyāṃ pṛthaktvañca parīkṣitumāha -- rūparasagandhasparśavyatirekādarthāntaramekatvam || 1 || rūparasagandhasparśeti,-saṃkhyādipañcakabhinnaguṇopalakṣaṇam| vyatirekāditi vyabhicārāt| tadayamarthaḥ -- eko ghaṭa iti viśiṣṭapratītirviśeṣaṇajanyā, tacca, viśeṣaṇaṃ na rūpādi, tadvyatirekeṇa jāyamānatvāt, na ca ghaṭatvādikameva nimittam, paṭe'pi jāyamānatvāt| na caikatvaṃ sattāvat sāmānyam, sattayā sahānyūnānatiriktavṛttitvāt| na ca dravyamātrasāmānyaṃ tat, dravyatvenānyūnānatiriktadeśatvāt| na cānyūnānatiriktadeśatve'pi pratītibhedādbhedaḥ pratītibhedasya svarūpakṛtatve sattā'pi bhidyeta, viṣayabhedakṛtatve tu viṣayabhedānupapatteruktatvāt, anyathā ghaṭatvakalasasvayorapi bhedāpatteḥ| na ca svarūpābheda ekatvamiti būṣaṇamataṃ yuktam, ghaṭasvarūpābhedaścedekatvaṃ tadā paṭādāvekatvapratyayo na syāt| svarūpabhedo dvitvādikamityapi bhūṣaṇamatamanupapannam svarūpabhedasya tricaturādisādhāraṇyena vyavahāravaicitryānupapatteriti bhāvaḥ || 1 || <7-2-2> ekatvatulyatayaikapṛthak‌tvamapi sādhayitumāha -- tathā pṛthak‌tvam || 2 || apoddhāravyavahārastāvadasti -- idamasmāt pṛthaganyadarthāntaramityākāraḥ| apavṛjyāvadhimapekṣya ya uddhāro nirdhāraṇaṃ sa hyapoddhāraḥ, tatra ca na rūpādi tantraṃ vyabhicārādavadhyanirūpyatvācca| nanvanyonyābhāva eva pṛthak‌tvam, idamasmāt pṛthaganyadarthāntaramitivadbhinnamiti pratīteranyonyā bhāvāvalambanatvāt| na, pṛthagādiśabdānāṃ paryāyatve'pi nānyonyābhāvārthatvaṃ tatra pañcamīprayogānupapatteḥ, idamasmāt pṛthak idāmidaṃ na bhavatītipratītyobhinnaviṣayatvāt| na cānyonyābhāvavānarthaḥ pṛthaktvan aghaṭaḥ paṭa ityatrāpi pañcamīprayogāpatteḥ| nanu pṛthagiti viśiṣṭa iti pratītyorekākāratvādvaiśiṣṭyameva pṛthaktvamiti cenna maitrasya daṇḍavaiśiṣṭyadaśāyāṃ maitrāt pṛthagayaṃmaitra ityapi pratītyāpatteḥ| ata eva vaidharmyamapi na pṛthaktvaṃ pākarakte ghaṭe śyābhād ghaṭāt pṛthagayaṃ ghaṭa iti vyavahārāpatteḥ, tadvirodhidharmavattvameva hi tadvaidharmyaṃ tacca śyāmānantaraṃ raktatādaśāyāmapi| na ca sāmānyameva pṛthaktvaṃ sāmānyasyāvadhyanirūpyatbāt| jātisaṅkaraprasaṅgācca sanmātravṛttitve sattayā, dravyamātravṛttitve dravvatdhenānyūnānatiriktavṛttitvāpatteḥ || 2 || <7-2-3> nanvekamekatvaṃ rūpādibhyaḥ pṛthak pṛthaktvamiti vyavahārādekatve'pyekatvaṃ, pṛthaktve'pi pṛthaktvamevaṃ tatra tathāpītyata āha -- ekatvaikapṛthaktvayorekatvaikapṛthaktvābhāvo'ṇutvamahattvābhyāṃ vyākhyātaḥ || 3 || yathā'ṇutvamahattve nāṇutvamahattvavatī tad‌vyavahārastatra bhāktastathaikatvaikapṛthaktvavatī tad‌vyavahārastatra bhākta ityardhaḥ| "karmabhiḥ karmāṇi" "gaṇairguṇāḥ" ityapi dṛṣṭāntasūtradvaya pūrvadṛṣṭāntasūtreṇaikavākyatāpannamevātra pratibhāsate yathā karmāṇi na karmavanti guṇāśca na guṇavantastaṣṭaukatvekapṛthaktve na tadvatī ityarthaḥ || 3 || <7-2-4> nanu guṇeṣu karmasu ca sādhāraṇa evaikatvavyavahāraḥ kimatra vinigamakaṃ yaddravyeṣvevaikatvaṃ na guṇādiṣvisyatrāha -- niḥsaṃkhyatvāt karmaguṇānāṃ sarvaikatvaṃ na vidyate || 4 || sarveṣāmekatvaṃ sarvaikatvaṃ tanna vidyate, kuru ityata āha -- niḥsaṃkhyatvāt karmaguṇānāmiti| saṃkhyāyā niṣkāntāḥ niḥsaṃkhyāsteṣāṃ bhāvo nisaṃkhyatvam, tathā ca karmāṇi guṇāśca niḥsaṃkhyāni, saṃkhyāyā guṇatvena gaṇeṣu tāvat saṃkhyā na na vidyate na vā karmasu, guṇānāṃ karmasu niṣedhāt anyathā dravyatvaprasaṅgāt| sādhitañca saṃkhyāyā guṇatvamekatvasya ca saṃkhyātvamiti bhāvaḥ || 4 || <7-2-5> tarhi kathamekaṃ rūpameko rasa ityādijñānamityata āha -- bhrāntaṃ tat || 5 || guṇakarmasu yadekatvajñānaṃ tad bhrāntamityarthaḥ| sūtre ca jñānamiti śeṣaḥ ākṣiptapūrvapakṣatvāt prayogastu bhāktaḥ svarūpābheda eva ca bhāktaḥ na ca tadevaikatvamuktottaratvāt || 5 || <7-2-6> nanu dravyeṣvapyayamekatvaprayogo bhākto'stu pratyayastu tatra bhrāntaḥ kimekatvenetyata āha -- ekatvābhāvād bhaktistu na vidyate || 6 || yadi pāramārthikamekatvaṃ kvacinnābhyupagantavyaṃ tadā na prayogo bhāktaḥ mukhyapūrvakatvādbhakteḥ, na vā pratyayo bhrāntaḥ pramāpūrvakatvād bhramasya, pramitaṃ hyāropyate nāpramitam asatkhyāternirāsād anyathā khyāteḥ sādhanāditi bhāvaḥ || 6 || <7-2-7> kāryakāraṇayostantupaṭayorekatvamekapṛthaktvañca, yata evaikatvamata evaikapṛthaktvamapi na hi svasmādeva svaṃ pṛthagiti sambhavati, na hi paṭe pāṭyamāne pratyekaṃ tantūnāmākarṣe tadbhinnaḥ paṭa upalabhyate, yadi tantubhinnaḥ paṭaḥ syāt tadā tadbhinnatayopalabhyeta ghaṭavat, evaṃ ghaṭe'pi bhagne kapāladvayātiriktasyānupalambhāt ghaṭo'pī kapāladvayātmaka eva| taduktaṃ "nānyo'vayavyavayavebhyaḥ" iti tadidaṃ sāṅkhyīyaṃ mataṃ prasaṅgānnirācikīrṣurāha -- kāryakāraṇayorekatvaikapṛthaktvābhāvādekatvaikapṛthaktvaṃ na vidyate || 7 || kāryaṃ kāraṇañca dvayamekaṃ na bhavati, kuta etadityāha -- ekatvābhāvādabhedābhāvāt| tarhi yadeva kāryaṃ tadeva kāraṇaṃ tantavaḥ paṭa iti bahutvaikatvayoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyānupapatteḥ| bhavatyeva sāmānādhikaraṇyamekasyāmapi pāthaḥ kaṇikāyāmāpa iti prayogāt ekasyāmapi yoṣiti dārā iti prayogaditi cenna tatrāvayavabahutvamādāyopapatteḥ| pāthaḥ paramāṇau tu prakṛtigataṃ rūpādibahutvamādāyetyeke| śabdasvābhāvyamidamaparyanuyajyamityapare| na ca raṇḍākaraṇḍāvasthitāstantavaḥ paṭavyapadeśaṃ labhante, na vā dhāraṇākarṣaṇe tantavaḥ pratyekaṃ kartumīśate, na vā kārya kāraṇañca dvayamapyekapṛthaktvāśrayaḥ parasparāvadhikatvapratīteḥ| kuta ityata āha -- ekapṛthakatvābhāvāt ekapṛthaktvamavaidharmyaṃ tadabhāvāt kāryakāraṇayoranyonyavaidharmyānubhavāt tantutvapaṭatvayoḥ ghaṭatvakapālatvayośca bhinnabuddhivyapadeśayoḥ sārvalaukikatvāt| kathaṃ tarhi rūparasagandhasparśānāṃ na bhedenopalambhaḥ? atyantasārūpyāt, kvaciccitrapaṭādau bhedopalambho'pi, sahkhyāparimāṇādibhedasya cātisphuṭatvāt || 7 || <7-2-8> anityayorekatvekapṛthaktvayoḥ kāraṇaguṇapūrvakatvamāha -- etadanityayorvyākhyātam || 8 || anityayoḥ saṅkhyāpṛthaktvayoḥ kāraṇaguṇapūrvakatvaṃ yadvākhyātaṃ tadanityayorekatvaikapṛthaktvayoreva boddhavyam, anyeṣāṃ saṅkhyāpṛthaktvānāmapekṣābuddhijanyatvāt, yathā'nityayostejorūpasparśayoḥ kāraṇaguṇapūrvakatvaṃ tathaikatvaikapṛthaktvapasaṅkhyānam, upasaṅkhyānāntarañca -- `tatsamānādhikaraṇañca dvipṛthaktvādiparārddhapṛthaktvaparyantam'| tadayaṃ dvitvādyutpādavināśakramaḥ -- samānajātīyayorasamānajātīyayordravyayoścakṣuḥsannikarṣe satitanniṣṭhaikatvasaṅkhyāyoryatsāmānyamekatvaṃ tayornirvikalpakānantaraṃ tadviśiṣṭaguṇabuddhitvamutpadyate, saiva cāpekṣābuddhistayā tayordravyayordvitvamutpadyate utpannasya ca dvitvasya yatsāmānyaṃ dvitvatvaṃ tadālocanaṃ tenālocanenāpekṣābuddhernāśo dvitvatvaviśiṣṭaṃ dvitvaguṇaviṣayā viśiṣṭabuddhiścaikadā bhavati, tadagrimakṣaṇe ca dvitvaguṇasyāpekṣābuddhivināśādvināśaḥ dve dravye iti dvitvaviśiṣṭadravyajñānañca yugapadutpadyate, tatastasmād dvitvaviśiṣṭadravyajñānāt saṃskāraḥ| tadayaṃ saṃkṣepaḥ -- utpatsyamānadvitvādhāreṇenadriyasannikarṣaḥ? tataḥ ekatvaguṇagata sāmānyajñāna tata ekatvatvasāmānyavisiṣṭaikatvaguṇasamūhālambanarūpā'pekṣābuddhiḥ tato dvitvaguṇotpattiḥ tadgatasāmānyasya jñānaṃ tatastatsāmānyaviśiṣṭadvitvaguṇajñānaṃ tato dvitvaguṇaviśiṣṭadravyajñānaṃ tataḥ saṃskāraḥ itīnadriyasannikarṣamārabhya saṃskāraparyantamaṣṭau kṣaṇāḥ| vināśakramarat -- ekatvatvasāmānyajñānasyāpekṣābuddhito vināśaḥ dvitvatvasāmanyajñānādapekṣābuddhervināśaḥ dvitvasāmānyajñānasya ca dvitvaguṇabuddhito vināśaḥ dvitvaguṇabuddheśca dvitvaviṣṭadravyajñānāt tasya ca saṃskārāt viṣayāntarajñānādveti| nanvekatvajñānāttadviśiṣṭadravyajñānameva kathaṃ notpadyate tatsāmāgrīsattvāt, na hi guṇajñāne sati dravyajñāne vilambo'sti tathā ca tata evāpekṣābuddhervināśe tannāśācca tadagrimakṣaṇa eva dvitvanāśa iti dve dravye iti viśiṣṭajñānapūrvakṣaṇa eva dvitvavināśāpattyā dvitvaviśiṣṭadravyajñānasyānutpattireveti cenna dvitvādyupattisāmagryanabhibhūtāyā evāpekṣābuddherdravyaviśiṣṭajñānajanakatvaniyamāt phalavalena tathā kalpanāt| nanu tathāpi svajanitasaṃskāreṇaivāpekṣābuddhivināśe punaḥ sa doṣastadavastha eva, dvitvaviśiṣṭajñānapūrvakṣaṇa eva dvitvanāśasya sambhavāditi cenna kevala guṇajñānasya saṃskārājanakatvāt na hi kevalo guṇaḥ kvāpi smaryate, sarvatra dravyoparāgeṇaiva guṇasmaraṇāt| nanu bhavatvevaṃ tathāpi viśiṣṭabuddhikāle'pi dvitvanāśe viśiṣṭapratītyanudayastadavatha eva, nahi vartamānāvabhāsinī viśiṣṭapratītirviśeṣaṇanāśkāle sambhavati tathā'darśanāditi cenna viśeṣaṇajñānaviśeṣyendriyasannikarṣatadubhayāsaṃsargāgrahasya viśiṣṭajñānasāmagryāḥ prakṛte'pi sambhavāt| yadi tu viśeṣaṇendriyasannikarṣo'pi mṛgyate tadā pūrvakṣaṇe tasyāpi sattvāt pūrvakṣaṇavarttina eva sannikarṣasya kāraṇatvenābhyupagamāt viśeṣaṇaṃ viśiṣṭajñānāgocaro'pi sambhavati viśiṣṭajñānaviṣayatvamātrameva hi viśeṣaṇatve tantraṃ na tu viśiṣṭajñānāviṣayatvamapi| upalakṣaṇasyātyevaṃ viśeṣaṇatvāpattiriti cenna pratyāyyavyāvṛttisāmānādhikaraṇyasya viśeṣaṇatve tantratvāt, upalakṣaṇantu tadvyadhikaraṇam| evaṃ yadā devadattagṛhe kākavattā tadā kāko viśeṣaṇaṃ, yadā tu upari bhraman asan tadopalakṣaṇam| evaṃ sati rūpavati rasa ityādau rūpāderapi viśeṣaṇatvāpattiriti cenna iṣṭatvāt| tarhi tatrāpi raso varteteti cenna viśiṣṭavṛtterviśeṣaṇavṛttitvānāvaśyakatvāt, na hi viśeṣaṇaṃ viśiṣṭamityekaṃ tattvam| dvitvanāśakāle viśeṣaṇasambandho nāsti kuto viśiṣṭapratyaya iti cenna atadvyāvṛttereva vaiśiṣṭyapadārthatvāt, tadbhānantu tatrāpīti na kiñcidanupapannamityācāryāḥ| evaṃ dvitvotpattivināśavattritvotpattivināśāvapyūhanīyau| dvitvamapekṣābuddhināśanāśyam, āśrayanāśavirodhiguṇāntarābhāve guṇasya sato'vināśitvāt caramajñānavat, caramajñānasyādṛṣṭanāśanāśyatvāt| kvacidāśrayanāśādapi naśyati yatra dvitvādhārāvayavakarmasamakālamekatvasāmānyajñānam| yathā avayavakarmasāmānyajñāne vibhāgāpekṣābuddhī saṃyoganāśaguṇotpattī dravyanāśadvitvasāmānyajñāne tatradravyanāśād‌dvitvanāśaḥ, sāmānyajñānādapekṣābuddhināśaḥ, apekṣābuddhināśasya dvitvanāśasamānakālatvāt kāryakāraṇasamānabhāvābhāvāt| yadā tu dvitvādhārāvayavakarmāpekṣābuddhyoryaugapadyaṃ tadā dvābhyāmāśrayanāśāpekṣābuddhināśābhyāṃ dvitvanāśaḥ| tadyathā avayavakarmāpekṣābuddhī vibhāgotpattidvitvotpattī saṃyoganāśadvitvasāmānyajñāne dravyanāśāpekṣābuddhināśau tābhyāṃ dvitvanāśaḥ pratyekaṃ sāmarthyagrahāt| iyañca prakriyā jñānayorbadyaṣātakapakṣe paramupapadyate sa eva ca pakṣaḥ prāmāṇikaḥ| nanu dvitvatritvādīnāṃ sāmagrīsāmye kathaṃ kāryavailakṣaṇyaṃ? dvābhyāmekatvābhyāṃ dvitvaṃ tribhirekatvaistritvamiti cenna ekatve dvitvādyabhāvāt| samavāyikāraṇagatameva dvitvatritvādike tantramiti cenna dvitvādyutpatteḥ pūrvaṃ tatra dvitvādyabhāvāt, tatrāpi kāraṇacintāyā anivāraṇāt apekṣābuddhāvekatveṣu ca tādṛśaviśeṣasyānupalambhabodhitvāt, phalabalena tatkalpane, vā dvitvādivyavahāro'pi tata evāstu kiṃ dvitvādinā| adṛṣṭaviśeṣādviśeṣa iti cedevaṃ sati dvitvārambhakayā'pi sāmagryā kadācittritvaṃ catuṣṭvañcotpadyetetyaniyamaprasaṅgaḥ| atrocyate -- prāgabhāvaviśeṣādviśeṣopapatteḥ, yathā tulyayā sāmagryā pākajānāṃ rūparasagandhasparśānām| pragabhāvo'pi sādhāraṇa eveti cenna svasvaprāgabhāvasyaiva kāryaṃ prati kāraṇatvāvadhāraṇāt| yadvā śuddhayā'pekṣābuddhyā dvitvaṃ dvitvasahitayā tritvamiti nevam| śataṃ pipīlikānāṃ mayā hatamityādau samavāyikāraṇābhāve dvitvaṃ tāvannotpadyate tathāca gauṇastatra saṅkhyāvyavahāro draṣṭavyaḥ| senāvanādau niyatāpekṣābuddhyabhāvāddhahutvamātramutpadyate na tu śatasahastradisaṅkhyeti śrīdharācāryāḥ| evaṃ sati śatasahasrādikoṭikastatrasaṃśayo na syāt, na syācca mahatī mahattarā seneti naivamityudayanācāryāḥ| atraivamālocanīyam -- tritvādiparārddhaparyantā saṅkhyaiva bahutvam, tadbhinnaṃ vā vā saṅkhyāntaram? nādyaḥ senāvanādāvapi śatasahasrādisaṅkhyotpattiniyamāt| na dvitīyaḥ tritvādivilakṣaṇasya bahutvasyānanubhavāt| tathāca pratiniyataikatvānālambanāpekṣābuddhijanitaśatādisaṅkhyaiva bahutvaṃ śatādyabhivyaktistu tatra na bhavati tādṛśavyañjakābhāvāt| vayantu brūmaḥ -- tritvādisamānādhikaraṇaṃ saṅkhyāntarameva bahutvaṃ tritvādijanakāpekṣābuddhijanyaṃ prāgabhāvabhedādevaṃ bhāvaḥ kathamanyathā -- `bahavastāvat santi śataṃ vā sahasraṃ veti viśiṣya na jānīm' iti| yathaikadravye mahattvaṃ dīrghatvañca tathaikatraivādhikaraṇe tritvādikaṃ bahutvañca| bhavati hi `śataṃ vā sahasraṃ vā cūtaphalānyānayāmīti?' praśne bahavastāvadānīyantāṃ kiṃ viśeṣajijñāsayeti| evañca dvittvasahitāpekṣābuddhyā tritvaṃ tritvasahitāpekṣābuddhyā catuṣṭvamevamuttarottarottaram bahutvotpattau tu nāpekṣābuddhau pūrvapūrvasaṅkhyāviśiṣṭatvaniyamaḥ| ata eva senāvanādiṣu bahutvamātramutpadyate na tu saṅkhyāntaraṃ saṃśayastvasatkoṭiko'pi bhavatyeveti| `tatsamānādhikaraṇañca pṛthaktvamiti yathā dvitvaṃ tathā dvipṛthaktva' mityādi| nanu dvitvatritvādisamānādhikaraṇairekapṛthakatvaireva tad vyavahāropapattau kiṃ dvipṛthaktvādineti cenna ghaṭāt paṭaloṣṭau pṛthagiti -- dvipṛthaktvasyānyonyāvādhikatvāpratīteḥ pratyekapṛthaktve ca tatpratīteriti vaiṣamyāt| na caivaṃ dviparatvāpattiḥ dvitvasamānādhikaraṇābhyāṃ paratvābhyāmeva tadupapatteḥ| yathā pṛthaktve parasparāvadhikatvavirodhastathā na paratve, dvāvimau parāvitidvāvimau nīlābitivadupapatteḥ samānadeśasthayoḥ saṃyuktasaṃyogabhūyastvasāmye'pi dikpiṇḍasaṃyogasyāsamavāyikāraṇasya bhedena bhinnakāryotpattisambhavāt| militayorekatvayordvatvaṃ prati yathā'samavāyikākaṇatvaṃ tathā militayorekapṛthaktvayordvipṛthaktvaṃ pratyasamavāyikāraṇatvasambhavāt dravyātiriktamekaṃ kāryaṃ pratyanekeṣāṃ saṃyogānāṃ kāryaikārthasamavāyaptyāsattyā sambhūyārambhakatvādarśanāt| kāraṇaikārthapratyāsattyā tu bahabastantuturīsaṃyogā ekaṃ paṭaturīsaṃyogamārabhanta eveti dik| dvitvādivināśavad‌dvipṛthaktvādivināśo'pyūhanīyaḥ || 8 || <7-2-9> prakaraṇāntaramārabhate -- anyatarakarmajaḥ ubhayakarmajaḥ saṃyojaśra saṃyogaḥ || 9 || saṃyoge saṃyuktapratītirabādhitā pramāṇaṃ kāryāṇi ca, -- avayavasaṃyogeṣu dravyamagnisaṃyoge pākajā rūpādayaḥ pracaye parimāṇaviśeṣaḥ bheryākāśasaṃyoge śabda ityādyūhyam| na cāviralotpattireva saṃyogaḥ, kṣaṇabhaṅgapariṇāmayornirāsāt| apraptipūrvikā prāptiḥ saṃyogaḥ| sa cānyatarakarmajaḥ -- kriyāvatā śyenena niṣkriyasya sthāṇostadabhimukhakriyārahitasya sakriyasyāpi dhāvataḥ yathā dhāvatā pūruṣāntareṇa pṛṣṭhadeśasaṃyogaḥ| ubhayakarmajaḥ -- meṣayormallayorvā pratyekaṃ gṛhītasāmarthyābhyāmubyāmeva tajjananāt| tṛtīyastvaṅgulitarusaṃyogāddhastatarusaṃyogaḥ| sa caikasmādapi bhavati yathātantuvīraṇasaṃyogāt paṭavīraṇasaṃyogaḥ| kkacid‌dvābhyāṃ saṃyogābhyāmekaḥ saṃyogaḥ yathādvābhyāṃ tantubhyāmākāśasya dvau saṃyogau tābhyāmeka eva dvitanatukapaṭasyākāśena saṃyogaḥ| kvacicca bahubhirapi saṃyogairekaḥ saṃyoga ārabhyate yathādaśabhistantubhirākāśasya daśa saṃyogā ekameva daśatantukapaṭā kāśasaṃyogamārabhante| kvacit punarekasmādapi saṃyogādasamavāyikāraṇāt saṃyogadvayamutpadyate yathāpārthivāpyayoḥ paramāṇvoḥ prathamamanārambhake saṃyoge jāte pārthive paramāṇau pārthivaparamāṇvantareṇa, āpye ca paramāṇāvāpyaparamāṇvantareṇa, dvyaṇukadvayārambhakaṃ saṃyogadvayamutpadyate, tābhyāṃ saṃyogābhyāṃ sajātīyaniṣṭhābhyāṃ dvyaṇukadvyaṃ yugapadārabhyate, tatra yaḥ pārthivāpyaparamāṇvoranārambhakaḥ saṃyogautpannastenaikenaiva pārthivaparamāṇunā''pyadvyaṇukenaikaḥ saṃyogaḥ āpyaparamāṇunā
