pārthivadvyaṇukenāparaḥ saṃyogo dvyaṇukayo rūpādyutpattisamakālameva jāyate, kāraṇākāraṇasaṃyogena kāryākāryasaṃyogayoravaśyaṃ jananāt| mūrttairvibhūnāmanyatarakarmaja eva| vibhunostu na saṃyogaḥ kāraṇābhāvāt karma tāvattatra nāsti na ca kāraṇaṃ tena kāraṇākāraṇasaṃyogāt kāryākāryasaṃyogo'pi nāsti| nityastu saṃyogo na sambhavati aprāptipūrvikāyāḥ prāpteḥ saṃyogatvāt nityatve tadvighātāt evañca sati vibhāgopyajatastatra syāt| na ceṣṭāpattiḥ saṃyogavibāgayorvirodhinoravinaśyadavasthayorekatrānupapatteḥ| kiñca saṃyogaṃ prati prayojikā yutasiddhiḥ, na ca vibhunostatsambhavaḥ| sā hi dvayoranyatarasya vā pṛthaggatimātraṃ yutāśrayāśrayitvaṃ vā| vināśastu saṃyogasya samānādhikaraṇādvibhāgādāśrayanāśadapi kvacit yathā tantudva yasaṃyogānantaramekasya tantoravayaveṃ'śau karma jāyate tenāṃśvantarādvibhāgaḥ kriyate vibhāgādārambhakasaṃyoganāśastatastantuvināśastantuvināśāta saṃyoganāśo yatra tantudvayaṃ ciraṃ saṃyuktaṃ sadanutpannakriyaṃ bhavati| kecittu tantvavayavakarmaṇā yadā tantvārambhakasaṃyoganāśaḥ kriyate tadā tantvantare karmacintanāt āśrayanāśavibhāgābhyāṃ yugapadutpannābhyāṃ saṃyogo naśyatītyāhuḥ| taccānupapannaṃ samavāyikāraṇanāśakṣaṇe vibhāgānutpatteḥ samavāyikāraṇasya kāryasamakālasthāyitvaniyamāt| sa cāyaṃ saṃyogo dravyārambhe nirapekṣo, guṇakarmārambhe sāpekṣaḥ, svasamānādhikaraṇātyantābhāvapratiyogī tathaivānubhavāt| śākhāmātrāvacchedenāpi mahati nyagrodhatarau varttamānaḥ kapisaṃyogaḥ"nyagrodhatarau kapisaṃyoga" ityanubhavāt| avacchedamātreṇānyathāsiddhau paramāṇuvṛttirāpadyeta tathā ca nīpalabhyeta| vibhūtāmapyupādhibheda eva pradeśasta davacchedena varttamānasya saṃyogasyāvyapyavṛttitvaṃ paramāṇuniṣṭasyāpi saṃyogasya digādayo'vacchedakāscintanīyāḥ || 9 || <7-2-10> vibhāge saṃyogotpattiprakārabhatidiśannāha -- etena vibhāgo vyākhyātaḥ || 10 || saṃyogavadvibhāgo'pyanyatarakarmaja ubhayakarmajo vibhāgajaśca| śyenakarmaṇā sthāṇuśyenāvabhāgaḥ, saṃyuktayormallayormeṣayorvā karmabhyāṃ tadubhayavibhāgaḥ| sa cāyaṃ karmotpattyavyavahitakṣaṇotpattikaḥ apekṣaṇīyāntarābhāvāt| taduktaṃ -- "saṃyogavibhāgayoranapekṣakāraṇaṃ karma" iti| cenna svotpattyantarotpattikabhāvabhūtānapekṣatvasya karmaṇo nirapekṣatvāt| vibhāgajastu vibhāgo dvividhaḥ kāraṇamātravibhāgajakāraṇākāraṇavibhāgabhedāt kāraṇākāraṇavibhāgajakāryākāryavibhāgabhedācca| tatra kāraṇamātravibhāgāt kāraṇākāraṇavibhāgo yathākapāladvayavibhāgāt kapālākāśavibhāgaḥ| kāraṇākāraṇavibhāgācca kāryākāryavibhāgo yathā'ṅgulītaruvibhāgāddhastataruvibhāgastataḥ śarīrataruvibhāga iti| nanu vibhāga eva na pramāṇaṃ saṃyogābhāva eva vibhāgavyavahārāditi cenna saṃyogābhāvo'tyantābhāvaścet guṇakarmaṇorapi vibhāgavyavahāraprasaṅgāt| dravyayorvarttamānaḥ saṃyogātyantābhāvo vibhaktapratyayaheturiti cennāvayavāvayavinorapi prasaṅgāt| akāryakāraṇabhūtayordravyayoriti cet vindhyahimavatorapisyāt| bhavatyeva tatreti cenna bhrāntasya guṇakarmaṇorapi bhāvāt abhrāntamadhikṛtya vyavahārasya cintyamānatvāt| saṃyogavināśo vibāga iti cet ekatarasaṃyogināśena naṣṭe saṃyoge tadvyahāraprasaṅgāt| saṃyoginorvidyamānayoriti cet ekasaṃyoganāśānantaraṃ punaḥ saṃyuktayoḥ kuvalāmalakayoḥ saṃyogadaśāyāmapi vibhaktapratyayaprasaṅgāt tatrayāvadarthābhāvāt| tasmādasti vibhāgo'rthāntaram| sa ca guṇaḥ virodhiguṇāntaranāśyaḥ' virodhinaṃ samānādhikaraṇaṃ guṇamantareṇa satyāśraye guṇanāśānupapatteḥ| kamava saṃyoganāśakaṃ syāditi cenna virodhinoguṇasya guṇanāśakatvāt| kiñca yatrāṅgulīhastabhujaśarīrāṇāṃ svasvakarmaṇā tarusaṃyogastatrāṅgulīmātre samutpannena karmaṇā'ṅgulītarusaṃyoganāśasambhave'pi hastatarubhujataruśarīratarusaṃyogānāmanāśaprasaṅgāt hastādīnāmakriyatvāt aṅgulīkarmaṇaśca vyadhikaraṇatvāt| vyadhikaraṇasyāpi karmaṇaḥ saṃyoganāśakatve kvacidapyutpannena karmaṇā yugapadeva sarvasaṃyoganāśāpatteḥ| tvanmate tatra kā gatiriti cet aṅgulītaruvi bhāgena hastataruvibhāgo janito haratatarusaṃyoganāśaka ityabhyupagamāt| `vyadhikaraṇenāṅgulīkarmaṇaiva hastatarusaṃyoganāśo'stu, na cātiprasaṅgaḥ āśrayāśritaparamparāsaṃyogasyaiva vyadhikaraṇakarmanāśyatvābhyupagamāditi' sarvajñena yaduktam, tadapi na yuktaṃ virodhinaḥsamādhikaraṇasyaiva sarvatra nāśakatvānubhavātbādhakamantareṇa tatparityāgānupapatteḥ| śabdavibhāgau ca vibhāgakāryau, tatra vibhāgasya śabdāsamavāyikāraṇatvaṃ mṛṣyāmahe, na hi vaṃśe pāṭhyamāne dale ca caraṇayantraṇāvaṣṭavye dalāntarecoparikṛṣyamāṇe yaḥ śabdo jāyate tatra dalākāśavibhāgādanaydasamavāyikāraṇaṃ paśyāmaḥ| na ca davadahanadahyamānasphuṭadveṇucītkāro vibhāgātiriktamasamavāyikāraṇaṃ paśyāmaḥ| kāraṇākāraṇavibhāgācca kāryākāryavibhāgamanumanyāmahe kathamanyathā svasvakarmajanitāṅgulotaruvibhāge sati aṅgulītarusaṃyogānāśe satyapi hastatarusaṃyogādīnāṃ nāśaḥ, tatra hi vibhāgajavibhāgaparamparaiva tattatsaṃyoganāśiketyuktatvāt| kāraṇadvayavibhāgapūrvake tu kāraṇākāraṇavibhāge na saṃpratyaya yato vaṃśadale yadutpannaṃ karma tena dalāntaravibhāgavadākāśādivibāgasyāpi jananasambhavāt yāvadbhiḥ saṃyuktamāsīt tāvadbhastatkarmaṇā vibhāgasya darśanāt, na hyaṅgulyāmutpannena karmaṇā'ṅgulyantaravibhāgavadākāśādideśebhyo'pi vibhāgā na janyante kamaladale cotpannena karmaṇā dalāntaravibāgavadākāśādideśebhyo vā na vibhāgā ārabhyante| dravyārambhakasaṃyogāvirodhinaḥ śatamapi vibhāgānekaṃ karmārabhatāṃ tattu karma dravyārambhakasaṃyogavirodhinaṃ vibhāgabhāramate na tat dravyārambhakasaṃyogāvirodhinamapi yacca dravyārambhakasaṃyogāvirodhinaṃ na tad dravyārambhakasaṃyogavirodhinamiti brūmaḥ| kuta etaditi cet kāryayvaicitryeṇa kāraṇavaicitryasyāvaśyakatvāt| nanu karmaṇi vaicitryamāvaśyakaṃ tathācaikaṃ karma dravyārambhakasayogavirodhinaṃ vibhāgaṃ janayatu yathā vikasatkamalakuḍmalādāvaparañca dravyārambhakasaṃyogavirodhinamavirodhinañcobhayamiti| maivam, kāryyavirodho hi kāraṇavaicitryakalpanāmūlaṃ sa ca virodhaḥ ekasya dravyārambhakasaṃyogapratidvandvitvena, aparasya tu tadapratidvandvitveneti tathaiva vaicitryasyāpi kalpanaucityāt| taccedaṃ vaṃśadale vartamānaṃ karma daladvayavibhāgamātraṃ janayati, sa ca vibhāgo'gre ākāśādideśādvibāgaṃ dravyārambhakasaṃyogāpratidvandvinaṃ vibhāgamārabhate, tasya ca nirapekṣasya vibhāgajanane karmatvāpattiriti dravyanāśaviśiṣṭaṃ kālamapekṣate| nanu tadānīmapi karmaiva tajjanayatu atītakālatvāt vibhāgajanane karmaṇaḥ svotpattyanantara eva kālaḥ| nanveva vibhāgana janite vibhāgāntare karma pradeśāntarasaṃyogamapi na janayet, na saṃyogajananaṃ prati karmaṇo'natītakālatvāt anyathā karma na naśyedeva tasyottarasaṃyogamātranāśyatvāt| so'yaṃ vibhāga uttarasaṃyoganāśyaḥ kṣaṇatrayasthāyo| kvacidāśrayanāśanaśyaḥ, tad yathātantoravayave'śau karma tadanantarasaṃśudvayavibhāgastadaiva tantvantare karma tatoṃ'śudvayavibhāgena tantvārambhakasaṃyoganāśastantukarmaṇā ca vibhāgastato dravyārambhakasaṃyoganāśāttantunāśastannāśācca tantvantarakarmajanyavibhāganāśaḥ| nanvevaṃ tantvantarotpannasya karmaṇo na nāśaḥ syādvināśakābhāvāt uttarasaṃyogena hi kālamapekṣate| nanu tadānīmapi karmava tajjanayatu, atītakālatvāt vibhāgajanane tannāśyeta, vibhāge ca naṣṭe nottarasaṃyoga iti cenna tantau yat karmotpannaṃ tena yathā vinaśyadavasyatantorvibhāgo janitastathā tadaṃśorapi vibhāgo jananīyaḥ so'pyārambhakasaṃyogavirodhyeva tenāṃśutantuvibhāgena tantvākāśavibhāgastena cottarasayogastenatataḥ karmanāśaḥ| yadvā yatra tantau yadā karma tadaṃśāvapi tadaiva karma tacca karma vinaśyadavamyatantutadavayavākāśādideśādyugapadeva vibhāgānārabhate sarveṣāṃ vibhāgānāmārambhakasaṃyogāvirodhitvāt, tathā ca kāraṇamaṃśurakāraṇañcā kāśādi tadvibhāgāt kāryasya tantorakāryeṇākāśādinā yo vibhāga utpannastada nantarotpattikena saṃyogena tantusamavetasya karmaṇo vināśa iti| kvacidvābhyāṃ, tadu yathātantuvīraṇayoḥ saṃyoge sati tantvavayave'śau karmavīraṇe ca karmetyekaḥ kālaḥ, aṃśukarmaṇā'śvantaravibhāgastena ca saṃyogasya tantvārambhakasya vināśaḥ vīraṇakarmaṇā ca tantuvīraṇavibhāgastuntuvīraṇasaṃyoganāśaśca tantvārambhakasaṃyoganāśaśca tantvārambhakasaṃyoganāśānantaraṃ tantunāśastantuvīraṇasaṃyoganāśānantaraṃ vīraṇasya pradeśāntarasaṃyogastābhyāmāśrayayanāśasaṃyogābhyā vibhāganāśaḥ || 10 || <7-2-11> nanu saṃyoge'pi saṃyogo'stuvibhāge'pi vibhāga iti prasaṅganivāraṇārthamāha -- sayogavibhāgayoḥ saṃyogavibhāgābhāvo'ṇutvamahattvābhyāṃ vyākhyātaḥ || 11 || yathā'ṇutvamahattve nāṇutvamahattvavatī tathā saṃyogavibhāgau na saṃyogavibhāgavantau || 11 || <7-2-12> karmabhiḥ karmāṇi guṇairgaṇā aṇutvamahattvābhyāmiti || 12 || dvitīyañca sūtraṃ vyākhyātaṃ meva || 12 || <7-2-13> nanu dravyayoravayavāvayavinoḥ saṃyogaḥ kathaṃ netyata āha -- yutasiddhyabhāvāt kāryakāraṇayoḥ saṃyogavibhāgau na vidyete| asambandhorvidyamānatvaṃ yutasiddhiḥ pṛthagāśrayāśritatvaṃ vā tadabhāvastvavayavāvayavinorityarthaḥ || 13 || <7-2-14> idānīṃ prasaṅgācchabdārthayoḥ sāṅketikaṃ sambandhaṃ sādhayituṃ prakaraṇāntaram, tatra pūrvapakṣamāha -- guṇatvāt || 14 || saṃyosyeti śeṣaḥ| tathāca guṇasya śabdasya guṇaḥ saṃyogaḥ kathaṃ syāt arthena ghaṭādinetyarthaḥ || 14 || <7-2-15> kiñca viṣayo'pi kvacidruparasādilakṣaṇastena saṃyogo na sambhavati guṇe guṇānaṅgīkārādityāha -- guṇo'pi vibhāvyate || 15 || guṇo'pi viṣaya iti śeṣaḥ| guṇo'pi rūpādiḥ śabdasya viṣayo na tu tena samaṃ saṃyogaḥ sambandha ityarthaḥ| yadvā guṇo'pi śabdena vibhāvyate pratipādyate tena ca śabdasya na saṃyogaḥ sambandha ityarthaḥ || 15 | <7-2-16> kiñca kasyacidākāśāderdravyasya nānyatarakarmajaḥ saṃyogo nobhayakarmajaḥ śabdasyāpi niṣkriyatvādityāha -- niṣkriyatvāt || 16 || śabdasya kasyacidarthasya ceti śeṣaḥ || 16 || <7-2-17> sambandhe bādhakāntaramāha -- asati nāstīti ca prayogāt || 17 || asatyapi ghaṭapaṭādau -- nāsti gehe ghaṭaḥ, nāsti paṭaḥ, śratapūrvogakāro nāsti, abhūt paṭaḥ, paṭo bhaviṣyatītyādiprayogadaśaṃnādityarthaḥ| tathācāsatā ghaṭādinā śabdasya na saṃyogo na vā samavāya iti bhāvaḥ || 17 || <7-2-18> kiñcāta ityata āha -- śabdārthāvamambandhau || 18 || śabdārthayoḥ saṃyogaścennāsti tadetadāyātaṃ śabdārthāvasambandhāvevetyarthaḥ| <7-2-19> nanu saṃyogasamavāyayoranyatarasambandhaḥ kathaṃ na syādityata āha -- rsayogino daṇḍāt samavāyino viśeṣācca || 19 || daṇḍī puruṣaḥ -- hastī kuñjara -- iti pratyayau staḥ, tatra prathamaḥ saṃyogāt, dvitīyaḥ samavāyāt haste'vayavaviśeṣe kuñjarasya samavāyādhīnaḥ pratyayaḥ| hantaḥ samavāyitayā yasyāsti sa hastīti| viśeṣāditi| viśeṣa eva hastādau samavāyasambandhādviśeṣaṇatvaṃ na tu tantvādīnāmapi tantumān paṭa ityādiravayavaviśeṣaṇabāvena pratyayo bhavati, evaṃ ghaṭaśabdavān ghaṭo'rtha iti pratyayo na bhavati, tathāca śabdārthayorna saṃyogo nāpi samavāya iti bhāvaḥ || 19 || <7-2-20> nanu yadi na saṃyogo na vā samavāyaḥ śabdārthayostarhi kena sambandhena śabdo niyatamarthaṃ pratipādayatītyata āha -- sāmayikaḥ śabdādarthapratyayaḥ || 20 || sāmayika iti| samaya īśvarasaṅketaḥ -- asmācchabdādayamartho boddhavya ityākāraḥ, yaḥ śabdo yasminnarthe bhagavatā saṅketitaḥ sa tamarthaṃ pratipādayati, tathā ca śabdārthayorīśvarecchaiva sambandhaḥ sa eva samayastadadhīna ityarthaḥ| yathā nakuladaṃṣaṭrāgratpṛṣṭā yā kācidoṣadhiḥ sā sarvā'pi sarpaviṣaṃ hanti| sa ca samayaḥ kvacivdyavahārād gṛhyate, yathāprayojakena ghaṭa mānayetyukte prayojyasya kambugrīvāvantamarthamānayato jñānaṃ tāvada numinoti taṭastho bālaḥ -- iyamasya pravṛttirjñānajanyā pravṛttitvāt matpravṛttivat| tacca jhānameta dvākyajanyametadanantarabhāvitvāt, etajajñānaviṣayo'yaṃ kambugrīvāvānartho ghaṭapadavācya ityāvāpodvāpaprakriyayā bālasya ghaṭapaṭādāvarthe vyutpattiḥ| kvacicca sākṣādāptavākyādeva yathā'yaṃ kambugrīvāvānartho ghaṭapadavācya iti| kvacidupamānāt, yathāgosadṛśo gavayaḥ, yathā mud‌gastathā mud‌gaparṇī, yathā māṣastathā māṣaparṇītyādi sādharmyopamānāt| kvacinnindākārādapi vākyāt, yathādhik karabhamatilambauṣṭhaṃ dīrghagrīvaṃ kaṭhorakaṇṭakāśinamapasadaṃ paśūnāmiti nindāvākyaśravaṇānantaraṃ tādṛśapiṇḍamupalabhyāyamasau karabha iti vyutpattiḥ| kvacit prasiddhapadasāmānādhikaraṇyāt, yathāprabhinnakamalodare madhūni madhukaraḥ pibatīti vākyaśravaṇānantaraṃ bhavatyayamasau madhukarapadavācyaḥ prabhinnakamalodare madhupānakartṛtvāt, yathā vā sahakāratarau madhuraṃ piko rautīti| tadetadanumānaṃ vā śabda eva vā prasiddhapadasāmānādhikaraṇyasāmarthyādvyutpādakaḥ, upamānaviśeṣa eva vā, madhupānakartṛtvasya bhramarādivyaktyantarasādharmyasyopanayāt| samayaśac jātimātre, vyokterākṣepata evopasthiteriti tautātikāḥ| jātau vyaktau cobhaya(tra) śaktiḥ kintu jātyaṃśe jñātā vyaktyaṃśe svarūpasatī prayojiketi prābhākarāḥ| samayaḥ śaktireva `vyaktyākṛtijātayaḥ padārthaḥ iti' vṛddhāḥ. gavādipadānāmiyaṃ gatiḥ, guṇakarmādivācakaṇdānāntu jātivyaktī evārtha iti mayūkhe vipañcitam || 20 || <7-2-21> idānīmuddeśakramaprāpte paratvāparatve parasparānubaddhavyavahārakāraṇatayā śiṣyabuddhivaiśadyārtha saṃkṣepārthañcaikagranthenāha -- ekadikkābhyāmekakālābhyāṃ sannikṛṣṭaviprakṛṣṭābhyāṃ paramaparañca || 21 || paramaparañceti bhāvapradhāno nirdeśaḥ| utpadyata iti śeṣaḥ| yadvā paramaparañceti vyavahāra iti śeṣaḥ| itiradhyāhāryyam| ekā dig yayostāvekadikkau, tābhyāmekadikkāmyāṃ piṇḍābhyāmityarthaḥ| tulyadeśāvapyekadikkau bhavataḥ na tu tābhyāṃ paratvāparatve utpadyete vyavahliyete vetyata uktaṃ sannikṛṣṭaviprakṛṣṭābhyāmiti| sannikarṣaḥ saṃyuktasaṃyogālpatvam, viprakarṣastad‌bhūyastvam, tadvadbhyāmityarthaḥ| etena samavāyikāraṇamuktam| dik‌piṇḍasaṃyogastvasamavāyikāraṇam, tathā hi prāṅ‌mukhasya puruṣasya prācyavasthitayoḥ piṇḍayorekasmin saṃyuktasaṃyogabhuyastvamaparasmina saṃyuktasaṃyogālpataratvañcāpekṣya paratvamaparātvañcotpadyate, (asamavāyikāraṇamuktama)| sannikṛṣṭaviprakṛṣṭābhyāmiti,-viṣayeṇa viṣayiṇaṃ pratyayamupalakṣayati| tathā cāpekṣābuddhernimittakāraṇatvamuktam| ekadigavasthitayoreva paratvāparatve utpadyete iti na sarvatrotpattiḥ| ekasyaiva draṣṭurapekṣābuddhiḥ samutpadyate iti na sarvathotpattiḥ| apekṣābuddhiniyamānna sarvadotpattiḥ| kāraṇaśakterutpannayoḥ pratyakṣasiddhatvānna parasparāśrayatvam, anyathā hi notpadyeyātāṃ na vā pratīyeyātāṃ, parasparāpekṣāyāṃ hi dvayoranutpattirapratītiśca syāt, pratīyete ca paratvāparatve, pratītiśca tayornotpattimantareṇeti| ekakālābhyāmiti,-kālikaparatvāparatve abhipretya| tatraikakālābhyāmiti, eko varttamānaḥ kālo yayoryuvasthavirapiṇḍayoḥ tāvekakālau tābhyāmekakālābhyāmityarthaḥ| sannikarṣo'lpataratapanaparispandāntaritajanmatvam| atrāpi vipayeṇa viṣayiṇīṃ buddhimupalakṣayati, tena yuvasthavirapiṇḍau samavāyikāraṇe, kālapiṇḍasaṃyogaścāsamavāyikāraṇam, alpataratapanaparispandāntaritajanmatvabuddhiraparatve bahutaratapanaparispandāntaritajanmatvabuddhiḥ paratve nimittakāraṇam| ete ca paratvāparatve aniyatadigdeśayorapi piṇḍayorutpadyete| tatra daiśikaparatvāparatvayoḥ saptadhā vināśaḥ| utpādastu yugapadeva dvayoranyathā'nyonyāśrayaḥ syāt| apekṣābuddhināśāt, saṃyogasyāsamavāyikāraṇasya nāśāt, dravyasya ca samavāyikāraṇasya nāśāt, nimittāsamavāyikāraṇayornāśāt, nimittasamavāyikāraṇayornāśāt, samavāyyasamavāyikāraṇayornāśāt, nimittanāśāsamavāyikāraṇanāśasamavāyikāraṇanāśebhyaḥ | tatrāpekṣābuddhināśāt tāvat paratvotpattiḥ paratvasāmānyajñānaṃ tato'pekṣābuddhivināśastadvināśāt paratvaviśiṣṭadravyajñānakāle paratvanāśaḥ, dvitvanāśavadeva sarvamūhanīyam| upamavāyikāraṇanāśādapi, tad yathāyadaivāpekṣābuddhistadaiva paratvādhāre piṇḍe karma| tato yadaiva paratvotpattistadaiva dik‌piṇḍavibhāgastato yadā paratvasāmānyajñānaṃ tadā dik‌piṇḍasaṃyoganāśaḥ| tataḥ sāmānyajñānādapekṣābuddhināśastadaiva dik‌piṇḍasaṃyoganāśāt paratvāparatvayornāśaḥ| tatra cāpekṣābuddhināśasya paratvanāśasamakālatvānna tannāśakatvam| nanvasamavāyikāraṇānāśādapi guṇanāśe ātmamanaḥsaṃyoganāśādapi saṃskārādṛṣṭādīnāṃ vināśe bahu vyākulaṃ syāditi cenna, viprakṛṣṭatvena paratvasya vyāpanāt paratvādhārasyānyatra gamane viprakarṣābhāvāt, paratvanivṛttirāvaśyakī| na ca tadā nāśakāntaramastītyanyathā'nupapattyā saṃyoganāśa eva nāśakaḥ kalpyate, saṃskārādṛṣṭādeḥ kāryyasya smṛtisukhādeścireṇāpi darśanānna tannāśakalpanā| upalakṣaṇañcaitat avadherdraṣṭuśca taddeśasaṃyoganāśādapi paratvāparatve vinaśyataḥ, yuktestulyatvāt| samavāyikāraṇanāśādapi kvacit paratvanāśaḥ| tathāhi -- yadā piṇḍāvayave samutpannena karmaṇā'vayavāntarādvibhāgastadaivāpekṣābuddhiḥ, vibhāgāt piṇḍārambhakasaṃyoganāśaḥ paratvotpattiḥ, agrimakṣaṇe saṃyoganāśād dravyanāśaḥ paratvasāmānyajñānaṃ, dravyanāśāt paratvanāśo'pekṣābuddhināśaśca sāmānyajñānāt| tathā ca yaugapadyānnāpekṣābuddhināśāt paratvanāśa iti| kvacid dravyanāśāpekṣābuddhināśābhyāṃ paratvanāśaḥ| tadyathā -- piṇḍāvayave karmāpekṣābuddherutpādastato'vayavāntaravibhāgaḥ paratvotpattiśca, tata ārambhakasaṃyoganāśasāmānyajñāne tato dravyanāśāpekṣābuddhināśau tataśca tapatvanāśaḥ| kvacid dravyasya saṃyogasya ca nāśābhyāṃ paratvanāśaḥ, tad yathā yadā dravyāvayavavibhāgastadaiva piṇḍakarmāpekṣābuddhyorutpādastadanantaramavayavasaṃyoganāśadik‌piṇḍavibhāgaparatvotpattayaḥ| tato dravyānāśadik‌piṇḍasaṃyoganāśaparatvasāmānyabuddhayaḥ| tato dravyanāśadik‌piṇḍasaṃyoganāśābhyāṃ paratvanāśaḥ sāmānyabuddherapekṣabuddhināśa iti| kvacit saṃyoganāśāpekṣābuddhināśābhyāṃ paratvanāśaḥ, tadyathā -- paratvotpattipiṇḍakarmaṇī sāmānyajñānavibhāgau apekṣābuddhināśadik‌piṇḍasaṃyoganāśau tataḥ paratvanāśaḥ| kvacid samavāyyasamavāyinimittanāśebhyaḥ| tadyathā -- paratvotpattipiṇḍāvayavavibhāgapiṇḍakarmāṇi yugapat, tadanantaraṃ paratvasāmānyajñānāvayavasaṃyoganāśadik‌piṇḍavibhāgā tadanantaramapekṣābuddhināśadravyanāśadik‌piṇḍasaṃyoganāśebhyo yugapadutpannebhyaḥ paratvasyāparatvasya vā daiśikasya nāśaḥ| kālakṛtayostu paratvāparatvayorasamavāyikāraṇanāśādīno nāśo nāsti, daiśikayordik‌rpiṇḍasaṃyoganāśe sannikarṣaviprakarṣanāśo yathā na tathā kālikayoriti, tayoḥ samavāyikāraṇanāśādapekṣābuddhināśāt dvābhyāñceti trayaḥ pakṣāḥ pūrvavadūhanīyāḥ || 21 || <7-2-22> kālikaparatvāparatve prati viśeṣamāha -- kāraṇaparatvāt kāraṇāparatvācca || 22 || paratvāparatvayoḥ kāraṇaṃ kālastasya paratvāparatve paratvāsamavāyikāraṇakālasaṃyogo'paratvāsamavāyikāraṇakālasaṃyogaśca lakṣaṇayoktaḥ anyathā'nanvayāpatteḥ, na hi paratvāparatvābhyāmeva paratvāparatve utpadyete| tasmāt paratvāparatvapadayostadutpādakakālasaṃyogāvarthau lakṣaṇayā || 22 || <7-2-23-25> nanu paratve'pi paratvamaparatve'pyaparatvaṃ kiṃ na syādityata āha -- paratvāparatvayoḥ paratvāparatvābhāvo'ṇutvamahattvābhyāṃ vyākhyātaḥ || 23 || karmabhiḥ karmāṇi || 24 || gaṇairguṇāḥ || 25 || etāni sūtrāṇi pūrvameva vyākṛtakalpāni neha vyākriyante || 23-25 || <7-2-26> paratvāparatvādīnāṃ mūrttamātrasamavetatvamuktaṃ jñānamukhādīnāñcātmasamavetatvam| tatra samavāya eva ka iti śiṣyajijñāsāmanurudhya buddheruddheśakramaprāptāyā api laṅghanāt samavāyaparīkṣāmāha -- ihedamiti yataḥ kāryakāraṇayoḥ sa samavāyaḥ || 26 || kāryakāraṇayorityupalakṣaṇam, akāryakāraṇayorityapi draṣṭavyam| taduktaṃ padārthapdeśākhye prakaraṇe -- "ayutasiddhānāmādhāryyādhārabhūtānāṃ yaḥ sambandha ihetipratyayahetuḥ sa samavāyaḥ" iti| asambaddhayoravidyamānatvamayutamiddhiḥ, iha kuṇḍe dadhi iha kuṇḍe badarāṇītivat iha tantuṣu paṭa iha vīraṇepu kaṭa iha dravye guṇakarmāṇi iha gavi gotvam ihā''tmani jñānam ihā''kāśe śabda itīhabuddhirutpadyamānā na vinā sambandhamutpattumarhati tenānumīyate'sti kaścit sambandhaḥ| na cāsau saṃyoga eva, anyatarakarmādīnāṃ tadutpādakānāmabhāvāt vibhāgaparyyavasānābhāvācca sambandhināmayutasiddhatvācca niyatādhikaraṇatayaivonneyatvāt apratyakṣatvādekatvānnityatvācca| nanvekaścet samavāyastadā dravyatvādīnāṃ saṅkaraprasaṅgaḥ, karmatvādisamavāyasya dravye sasbhavāt| maivam, ādhārādheyaniyamādevāsaṅkarāt| yadyapi ya eva dravyatvasamavāyaḥ sa eva guṇatvakarmatvādīnāmapi, tathāpi caiṣāṃ na dravyamādhārastatra teṣāmapratīteḥ dravyeṣveva dravyatvaṃ pratīyate guṇeṣveva guṇatvaṃ karmasveva karmatvaṃ natvanyatretyanvayavyatirekadarśanādeva niyamaḥ, yathā kuṇḍadadhnoḥ saṃyogaviśeṣe'pi kuṇḍamevādhāro na dadhītyāśrayāśrayibhāvaniyamastathā vyaṅgyavyañjakaśaktibhedādevātrāpi niyama upapatsyate, na hi dravyeṇa dravyatvavat karmatvādyapyabhivyajyate| taduktam -- "saṃvideva hi bhagavatī vastūpagame naḥ śaraṇam" iti| na hyādhāratvaṃ prati viparītā saṃvidasti, na hi bhavati dravyaṃ karmeti, na vā bhavati paṭe tantava iti| etena vāyau rūpasamavāye'pi vāyau rūpamityādhāratā na vāyoḥ pratīyate| tasmāt svabhāvaśaktireva sarvatra niyāmikā| sa cāyaṃ nitya akāraṇakatvāt| bhāvānāṃ hi samavāyikāraṇādutpattiniyamaḥ, tadanurudve ca nimittāsamavāyinī, tathāca samavāyasya samavāyikāraṇaṃ yat syāt tat samavāyāntareṇa tenaiva samavāyena vā? na tāvadādyaḥ, anavasthāpātāt| na dvitīyaḥ, na hi sa eva samavāyaḥ svenaiva samavetaḥ sambhavatītyātmāśrayāt| tantuṣu paṭasamavāyaḥ paṭe rūpasamavāya iti pratītiḥ kathamiti cet svarūpasambandhena, samavāyāntarāṅgīkāre'navasthāpātāt| tarhīha paṭarūpamityapīhapratyaḥ svarūpasambandhenaiva syāt kiṃ samavāyeneti cenna, tatrātiriktasambandhe bādhakābhāvāt| tarhīha bhūtale ghaṭābhāva ityatrāpi samavāyaḥ sambandhāntaraṃ vā syāditi cenna, svarūpasambandhenaiva tadupapatteḥ, anyathā ghaṭātyantābhāvānyonyābhāvayornityayoranekasamavetayoḥ sāmānyatvāpatteḥ| pradhvaṃsasya ca samavetakāryyatvena vināśitvāpatteḥ, prāgabhāvasya ca samavetānutpannattvenāvināśitvāpatteśca| na ca bhāvatvaṃ tatra tantram, bhāvatvasyāpādyatvāt| abhāve'styeva vaiśiṣṭyākhyaṃ sambandhāntaramiti bhāṭṭāḥ| tatra yadi sarvābhāvavyaktīnāmekameva vaiśiṣṭyāṃ tadā ghaṭavatvapi ghaṭābhāvapratyaprasaṅgaḥ paṭābhāvavaiśiṣṭyenaiva ghaṭābhāvavaiśiṣṭyasattvāt| ghaṭa eva tatra ghaṭābhāvadhīpratibandhaka iti cet vaiśiṣṭyasambandhena pratibandhakābhāvasyaiva tatra sattvāt| na cāśrayasvabāva eva tādṛśo yena na tatra ghaṭābhāvābhivyaktiḥ, ghaṭāpasāraṇānantaraṃ tatraiva ghaṭābhāvapratīteḥ| tavāpi rūpanāśānantaraṃ kathaṃ na rūpavattāpratyayaḥ samavāyasya nityatvādekatvācceti cet, rūpanāśādeva tadapratīterupapatteḥ| samavāyapratibindhiḥ (ndī?)pratyakṣamayūkhe mocita evetyāstām || 26 || <7-2-27> dravyādibhyaḥ pañcabhyo bhedaṃ sādhayannāha -- dravyatvaguṇatvapratiṣedho bhāvena vyākhyātaḥ || 27 || bhāvaḥ sattā| yathā sattā na dravyādyātmikā vilakṣaṇabuddhivedyatvāt vathā samavāyo'pi tata eva dravyādibhyo bhinnaḥ| dravyatvaguṇatvetyupalakṣaṇaṃ karmatvādyapi draṣṭavyam || 27 || <7-2-28> ekatvaṃ sādhayati -- tattvabhāvena || 28 || vyākhyātamiti śeṣaḥ| tattvamekatvaṃ bhāvena sattayā vyākhyātam| yathaikā sattā sarvava sad‌buddhipravartikā tathaika eva samavāyaḥ sarvatra samavetabuddhipravartakaḥ svaliṅgāviśeṣādviśeṣaliṅgābhāvācca, na hi samavāyasya viśeṣaliṅgaṃ bhedakaṃ liṅgamākalayāmo yena nānātvamabhyupagacchāmaḥ| ata eva nityaḥ deśakālādibede'pyabhinnasya sattāvadevānityatvāyogāt| nanu samavāyo yadyayaṃ sambandha eva tadā tantupaṭayoḥ paṭarūpayorvā viśleṣaḥ syāditi, cenna, yutasiddhyabhāvādviśleṣānupapatteḥ, na hi rūparūpavatoravayavāvayavinorvā'sambaddhayorvidyamānatvamasti yena viśleṣaḥ syāt| yutasiddhirevāpādyata iti cenna, kadācidapi tathā'nanubhavenāpādyabādhāt| samavāyo nānā'nityaśceti prābhākarāḥ| taccānupapannam, rūpaṃ naṣṭamiti hi pratyayo na tu rūpasamavāyo naṣṭa iti kasyāpi pratyayaḥ| pratyakṣaḥ samavāya iti naiyāyikāḥ| tadapyanupapannam, samavāyo'tīndriyaḥ ātmānyatve satyasamavetabhāvatvāt manovat, kālādivadvā || 28 || iti śrīśāṅkare vaiśeṣikasūtropaskāre saptamādhyāyasya dvitīyāhnikam| samāptaścāyaṃ saptamādhyāyaḥ| <8> <8-1-1> śiṣyajijñāsānurodhāt kramalaṅghanam, idānīmud‌deśakramamālambate| tatra buddhiparīkṣā aṣṭamādhyāyārthaḥ| ātmasādhanāya pūrvaṃ buddhiruktā, tāṃ smārayannāha -- dravyeṣu jñānaṃ vyākhyātam || 1 || dravyeṣviti, viṣayeṇa viṣayiṇaṃ tṛtīyādhyāyamupalakṣayati| "indriyārthaprasiddhirindriyārthebhyo'rthāntarasya hetuḥ" "ātmendriyārthasannikarṣādyanniṣpadyate tadanyat" ityetābhyāṃ sūtrābhyāṃ jñānaṃ vyākhyātamityarthaḥ| tatra "buddhirupalabdhirjñānaṃ pratyaya iti paryyāyāḥ" iti samānatantre buddhilakṣaṇe sāṅkhyamatanirāsārthaṃ paryyāyābhidhānam| sāṅkhyā hi buddhyādiśabdānāmarthabhedamāttakṣate| tathāhi -- "sattvarajastamasāṃ sāmyāvasthā prakṛtiḥ, sā caikaiva, puruṣāstu paraṃ bhidyante, te ca kṛṭasthā nityā apariṇāmino nityacaitanyasvabhāvāḥ| te ca paṅgavo'pariṇāmitvāt, prakṛtistvandā jaḍatvāt| yadā vipayabhogecchā prakṛtipuruṣabhedadidṛkṣā ca prakṛterbhavati tadā sā puruṣoparāgavaśāt pariṇamate| tasyāścādyaḥ pariṇāmo buddhirantaḥkaraṇaviśeṣaḥ| buddhireva mahattvaṃ taduktam -- "prakṛterbhahān" iti| sā ca buddhirdapaṇavannirmalā, tasyāśca bahirindriyapraṇāḍikayā viṣayākāro yaḥ pariṇatibhedo ghaṭa iti paṭa ityādyākārastajjñanaṃ vṛttiriti cākhyāyate, svacchāyāṃ buddhau varttamānena jñānena caitanyasya puruṣasya bhedāgrahādahaṃ jānāmīti yo'bhimānaviśeṣaḥ saivopalabdhiḥ| srakcandanādiviṣayasannikarṣādindriyapraṇāḍikayaiva sukhaduḥkhādyākāro buddhereva yaḥ pariṇāmaviśeṣaḥ sa pratyayaḥ| ataeva jñānasukhaduḥkhecchādvepaprayatnasaṃskāradharmādharmāḥ sarva eva buddheḥ pariṇāmaviśeṣāḥ sūkṣmamātrayā prakṛtāveva varttamānā avasthābhedādāvirbhavanti tirobhavanti ca| puruṣastu puṣkalapalāśavannirleṣaḥ pratibimbate paraṃ buddhāviti" -- yanmanyante tadanena paryyāyābedhānasūcitapramāṇena nirākriyate| tathāhi -- buddhiśabdo yadi buddhyate'nayeti karaṇavyutpannastadā mana eva tatparyyavasyati| na ca manaḥ pratyakṣam, buddhistvahaṃ buddhye iti pratyakṣavedyaiva| na cāntaḥkaraṇasya jñānādayo dharmāḥ, kartṛdharmatvenaiva teṣāṃ siddheḥ, bhavati hi ahaṃ jāne ahaṃ pratyemi ahamupalabhe ityahantvasāmānādhikaraṇyena pratibhāsaḥ| abhimāno'sāviti cet tāttvikatve bādhakābhāvāt| puruṣasyāgantukadharmānādhāratvaṃ kūṭasthatvaṃ tadeva bādhakamiti cenna, āgantukadharmādhāratve'pi nityatvasambhavāt, na hi dharmī dharmaścetyekaṃ tattvaṃ yena dharmotpādavināśāveva dharmyutpādavināśau syātām| tathāca ya eva cetayate sa eva buddhyate jānātyupalabhate pratyeti ceti nārthāntarakalpanā yukteti dik || 1 || <8-1-2> tacca jñānaṃ dvividhaṃ -- vidyā cāvidyā ca| vidyā caturvidhā pratyakṣalaiṅgikasmṛtyārṣalakṣaṇā| avidyā'pi caturvidhā saṃśayaviparyyayasvapnānadhyavasāyalakṣaṇā| tatra yallaiṅgikaṃ tadanindriyajam, kuta etadityāha -- tatrātmā manaścāpratyakṣe || 2 || ātmā'tra paramātmā svātmā vā, svātmani mānasasya kvācitkāhampratyayasyāhaṃ gauraḥ kṛśo mahābāhurityādipratyayatiraskṛtatvāt svātmano'pyapratyakṣatoktā| cakārādākāśakāladiśāṃ vāyoḥ paramāṇūnāñca dravyāṇāmuṣagrahaḥ| indriyajamapi dvividhaṃ -- sarvajñīyamasarvajñīyañca| sarvajñīyaṃ -- yogajadharmalakṣaṇayā pratyāsattyā tattatpadārthasārthajñānaṃ, tathāhi paramāṇavaḥ, prasaktāḥ prameyatvādabhidheyatvāt sattvāt| sāmagrīvirahāt kathamevaṃ mahattvasyāpi pratyakṣaṃ prati kāraṇatvāt na ca paramāṇavo mahāntaḥ, rūpavattvasyāpi cākṣuṣapratyakṣakāraṇatvāt, na ca digādayo rūpavanta iti cenna, yogajadharmasahakāriṇā manasaiva tatsambhavāt, tadupagrahāccakṣurādinā vā, acintyaprabhāvo hi yogajo dharmo na sahakāryantaramapekṣaro na mīmāṃsābhijñaḥ puruṣatvādahamiva" ityādivadvipakṣabādhakatarkaśūnyatvādaprayojakam| asarvajñīyañca pratyakṣaṃ dvividhaṃ savikalpakaṃ nirvikalpakañca| savikalpakaṃ jñānaṃ na pramāṇamiti kīrttidiṅnāgādayaḥ| tathāhi -- abilāpasaṃsargayogyapratibhāsaṃ hi tat, na hyabhilāpena nāmnā sambhavatyarthasya sambandho yena ghaṭa iti paṭa iti vā nāmānurañjitaḥ pratyayaḥ syāt| na ca sataḥ svalakṣaṇasyāsatā sambandhaḥ sambhavati, na cāsat indriyagocaraḥ, tasmādindriyeṇālocanaṃ janyate ālocanamahimnā ca savikalpakamutpadyamānaṃ tatrārthe pravarttayat pratyakṣamiti cocyate iti| taccaitadanupapannam, abhilāpasaṃsargayogyapratibhāsañca bhavet pramāṇañcendriyārthasannikarṣajanyaṃ syāditi sandigdhavyatirekitvam| nāmavaiśiṣṭyañca cākṣuṣajñāne sambhavatyeva, surabhicandanamitivadupanītabhānasambhavāt| yadvā saṃjñāveśiṣṭyaṃ pratyakṣajñāne na bhāsate saṃjñāyāḥ smaraṇamātram, smṛtaiva sā arthavyāvarttikā, abhāvajñāne pratiyogismaraṇavat| jātyādikañca vastubhūtaṃ sādhitamevātaḥ savikalpakamapīndriyārthasannikarpajatvāt pratyakṣam| nanu nirvikalpakaṃ na vyavahārapravartakaṃ na vā vyavahāraviṣaya iti kintatra pramāṇamiti cet, savikalpakameva| taddhi viśiṣṭajñānam, na ca viśeṣaṇajñānamantareṇa tadutpadyate, viśiṣṭajñāne hi viśeṣaṇajñānaviśeṣyendriyasannikarṣatadubhayāsaṃsargāgrahasya kāraṇatvāvadhāraṇāt || 2 || <8-1-3> yatra yathā jñānaṃ yatkāraṇakañca tadviśadayitumāha -- jñānanirdeśe jñānaniṣpattividhiruktaḥ || 3 || jñānāntarānnirdeṣṭavyaṃ yatprakārakaṃ yadviṣayakaṃ yaddharmakaṃ tatra jñānanirdeśe karttavye jñānasya niṣpattividhirutpattividhirutpattiprakāra uktaḥ -- ucyate ityarthaḥ| ādikarmaṇi ktavidhānāt || 3 || <8-1-4> kīdṛśo niṣpattividhistamāha -- guṇakramasu sannikṛṣṭeṣu jñāniṣpatterdravyaṃ kāraṇam || 4 || guṇeṣu rūpādiṣu karmasu cotkṣepaṇādiṣu yajjñānaṃ niṣpadyate tatra dravyaṃ kāraṇaṃ yogyadravyaniṣṭhameva tadubhayaṃ gṛhyata iti dravyayogyataiva tatra tantram, sannikarṣaśca teṣāṃ dravyaghaṭita eva, saṃyuktasamavāyena teṣāṃ grahaṇāt| yadyapi viṣaktacampakāvayavakarpūrabhāgānāmayogyānāṃ gandho gṛhyate, tathāpi sannikarṣaghaṭakaṃ tatrāyogyamapi dravyameva| yadyapi śabdagrahe dravyayogyatā na tantraṃ, tathāpi tatraiva samavetaḥ śabdo gṛhyata iti tadeva tantram| nanvadṛṣṭasannikarṣakalpanā kutaḥ kriyate iti cenna, jñānaniṣpatteḥ, kāryyeṇa hi kāraṇamavaśyaṃ kalpanīyamiti bhāvaḥ || 4 || <8-1-5> aparaṃ jñānaniṣpattividhimāha -- sāmānyaviśeṣeṣu sāmānyaviśeṣābhāvāttata eva jñānam || 5 || sāmānyaṃ sattā tasya viśeṣā dravyatvaguṇatvakarmatvāni evameteṣāmapi sāmānyānāṃ viśeṣāḥ pṛthivītvādirūpatvādyut‌kṣepaṇatvādīni| tatra dravyagatānāṃ sāmānyānāṃ tata eva yogyāśrayaviśeṣādeva tannibandhanācca sayuktasamavāyāt guṇakarmagatānāmapi sāmānyānāṃ tata eva yogyāśrayādeva tannibandhanācca saṃyuktasamavetasamavāyāt samavetasamavāyācca sārvendriyaṃ jñānam, guṇatve ca saṃyuktasamavetasamavāyāt, śabdatvakatvādau samavetasamavāyāt| sattāyāḥ saṃyuktasamavāyāt saṃyuktasamavetasamavāyāt samavetasamavāyācca sārvendriyaṃ jñānam| guṇatve ca saṃyuktasamavāyaḥ samavāyaśca na pratyāsattiriti| nanu tata eva svāśrayasannikarṣādevetyavadhāraṇānupapattiḥ, yataḥ sāmānye viśeṣeṣu ca pṛthivītvādiṣu sāmānyaviśeṣāntaramastyeva tatsannikarṣo'pi kāraṇamevāta āha -- sāmānyaviśeṣābhāvāditi| na hi sāmānyaviśeṣeṣu sāmānyaviśeṣā vartante, anavasthāprasahgāt| teṣāṃ parasparaṃ bhedapratītiḥ svarūpata eva, gavetarāvṛttitve sati sakalagovṛttitvalakṣaṇopādhisambhedādbā| evaṃ ghaṭatvādāvapīti || 5 || <8-1-6> nanu sāmānyaviśeṣeṣu sāmānyaviśeṣābhāvādyathā tannirapekṣameva jñānaṃ tathā dravyaguṇakarmasvapi kiṃ tannirapekṣameva? netyāha -- sāmānyaviśeṣāpekṣaṃ dravyaguṇakarmasu || 6 || jñānamutpadyate iti prakṛtam| dravyaguṇakarmasu dravtvaguṇatvakarmatvaviśiṣṭabuddhistāvadasti, viśiṣṭajñānañca viśeṣyaviśeṣaṇendriyasannikarṣādutpadyate iti sāmānyaviśeṣāpekṣā tatrāvaśyakī| bhavati hi dravyamidaṃ guṇo'ṃya karmedamiti viśiṣṭajñānamiti bhāvaḥ || 6 || <8-1-7> tat kiṃ dravye'pi sāmānyaviśeṣamātrāpekṣameva jñānam? ata āha -- dravye dravyaguṇakarmāpekṣam || 7 || jñānamutpadte iti prakṛtam| ghaṇṭāvān śuklo gaurgacchatīti jñānam| tatra dravyaṃ ghaṇṭā viśeṣaṇam, śukla iti guṇaḥ, gacchatīti karma| tathāca nāgṛhītaviśeṣaṇā viśiṣṭapratītirna vā viśeṣaṇasambandhamantareṇeti bhavati dravyaguṇakarmāpekṣeti bhāvaḥ || 7 || <8-1-8> tat kiṃ guṇakarmaṇorapi guṇakarmāpekṣā? netyāha -- guṇakarmasu guṇakarmābhāvād guṇakarmāpekṣaṃ na vidyate || 8 || jñānamiti śeṣaḥ| guṇe guṇaviśiṣṭabuddheḥ karmasu karmaviśiṣṭabuddherabhāvāt guṇakarmāpekṣā na tadgatabuddhiḥ| na hi guṇe guṇo, na vā karmasu karma, yena tatra viśeṣaṇatvena bhāseteti bhāvaḥ || 8 || <8-1-9> nu guṇakarmaṇoḥ sphuraṇād guṇabuddhau karmabuddhau ca kathaṃ na guṇakarmāpekṣetyāśaṅkya prakaraṇāntaramārabhate -- samavāyinaḥ śvaityācchvaityabuddheśca śvete buddhiste ete kāryyakāraṇabhūte || 9 || samavāyina ityabhidhānāt sambandhasya kāraṇatāmāha, tathāca guṇe guṇasamavāyābhāvāt karmasu karmasamavāyābhāvācca na tattajjñāne guṇakarmāpekṣā viśeṣaṇatvena viśeṣyatvena tvastyeva| evañca śvetaḥ śaṅkha ityādipratītau śvaityasamavāyasya śvaityaguṇasya śvaityaviśeṣaṇajñānasya ca kāraṇatvamityuktam, tathā ca viśeṣaṇasambandhaviśeṣaṇatajjñānānāṃ viśiṣṭapratyakṣapramāṃ prati kāraṇatvamiti, tena pūrvoktaṃ sarvaṃ sidhyati || 9 || <8-1-10> nanu yathā ghaṇṭāvānityatra dravyāpekṣaṃ dravyajñānam, tathā'yaṃ stambhaḥ ayaṃ kumbha ityādāvapi dravyāviśeṣaṇakabuddhau dravyabuddhiḥ kāraṇam, tathāca kvāpi prathamato dravyabuddhirna syādityata āha -- dravyeṣvanitaretarakāraṇāḥ || 10 || buddhaya iti śeṣaḥ| stambhajñānānantarakālīnamapi kumbhajñānaṃ na stambhajñānakāryaṃ stambhasya kumbhaṃ prati viśeṣaṇatvāyogāt || 10 || <8-1-11> nanu ghaṭapaṭādibuddhīnāṃ kramo dṛśyate, kramaśca kāryakāraṇabhāvaghaṭita evetyata āha -- kāraṇāyaugapadyāt kāraṇakramācca ghaṭapaṭādibuddhīnāṃ kramo na hetuphalabhāvāt || 11 || kāraṇakramādhīno ghaṭapaṭādbiddhīnāṃ kramo, na hetuphalabhāvādhīnaḥ| kāraṇakrama eva kathamata āha -- kāraṇāyaugapadyāditi| buddhīnāṃ yaugapadyaṃ pratiṣiddhamato nānābuddhikāraṇānāmapi na yaugapadyam, yadi tu kāraṇayaugapadyaṃ bhavettadā kāryayaugapadyamapyāpadyetaḥ tathāca yugapajjñānānutpattirmanaso liṅgamiti bahu bhajyeteti bhāvaḥ || 11 || iti śrīśāṅkare vaiśeṣikasūtropaskāre'ṣṭamādhyāsya prathamāhnikam| aṣṭamādhyāye dvitīyāhnikam <8-2-1> prātyakṣikasya savikalpakasya nirviklpakasya ca jñānasya niṣpattividhimabhidhāyedānīṃ viśiṣṭavaiśiṣṭyapratyakṣamabhidhātumekadeśamāha -- ayameṣa tvayā kṛtaṃ bhojayanamiti buddhyapekṣam || 1 || sannikṛṣṭe vastuni tāvadayamiti buddhirutpadyate, viprakṛṣṭe ca vastunyepa iti kriyāyāṃ svatantro'yamiti buddhimapekṣya tvayeti kartṛtvoparaktā buddhiḥ| kāraṇavyāpāraviṣayatvabuddhimapekṣya kṛtamiti karmabuddhiḥ| ayaṃ bhujikriyāyāṃ karttā prayojakaścāyamiti buddhimapakṣya bhojayeti| niyojyaniyoktṛvyāpārasya viṣayo'yamiti budhdyapekṣamenāmiti| evamanyadapi buddhyapekṣamūhanīyam || 1 || <8-2-2> anvayavyatirakaparicchedyamevaitadityāha -- dṛṣṭeṣu bhāvādadṛṣṭeṣvabhāvāt || 2 || yadā'yamitibuddheḥ sannikṛṣṭo viṣayaḥ, eṣa iti buddherviprakṛṣṭo'pi buddhyārūḍho viṣayaḥ, tvayetibuddheḥ sannikṛṣṭaḥ karttā viṣayaḥ, kṛtamiti buddheḥ karma viṣayaḥ, bhojayetibuddherniyojyaniyoktārau viṣayau, enamitibuddhestadubhayavyāpāro viṣayaḥ, sannikṛṣṭo bhavati tadaitādṛśo buddhirutpadyate, adṛṣṭeṣu tu viṣayeṣu naitā buddhayaḥ prādurbhavantītyanvayavyatirekagamyamevaitadityarthaḥ || 2 || <8-2-3> idānīṃ prakaraṇāntaramārabhate -- artha iti dravyaguṇakarmasu || 3 || eteṣāṃ dravyaguṇakarmaṇāmarthyamānatvaṃ tena tena vidhinoktam, tena teṣu triṣu veśeṣikāṇāmartha iti paribhāṣā, arthapadena trayāṇāmupasthiteḥ| taduktaṃ -- praśastadevācāryaiḥ "trayāṇāmarthaśabdābhidheyatvañca" iti || 3 || <8-2-4> prakaraṇāntaramavatārayati -- dravyeṣu pañcātmakatvaṃ pratiṣiddham || 4 || dravyeṣviti dravyapadārthanirūpaṇaprakaraṇamupalakṣayati| pratyakṣāpratyakṣāṇāmityādisūtreṇa śarīrādīnāṃ paṃcātmakatvaṃ paṃcabhūtātmakatvaṃ pratiṣiddhaṃ nirākṛtam| yathā śarīrasya na nānāprakṛtikatvaṃ tathā vakṣyamāṇānāṃ ghrāṇādīnāmindriyāṇāmapi| tena teṣāṃ pratiniyataguṇagrāhakatvaṃ siddhyatīti bhāvaḥ || 4 || <8-2-5> yadarthamidamārabdhaṃ tadāha -- bhūyastvād gandhavattvācca pṛthivī gandhajñāne prakṛtiḥ || 5 || gandho jñāyate'neneti jgandhajñānaṃ ghrāṇantatra pṛthivī pṛthivīmātra prakṛti-upādānakāraṇam| kuta etadityata āha -- gandhavattvāt| na hi gandhavat nirgandhenārabyate ityuktam| gandhavatatvaṃ ca bahirindriyāṇāṃ grāhyajātīyaguṇavattvaniyamāt siddham| tarhi pārthivatvāviśeṣe'pi śarīrāvayavāntarāṇāṃ na gandhavyañjakatvaṃ kintu ghrāṇasyaiveti kuto niyama ityata āha -- bhūyastvāditi| itaradravyānabhibhūtaiḥ pārthivāvayavairārabdhatvameva bhūyastvam| pāribhāṣikaṃ caitad bhūyastvaṃ samānatantre'pi || 5 || <8-2-6> inadriyāntare'pyetadatidiśati -- tathāpastejovāyuśca rasarūpasparśāviśeṣāt || 6 || rasanacakṣuṣṭvagindriyāṇāṃ prakṛtiriti śeṣaḥ| tena yathāsakhyaṃ rasanādīnāmabādayaḥ prakṛtayaḥ, tattatpratiniyatārthagrāhakatvāt| atrāpi niyame bhayastvameva tantram| rasādimattve ca rasanādīnāṃ grāhyajātīyaviśeṣaguṇavattvaniyamaeva pramāṇamityuktam| evca viśiṣṭādṛṣṭopagṛhītakarṇaśaṣkulyavacchinno nabhodeśa eva śrotram || 6 || iti śrīśaṅkare vaiśeṣikasūtropaskāro'ṣṭamādhyāyasya dvitīyamāhnikam| samāptaścāyamaṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ| <9> <9-1-1> saṃyogasamavāyānyatarasannikarṣajalaukikapratyakṣanirūpaṇānantaraṃ taditarapratyāsattijanyalaukikapratyakṣavyutpādanaphalakaṃ navamādhyāyamāha -- kriyāguṇavyapadeśābhāvāt prāgasat || 1 || kāryamiti śeṣaḥ| prāgiti kāryotpatteḥ prāk kāryaṃ ghaṭapaṭādi asat tat‌kālīnasvajanakābhāvapratiyogītyarthaḥ| atra hetuḥ kriyāguṇavyapadeśābhāvāt| yadi tadānīmapi kāryaṃ ghaṭādi sadeva syāt tadā kriyāvattvena gaṇavatvena ca vyapadiśyeta, yathotpanne ghaṭe ghaṭastiṣṭhati ghaṭaścalati rūpavānayaṃ dṛśyate ghaṭa ityādiprakāreṇa vyapadiśyate na tathotpatteḥ prāgapi vyapadeśo'sti| tena gamyate tadānīmasanniti| sa ca vyūhyamāneṣu vīraṇeṣu yojyamāneṣu yojyamāneṣu tantuṣu cakrārūḍhāyāṃ mṛdi kulālādivyāpāreṣu anuvarttamāneṣu bhaviṣyatyatra kaṭaḥ paṭo ghaṭo veti sārvalaukikī pratyakṣapratītiḥ, cakṣurvisphāraṇānantaraṃ jāyamānatvāt| na ca saṃyogasamavāyānyataraghaṭitā pratyāsattiratra prabhavati, tasmādindriyasambaddhaviśeṣaṇatā pratyāsatti ratra tantram| nanu cānyonyāśrayaḥ satyāṃ viśeṣaṇatāyāṃ tatpratītiḥ pratītau ca viśeṣaṇateti cenna, viśeṣaṇatā hi tadubhayasvarūpameva upaśliṣṭapratyayajananayogyam| tacca pratīteḥ pūrvamapi sadeva, taduktaṃ nyāyavārttike -- "samavāye'bhāve ca viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvaḥ" iti| sa cāyaṃ prāgabhāvaḥ pratiyogijanakaḥ na hi ghaṭe jāte sa eva ghaṭastadānīmevotpadyate tatra kāraṇāntarasattve'pi kāraṇavaikalyamanusriyamāṇaṃ svaprāgabhāvavaikalyamevānusarttu marhati| taddhaṭotpattau sa eva ghaṭaḥ pratibandhaka iti cettarhi pratibandhakābhāvatvena tasya kāraṇatvamavarjanīyam| nanu yadi ghaṭa eva tasyābhāvastadā ghaṭe naṣṭe tadunmajjanāpattiriti cenna, ghaṭanāśasyāpi tadvirodhitvāt, na hi virodhisattvakāle'pi virodhyantaraprādurbhāva iti| na hyanayordeśakṛto virodho yena gotvāśvatvavat samānakālīnatvaṃ syāt| kiṃ tarhi? kālakṛtastathāca kathamekakālāvasthāyitvambhavet || 1 || <9-1-2> abhāvāntaraṃ pratītibalasiddhamāha -- sadasat || 2 || yathā kāraṇavyāpārāt pūrvaṃ pratyakṣānumānābhyāṃ kāryasyāsattvaṃ pramīyate tathā vināśakasya mudgarādervyāpārānantaraṃ sadeva kāryaṃ ghaṭādi idānīmasaditi pratyakṣānunāmābhyāmeva pramoyate| bhavati hi ghaṭo naṣṭo dhvasya idānīṃ śrutapūrvo gakāro nāstītyādidhīriti bhāvaḥ || 2 || <9-1-3> nanu ghaṭa evāvasthāviśeṣe dhvaṃsavyavahāraṃ karoti na tu ghaṭādanyastasya dhvaṃsa ityata āha -- asataḥ kriyāguṇavyapadeśābhāvādarthāntaram || 3 || saditi sūtraśeṣaḥ| asataḥ sat arthāntaram| kuta ityata āha -- kriyāguṇavyapadeśābhāvāditi| na hi pradhvaṃsakāle'pi varttate ghaṭaḥ -- asti ghaṭaḥ -- idānīṃ rūpavān ghaṭaḥ -- ghaṭamānayotyādivyapadeśastadito vaidharmyādasataḥ sadarthāntaramiti || 3 || <9-1-4> prāgabhāvapradhvaṃsau sādhayitvā'nyobhāvaṃ sādhayitumāha -- yatra sadeva ghaṭādi asaditi vyavahriyate tatra tādātmyābhāvaḥ pratīyate| bhavati hi asannaśvo gavātmanā -- asan gauraśvātmanā -- asan paṭo ghaṭātmanā aghaṭaḥ paṭaḥ -- anaśvo gauḥ -- agauraśva ityādi pratītiḥ| tadasyāmaśvānyābhāvavān gauḥ paṭānyonyābhāvavāt ghaṭa ityanyonyābhāva eva tādātmyābhāvāparanāmā bhāsate| tadatra tādātmyaṃ pratiyogitāvacchedakam| pratiyogisamānādhikaraṇaścāyamabhāvaḥ, bhavatihi ghaṭo na bhūtalamiti pratītiḥ| nityaśca, kadācidapi ghaṭapaṭayostādātmayā sambhavāt || 4 || <9-1-5> idānīṃ caturthamabhāvamatyantābhāvākhyamāha -- yaccānyadasadatastadasat || 5 || ataḥ pūrvoktādabhāvatrayāt, yadanyadasat tadasat tadatyantāsattvam| asadityubhayatra bhāvapradhāno nirdeśaḥ| tatraikamasaduddeśyamaparamasadvidheyam, tathā coktābhāvatrayabhinno yo'bhāvaḥ so'tyantābhāva iti paryyavasanno'rthaḥ| tatra prāgabāvasya uttarāvadhikatvam, pradhvaṃsasya pūrvāvadhikatvam, anyonyābhāvasya pratiyogisamānādhikaraṇatvamatyantābhāvasya tu tritayavaidharmyamataścaturtho'yamabhāvaḥ || 5 || <9-1-6> idānīṃ prakaraṇāntaramārabhate, tatra pradhvaṃse tāvat pratyakṣasāmagrīmāha -- asaditi bhūtapratyakṣābhāvāt bhūtasmṛtervirodhipratyakṣavat || 6 || asaditītikāreṇa pratyakṣākāraṃ jñānamāha, tenāsan ghaṭaḥ -- naṣṭo ghaṭaḥ -- dhvasya idānīṃ ghaṭa -- iti pratyakṣapratītirasti| tatra dṛṣṭānto virodhipratyakṣavaditi| virodhino ghaṭāderyathā spaṣṭaṃ pratyakṣaṃ tathā tatpradhvaṃsasyāpi| tatra kāraṇamāhabhūtapratyakṣābhāvāditi| bhūtasya utpadya vinaṣṭasya ghaṭādeḥ pratyakṣābhāvāt| etena yogyānupalabdhimāha| tatra cāyaṃ tarkaḥ sahakārīyadyatra ghaṭo'bhaviṣyat bhatalamivādrakṣyata na ca dṛśyate tasmānnāstīti| sahakāryantaramāha -- bhūtasmṛteriti| bhūtasya pratiyogino ghaṭādeḥ smṛteriti pratiyogismaraṇamuktam || 6 || <9-1-7> prāgabhāve pradhvaṃsapratyakṣatākāramatidiśannāha -- tathā'bhāve bhāvapratyakṣatvācca || 7 || sāmānyavacyapyayamabhāvaśabdaḥ prakaraṇāt prāgabhāvaparaḥ| yathā pradhvaṃse pratyakṣajñānaṃ tathā prāgabhāve'pi| kutaḥ? bhāvapratyakṣatvāt| bhāvasya vyūhyamāmānavīraṇādeḥ pratyakṣatvāt pratyakṣeṇa viṣayīkriyamāṇatvāt| yadvā bhāvasyādhikaraṇasya pratiyoginaśca pratyakṣatvāt yogyatvādityarthaḥ| saṃsargābhāvagrahe'dhikaraṇayogyatāyāḥ| pratiyogiyogyatāyāśca tantratvāt| cakārāt pratiyogismaraṇamuktañca tarkaṃ samuccinoti| anāderapi prāgabhāvasyānantasyāpi pradhvaṃsasyāviśeṣamātre pratyakṣatvam || 7 || <9-1-8> anyonyābhāvasya pratyakṣatāmāha -- etenāghaṭo'gauradharmaśca vyākhyātaḥ || 8 || eteneti pratiyogismaraṇādhikaraṇagrahaṇaprāguktatarkānatidiśati| yogyānupalambhaḥ sarvatra samānaḥ| cakāra uktasamuccayārthaḥ| adharma ityatīndriyasyapi dharmasya sukhajñānādāvadhikaraṇe'nyonyābhāvasya pratyakṣatāṃ vadan anyonyābhāvagrahe pratiyogiyogyatā na tantraṃ kintvadhikaraṇayogyatāmātraṃ tantramityupadarśayati| kathamanyathā stambhaḥ piśāco na bhavatīti piśācānyonyābhāvaḥ stambhe gṛhyeta stambhātmatayā piśācānupalambhasya tadanyonyābhāvagrāhakatvāt, tasyāpyanupalambhasya pratiyogisattvavirodhitvāt stambhe piśācatādātmye satyanupalambhānupapatteḥ| nanu piśācatādātmyamiha na pratiyogi, kintarhi? piśācaḥ sa ca stambhe varttamāno'pi gurutvavannopalabhyate iti tadanupalambhaḥ pratiyogisattvavirodhī na bhavatīti cenna, pratiyogyanupalambhavat pratiyogitāvacchedakānupalambhasyāpyabhāvagrahakāraṇatvāt| nanu pratiyogitvagrahādhīno'nyonyābhāvagrahaḥ, pratiyogitvañcānyonyābhāvavirahātmatvaṃ tataścānyonyābhāvagrahādhīna evānyonyābhāvagraha iti cennādhikaraṇāvṛttitvena jñāyamāno dharma eva pratiyogitāvacchedakatvenāpi tad‌grahastantramityuktatvāt || 8 || <9-1-9> athedānīmatyantābhāvapratyakṣatāmāha -- bhūtamidānīṃ nāstītipratītirdhvaṃsamālambate bhūtatvaṃ nollikhati kintvidaṃ nāstītimātrollekhinī pratyakṣapratītiratyantābhāvamālambate| abūtamityutpādavināśālambanatvaṃ dyotayati, anarthāntaratvamapi tadabhiprāyakameva yathā jale pṛthivītvaṃ nāsti pṛthivyāṃ na jalatvamiti| yadi hi jalāvayavini pṛthivītvaṃ syāt uṣalabhyeta na copalabhyate tasmānnāstītittarkapuraskāro'trāpi draṣṭavyaḥ| evañca yadvastu yatra na kadā'pi bhaviṣyati na ca kadācid bhūtaṃ tasya vastunastatrātyantābhāvo mantavyaḥ| bhūtabhaviṣyatośca tatra pradhvaṃsaprāgabhāvālambana eva tatrādhikaraṇe nāstīti pratyayaḥ| ata evāyamātyantikastraikālika ityabhidhīyate || 9 || <9-1-10> nanu gehe ghaṭābāvo nātyantābhāvaḥ kadācittatra ghaṭasattvāt, nāpi prāgabhāvapradhvaṃsau, tayoḥ samavāyikāraṇamātravṛttitvāt, nāpyutpādavināśaśīlo'tyantābhāva eva ātyantikaścotpādavināśaśīlaśceti virodhāt, nāpi caturtha evāyaṃ saṃsargābhāvaḥ, tasya traividhyavibhāgavyāghātādityata āha -- nāsti ghaṭo gehe iti sato ghaṭasya gehasaṃsargapratiṣedhaḥ || 10 || gehe ghaṭasya yaḥ saṃsargaḥ saṃyogastasya pratiṣedhaḥ, sa ca yadi kadācidapi na ghaṭastadātyantābhāva eva, bhaviṣyataḥ prāgabhāvo bhūtasya pradhvaṃsābhāvaḥ| tarhi ghaṭasaṃsargo gehe nāstīti -- pratītyā bhavitavya, miti cet pratītyā bhavitavyamiti ko'rthaḥ? yadi tadviṣayayā pratītyā bhavitavyamityāpādanārthastadeṣṭāpattiḥ atha tadullekhinyeti, tadā gehe ityadhikaraṇollekhasyaiva saṃsargollekhaparyyavasānamādhāratvasyaiva dharmasambandhākāratvāt. tat kiṃ ghaṭastatrāstyeva| astyeveti ko'rthastatra samavetaḥ saṃyukto vā? nādyaḥ samavetaghaṭasya tatrābhāvāt| na dvitīyaḥ saṃyogasya niṣedhāt| nanvevaṃ ghaṭādīnāṃ kevalānvayitvaprasaṅgaḥ, tatsaṃyogasamavāyāntarasyaiva sarvava niṣedhāditi cenna, tadubhayaniṣedhasyaiva ghaṭaniṣedhātmakatvāt| tat kiṃ ghaṭastatsaṃyogaścetyekaṃ tattvaṃ, yena ghaṭasaṃyoganiṣedho ghaṭaniṣedhaḥ syāt, tat kiṃ ghaṭastatsaṃyogasamavāyāvekaṃ tattvaṃ, yena tadvidhireva ghaṭavidhiḥ syāt, na hi tau yatra niṣedhyete tatra ghaṭānvayo yena kevalānvayitvaṃ tasya syāt, tathāca yasya yo vidhistanniṣedha eva tanniṣedha iti| yadvā ghaṭasya samavāyitayā gehe'tyantābhāva eva, sa eva gehe ghaṭo nāstīti pratītiviṣayaḥ, kapāle saṃyogitayeva| evaṃ sati kevalānvayyatyantābhāvapratiyogitayā ghaṭo'san syāditi cet bhavedevaṃ yadi saṃyogitvasamavāyitvābhyāṃ sarvatrāsat syāditi bhāvaḥ || 10 || <9-1-11> prakaraṇāntaramārabhate -- ātmanyātmamanasoḥ saṃyogaviśeṣādātmapratyakṣam || 11 || jñānamutpadyate iti śeṣaḥ| dvividhāstāvadyoginaḥ samāhitāntaḥkaraṇā ye yuktā ityabhidhīyante, asamāhitāntaḥkaraṇāśca ye viyuktā ityabhidhīyante| tatra yuktāḥ -- sākṣāt‌karttavye vastunyādareṇa mano vidhāya nididhyāsanavantaḥ, teṣāmātmani svātmani paramātmani ca jñānamutpadyate| ātmapratyakṣamiti| ātmā pratyakṣaḥ sākṣāt‌kāraviṣayo yatra jñāne tattathā| yadyapyasmadādīnāmapi kadācidātmajñānamasti tathāpyavidyātiraskṛtatvāt tadasat‌kalpamityuktamātmamanasoḥ sannikarṣaviśeṣāditi| yogajadharmānugraha ātmamanasoḥ sannikarṣe viśeṣastasmādityarthaḥ || 11 || <9-1-12> tat kimātmanyeva yuktānāṃ jñānaṃ tat kutaḥ sārvajñyamityata āha -- jñānamutpadyata iti prakaraṇāyātam| tatheti yogajadharmānugṛhītenaiva manasā, dravyāntareṣu caturṣvaṇuṣu manasi vāyudik‌kālākāśeṣu, dravyapadena tadgataguṇakarmasāmānyānāṃ viśeṣapadārthasya samavāyasya pratyakṣagatasyāpi gurutvasthitisthāpakāderātmagatasyāpi jīvanayoniyatnanirvikalpakabhāvanādharmādharmādeḥ saṅgrahaḥ sāmagryā yogajadharmopagrahasya tulyatvāt anyathā sārvajñyamuktaṃ na bhavet || 12 || <9-1-13> yuktānāṃ pratyakṣaṃ jñānamabhidhāyedānīṃ viyuktānāmāha -- asamāhitāntaḥkaraṇā upasaṃhṛtasamādhayasteṣāñca || 13 || asamāhitāntaḥkaraṇā ityasyaiva vyākhyānamupasaṃhṛtasamādhaya iti| yadvā kathamasamāhitāntaḥkaraṇā ityata āha -- upasaṃhṛtasamādhaya iti| upasaṃhṛto dūrīkṛtaḥ samādhirnididhyāsanātmako yaiste tathā| te hisamādhiprabhāvādvikaraṇadharmā aṇimādyāḥ śarīrasiddhīrdūraśravaṇādyāścendriyasiddhīrāptavantaḥ samādhāvapyalaṃpratyayamāsādayantaḥ "tāvadevāsya ciraṃ yāvanna vimokṣye atha sampatsye" ityādi śratisamadhigatakṛtyāntarābhāvāḥ bhogamātrasya karttavyatāmākalayya teṣu teṣu pradeśeṣu dvīpopadvīpādiṣu tena tena janmanā turaṅgamātaṅgavihaṅgabhujaṅgādinā (yāvadeva ciraṃ yāvat) devarṣimānuṣabhāvena ca pūrvopāttān kamaśiyānupabhuñjmahe tāvat prāptaiva nirapāyā bhūmirityākalayantaḥ sakalamarthajātaṃ yogajadharmabalopabṛṃhitendriyaśaktayo vyavahitaṃ viprakṛṣṭañca pratyakṣīkurvanti || 13 || <9-1-14> nanu na tāvatteṣu mānasaṃ jñānaṃ manaso bahirasvātantryāt, nāpi bahirindriyajanyam teṣāṃ sambaddhavarttamānārthagrāhitvāt yathāyogaṃ rūpodbhavādisāpekṣatvāt ālokādisavyapekṣatvāccetyāśaṅkyakeṣucit padārtheṣu pratyāsattimupapādayannāha -- tat‌samavāyāt karmaguṇeṣu || 14 || pratyakṣajñānaṃ jāyate iti śeṣaḥ| bhautikānīndriyāṇi yadi sannikarṣamapekṣante tadā paramāṇvākāśadikkālasamaveteṣu svamanaḥsaṃyogisamavāyāt itaradravyeṣu ca kāyavyūhopabhogārthopagṛhītanānāpaṇḍamanaḥsaṃyogāt tatsaṃyuktasamavāyāt tattad‌dravyaguṇādiṣu jñānamutpadyate| etaccopapattisaukaryamanurudhyoktam| vastuto bāhyendriyeṣu manasi ca yogaja eva dharmaḥ pratyāsattistata eva sarvānupapattiśānteḥ, agastyasamudrapānaṃ daṇḍakāraṇyanirmāṇañceti dṛṣṭāntaḥ || 14 || <9-1-15> sattiḥ, netyāha -- ātmasamavāyādātmaguṇeṣu || 15 || yogināṃ pratyakṣaṃ jñānamutpadyate iti prakṛtam| ātmasamavetānāntu buddhyādīnāṃ saṃyuktasamavāyādeva pratyakṣe jñānamutpadyate'smadādīnāmiveti na tatra sannikarṣāntarāpekṣetyarthaḥ| tatrendriyārthasannikarṣotpannamavyabhicārijñānaṃ laukikālaukikapratyakṣam, arthajaṃ vā| sākṣāttvayogijñānaṃ pratyakṣamiti laukikālaukikasādhāraṇam || 15 || iti śrīśāṅkare vaiśeṣikasūtropaskāre navamādhyāyasya prathamāhnikam| navamādhyāye dvitīyāhnikam| <9-2-1> tadevaṃ pūrvāhnike yogipratyakṣamayogipratyakṣañca kāraṇataḥ svarūpato lakṣaṇataśca nirūpitam| pramāṇaṃ dvividhaṃ pratyakṣaṃ laiṅgikaceti yadvibhaktaṃ tatra laiṅgirumidānīṃ nirūpayitumupakramate -- asyedaṃ kāryyaṃ kāraṇaṃ saṃyogi virodhi samavāyi ceti saiṅgikam || 1 || jñānamiti prakṛtam| liṅgājjātaṃ laiṅgikaṃ vyāptiviśiṣṭaḥ pakṣadharmo liṅgam| tatra vyāptiruktā, yatsiṣādhayiṣāvirodhipramāṇābāvo yatra sa taṃ prati pakṣaḥ| tādṛśaṃ pramāṇaṃ sādhakaṃ bhādhakaca, tadubhayābhāvavataḥ pakṣatvāt| na hi sādhake bādhake vā pramāṇe satikasyacit saṃśayaḥ siṣādhayiṣā vā| ata eva sandigdha sādhyadharmā dharmī siṣādhayiṣitasādhyadharmā dharmī vā pakṣa iti prāñcaḥ| utpādyasādhyavattānirṇayanivartyasaṃśayotpattipratibandhakamānatvāvacchinnābhāvo yatra sa pakṣa iti jīvanāthamiśrāḥ| siṣādhayiṣāvirahasahakṛtasādhakamānābhāvo yatra sa pakṣa iti kecit| etanmate tu bādhasthale'pi pakṣatā| tadetadanumānamayūkhe draṣṭavyam| tadetasya pakṣasya dharmo liṅgamityuktaṃ bhavati| liṅgañca dṛṣṭamanumitaṃ śrutaṃ vā yadanubhavarūpaṃ jñānaṃ janayati tallaiṅgikam| taduktam -- anumeyena sambaddhaṃ prasiddhañca tadanvite| tadabhāve tu nāstyeva talliṅgamanumāpakam || iti| etena liṅgamevānumitikaraṇaṃ na tu tasya parāmarśaḥ, tasya nirvyāpāratvenākaraṇatvāt, liṅgasya tu sa eva vyāpāra| yatra dhūmāderatītatvamanāgatatvaṃ vā tatra kathamanumitiriti cenna, sādhyasyāpyatītānāgatatvayostatrānumānāt, tatraiva pratibandhāt. atītatvamanāgatatvaṃ varttamānatvañca dhūmāderyatra na niścitaṃ tatra kathamanumitiriti cet, na kathañcit tatra sādhyasyāpi sandehāt| pūrvāparadinayoḥ sattvaniścaye madhyandine tu sandehe kathamanumitiriti cet taddināvacchinnadhūmādinā taddināvacchinnavahnyāderanumānāt, tathaiva vyāpteḥ kāraṇatvāvadhāraṇāt| dhūlīpaṭalāt kathaṃ dhūmabhramādanumitiriti cet vyāptatvena jñātasyaiva liṅgatvāt jñānasya ca yāyārthyāyāthārthyābhyāmanumitestādrūpyāt, anyathā tavāpi kathaṃ tatra parāmarśaḥ karaṇaṃ syāt| atīndriyaliṅgasthale parāmarśasya tadajanyatayā kathaṃ tadvyāpāratvamiti cet tatsattānirvāhakatvarūpakṣaimikasādhanatāyāstatra vyāpāratvaghaṭakatvāt, anyathā samavāyasya śravaṇādervyāpāratvānupapatteriti| kāryyālliṅgāt dhūmālokāderagnyādyanumānam| kāraṇādapi yathā badhirasya bherīdaṇḍasaṃyogaviśeṣāt śabdānumānam, yathā vā dhārmikasya yathāvidhiyāgasnānādyanuṣṭhānāddharmasvargādyanumānam, yathāvidhi kārīryyādyanuṣṭhānādvā varṣānumānam, payaḥpūrṇanadyādau khanyamānapravāhādvā jalaniḥsaraṇānumām, uparivṛṣṭidarśanādvā nadīvṛddhyanumānam| sa cāyaṃ kāryyakāraṇabhāvalakṣaṇekasambandhaḥ prakāradvayenoktaḥ| saṃyoginaḥ śarīrasya darśanāttvagindriyānumānam| virodhino visphūrjato'herdarśanāj‌jhāṭādyantaritanakulānumānam| samavāyinā jalauṣṇyena tatsambandhatejo'numānam || 1 || <9-2-2> nanvavyāpakamidaṃ parisaṅkhyānam| na hi candrodayena samudrajalavṛddheḥjalaprasādenāgastyodayasya -- kumudaprakāśena candrodayasya -- caturdaśanakṣatrodayenāparacaturdaśanakṣatrāstamayasya -- rasena rūpasya -- rūpaviśeṣeṇa vā rasaviśeṣasyānumānamanena saṃgṛhyate ityata āha -- asyedaṃ kāryyakāraṇasambandhaścāvayavādbhavati || 2 || asyedamityetāvadeva prayojakaṃ bhavatīti, asya sādhanasya dhūmāderidaṃ sādhyaṃ vahnyādi| yadvā'sya vahnayāderidaṃ vyāpyaṃ dhūmādi| tathāca vyāpyatvagrahamātraṃ tantraṃ na tu kāryakāraṇabhāvādirapi| nanu pūrvasūtre tarhi parisahkhyānamatantramata āha -- kāryyakāraṇasambandha iti| anena coktaṃ sambandhāntaramapyupalakṣayati| sambandhapade ca viṣayilakṣaṇā, tena sambandha iti sambandhopanyāsa ityarthaḥ| kutastadupanyāsa ityata āha -- avayavāt ekadeśāt udāharaṇamātrāt lyab‌lope pañcamī| tenodāharaṇamanurudhya kāryyakāraṇabhāvādeḥ sambandhasyopanyāsa iha darśane sāṅkhyādidarśane ca bhavatītyarthaḥ| evaṃ ca svābhāvikasambandhaśālitvaṃ vyāpyatvam| svābhāvikatvaṃ cānaupādhikatvam| tacca pratyakṣāṇāṃ keṣāṃcit sādhyāvyapakatvaniścayāt, keṣāṃcit sādhanevyāpakatvaniścayādevānupādhitvaṃ jñeyam| atīndriyāṇāṃ ca pramāṇasiddhānāṃ keṣāṃcidubhayavyāpakatvam ubhayāvyāpakatvaṃ sādhanamātravyāpakatvaṃ sādhyamātravyāpakatvaṃ vā| tatrādye sādhanavyāpakatvāt dvitīye sādhyāvyāpakatvāt caturthe'pi sādhanavyāpakatvādevānupādhitvaṃ niśyeyam| tṛtīye'pi vyāpakasya tanmātravyāpakatvānupapattiritarasya tu kathaṃ tanmātravyāpakatvamityatra tarko'nusandheya iti tulyayogakṣematvādinā'nupādhitvamadhyavaseyam| bhaviṣyati kaścidatropādhiritiśaṅkāpiśācī sakalavidhiniṣedhavyavahārānāskandatītyanādeyetyanaupādhikatvaniścayasambhavāt| upādhilakṣaṇaṃ vyāptilakṣaṇaṃ coktam| taccānumānaṃ dvividhaṃ -- svārthaṃ parārthañca| tatra svārthaṃ svayageva vyāptipakṣadharmatayoranusandhānāt| parārthañca parodīritanyāyajanyavyāptipakṣadharmatājñānāt| nyāyaśca tṛtīyaliṅgaparāmarśaprayojakaśabdajñānajanakavākyam| tadavayavāśca pañca| tatrāvayavatvaṃ tṛtīyaliṅgaparāmarśaprayojakaśābdajñānajñanakaśābdajñānajanakavākyatvam| tāni ca vākyāni pratijñāhetūdāharaṇopanayanigamanāni| tatra pratijñā -- uddeśyānumityanyūnānatiriktaviṣayakaśābdajñānajanakaṃ nyāyāvayavavākyam| hetuśca prakṛtasādhanagatapañcamyanto nyāyāvayavaḥ| udāharaṇantu prakṛtasādhyasādhanāvinābhāvapratipādako nyāyāvayavaḥ| upanayaścāvinābhāvaviśiṣṭasya hetoḥ pakṣavaiśiṣṭyapratipādako nyāyāvayavaḥ| nigamanantu pakṣe prakṛtasādhyavaiśiṣṭyapratipādako nyāyāvayavaḥ| evaṃ ca pravarttate nyāyaśabdo'nityaḥ kṛtakatvāt, yad yat kṛtakaṃ tadanityam, anityatvavyāpyakṛtakatvavāṃścāyam, tasmādanityaḥ| eteṣāmeva pratijñāpadeśanidarśanānusandhānapratyāmnāyā ityanvarthā vaiśeṣikāṇāṃ sajñāḥ| atra ca vādajalpavitaṇḍānāṃ pravṛttiprakāraśchalajātinigrahasthānalakṣaṇāni ca vādivinode'nveṣṭavyāni || 2 || <9-2-3> pramāṇāntarāṇi laiṅgike'ntarbhāvayituṃ prakaraṇāntaramārabhate -- etena sābdaṃ vyākhyātam || 3 || śābdaṃ śabdakaraṇakaṃ jñānamidamiti yannaiyāyikādīnāmabhimataṃ tadapyetena laiṅgikatvena liṅgaprabhavatvenaiva vyākhyātam| yathā vyāptipakṣadharmatāpratisandhānāpekṣaṃ laiṅgikaṃ tathā śābdamapi| tathāhi ete padārthāḥ mithaḥ saṃsargavantaḥ ākāṅkṣādimadbhiḥ smāritatvāt gāmabhyājeti padārthasārthavat| tatra hi ākāṅkṣādimat‌tpadakadambamāristatvaṃ padārthānāṃ mithaḥ saṃsargavattvavyāpyaṃ gṛhītvaiva saṃsargavattvamanuminoti kiṃ kalpanīyapramāṇabhūvena śabdena| nanu nadītīre paṃca phalāni santītyanāptavākye vyabhicārānnedamanumānamiti cenna, āptoktatvenāpi viśeṣaṇāt, āptatvaṃ hi prakṛtavākyārthagocarayathārthavākyārthajñānavattvaṃ na tvapratārakatvamātram, tacca vākyārthapratīteḥ pūrvaṃ durgrahamiti cenna, śabdaprāmāṇyavādibhirapi vyabhicāriśabdavyāvarttakasyāptoktatvasya grāhyatvenābhimatatvāt| teṣāṃ prāmāṇyagrahaṇārthaṃ tadapekṣā, śābdantu jñānaṃ tad‌grahamanatreṇāpyupapadyate, tava tu yādṛśaṃ liṅgaṃ tādṛśagrahaṇamāvaśyakam, vyāpyantvāptoktatvaviśiṣṭamiti cenna, ayamatrābhrānta iti sāmānyato grahaṇasambhavāt| nanvatreti prakṛtasaṃsarge ityeva paryyavasyati tathāca pūrvamaśakyameva tad‌grahaṇamiti cenna, prakaraṇasamabhivyāhārādimāhātmyāt sāmānyata āptatvaniścayasambhavena liṅganiścayasambhavāt, kadācittatra visaṃvāde'pi vāṣpādau dhūmadharmeṇevānumānapravṛtteḥ| nanvete padārthāḥ saṃsṛṣṭā eveti vā sādhyam sambhāvitasaṃsargā iti vā? nādyaḥ, anāptokte vyabhicārāt, na dvitīyaḥ, yogyatāmātrasiddhāvapi saṃsargāniścayānniṣkampapravṛttyanupapatteḥ, yogyatāyāśca pūrvameva hetuviśeṣaṇatvena jñātatvāt kimanumāneneti cenna, niyamasyaiva sādhyatvāt āptoktatvena viśeṣaṇācca na vyabhicāra ityuktatvāt| nanvākāṅkṣā śrotari tadutpādyasaṃsargāvagamaprāgabhāvaḥ, sa ca svarūpasanneva hetustaj‌jñāne ca saṃsargajñānasya pūrvameva bhāvādanumānavaiyarthyamiti cenna, na hi saṃsargāvagamaprāgabhāvamātramākāṅkṣāṃ brūmaḥ| kiṃ tarhi? smāritatadākṣiptāvinābhāvaviśiṣṭam, tathā ca viśeṣaṇāṃśajñānādevākāṅkṣāyā jñānāt| tarhi tāvadevākāṅkṣā'stviti cenna, vimala jalaṃ nadyāḥ kacche mahiṣaścaratītyatrāpi nadīkacchayoravinābhāvasattvenānvayabodhāpatteḥ, nīlamutpalamityatra nīlotpalayoravinābhāvābhāve'pi tadākṣiptayordravyaguṇayoravinābāvasambhavāt| yadvā padasmāritagocarā jijñāsaivākāṅakṣā abhidhānāparyyavasānaṃ vā| tathāpi taj‌jñānamāvaśyakaṃ jñāyamānakāraṇe jñānopayuktavyabhicārivailakṣaṇyāt vyāptavat| ata evānanvayaniścayaviraho vā, bādhakapramāṇābhāvo vā, sajātīye darśanaṃ vā, itarapadārthasaṃsarge'parapadārthaniṣṭhātyantābhāvāpratiyogitvapramāviśeṣyatvaṃ vā yogyatā'stu, taj‌jñānamāvaśyakam| āsatterapyavyavadhānena smaraṇarūpāyā jñānaṃ tantram| saṃsarge ca saṃsṛjyamānaviśeṣādeva viśeṣa iti nānabhimataviśeṣasiddhiḥ| yadvā etāni padāni smāritārthasaṃsargajñānapūrvakāṇi ākāṅkṣāyomyatāsattimatpadakadamvatvāt gāmabhyājeti padakadambavadityanumānāt jñānāvacchedakatayā'bimataviśeṣasiddhiḥ| yattu etāni padāni smāritārthasaṃsargavantīti sādhyam, tat padānāṃ padārthasaṃsargavattvaṃ bādhitamityupekṣaṇīyam| na ca liṅgatayā saṃsargajñāpakatvameva padānāṃ saṃsargavattvam, tasyānumānāt pūrvamasiddhatvena vyāpteragrahāt| kecicceṣṭā pramāṇāntarāmiti vadanti| tatrocyate -- ceṣṭā dvividhā kṛtasamayā'kṛtasamayā ca| tatra kṛtasamayā abhiprāyasthaṃ śabdaṃ smārayati na tu saṃsargapramāmapi janayati lipivat, smṛtyārūḍhaḥ śabda eva tatra pramāṇaṃ śabdasya ca liṅgatvamuktam| na ca śabdasmaraṇaṃ ceṣṭāyā avāntaravyāpāraḥ, ceṣṭāmantareṇāpi śabdārthapratyayāt vyāpāratve tu ceṣṭānaiyatyāpatteḥ| nanvevaṃ kathameḍamūkasya ceṣṭādhīno vyavahāraḥ? tasya tatrasamayagrahābhāvāditi cenna, tasya ceṣṭātaḥ kathamarthe'pi saṃpratyaya iti cintanīyatvāt tasyārthe'pi saṅgatigrahābhāvāt| vyavahārastu tasyāvinābhāvagrahāt karituragayoriva kaśāṅkuśābhighātāttattadvyavahārapāṭavopapatteḥ| akṛtasamayā tu yā kṛtyānvayinī sā prayojakābhiprāyaṃ smārayantī prayojyaṃ pravarttayati, na tu kutracit pramāṃ janayati| yathā śaṅkhadhvanau tvayā gantavyamiti śrutaśaṅkhadhvaniḥ pratiṣṭhate, tatā yadā mayā tarjanyūrdhvīkriyate tadā tvayā'sau tāḍanīya iti tadā tāḍayati, na tu kiñcit pramiṇoti| jñaptyanvayinī tvakṛtasamayā yathādaśānāmaṅgulīnāmūrdhvakaraṇena daśa saṅkhyā mudrāṇāṃ purāṇānāṃ vā tvayā jñātavyeti -- kārakapradhānā| hastākuñcanadarśanāttvayā samāgantavyamiti kriyāpradhānā| tathācānayā ceṣṭayā padārthā eva svatantrāḥ paraṃ smāryyante na tu teṣāṃ parasparamanvayo'pi bodhyate, tad‌bodhakakartṛkarmādivibhaktivat prakṛte ceṣṭaikadeśānāṃ niyatānāmabhāvāt| tarhi saṃsargabodhamantareṇa ceṣṭātaḥ kathaṃ pravṛttinivṛttī iti cet saṃśayapratibhayoranyatarasmāditi gṛhāṇa| tasmānna ceṣṭā'pi pramāṇamitiṃ || 3 || <9-2-4> nanu śabdaḥ kathaṃ liṅgaṃ śabdasyāpadeśasvabhāvatvena liṅgabhinnatvādityāśaṅkyāha -- heturapadeśo liṅgaṃ pramāṇaṃ karaṇamityanarthāntaram || 4 || apadiśyate kathyate'nenārtha ityapadeśaḥ śabdaḥ, sa ca hetuliṅgaparyyāya eva pramāṇamiti| liṅgavidhayā pramākaraṇamityarthaḥ| evaṃ karaṇaśabdo'pi laiṅgikajñānakaraṇe liṅga eva varttate| dvayī karaṇagatiḥ, kiñcit sannikarpādhīnapravṛtti kiñciccāvinābhāvabalapravṛtti| śabdasya tu arthena na sannikarṣo nāpyavinābhāva iti kathamarthaṃ gamayet| saṅketād gamayatīti cet saṅketo hi padārthe na tu tatsaṃsarge| tatrāpi saṅketa iti cenna, tasyānekavidhatvena saṅketaviṣayabhāvānupapatteḥ| padārthasaṅketabalādeva vākyārtho'pi bhāsate iti cenna, anyasaṅketenānyopasthitāvatiprasaṅgāt, śabdasmāritasaṃsargatvena niyama iti cet tathācaitanniyamabalenānumānasyaiva labdhāvasaratvāt| saṅketasyāpi icchāmātratvenāti prasaktatvāt| īśvarecchā nātiprasakteti cenna, tadicchāmantareṇāpi gaṅgādipadāttīrādyupasthiterityalaṃ naiyāyikeṣu dhṛṣṭatayeti || 4 || <9-2-5> upamānādīnāmapi parābhimatānām avinābhāvabalapravṛttikānāṃ laiṅgika evāntarbhāva iti pratipādayitumāha -- asyedamiti buddhyapekṣitatvāt || 5 || upamānārthāpattisambhavābhāvānāmiti śeṣaḥ| asya vyāpakasya idaṃ vyāpyamityākārā yā buddhiḥ sā janakatvenāpekṣitā yeṣāṃ te tadapekṣitāstasya bhāvastadapekṣitatvaṃ tasmādityarthaḥ| āhitāgnipāṭhāt ktāntena bahuvrīhiḥ, tārakādipāṭhādito vā || tatropamānaṃ tāvadanumānameva śabdadvārā| tathāhi gosadṛśo gavaya iti vākyantāvat āraṇyakena kīdṛk gavaya iti nāgarikajijñāsāyāmabhidhīyate tatra yo gosadṛśaḥ sa gavayaśabdavācya iti sāmānādhikaraṇyabalāt atideśavākyaśravaṇānantarameva paricchinatti, vanaṃ gatastu tādṛśa piṇḍamupalabhyāyamasau gavayaśabdavācya iti pratisandhatte| atideśavākyaśravaṇasamaye gavayatvaṃ pravṛttinimittaṃ na jñātamataḥ kathaṃ saṃjñāpariccheda iti cet lakṣaṇayā tatpratītisambhavāt| gosadṛśo gavaya iti vākye'nvayānupapattivirahāt kathaṃ lakṣaṇeti cet tātparyyānupapatteḥ sattvāt, na hi vyutpitsuṃ prati gosādṛśyasya sakhaṇḍasya pravṛttinimittatvenopadarśanamanucitaṃ tasmādakhaṇḍajātiviśeṣe tātparyamasyeti lakṣaṇāmambhavāt| yadvā gavayaśabdo gavayavācakaḥ asati vṛttyantare śiṣṭaistatra prayujyamānatvāt, asati vṛttyantare yaḥ śabdo yatra śiṣṭeḥ prayujyate sa tasya vācako yathā gośabdo gorityanumānādeva gavayasaṃjñāṃ paricchinatti| tarkaśca yastvayopamānasahakārī vācyaḥ sa varamanumāne klṛptapramāṇabhāve'stu kiṃ kalpanīyapramāṇabhāvenopamāneneti, anumānamayūkhe vistaro'trānveṣṭavyaḥ| arthāpattirapyanumānameva| tathāhi dṛṣṭāthaṣittistāvajjovataścaitrasya gṛhāsattvena dṛḍhatarapramāṇāvadhṛtena bahiḥsattvaṃ kalpayati| tatropapādyopapādakayorvyāpyavyāpakabhāvāvadhāraṇādhīnaiva bahiḥsattvapratītiḥ, bhavati hi jīvato gṛhīsattvaṃ bahiḥsattvena sahacaritaṃ, bahiḥsattvaṃ vinā jīvato gṛhāsattvamanupapannamiti vā jñānam| tatrādye'nvayavyāptirevāntye tu vyatirkavyāptereva graha iti| vyāptirasti na tasya grahaṇamihopayujyate iti cet vyāptigrahamantareṇārthāpattyābhāsānavakāśāt, svarūpasatyā vyāptyā vastuto yadupapādakaṃ tasyaiva kalpanā syāditi dik| saṃśayakaraṇikāyā virodhakaraṇikāyāścānumānāntarbhāva ūhanīyaḥ| virodhasyāpi sahānavasthānaniyamalakṣaṇasya vyāptighaṭitatvāt| śrutārthāpattirapyanumitānumānaṃ pīno devadatto divā na bhuṅkte ityanena vākyena pīnatvamanumitaṃ tena ca pīnatvena rātribhojanānumānam -- devadatto rātrau bhuṅkte divā'bhojitve sati pīnatvāsambhavāditi| sambhavo'pyanumānameva, tadudāharaṇaṃ hi -- sambhavati khāryyāṃ droṇaḥ sambhavati droṇe āḍhakam sambhavati sahasre śatamityādi tatreyaṃ khārī droṇavatī taddhaṭitatvāt yadyena ghaṭitaṃ tattena tadvat, yathā'vayavavān ghaṭaḥ| evamanyadapyūhyam| yattu sambhavati brāhmaṇe vidyā -- sambhavati kṣatriye śauryyamityādi, tatpramāṇameva na bhavati aniścāyakatvāt| abhāvo'pi na mānāntaraṃ kāryyeṇa kāraṇānumānavat kāryyābhāvena kāraṇābhāvānumānasya vyāptimūlakatvenānumāna evāntarbhavāt| bhaṭṭamate tu bhūtalādāvabhāvagrāhakaṃ pramāṇamanupalambhākhyam| yat kvacit pratyakṣe kvaciccānumāne'ntarbhūtaṃ cakṣurādinaivābhāvagrahāt| na cendriyamadhikaraṇagraha evopakṣīṇam, abhāvagrahaparyyantaṃ tadvyāpārasattvāt| aitihyamavijñātapravaktṛkaṃ pravādapāramparyyam| iti heti nipātasamudāyaḥ purāvṛtte varttate, tasya bhāva etihyam| tat yadi bādhitārthaṃ na bhavati tadā śabdāntarniveśādanumānam| yadiha vaṭe yakṣo madhūkatarau gaurītyādi, tad yadyāptoktaṃ tadā pūrvavat| nāptoktcettadā na pramāṇam| tadevaṃ pratyakṣamanumānañceti siddhaṃ dvayameva pramāṇamiti || 5 || <9-2-6> laiṅgikaṃ vyākhyāya idānīṃ prakaraṇāntaramārabhate -- ātmamanasoḥ saṃyogaviśeṣāt saṃskārācca smṛtiḥ || 6 || utpadyata iti śeṣaḥ| saṃyogaviśeṣaḥ praṇidhānādisannidhānam| etasmādasamavāyikāraṇādātmani samavāyini smṛtirvidyāviśeṣa utpadyate| nimittakāraṇamāha -- saṃskārāditi| cakāreṇa vyāpārī pūrvānubhavaḥ samuccīyate| anubhavayāthārthyāyāthārthyamiyamanuvidhatte, rajjuṃ bhujaṅgatayopalabhya palāyitasya tathaiva smṛteḥ| na ca satataṃ smṛtiprasaṅgaḥ, saṃskārod‌bodhādhīnatvāt taduktaṃ praśastadevapādaiḥ -- "liṅgadarśanecchānusmaraṇādyapekṣādātmamanasoḥ saṃyogaviśeṣāt paṭ‌vabhyāsādarapratyayajanitācca saṃskārād‌dṛṣṭa śrutānubhūteṣu śeṣānuvyavasāyasmaraṇecchādveṣaheturatītaviṣayā smṛtiḥ" iti| ārṣaṃ jñānaṃ sūtarkṛtā pṛthaṅ na lakṣitaṃ yogipratyāntarbhāvitam| padārthapradeśākhye tu prakaraṇe taduktaṃ tadyathā -- "āmnāyavidhātṝṇāmṛṣīṇāmatītānāgatavarttamāneṣvatīndriyeṣvartheṣu dharmādiṣu granthopanibaddheṣu liṅgādyanapekṣādātmamanasoḥ saṃyogāddharmaviśeṣācca prātibhaṃ jñānaṃ yadutpadyate tadārṣam" iti| tacca kadācillaukikānāmapi bhavati yathā `kanyakā vadati śvo me bhrātā''ganteti hṛdayaṃ me kathayatīti' || 6 || <9-2-7> tadevaṃ caturvidhāṃ vidyāṃ vyutpādya idānīmavidyāṃ vyutpādayitumarhati| tatra saṃśayaviparyyayau prasaṅgāt pūrvameva nirūpitau, svapnaṃ nirūpayitumāha -- tathā svapnaḥ || 7 || yathā''tmamanasoḥ saṃyogaviśeṣāt saṃskārācca smṛtistathā svapnajñānamapītyarthaḥ| uparatendriyagrāmasya pralīnamanaskasya indriṇdvāreṇa yadanubhavanaṃ mānasam, tat svapnajñānam| tacca trividham| kiñcit saṃskārapāṭavāt kāmī kruddho vā yamarthamādṛtaścintayan svapiti tasya tasyāmavasthāyāṃ pratyakṣākāraṃ jñānaṃ purāṇādiśravaṇajanitasaṃskāravaśājjāyate karṇārjunīyaṃ yuddhamidamityākāram| kiñciddhātūnāṃ vātapittaśleṣmaṇāṃ doṣāt| tatra vātadoṣādākāśagamanaḥ vasundharāparyyaṭanavyāgrādibhayapalāyanādīni paśyati| pittopacayadoṣamahimnā vahnipraveśavahnijvālāliṅganakanakaparvatavidyullatāvisphuraṇadigdāhādikaṃ paśyati| śleṣmadoṣaprābalyāttu samudrasantaraṇanadīmajjanadhārāsāravarṣaṇarajataparvatādi paśyati| adṛṣṭavaśādapi tajjanmānubhūteṣu janmāntarānubhūte vā siddhoplutāntaḥkaraṇasya yaj‌jñānamutpadyate, tatra śubhāvedakaṃ dharmāt gajārohaṇaparvatārohaṇachatralābhapāyasabhakṣaṇarājasandarśanādiviṣayakam| adharmāttu tailābhyañjanāndhakūpapatanoṣṭrārohaṇapaṅkamajjanasvavivāhadarśanādiviṣayakaṃ svapnajñānamutpadyate| trayāṇāṃ militānāmevātra kāraṇatvaṃ guṇapradhānabhāvamāśrityāyaṃ vibhāgo draṣṭavyaḥ || 7 || <9-2-8> nanu yaj‌jñānaṃ svapnamadhye svapnajñānānubhūtasyaivārthasya smṛtirūpaṃ jāyate tatra svapnatvaṃ na varttate svapnasyānubhavarūpatvāt tathā ca kasmāt kāraṇāttadutpattirityata āha -- svapnāntikam || 8 || tatheti pūrvasūtrādanuvarttate| tenātmamanasoḥ saṃyogaviśeṣāt saṃskārācca yathā svapnastathā svapnāntikamapītyarthaḥ| etāvāneva viśeṣo yat svapnajñānaṃ pūrvānubhavajanitāt saṃskarāt, svapnāntikantu tat‌kālotpannanubhavajanitasaṃskārādeva| taduktaṃ praśastadevācāryyaiḥ -- "atītajñānapratyavekṣaṇāt smṛtireva" iti| uktañca vṛttikāraiḥ -- "anubhūtavastusphuraṇārthatayā na smaraṇādarthāntaraṃ svapnajñānam" iti| svapnamadhye pramābhūtaṃ yaj‌jñānaṃ tat tvapnāntikamiti kecit| yathā śayyāyāṃ śayāno'smītyādi || 8 || <9-2-9> svapnasvapnāntikayoḥ kāraṇaṃ samuccinoti -- dharmācca || 9 || adharmasamuccayārthaścakāraḥ| kṛtavyākhyānametat || 9 || <9-2-10> idānīṃ paryyāyamadhikṛtyāha -- indriyadoṣāt saṃskāradoṣāccāvidyā || 10 || avidyeti sāmānyavācyapi padaṃ viparyyaye varttate prakaraṇāt saṃśayasvapnānadhyavasāyānāmuktatvāt| tatrendriyadoṣo vātapittādyabhibhavakṛtamapāṭavam| saṃskāradoṣo viśeṣādarśanasāhityaṃ tadadhīnaṃ hi mithyājñānaṃ jāyate || 10 || <9-2-11> avidyāsāmānyalakṣaṇamāha -- tadityavyayapadaṃ sarvanāmasamānārthakamavidyāṃ parāmūśati| sā'vidyā duṣṭajñānaṃ -- vyabhicārijñānamatasmiṃstaditi jñānaṃ -- vyadhikaraṇaprakārāvacchinnaṃ -- viśeṣyāvṛttiprakārakamiti yāvat| doṣaśca jñānasyāniścayarūpatvamapi| tenaikakoṭisattve'pi saṃśayo duṣṭa evānavadhāraṇātmakatvāt| tadanena saṃśayaviparyyayasvapnānadhyavasāyānāñcaturṇāmapyupagrahaḥ || 11 || <9-2-12> aduṣṭaṃ vidyā || 12 || jñānamityanuvarttate| aduṣṭamaduṣṭendriyajanyaṃ yatra yadasti tatra tadanubhavo vā samānādhikaraṇaprakārānubhavo vā viśeṣyāvṛttyaprakārakānubhavo vā vidyetyarthaḥ| taccādhyakṣaṃ laiṅgikañca dvayameva || 12 || <9-2-13> nanvārṣamapi jñānaṃ samānādhikaraṇaprakārakameva tacca nendriyajanyamasannikṛṣṭārthagocaratvāt| na laiṅgikaṃ liṅgānusandhānamantareṇa jāyamānatvāt| tathā caitatkaraṇaṃ tṛtīyaṃ pramāṇamāyātasata āha -- ārṣaṃ siddhadarśanañca dharmebhyaḥ || 13 || ṛṣīṇāṃ gālavaprabhṛtīnāṃ yadatītānāgataviṣayakaṃ jñānaṃ tadārṣam| yacca siddhānāṃ mantrauṣadhiguṭikāñjanādinā vyavahitaviprakṛṣṭārthagocarajñānaṃ pratisiddhigatānāṃ yaddarśanaṃ tadubhayaṃ dharmebhyo yathārthasākṣāt‌kāri jñānaṃ jāyate| tadyogipratyakṣe'ntaramiti vṛttikṛtaḥ| ārṣaṃ jñānaṃ caturthī vidyaiva, sā ca ṛṣīṇāṃ laukikānāñca bhavati| tacca mānasaṃ pratyakṣameva utprekṣāsahakṛtena manasā janitaṃ niyamasandarśanādiliṅgajanitaṃ vā| prāgbhavīyasaṃskārādhīnaivātra vyāptidhīḥ, stanapāneṣṭasādhanatāvyāptigrahavat| praśastācāryyāstu siddhadarśanaṃ na jñānāntaramityāhuḥ| tathā hi yadi siddhānāṃ guṭikāñjanādisiddhinimittaprabhavaṃ vyavahitaviprakṛṣṭaviṣayaṃ taducyate tadā pratyakṣameva| yadi tu divyāntarīkṣabhaumānāṃ grahanakṣatrasañcārādinimittādhīnaṃ tadā tallaiṅgikameva tathā sahacāradarśanena vyāptiparicchedāditi || 13 || iti śrīśāṅkare vaiśeṣikasūtropaskāre navamādhyāyasya dvitīyāmāhnikam| samāptaścāyaṃ navamo'dhyāyaḥ| <10> <10-1-1> ātmaguṇānāṃ kāraṇato bhedavyutpādanaṃ daśamādhyāyārthaḥ| tatra "ātmaśarīrendriyārthabuddhimanaḥpravṛttidoṣapretyabhāvaphaladuḥkhāpavargāstu prameyam" iti gautamīye prameyavibhāgasūtre sukhasyānabhidhānāt duḥkhābhinnameva sukhamiti bhramanirāsārthaṃ sukhaduḥkhayoreva prathamaṃ bhedamāha -- iṣṭāniṣṭakāraṇaviśeṣādvirodhācca mithaḥ sukhaduḥkhayorarthāntarabhāvaḥ || 1 || sukhaduḥkhayormithaḥ parasparamarthāntarabhāvo bhedo vaijātyamiti yāvat| kuta ityata āha -- iṣṭāniṣṭakāraṇaviśeṣāt iṣṭaṃ iṣyamāṇaṃ srak‌candanavinatādi aniṣṭamaniṣyamāṇamahikaṇṭikādi tadrūpaṃ yat kāraṇaṃ tasya viśeṣād‌bhedāt, kāraṇavaijātyādhīnaṃ kāryyavaijātyamāvaśyakaṃ yataḥ| bhedakāntaramāha -- virodhāt sahānavasthānalakṣaṇāt na hyekasminnātmanyekadā sukhaduḥkhayoranubhavaḥ| cakārādanayoḥ kāryyabhede bhedakaṃ samuccinoti| tathāhi -- anugrahābhiṣvaṅganayanaprasādādi sukhasya, dainyamukhamālinyādi duḥkhasya kāryyamiti tato'pyanayorbhedaḥ. taduktaṃ praśastācāryyaiḥ -- "anugrahalakṣaṇaṃ sukhaṃ sragādyabhipretaviṣayasānnidhye sati iṣṭotpannadhīndriyārthasannikarṣāddharmādyapekṣādātmanasoḥ saṃyogād yadanugrahābhiṣvaṅganayanādipramodajanakamutpadyate tat sukham" iti| tadidamatīteṣu srak‌candanādiṣu smṛtijamanāgateṣu saṅkalpajam| gautamīye sūtre su cāparigaṇanaṃ vairāgyāya sukhamapi duḥkhatvena bhāvayato vairāgyaṃ syādetadarthamiti || 1 || <10-1-2> nanvāstāṃ sukhadukhe parasparaṃ bhinne jñānādabhinne syātāṃ smṛtyanubhavavadityata āha -- saṃśayanirṇayāntarābhāvaśca jñānāntaratve hetuḥ || 2 || sukhaduḥkayorjñānāntaratve jñānabhinnatve saṃśayanirṇayābhyantaratvābhāvo heturliṅgamityarthaḥ| tadayamarthaḥ -- sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ vā jñānaṃ bhavat saṃśayarūpaṃ vā syāt nirṇayarūpaṃ vā? nādyaḥ koṭidvayānullekhitvāt| na dvitīyaḥ ekakoṭyanullekhitvāt| tathā ca yāvadviśeṣabādhāt sāmānyabādhaḥ| dvāveva hi jñānasya viśeṣau saṃśayatvaṃ nirṇayatvañca, tadubhayañca sukhe duḥkhe ca bādhitamiti jñānatvamapi tatra bādhitam| cakarādanubhāvabādhaṃ samuccinoti| sukhaduḥkhayorahaṃ sukhī duḥkhīti mānaso'nubhavo na tvahaṃ jāne sandehyi niścinomītyākāro'nubhava iti || 2 || <10-1-3> bhedakāntaramāha -- tayorniṣpattiḥ pratyakṣalaiṅgikābhyām || 3 || tayoḥ saṃśayanirṇayayorniṣpattirutpattiḥ pratyakṣālliṅgācca sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ vā na pratyakṣasāmagrījanyaṃ na vā liṅgajanyam| caturvidhaṃ hi sukhaṃ -- vaiṣayikaṃ mānorathikam ābhimānikamābhyāsikañca| tatra trayāṇāmandriyasannikarṣaprabhavatvaṃ nāstyeva| prathamamindriyārthasannikarṣajatvāt jñānaṃ syāditi cenna sāmagryekadeśasya kāryyasya sājātyānāpādakatvāt anyathā dik‌kālasādhāraṇyena sakalakāryyaikajātyāpatteḥ| kiñca indriyārthasannikarṣādutpadyamānaṃ sukhaṃ nirvikalpakaṃ vā syāt savikalpakaṃ vā? nādyaḥ atīndriyatvaprasaṅgāt| na dvitīyaḥ viśeṣyaviśeṣaṇabhāvena dvayoranā kalanarūpatvāt| kiñca sukhaduḥkhayoravaśyasaṃvedyatvāt jñānasyāvaśyasaṃvedyatve'navasthāprasaṅgāt| laiṅgikamiti liṅgameva vaiṣayikavat| vṛttikṛtastu tayorjñānasukhayorniṣpattiḥ pratyakṣalaiṅgikābhyāṃ pratyakṣalaiṅgikajñānavyākhyānābhyāṃ vyākhyātā| pratyakṣaṃ jñānamindriyajam, laiṅgikantu liṅgajam, sukhādikantu naitādṛśamiti vyācakruḥ || 3 || <10-1-4> laiṅgikajñānāt sukhādeḥ prakārabhedādhīnaṃ bhedamāha -- abhūdityapi || 4 || itiśabdaḥ prakāre| apiśabdo bhaviṣyatītyākārāntarasamuccaye| tathā ca parvate vahnirabhūdbhaviṣyati veti laiṅgike jñāne'tītādiḥ prakāro dṛśyate, na caivaṃprakāraṃ sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ votpadyamānamupalabdham || 4 || <10-1-5> bhedakāntaraṃ samuccinoti -- sati ca kāryyādarśanāt || 5 || sati indriyārthasannikarṣe sati ca vyāptipakṣadharmatādipratisandhāne kāryyasya sukhasya duḥkhasya vā'darśanāt na pratyakṣamātraṃ sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ vā, na laiṅgikamātraṃ vā| tadayamarthaḥ -- jñānasāmānyaṃ tāvat sukhaduḥkhe na bhavata ityuktam| jñānaviśeṣaḥ pratyakṣajñānaṃ vā bhavedanumitirūpaṃ vā? indriyārthasannikarṣe srakacandanādipratyakṣe sukhatvānubhavābhāvāt| na dvitīyaḥ, candanādyanumitau banhyādyanumitau vā sukhatvaduḥkhayorananubhavānna tadviśeṣo'pīti || 5 || <10-1-6> bhedakāntaramāha -- ekārthasamavāyikāraṇāntareṣu dṛṣṭatvāt || 6 || sukhaduḥkhayoriti śeṣaḥ| śukhaṃ prati ekārthasamavetāni asādhāraṇakāraṇānidharmaḥ sukhe rāgaḥ sukhakāraṇecchā tadupādānayatnaḥ srak‌candanādijñānam| duḥkhaṃ prati tu -- adharmaḥ aniṣṭakaṇṭakādijñānam, eṣu ekārthasamavāyiṣu kāraṇeṣu dṛṣṭatvādityarthaḥ| jñānantunirvikalpakamekārthasamavetamasādhāraṇakāraṇaṃ nāpekṣata eva| savikalpakantvapekṣate viśeṣaṇajñānaṃ tattu kāraṇāntaraṃ svavijātīyakāraṇaṃ na bhavati, manaḥsaṃyogastu sādhāraṇatvādavivakṣitaḥ| yadyapi smṛtiḥ saṃskāramasādhāraṇamapekṣate tathāpi tadbhedāsphuṭasiddha evetyanubhavamādāya bhedacintanāt| laiṅgike yadyapi vyāptismṛtipakṣadharmatādijñānāpekṣā tathāpyantaraśabdenaiva tad‌vyudāsaḥ| tadayaṃ pramāṇārthaḥ sukhaduḥkhe anubhavabhinne svasamānādhikaraṇasvajātīyāsādhāraṇakāraṇajanyatvāt smṛtivadādyaśabdavacca || 6 || <10-1-7> nanu yadi kāraṇabhedādhīno jñānāt sukhaduḥkhayoḥ sukhācca duḥkhasya stambhakumbhādivadeva parasparaṃ bhedaḥ, syāt, tatra hi paramāṇudvyaṇukādīnāṃ lohitaretasorvā kāraṇānāmaviśeṣādityata āha -- ekadeśe ityekasmin śiraḥ pṛṣṭhamudaraṃ marmāṇi tadviśeṣebhyaḥ || 7 || ekadeśa iti| avayave ityarthaḥ| ekasminniti śarīre ityarthaḥ| śira ityekadeśaḥ udaraṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ marmāṇi ca snāyuprabhṛtīni teṣāṃ viśeṣo vaijyātyam, tadviśeṣebhya stat‌kāraṇaviśeṣebhyaḥ| tatrāvi kāraṇavaijātyādeva vaijātyam, na hi yajjātīyaṃ śiraḥsamavāyikāraṇaṃ tajjātīyamevodarapṛṣṭhāderapi, tantukapālād‌yupādānavaijātyāt paṭaghaṭādau vaijātyavat tatrāpi vaijātyasambhavāt| tantukapālāderapi aṃśuśarkarādivaijātyāt| evaṃ tatra tatrāpyanveṣṭavyam| paramāṇanāṃ sādhāraṇye'pi tvatvīpādānavaijātyasya sarvatra vaijātyaprayojakatvāt| dravyatvena tūpādānasājātyaṃ na vaijātyaprayojakamiti dik || 7 || iti śrīśāṅkare vaiśeṣikasūtropaskāre daśamādhyāyasya prathamamāhnikam|| daśāmādhyāye dvitīyāhnikam <10-2-1> idānīṃ prasaṅgatasvayāṇāṃ kāraṇānāṃ viśeṣavivecanamārabhate -- kāraṇamiti dravye kāryyasamavāyāt || 1 || kāraṇa samavāyikāraṇamidamiti pratītiprayogau dravye draṣṭavyau| kuta evamata āha -- kāryyasamavāyāt| kāryāṇi dravyaguṇakarmāṇi tatraiva samaveyanti yataḥ || 1 || <10-2-2> tat kiṃ samavāyikāraṇatvamātraṃ dravyāṇāmata āha -- saṃyogādvā || 2 || paṭotpattau tantūnāṃ samavāyikāraṇatvavat nimittakāraṇatvavat nimittakāraṇatvamapi turītantusaṃyogasyāpi paṭakāraṇatvāt, tat‌saṃyogadvārā turyyāstantośca paṭanimittakāraṇatvamapi| vākāraḥ samuccaye| turītantusaṃyogaṃ prati tantoḥ samavāyikāraṇatve'pi paṭaṃ prati tad‌dvārā nimittakāraṇatvāt || 2 || <10-2-3> karmaṇi yādṛśakāraṇatvaṃ tadāha -- kāraṇe samavāyāt karmāṇi || 3 || asamavāyikāraṇānīti śeṣaḥ| asamavāyikāraṇatvañca kāryakāraṇabhāvasambandhyekāryasamavetakāraṇatvam| taca kāryaikārthasamavāyāt kāraṇaikārthasamavāyādvā| tatrādyā ladhvī dvitīyā mahatītivairoṣikaparibhāṣā| tatra kayā pratyāsattyā saṃyogavibhāgasaṃskārān prati karmaṇāmasamavāyikāraṇatvamityata āha -- kāraṇe samavāyāt| kāraṇe saṃyogādisamavāyikāraṇe samavāyāt, tathāca kāryaikāryasamavāyalakṣaṇayā ladhvyā pratyāsattyā saṃyogādau karmaṇo'samavāyikāraṇatvamityarthaḥ || 3 || <10-2-4> rūpādīnāṃ guṇānāmavayavavarttināmavayaviguṇādiṣu kīdṛśī kāraṇatetyapekṣāyāmāha -- tathā rūpe kāraṇaikārthasamavāyācca || 4 || rūpa iti| rūparasagandhasparśasaṅkhyāparimāṇapṛthak‌tvagurutvasnehādyupalakṣayati| tathetyasamavāyikāraṇatvamatidiśati| kāraṇaikārthasamavāyāditi| avayavirūpādīnāṃ samavāyikāraṇaṃ yadavayavi tena sahaikārthasamavāyena mahatyā pratyāsattyā'vayavirūpādikamārabhate, tad yathā kapālarūpādi ghaṭe rūpādikamārabhate iti sarvatradraṣṭavyam| cakārādamīṣāṃ kvacinnimittatvamapi samuccinoti || 4 || <10-2-5> dravyārambhe saṃyogasyāsamavāyikāraṇasya ladhvīṃ pratyāsattimāha -- kāraṇasamavāyāt saṃyogaḥ paṭasya || 5 || kāraṇe samavāyikāraṇe samavāyāt saṃyogo'pi paṭādau kāryye kāryyaikārthasamavāyalakṣaṇayā pratyāsattyā'samavāyikāraṇamityarthaḥ| paṭapadena kāryyadravyakāraṇaikārthasamavāyo'pīti kaścit || 5 || <10-2-6> saṃyogasya kvacit mahatyā pratyāsattyā kāraṇatvamityāha -- kāraṇakāraṇasamavāyācca || 6 || tūlapiṇḍāvayave varttamānaḥ pracayākhyaḥ saṃyogastūlakapiṇḍe mahattvamārabhate tatra kāraṇaikārthasamavāyaḥ pratyāsattirityarthaḥ || 6 || <10-2-7> evaṃ samavāyinirūpitāṃ kāraṇatāṃ nirūpya nimittakāraṇatāṃ nirūpayituṃ prakaraṇāntaramārabhate -- saṃyuktasamavāyādagnervaiśeṣikam || 7 || agnervaiśeṣikaṃ viśeṣaguṇamauṣṇyaṃ saṃyuktasamavāyāt pākajeṣu nimittakāraṇam| upalakṣaṇañcaitat jñānaṃ pratisarveṣāṃ nimittakāraṇatvaṃ, buddhisukhaduḥkhecchādveṣaprayatnadharmādharmabhāvanānāṃ nimittakāraṇatvameva| sukhādīnāṃ bedapratipādanāya prapañco'yaṃdraṣṭavyaḥ || 7 || <10-2-8> idānīmāmnāyaprāmāṇyaṃ draḍhayitumuktamevārthamāha -- dṛṣṭānāṃ dṛṣṭaprayojanānāṃ dṛṣṭābhāve prayogo'bhyudayāya || 8 || dṛṣṭānāṃ pramāṇata upalabdhānāṃ karmaṇāṃ yāgadānasnānādīnāṃ, dṛṣṭaprayojanānāṃ dṛṣṭamupadiṣṭaṃ prayojanaṃ yeṣāṃ, tathāhi "svargakāmo yajeta" "agnihotraṃ juhuyāt svargakāmaḥ" ityādau vidhisamabhivyāhṛtameva phalam, kvacidārthavādikaṃ yathā "ya etā rātrīradhīyīta tasya pitaro, ghutakulyā madhukulyāḥ kṣaranti" ityādau, kvaciccaupādānikam yathā "viśvajitā yajeta" ityādau, atra hi na vidhisamabhivyāhṛtaṃ nārthavādorasthitamityaupādānikaṃ -- kālpanikaṃ svargasyaiva tvataḥsundarasya phalasya kalpanīyatvāt, tathā cāśutaravināśitāmeteṣāṃ karmaṇāṃ cirabhāvine phalāya kāraṇatvamanupapadyamānamata eveṣāṃ prayogo'nuṣṭhānamabhyudayāyāpūrvāyetyarthaḥ| nanu śrutuprāmāṇye sati syādevaṃ tadeva tu durlabham, na hi mīmāṃsakānāmiva nityanirdoṣatvena śrutiprāmāṇyaṃ tvayeṣyate, gairuṣeyatvenābhyupagamāt, puruṣasya ca bhramapramādavipralipsādisambhavādat āha -- dṛṣṭābhāva iti| dṛṣṭaṃ puruṣāntare'smadādau, bhramapramādavipralipsādikaṃ puruṣadūṣaṇaṃ tadabhāve satītyarthaḥ| kṣitikartṛtvena vedavaktṛtvena vā'numitasya puruṣadhaureyasya nirdoṣatvenaivopasthiteḥ| tatāca tadvacasāṃ na nirabhidheyatā na viparītābhidheyatā na niṣprayojanābhidheyatā, bhūtendriyamanasāṃ doṣāt bhramapramādakaraṇāpāṭavādiprayuktā eva vacanasāmaviśuddhayaḥ sambhāvyante. na ceśvaravacasi tāsāṃ sambhavaḥ, taduktam rāgājñānādibhirvaktā grastatvādanṛtaṃ vadet| te ceśvare na vidyante sa brūyāt kathamanyathā || iti || 8 || <10-2-9> nanu teneśvareṇa vedaḥ praṇīta ityatraiva vipratipattirata āha -- tadvacanādāmnāyasya prāmāṇyamiti || 9 || iti śāstraparisamāptau| tadvacanātteneśvareṇa vacanāt praṇayanādāmnāyasya vedasya prāmāṇyam| tathāhi vedāstāvat pauruṣeyā vākyatvaditi sādhitaṃ na cāsmadādayasteṣāṃ sahasraśākhāvacchinnānāṃ vaktāraḥ sambhāvyante, atīndriyārthatvāt, na cātindriyārthadarśino'smadādayaḥ| kiñcāptoktā vedā mahājanaparigṛhītatvāt, yannāptoktaṃ na tanmahājanaparigṛhītaṃ mahājanaparigṛhītañceda tasmādāptoktam| svatantrapuruṣapraṇītatvañcāptoktatvam| mahājanaparigṛhītatvañca sarvadarśaṃnāntaḥpātipuruṣānuṣṭhīyamānārthatvām| kvacit phalābhāvaḥ karmakartṛsādhanaveguṇyādityuktam| kartṛsmaraṇābhāvānnaivamiti cenna, kartṛsmaraṇasya pūrvameva sādhitatvāt| tat‌praṇītatvañca svatantrapuruṣapraṇītatvādeva siddham, na tvasmadādīnā sahasrasākhavedapraṇayane svātantryaṃ sambhavatītyuktatvāt| kiñca pramāyā guṇajanyatvena vaidikapramāyā api guṇajanyatvamāvaśyakam| tatra ca guṇo vaktṛyathārthavākyārthajñānamava vācyaḥ, tathā ca tādṛśa eva vede vaktā, yaḥ svargāpūrvādiviṣaḥ yakasākṣāt‌kāravāt, tādṛśaśca neśvarānya iti suṣṭhu || 9 || akṛta bhavānītanayo bhavanāthasuto bhavārcane nirataḥ| pataṃ kaṇādasūtropaskāraṃ śaṅkaraḥ śrīmān|| ślāghāspadaṃ yadyapi netareṣāmiyaṃ kṛtisyādupahāsayogyā| tathāpi śiṣyairgurugauraveṇa parassahasraiḥ samupāsanīyā|| iti śrīśāṅkare vaiśeṣikasūtropaskāre daśamādhyāyasya dvitīyamāhnikam| samāptaścāyaṃ daśamādhyāyaḥ| samāptañcedaṃ śāstram|
